citlali-escoffier-furina-skirk.desc: [2N2D N3W] Skirk Furina Citlali Escoffier. ~21s rot. Skirk : tE 2N2D N2Q 2(2N2D N3W) N2CD N2D N3W 2N2D N2 (first rotation does a slightly different combo). Freeze immunity (assuming 4pc MH) loses ~4.5K (~3%) DPS. Worst-case DPS (MH + unfreezable) is ~145K.

escoffier-furina-skirk-yelan.desc: [N5D] Skirk Furina Yelan Escoffier. 21s rot. tE N2Q 3[N5D] N2CD N5D N2. First rot Nuke included, 4k loss otherwise. Freeze Immunity loses 10k(~7.5%) DPS.

escoffier-furina-mualani-skirk.desc: [N5D] Skirk Furina Mualani Escoffier. 21s rot. tE N2Q 3[N5D] N2CD N5D N2. First rot Nuke included, 6k loss otherwise. Freeze Immunity loses 6k(~4%) DPS. Do note that Mualani's Scroll proc can be inconsistent due to Furina RNG app removing underlying Cryo.

escoffier-furina-neuvillette-skirk.desc: Neuv Furina Skirk Escoffier. 4CA 30s rot. Skirk hE Q twice, Escoffier 1E1Q and Furina 1Q per rot. Finale R5 isn't full uptime due to Esco Q used only once to clear the BoL.

bennett-chongyun-citlali-mavuika.desc: Mavuika Citlali Chongyun Bennett. 16s rot. Chongyun E > Mavuika E > Bennett EQ > Citlali EQ N1 > Mavuika Q (wait) 4[C2D] C. Here, Chongyun provides Cryo app from his A4 and Cryo Resonance. the last CA should be a little bit delayed to be melted.

chevreuse-mavuika-ororon-varesa.desc: Mavuika Varesa Ororon Chev. ~19s rot. Dual Carry. Mavuika tE Q 3[C2D] C1D. Varesa 4 Plunge Combos (+2 in opening rotation). ayaka-bennett-citlali-mavuika.desc: Mavuika Citlali Ayaka Bennett. ~20s rot. Ayaka Q every rotation. Mavuika combo: Q 3(CDN) (C2FD) 2(C2D). Instructor Ayaka is ~700 DPS loss due to high ER requirements but it's an ~8% Mavuika personal DPS increase so it is recommended in practice if ER can be met.

escoffier-shenhe-skirk-yelan.desc: [N5D] Skirk Yelan Shenhe Escoffier. 21s rot. tE N2Q 3[N5D] N2CD N5D N2. First rot Nuke is not included, it was 4k loss. Freeze Immunity loses 3k(~3%) DPS.

bennett-chevreuse-mavuika-ororon.desc: Mavuika Ororon Chev Bennett. 18s rot. Mav Q 7[C2D]. DPS build Chev. EM build Ororon, Not having Chev C6 is ~12k(12%) DPS Loss. While Ororon C6 is ~6.5k(6%)

bennett-citlali-freminet-xianyun.desc: Freminet Citlali Bennett Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Freminet Melt Plunge. Very precise combo. bennett-mavuika-xilonen-xingqiu.desc: Mavuika Bennett Xilonen Xingqiu. Mavuika vape relying on Xingqiu's orbitals for hydro application. Sac Sword Xingqiu enables 18s rotations. citlali-escoffier-furina-neuvillette.desc: Neuvillette Furina Citlali Escoffier. 4CA 24s rotation. Citlali doesn't burst. KQMS Stats.

ayaka-escoffier-furina-yelan.desc: Ayaka Furina Yelan Escoffier. Yelan 2E 21s rot. freeze_resist=1 loses 5k(5%) team DPS.

furina-kazuha-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Xilonen. 4CA 28s rotation. Both Xilonen and Kazuha using Q every rot, 2Es per rot.

mualani-sucrose-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Mualani Vape. Mualani, Xiangling and Sucrose burst every other Mualani skill, Xilonen never bursts. When Mualani bursts, she skips her third NA. Xiangling's C4 ruins this rotation. Assumes Mualani's burst hits almost instantly.

mavuika-mualani-xilonen-zhongli.desc: Mualani Zhongli Mavuika Xilonen. ~16s rot. Alernate between 3[3-stacked bite] and 1[3-stacked bite] Q 1[3-stacked bite]. Mualani, Mavuika and Xilonen Q every other rotation. Zhongli's pillar prevents Mavuika from Vaping her Q after the first rotation.

bennett-citlali-mavuika-neuvillette.desc: Mavuika Citlali Bennett Neuvillette. 18s~ rotation. Ins + Fav Neuvi acting as a cheerleader.

arlecchino-bennett-citlali-sucrose.desc: Arle Citlali Sucrose Bennett. 16-17s rot. No Arle Q. CA dash cancel, NA spam. Due to short rot length and high ER needs, Citlali couldn't hold TTDS.

charlotte-furina-skirk-yelan.desc: [N5D] Skirk Furina Yelan Charlotte. 21s rot. tE N2Q 3[N5D] N2CD N5D N2. First rot Nuke included, 2.5k loss otherwise. Freeze Immunity loses 7.5k(~8%) DPS.

bennett-furina-mavuika-ororon.desc: Mavuika Furina Ororon Bennett. 20s rot. Mavuika Q 7[C2D]. Ororon tries Pyro Scroll. Mavuika benefits from Overvape.

bennett-chevreuse-ororon-varesa.desc: Varesa Ororon Bennett Chevreuse. ~17s rot. 5 Plunge Combos. Opening rotation's setup is slightly different. Bennett uses his E after 3 Plunge Combos to refresh Chevreuse's RES Shred. Chevreuse is on a healing build. 100% Collisions.

chasca-escoffier-furina-mavuika.desc: Chasca Escoffier Furina Mavuika. ~32s rot. Very tight Chasca combo EQ 4[CA]. All units skip their Bursts on 1st part of the rotation and cast them during the second part. Wait at the end for Chasca's CA to land.

charlotte-furina-shenhe-skirk.desc: [N5D] Skirk Furina Shenhe Charlotte. 21s rot. tE N2Q 3[N5D] N2CD N5D N2. First rot Nuke included, 3k loss otherwise. Freeze Immunity loses 3.5k(~4%) DPS.

citlali-skirk-xingqiu-yelan.desc: [N5D] Skirk Yelan Xingqiu Citlali. 21s rot. tE N2Q 3[N5D] N2CD N5D N2. First rot Nuke included, 0.5k loss otherwise. Freeze Immunity loses 7k(~7.5%) DPS.

chevreuse-fischl-mavuika-varesa.desc: Varesa Fischl Mavuika Chevreuse. ~18s rot. 6 Plunge Combos (+1 in opening rotation). Opening rotation is extended by starting with 1 extra Plunge Combo. Chevreuse is on a healing build. 100% Collisions. Rotation: (Varesa 1 Plunge Combo) > Chevreuse Q/N1 hE > Fischl N1 E N1 / N2 Q > Mavuika Q C ED > Varesa 6 Plunge Combos.

chevreuse-citlali-escoffier-gaming.desc: Gaming Citlali Escoffier Chevreuse. ~19s Rot. Gaming Melt Plunge free from circles. 7/7 Plunges melted. Gaming juggles Man Chai, using burst into skill + plunge and waiting on the ground before catching Man Chai mid descent. Escoffier uses burst every other rotation past the first.

bennett-citlali-dehya-mavuika.desc: Mavuika Bennett Citlali 0 field time Dehya, ~18s rotation. fav on citlali to meet er requirements

arlecchino-bennett-citlali-kaeya.desc: Arlecchino Citlali Kaeya Bennett. ~16s Rot. Arlecchino Double Cryo Melt with N1C 5N3D N1. Citlali before Kaeya for Keaya burst uptime. No Arlecchino CA cancel needed.

arlecchino-bennett-citlali-layla.desc: Arlecchino Bennett Citlali Layla. Arlecchino does N14 (NA spam) combo. ~17s rot length.

chevreuse-furina-gaming-xianyun.desc: vape gaming without circle impact. chev provide her c6 buff, pyro energy, and pyro application for easy and consistent vv setup. sodp and noblesse are close for chev.

fischl-nahida-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Fischl Xingqiu Nahida

chevreuse-clorinde-fischl-mavuika.desc: OL Clorinde w/ Fischl, Mavuika Chevreuse. 16s rotations. Mavuika uses her Burst every other rotation. Weaves NA where possible to fill rotation time, maximize Fischl C6 and stack FS.

candace-mavuika-mualani-xilonen.desc: Mualani Candace (C5-) Xilonen Mavuika. ~16s rot with Mavuika Burst every other rotation. Candace casts her Burst at the start of every rotation. 4AP on Mavuika is a good increase over Codex. You lose ~6k w/o 4AP. Candace's C6 is a huge ~35k DPS loss.

furina-mika-skirk-yelan.desc: [N5D] Skirk Furina Yelan Mika. 21s rot. tE N2Q 3[N5D] N2CD N5D N4. Mika's Attack SPD helps fits 2 extra NAs. First rot Nuke included, ~2.5k loss otherwise. Freeze Immunity loses ~8.8k(~9.5%) DPS.

furina-mavuika-sucrose-xilonen.desc: Mavuika team without Bennett and Cryo. 1 Rot. Attack sands due Sucrose EM boost. Xilonen only Pyro scroll due only 1 Rotation made. Scales better then Bennett's team with C2 R1 Mavuika

citlali-mavuika-sucrose-xilonen.desc: Mavuika Citlali Xilonen Sucrose. 18s rot. Mavuika 2[C3FD] combo. Sucrose is great Bennett alternative when he isn't available.

charlotte-citlali-furina-skirk.desc: [N5D] Skirk Furina Citlali Charlotte. 20s rot. tE N2Q 3[N5D] N2CD N5D N2. First rot Nuke included, 4k loss otherwise. Freeze Immunity loses 3k(~3.5%) DPS. Full uptime Eshu R5 is ~6.5k more

citlali-mavuika-xilonen-zhongli.desc: Mavuika Citlali Xilonen Zhongli. 18s rot. Mavuika 2[C3FD] combo. No fav needed so ZL given damage weapon.

bennett-kazuha-mavuika-xilonen.desc: Mavuika Bennett Kazuha Xilonen. Mono Pyro Mavuika with 5[C2D] combo. NO Bennett is -3k DPS. Bennett catches Mavuika's Pyro particles despite Xilonen used in-between (even if he doesn't in-game, you don't need a lot more ER on him than what the sim is suggesting).

kazuha-neuvillette-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Neuvillette Vape with Xiangling Petra. 4CA Per Rotation

arlecchino-bennett-chevreuse-yaemiko.desc: Arle Overload with Yae. 16-17s rotation. No Arle Q, No Yae Q, 2N2C 4N3D N3. KQMS stats.

furina-navia-xilonen-yelan.desc: Navia double hydro. 2 Xilonen and Yelan skills. 22s rotation. No Archaic Petra Navia isn't good.

bennett-chasca-furina-mavuika.desc: Chasca Furina Mavuika Bennett. 33s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Alternating Furina Q and Mavuika Q for shorter rot length. You need to be really good at playing this rotation, otherwise Mavuika won't get the last Bennett Q tick, losing huge DPS from her vaped Q. Chasca prefers Pyro% Goblet by 1k(~1%).

bennett-chiori-mavuika-xilonen.desc: Mavuika Bennett Xilonen Chiori. 17-18s rot. Mavuika Double Geo. First rot Mavuika combo: 6(2Cd) with last 2C not buffed by burst. Second+ rot Mavuika combo: 5(C2d) CEd with last C not buffed by burst. Xilonen does not burst during the first rotation. Mavuika does a Pyro-infused charge attack before bursting during the second rotation onwards to fill time. 4pc Petra Chiori is +4.3k DPS if Bennett doesn't dash to pick up a Crystallize shard.

albedo-citlali-mavuika-xilonen.desc: Mavuika Citlali Xilonen Albedo. 18s rot. Mavuika 2[C3FD] combo. Albedo burst is very slightly optimal for EM on Mavuika. Albedo ER and DEF% sands are interchangeable when balancing with substats.

bennett-candace-mavuika-xilonen.desc: Mav Vape with C6 Candace. Using Mav's CDN1 combo allows Candace's Overflow to maintain hydro aura for 6 Vaped Burst CAs. Candace must catch her own particles.

bennett-mavuika-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Mavuika Bennett Neuvillette Xilonen - Neuvi is just there to hold instructor, TTDS, and apply hydro for Mavuika's Q and first CA. Mavuika does unreacted CAs to fill downtime. 18s rotation.

furina-neuvillette-sucrose-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Sucrose Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Sucrose provides 20% Hydro DMG Bonus with her C6 on the first half.

furina-hutao-xilonen-yelan.desc: Hu Tao C0 Vape, 2 Yelan E and 2 Xilonen E per rotation. Focused on the Hydro DPS. Hutao Start HP=60%.

bennett-gaming-rosaria-xilonen.desc: Gaming melt. 20s rotation. 6 Melted plunges. Bennett funnels E to Gaming. ▶The last rotation skips ~3s of funneling actions to display higher DPS◀

clorinde-fischl-kirara-sucrose.desc: Aggravate Clorinde (TF) w/ Fischl, Sucrose and Kirara. ~25s rotation. Sucrose uses her burst when available.

lanyan-mavuika-mualani-xilonen.desc: Mualani Lan Yan Mavuika Xilonen. ~16s rot. Alernate between 3[3-stacked bite] and Q 2[3-stacked bite]. Mualani, Mavuika and Lan Yan Q every other rotation. Mavuika Vapes her Q.

luminepyro-mualani-sucrose-xilonen.desc: ⚠️ Mualani Sucrose Xilonen PMC. ~13-14s rot. 3 rotations only to display higher DPS. Mualani does 3[3-stacked bite] and Q 2[3-stacked bite] when her Q is ready. Alternate between doing Sucrose Q + PMC Q and doing PMC tE for Pyro application. ▶11 Frame delay. 0 Frame travel time on Mualani Burst to avoid buffs expiring, default setting is ~5.5k less DPS◀

nahida-neuvillette-xiangling-xilonen.desc: neuvi burnvape with xilo+nahida. pretty consistent to get hydro back at the end of rotation for xilonen refresh. No xilonen bursting

bennett-furina-kinich-mavuika.desc: Kinich Furina Mavuika Bennett. 20s rotation. Mavuika E and Q is split to battery Bennett and maximize Mavuika Q vapes. Kinich does not Burst. Without seeking blindspots, 4 cannon shots with short holds consistently, nearly always 3 without.

chiori-mavuika-mualani-xilonen.desc: Mualani Mavuika Xilonen Chiori. 18s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. Mualani N1 > Mavuika Q (vape) C2D ED > Xilonen E N2 > Chiori 2[E] > Mualani E combo. Mualani or Chiori Q at the end. Xilonen Q healng instead of Chiori Q loses 5k DPS, becoming 85k DPS. Xilonen can use either 4Instructor or 4Scroll. Try to pick up the shard consistently to benefit from Geo Resonance's DMG%/Geo RES Shred.

arlecchino-bennett-fischl-yelan.desc: Arlecchino Overload + Vaporize. 18s rotation. N1C + 5N3C combo. 1 Bennett and Yelan E.

emilie-kinich-mavuika-ororon.desc: Kinich Emilie Mavuika Ororon. 18-20s rotation. Kinich and Emilie use their Bursts every other rotation. While seeking blindspots, mostly cosistent 4 cannon shots with short holds, consistent 3 cannons without (-7K DPS). Mavuika does some Charged Attacks after her Burst.

bennett-chevreuse-lyney-xilonen.desc: Lyney Mono pyro 16s rotation. Chevreuse used for her c6 only. AP chev is approx 5kdps higher than SODP

bennett-freminet-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Freminet Rosaria Bennett Xianyun. ~19s Rot. Freminet Melt Plunge. Hyperoptimized by using 2 Freminet Skills to melt 2 extra Plunges for a total of 8 melted Plunges, very tight margin to achieve this. ER needs makes Favonius Bennett a must. LNO is a 12% upgrade over CW and SR. 50% Collisions. ▶The last rotation skips ~1-2s of funneling time to display higher DPS◀

bennett-furina-lyney-sucrose.desc: Lyney vape with Sucrose. Sucrose burst every other rotation for more consistent hydro app. Sucrose only gets pyro VV

bennett-gaming-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Gaming melt. ~20-21s rotation. 6 Melted plunges. Bennett funnels E to Gaming. VV lasts 3 plunges only. ▶The last rotation skips ~3s of funneling actions to display higher DPS◀

bennett-citlali-gaming-sucrose.desc: Gaming Citlali Sucrose Bennett. ~19s Rot. Gaming Melt Plunge with 7 plunges, 6 melted, 5 buffed by Bennett/TTDS, 4 with VV. Gaming juggles Man Chai, using burst into skill + plunge and waiting on the ground before catching Man Chai mid descent. The final plunge is not melted, but is delayed for Gaming's particle ICD. Sucrose swirls Pyro in Bennett Q. Option for 7 melt plunges in config.

bennett-chevreuse-lyney-raiden.desc: Lyney Chevreuse Raiden Bennett. ~15s Rot. Lyney without interrupt resist. On the last rot, Lyney ends with aim, aim, skill instead of aim, skill, aim so that all of his Hat damage happens, instead of the last Hat damage disappearing due to the sim ending.

furina-xilonen-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Mono hydro on field Yelan. 2 Yelan skill 2 Xilonen skills. AP Xingqiu is a big difference, +6K > ND.

mavuika-mualani-nahida-yelan.desc: Mualani burn vape 20s otation. Mualani Burst every other rotation. Timings can be sensitive to 100% consistently vape Mualani's damage. Nahida can use Pamber with no damage loss or energy issues.

arlecchino-bennett-citlali-kazuha.desc: Arle Citlali Kazuha Bennett. 16-17s rot. No Arle Q. CA dash cancel, NA spam. Due to short rot length and high ER needs, Citlali couldn't hold TTDS.

escoffier-furina-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Escoffier Xilonen. 4CA 25s rot. Escoffier EQ before Furina Q.

faruzan-furina-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Faruzan Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Faruzan wanted to join the party. Don't ask what she does here.

bennett-furina-gaming-xilonen.desc: Gaming vape. 20s rotation. 2 Bennett skill rotation. 9 Gaming skill plunges with delays.  1E Xilonen. AP Bennett can be a small dps increase with rotation change.

bennett-chevreuse-kuki-lyney.desc: Lyney Overload with Kuki. 15s rotation. Kuki's C4 is ~1.5% DPS loss due to the extra Electro application disabling Lyney's A4 Passive. Lyney does 4 or 5 CAs depending on Burst availability.

chevreuse-citlali-diona-gaming.desc: Gaming Citlali Bennett Xilonen. ~20s Rot. Gaming Melt Plunge with 7/7 Plunges melted. Gaming juggles Man Chai, using burst into skill + plunge and waiting on the ground before catching Man Chai mid descent. Citlali refreshes Cryo with NA for the final Melt plunge. Give up on Instructors Diona. Chev and Diona C6 are worth ~10K each.

bennett-chevreuse-sara-varesa.desc: Varesa Sara Bennett Chevreuse. 17s rot. 5 Plunge Combos (+1 in opening rotation). Opening rotation starts with 1 extra Plunge Combo. Bennett uses his E after 3 Plunge Combos to refresh Chevreuse's RES Shred. Chevreuse is on a healing build, skips her Q outside of the opening rotation and casts her abilities before Bennett. EoSF on Sara with Scroll on Chevreuse is ~2.5k less DPS. 100% Collisions.

bennett-citlali-gaming-xilonen.desc: Gaming Citlali Bennett Xilonen. ~19s Rot. Gaming Melt Plunge with 7 plunges, 6 melted. Gaming juggles Man Chai, using burst into skill + plunge and waiting on the ground before catching Man Chai mid descent. The final plunge 2 plunges aren't Bennett buffed, the final plunge is not melted, but is delayed for Gaming's particle ICD. Option for 6 buffed/7 melted plunged included.

chasca-citlali-escoffier-mavuika.desc: Chasca Citlali Escoffier Mavuika. ~19s rot. Very tight Chasca combo EQ 4[CA]. Wait at the end for Chasca's CA to land. GT Escoffier is ~2k less DPS compared to TotM. NO Citlali + Scroll Mavuika is ~2.5k less DPS.

charlotte-furina-mona-skirk.desc: [N5D] Skirk Furina Mona Charlotte. 21s rot. tE N2Q 3[N5D] N2CD N5D N2. First rot Nuke included, ~1.5k loss otherwise. Freeze Immunity loses 8k(~9%) DPS.

alhaitham-furina-kuki-nahida.desc: alhaitham quickbloom with furina. split 30s rotation with 2 kuki skills.

furina-jean-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Jean Xilonen. 4CA 25s rot. No Xilonen Q, Jean heals instead. See Jean using her Q every rot with only 1E per rot here.

chevreuse-lisa-mavuika-ororon.desc: Mavuika Chevreuse Ororon Lisa. ~18s Rot. Mavuika Double Electro Overload. Mav Q 4C2FD 1CF; C13 is -4K DPS. Healer Chevreuse. Lisa bursts every other rotation, while her DEF shred lingers into the next.

diona-mavuika-rosaria-xilonen.desc: Mavuika Xilonen Diona Rosaria. 20-21s rot. Rosaria on Petra, Mavuika combo: Q Wait(0.1s-0.2s) 3CA F D 4(2CA D) CA F. Archaic petra on rosaria coupled with high precision required during Mavuika combo makes this not very consistent in practice. Casual combo which is not trying to thread the needle between Diona's and Rosaria's aplication is around 20% worse on average. -Ins Rosaria is -4K DPS

chevreuse-clorinde-mavuika-yaemiko.desc: OL Clorinde w/ Yae Miko, Mavuika, Chevreuse. 16s rotation. Yae uses her Burst at the end of the opener to fill rotation time. Mavuika uses her Burst every other rotation.

furina-mualani-nahida-xiangling.desc: Mualani burn vape. 20s rotation Mualani bursts every rotation. Prototype Amber as the only healing source can cause team to die easily. Particle drop HP threshold based on 12-3 Icewind Suite (250% HP Multiplier).

furina-lynette-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Lynette Xilonen. 4CA 27s rot. Using Xilonen Q. Lynette contributes to Fanfare stacking with her HP fluctuation. Providing taunt with her Q.

arlecchino-bennett-chevreuse-raiden.desc: Arle Raiden Chev Bennett. 16s rot. No Arle Q, 6N3D. Raiden provides long lasting electro app and Overloaded damage.

furina-neuvillette-sayu-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Sayu Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. No Xilonen Q, Sayu heals instead. See Sayu using her Q every rot with only 1E per rot here.

escoffier-furina-kokomi-yelan.desc: Kokomi Furina Yelan Escoffier. ~21s Rot. Kokomi Mono Hydro with Escoffier. Kokomi's skill heals through Furina and Yelan setup before being refeshed by her burst. Yelan ensure that she catches her 2nd skill particles. Slingshot Yelan is ~200 more DPS. Escoffier builds full damage and does not burst.

arlecchino-bennett-xilonen-xingqiu.desc: Arle XQ Xilonen Bennet. Standard rotation into N2C spam from Arle. Fav is a marginal DPS loss on Xilo.

bennett-chevreuse-clorinde-fischl.desc: Clorinde Chev OL w/ C6 Bennett, which allows Clorinde to refresh Chev's A1 with a Pyro NA in between her Burst and Skill combo.

mavuika-mona-mualani-sucrose.desc: Mualani Mona Sucrose Mavuika. 18s rot. 3[3-stacked bites]. Mualani Q every 2rots. Mona and Mavuika Q every rot. Start with Mona E and Vape Mavuika Q, triggering 4Scroll. Use Sucrose E after Mona Q to reduce the Hydro aura.

bennett-mavuika-xilonen-zhongli.desc: Mavuika Xilonen Zhongli Bennett. ~18s Rot. Mavuika double Geo with Xilonen. Mavuika Q 7[C2D]. Zhongli goes after Xilonen for better AP uptime. Xilonen scroll/RES shred last until Mavuika field time ends.

clorinde-fischl-kazuha-kirara.desc: Clorinde TF Kirara doing 2 E's per rot and sapwood blade. KQMS Stats

furina-hutao-xianyun-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Double Hydro Plunge. 2 Yelan E rotation. Xianyun applies VV debuff twice per rotation. Hu Tao 6 N1CJP. Noblesse and Emblem Yelan are comparable due to her proccing her burst less than non plunge teams . First rotation is slightly different. Hutao Start HP: 70%.

furina-mavuika-navia-xilonen.desc: Navia Xilonen Furina Mavuika. Xilonen 2E 20-21s rot. Navia ATK Goblet. N3D N2 > Xilo E N2 > N3D N2. Switch between tE and hE based on current shrapnel stacks. Navia 3rd E if available. Mavuika single field time as Q C E.

citlali-furina-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Citlali Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Assuming you use dash on Xilonen to pick up the crystallize shard.

furina-neuvillette-ororon-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Using Xilonen Q. She can utilize 4AP. Technically Ororon doesn't need field time to trigger 4Scroll since Xilonen deals Nightsoul aligned damage.

furina-neuvillette-raiden-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Xilonen Raiden. 4CA 26s rot. 4AP Full EM Raiden. Raiden has a single field time during the entire rot, meaing only one 4AP proc. 4GD instead of 4AP is only 3k(3.5%) DPS loss.

fischl-furina-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Fischl Xilonen. 4CA 28s rot. Trying to get Hydro Scroll as much as possible. Check out the samples to see how scroll setup works, noting that Oz has ~12s duration. Reaches 89k with 4AP Fischl.

furina-ororon-varesa-xianyun.desc: Varesa Ororon Furina Xianyun. 20s rot. 7 Plunge Combos. 100% Collisions.

furina-neuvillette-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Xianyun Xilonen. 4CA 25s rot. No Xilonen Q, Xianyun heals instead. See Xianyun using her Q every rot with only 1E per rot here.

furina-kazuha-neuvillette-ororon.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Ororon. 4CA 26s rot. [ Ororon > Kazuha > Furina Q > Neuv ] to maximize Kazuha and Furina buff uptime on Neuv. You can run damage oriented weapon on Ororon but not that worth doing it. Favmen.

baizhu-nahida-nilou-xingqiu.desc: Nilou Bloom with on field Nahida, with alright ST DPS, Healing and Shield. Simple Rotation. KQMS Stats.

escoffier-furina-kazuha-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Escoffier Kazuha. 4CA 26s rot. No Escoffier Q. Escoffier E > Kazuha hEPQ > Furina Q > Neuv C E C Q.

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-varesa.desc: Varesa Fischl Bennett Chevreuse. ~17s rot. 5 Plunge Combos (+1 in opening rotation). Opening rotation starts with 1 extra Plunge Combo. Bennett uses his E after 3 Plunge Combos to refresh Chevreuse's RES Shred. Chevreuse is on a damage build. 100% Collisions.

chevreuse-ororon-varesa-xiangling.desc: Varesa Ororon Xiangling Chevreuse. ~21s rot. 7 Plunge Combos (+1 in opening rotation). Opening rotation is slightly different and extended by starting with 1 extra Plunge Combo. Chevreuse is on a healing build. EoSF Xiangling is ~100 less DPS. 100% Collisions.

furina-mika-shenhe-skirk.desc: [N5D] Skirk Furina Shenhe Mika. 21s rot. tE N2Q 3[N5D] N2CD N5D N4D. First rot Nuke included, 3.5k loss otherwise. Freeze Immunity loses 3k(~4%) DPS.

furina-neuvillette-xilonen-yelan.desc: Neuvillette Furina Yelan Xilonen. 4CA 28s~ rotation. Yelan picks up the crystalise shard for Petra twice. Yelan does skill twice

furina-lanyan-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Lan Yan Xilonen. 4CA 28s rot. Requiring Lan Yan C6. She can build for her personal damage.

bennett-chevreuse-furina-gaming.desc: Gaming plunges 8 times. To do this ingame, Press E immediately after Q and each plunge. Wait till Man Chai is extremely close to you, then plunge.

arlecchino-bennett-citlali-yelan.desc: Arle Yelan Citlali Bennett. 18s rot. No Arle Q. N2C 5[N3D] N1. Pyro Scroll setup as Yelan EQ N1 > Arle E > Bennett EQ > Citlali EQ. First rot has 79k, two rot has 82k DPS. -17K DPS with Freeze immunity.

furina-kokomi-xilonen-yelan.desc: Kokomi Mono Hydro. 21/22s rotation; The first rotation is different. 2 Yelan and Xilonen skills. Kokomi N2D/N2W combo. OHC Kokomi is -2K DPS.

furina-kuki-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Kuki Xilonen. 4CA 27s rot. Kuki picks up the shard before Neuv field time. Kuki's 2nd field time for that is DPS neutral, so you can skip it.

furina-lisa-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Lisa Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Lisa can have low ER with 2pc Scroll and Xilonen in the team. Prototype Amber helps stacking fanfare and her own Energy.

furina-luminepyro-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Xilonen PMC. 4CA 26s rot. PMC hE for ranged attack. Xilonen Q can also be used before PMC.

lynette-neuvillette-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Neuv Vape with Xiangling Xilonen Lynette. Gets 4pc Scroll refresh, but only gets Hydro VV for Neuv's first field time. Neuv starts with E N1 first rot, then does N2D N2 second rot onwards to let Lynette's Burst run out and ensure Hydro VV.

mualani-xiangling-xilonen-yelan.desc: Mualani vape. Yelan doesn't interfere with Mualan's ability to vape all dmg. Very high energy requirements on Xiangling. Particle drop HP threshold based on 12-3 Icewind Suite (250% HP Multiplier).

chevreuse-luminepyro-ororon-varesa.desc: Varesa Ororon Pyro Traveler Chevreuse. ~19s rot. 6 Plunge Combos (+1 in opening rotation). Opening rotation is very slightly different and extended by starting with 1 extra Plunge Combo. Chevreuse is on a healing build. 100% Collisions.

kazuha-mualani-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Mualani Vape. Mualani and Xiangling burst every other Mualani skill, Xilonen and Kazuha never burst. When Mualani bursts, she skips her third NA. Xiangling's C4 ruins this rotation. Assumes Mualani's burst hits almost instantly.

clorinde-fischl-kirara-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Kirara Fischl Xilonen. ~25s Rot. TF Clorinde Aggravate, shielded. Clorinde, Kirara, and Xilonen do not burst. Kirara builds for shield. Ins Kirara is -3K DPS. Clorinde takes the sapwood leaf.

bennett-citlali-gaming-kazuha.desc: Gaming Citlali Kazuha Bennett. ~20s Rot. Gaming Melt Plunge with 7 plunges, 6 melted, 5 buffed by Bennett. Gaming juggles Man Chai, using burst into skill + plunge and waiting on the ground before catching Man Chai mid descent. The final plunge is not melted, but is delayed for Gaming's particle ICD. Burstless Kazuha uses E in Bennett Q.

escoffier-furina-ganyu-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Ganyu Escoffier. 4CA 26s rot. Ganyu 2E1Q, no CAs used.

furina-neuvillette-xiao-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Xiao Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Xiao sweeps the battlefield with his E. Enemies won't survive after he uses E.

arlecchino-bennett-rosaria-sucrose.desc: Arle Rosaria Sucrose Bennett. ~17s rot. Cancels CA and uses N3D Arle with specific waits to line up Melts. Sucrose Q every 3 rotations. Without Sucrose's Q, Rosaria casts her E for extra Cryo application and the rotation is slightly different. Emblem Rosaria is -1K DPS.

furina-kuki-nahida-neuvillette.desc: 2 Kuki skill 30s rotation. Nahida fills some downtime on fielding.

kazuha-mavuika-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuvilette, Mavuika, Kazuha, Xilonen. 36s rotation. Use Kazuha's Burst and Mavuika to maintain 100% Vape uptime for Neuv. Uses waits for precise timing. Pyro aura checks are crucial. Against multiple enemies, use Kazuha’s skill before Xilonen and cast Mavuika as E → Q. To Vaporize Neuv’s second charge attack, skip Kazuha’s second skill.

furina-lumineanemo-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina AMC Xilonen. 4CA 27s rot. AMC provides 20% Hydro RES Shred with her C6 on the first half. AMC 1E per rot.

arlecchino-bennett-lanyan-yelan.desc: Arle Yelan Lan Yan Bennett. 19s rot. No Arle Q. 5[N3C] N1. Double Swirl setup by seperating Bennett E and Q. This rot works with C0 Lan Yan, READ the config. The 1st rotation has 77.5k DPS, and the 2 rotations has 80k DPS.

kazuha-mavuika-mona-mualani.desc: Mualani Mona Kazuha Mavuika. 18s rot. 3[3-stacked bites]. Mualani Q every 2rots. Mona and Mavuika Q every rot. Start with Mona E and Vape Mavuika Q, triggering 4Scroll. Use Kazuha E after Mona Q to reduce the Hydro aura.

bennett-escoffier-kaeya-mavuika.desc: Mavuika Escoffier Kaeya Bennett. ~18s Rot. Mavuika double Cryo Melt without Natlan. Mavuika Q 6[C2D] CD E. 200 FS bust first rotation only.

citlali-furina-kazuha-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Citlali Kazuha. 4CA 26s rot. Citlali just E N2 before Furina Q.

bennett-escoffier-gaming-rosaria.desc: Gaming Rosaria Escoffier Bennett. ~19s Rot. Gaming Double Cryo Melt. 7/7 plunges melted, 7/6 buffed by Bennett. Gaming waits on the ground between plunges, timed to catch Manchai while descending for the juggle.

furina-neuvillette-venti-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Venti Xilonen. 28s rot. Venti & Xilonen 2E+Q each rot.

clorinde-fischl-nahida-xilonen.desc: Aggravate Clorinde (FoHW) w/ Fischl Nahida Xilonen. 16s rotation w/ modified opening rotation to maximize Clorinde field time. Xilonen and Nahida alternate using their bursts. Nahida picks up the Electro shard generated by Xilonen.

chevreuse-sara-varesa-xiangling.desc: Varesa Sara Xiangling Chevreuse. ~14s rot (20s opening rotation). 4 Plunge Combos (+2 in opening rotation). Opening rotation is different and extended by starting with 1 extra Plunge Combo and ending with 5 Plunge Combos instead of 4. Chevreuse is on a healing build. EoSF on Xiangling is ~200 less DPS. 100% Collisions.

citlali-mavuika-mualani-xilonen.desc: Mualani Mavuika Citlali Xilonen. 18s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. Mualani Q or Xilonen Q at the end. Do note that Citlali's Cryo app can ruin the reaction.

bennett-mavuika-navia-xilonen.desc: Navia Mavuika Bennett Xilonen. ~18s Rot. SubDPS Navia with On field Mavuika. Mavuika Q 4CD. Navia uses an extra skill every 3rd rotation. Xilonen uses burst every rotation. Xilonen uses skill twice per rotation, particles funneled to Navia. AP Navia isn't recommended because of the time loss from Hold Skill/picking up shards.

furina-heizou-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Heizou Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. No Xilonen Q. Heizou Q twice in a rot with Prototype Amber healing the team.

fischl-furina-kazuha-neuvillette.desc: Neuvillette Electrocharge with no Interruption Resistance - Hyperoptimised sim

clorinde-emilie-fischl-mavuika.desc: Clorinde Emilie Fischl Mavuika. ~16s Rot. Whimsy Clorinde Quickburn. Emilie bursts every other rot after the first. Mavuika & Emilie burst in alternate rotations. Mavuika or Fischl first in the rotation leads to similar overall DPS.

fischl-nahida-varesa-xilonen.desc: Varesa Fischl Nahida Xilonen. ~13s rot. 4 Plunge Combos (+2 in opening rotation). Xilonen and Nahida do not cast their Q. 100% Collisions.

bennett-furina-lyney-zhongli.desc: Furina sees the field every other rotation to keep rotation time low

ayaka-escoffier-furina-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Ayaka Escoffier. 4CA 27-28s rot. Ayaka 2E1Q, she uses her Q between Neuv field time to benefit from Furina Q buff. She needs a lot of ER, so holds Amenoma R5 with 4EoSF here.

emilie-neuvillette-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Neuvillette Burnvape with Xilonen, Emilie, and Xiangling.  ~26s rotation. Ensure that enemy has Hydro aura before trying to proc Scroll with Xilonen. Emilie does not Burst. Xilonen only Bursts to fill time as otherwise Neuv's skill will be on cooldown after C Q.

chevreuse-fischl-varesa-xiangling.desc: Varesa Fischl Xiangling Chevreuse. ~16s rot. 6 Plunge Combos. Opening rotation moves one of the Plunge Combos to the start of the rotation. Chevreuse is on a healing build. GT on Fischl is ~200 less DPS. EoSF on Xiangling is ~2.5k less DPS. 100% Collisions.

alhaitham-nahida-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Alhaitham raiden hyperbloom with pos and radius

furina-sara-varesa-xianyun.desc: Varesa Sara Furina Xianyun. 23s rot. 6 Plunge Combos. Xianyun refreshes VV RES Shred after 2 Plunge Combos. 100% Collisions.

ayaka-escoffier-furina-mualani.desc: Ayaka Furina Mualani Escoffier. Mualani 2E 20s rot. Both of Mualani E N1 is batterying Ayaka. 4Scroll TTDS Mualani. Since Mualani doesn't have any off-field app, Cryo Resonance is somewhat safe even against the enemies not Freezable.

arlecchino-bennett-kaeya-kazuha.desc: Arlecchino with C6 Kaeya Melt. 6N3D combo. KQMS stats.

furina-kazuha-luminepyro-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha PMC. 4CA 26s rot. PMC hE for ranged attack.

bennett-citlali-furina-lyney.desc: Lyney Furina Citlali Bennett. ~21s Rot. Lyney VapeMelt. Assumes 50% Headhsots with Crescent, -1K DPS with Stillness. Significant (~14K) DPS loss with Freeze Immunity. Bennett is built for healng.

bennett-kazuha-mavuika-ororon.desc: Mavuika Bennett Kazuha Ororon. 18s rot. Mono Pyro Mavuika with Ororon as the Fighting spirit generator instead of Xilonen. Uses 5[C2D] combo 90k DPS on first rotation because of 200 FS.

bennett-lyney-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Lyney Monopyro with Xilonen. No RES. Interruption else than the Crystallize shields.

clorinde-fischl-mavuika-nahida.desc: Clorinde Nahida Fischl Mavuika. ~16s Rot. Whimsy Clorinde Quickburn. Nahida bursts every other rot after the first. Mavuika & Nahida burst in alternate rotations.

furina-kirara-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Kirara Xilonen. 4CA 27s rot. Xilonen using Q. Kirara short hold E before each Neuv field time while picking up the shard generated from Xilonen.

chevreuse-luminepyro-sara-varesa.desc: Varesa Sara Pyro Traveler Chevreuse. ~19s rot. 6 Plunge Combos (+1 in opening rotation). Opening rotation is very slightly different and extended by starting with 1 extra Plunge Combo. Chevreuse is on a healing build. EoSF on Sara is ~2k less DPS. 100% Collisions.

alhaitham-kirara-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Alhaitham Hyperbloom with kirara. High dps hyperbloom team with great defensive utility and no Nahida

clorinde-fischl-nahida-sucrose.desc: Aggravate Clorinde (4TF) w/ Fischl Sucrose Nahida. ~25s rotation. Clorinde uses her Burst to fill downtime. Sucrose uses her Burst when available.

citlali-furina-mavuika-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Citlali Mavuika. 4CA 26s rot. Citlali EQ N1 > Mavuika QE > Furina Q.

furina-navia-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Navia Xilonen. 4CA 29s rot. Navia hold E to collect the shard, activating 4AP buff. 4pc Nighttime on navia is ~5% team DPS loss.

furina-kinich-mavuika-ororon.desc: Kinich Mavuika Furina Ororon. No healing or any form of defensive utility, while taking burgeon damage. Furina only bursts on the first rotation. Kinich uses short hold E and spin to catch blindspots, get 3-4 canons per rotation.

kaveh-nahida-nilou-xingqiu.desc: Kqmc kaveh nilou bloom with  N8W-N4E-N4 string

arlecchino-bennett-kazuha-xilonen.desc: Arle Xilo Kazuha Bennett. 16s rotation. Arle N1 C N3C 4[N3D] N2. First rotation is different. Bennett on Noblesse is -3k DPS.

furina-kazuha-kuki-neuvillette.desc: Furina catches Neuv particles, Kuki E N1 before Furina to let Neuv have more Furina Q uptime as well as make Kaz Q's DoT swirl electro. Neuv does 4 CA's.

arlecchino-bennett-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Arlecchino double hydro. Arlecchino 8N2C 2N2 Combo. 2 Yelan E 21s rotation.

bennett-furina-xianyun-xiao.desc: Pyro Xiao vape with 50% collision rate. 8 high plunges. KQMC

clorinde-fischl-kazuha-nahida.desc: Aggravate Clorinde (4TF) w/ Fischl Kazuha Nahida. 25s rotation to maximize Oz uptime; Clorinde does not burst.

furina-kazuha-neuvillette-raiden.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Raiden. 4CA 26s rot. 4Scroll Full EM Raiden.

chasca-escoffier-mavuika-shenhe.desc: Chasca Shenhe Escoffier Mavuika. ~18s rot. Chasca and Shenhe alternate Bursting each rotation while Escoffier doesn't use her Burst. Wait at the end for Chasca's CA/Q to land.

alhaitham-kuki-nahida-yelan.desc: Alhaitham hyperbloom 2 Yelan e split uptime rotation. 8 swap delay to allow Kuki to N1 Q in Alaitham Burst window. Tech requires lower ping or canceling n1 before dmg instance.

furina-navia-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Navia Plunge. 2 Xilonen skills, one funneled to Navia. Rotation gives TTDS to Navia for both skills and all plunges. C0 Xilonen doesn't give resistance shred but provides energy and Scroll set.

ayaka-escoffier-furina-rosaria.desc: Ayaka Furina Rosaria Escoffier. Rosaria 2E 20s rot. Both of Rosaria E is batterying Ayaka, Rosaria doesn't need high ER for that.

furina-kazuha-lisa-neuvillette.desc: Neuvillette Hypercarry ft. Lisa providing DEF Shred and healing. Lisa can use any artifact set; but at KQMS she needs the 20% ER from 2pc EoSF.

furina-lynette-neuvillette-ororon.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Lynette. 4CA 25s rot. EM build Lynette. If Lynette is Pre-C4, put Lynette EQ before Furina Q to manage E cd.

escoffier-furina-hutao-yelan.desc: Hutao Furina Yelan Escoffier. ~21s Rot. VapeMelt Hutao double Hydro with Escoffier. E 8N1CJ N2CJ N1 Hutao. 2E Yelan. Freeze immunity is -6K DPS.

chasca-citlali-mavuika-mona.desc: Chasca Citlali Mona Mavuika. ~37s rot. Chasca does EQ 3[CA] when Burst is ready. Mona casts her Burst once at the beginning of the rotation. Setup enables consistent triple Scroll. Wait at the end for Chasca's CA to land. Against unfreezable enemies, ~11.5k DPS drop.

escoffier-furina-ganyu-shenhe.desc: Ganyu Furina Shenhe Escoffier. 4CAs 21s rot. Furina > Escoffier EQ > Shenhe tEQ > Ganyu. Ganyu uses 1CA before EQ to snapshot all the 3 stacks of 4MH.

charlotte-furina-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Charlotte Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. No Xilonen Q, Charlotte heals instead. Chalotte triggers 4AP twice(1st/2nd half).

chasca-escoffier-mavuika-yelan.desc: Chasca Yelan Escoffier Mavuika. ~18s rot. Very tight Chasca combo E 3[CA] Q CA. Altered Chasca Burst position to stack Yelan's A4. Yelan here fully for DMG% buff and her Hydro Element, only 1 wave of her Q is fired. Against unfreezable, Mavuika DPS reduced by about ~9k.

clorinde-fischl-lanyan-nahida.desc: Clorinde Fischl Lanyan Nahida. ~24s Rot. TF Clorinde Aggravate. Clorinde burst every other rotation and Lanyan burst every other rotation

layla-mavuika-rosaria-xilonen.desc: Mavuika Rosaria Layla Xilonen. ~18s Rot. Mavuika double Cryo Melt. Mavuika Q 6[C2D], Q C13 is -3K DPS. Mavuika does a few NA before burst to better align her burst CD.

mavuika-mona-mualani-xilonen.desc: Mualani Mona Xilonen Mavuika. 18s rot. 3[3-stacked bites]. Mualani Q every 2rots. Mona and Mavuika Q every rot. Start with Mona E N1 > Xilo E N2 for Hydro Scroll, and then Mona Q > Mavuika Q C E to do huge Vaped damage. 4TotM Mona to buff Mavuika.

baizhu-raiden-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Double Hydro and Baizhu

furina-mavuika-mona-xilonen.desc: avuika Furina Mona Xilonen. ~20s Rot. Mavuika Double Hydro with Mona to buff her initial burst hit. Q 6C2D Mavuika. Q C11D Mavuika is -4K DPS. 1E Xilonen.

bennett-citlali-escoffier-xianyun.desc: Escoffier Citlali Bennett Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Escoffier Double Cryo Melt plunge with VV. Escoffier doesn't cancel her plunges. Bennett needs Favonius for smooth rotations.

kaeya-mavuika-rosaria-xilonen.desc: Mavuika Rosaria Kaeya Xilonen. ~19s Rot. Mavuika double Cryo Melt. 1E Xilonen. Mavuika Q 6[C2D], Q 11C D is -7K DPS. Kaeya after Rosaria, Ins proc for Kaeya isn't possible.

baizhu-furina-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Baizhu Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. No Xilonen Q, Baizhu heals instead. Baizhu triggers 4AP twice(1st/2nd half).

bennett-diluc-furina-xianyun.desc: Diluc Furina Xianyun Bennett. 4 Rots; same-ish rotation as the 81k sim, removes HP based energy drops, travel=0 NA on Xianyun, and the waiting for Hydro aura. 50% plunge collisions.

bennett-chevreuse-kazuha-lyney.desc: Lyney Mono Pyro with C6 Chev and no interrupt resistance: Lyney, Chevreuse, Bennett, Kazuha. 15s 4CA rotation. Not having C6 Chev is around a 14% dps loss.

bennett-kinich-mavuika-rosaria.desc: Kinich Mavuika Rosaria Bennett. ~18s Rot. N2 (wait) E Kinich. Kinich does not intentionally seek blindspots. No Kinich short hold  is -9K DPS (missed cannons). Kinich does not burst. Mavuika Melts her burst every rotation. Rosaria can clear Burning every rotation for Scroll, but OC and UR Mavuika are more damage.

furina-kazuha-neuvillette-zhongli.desc: Neuvillette Hypercarry with resistance to interruption. 4CA rotation

dori-furina-kazuha-neuvillette.desc: Neuv+Furina with dori as healer, as well as to let kazuha swirl ec.

arlecchino-bennett-kaeya-zhongli.desc: Arle Bennett Zhongli Kaeya. Arle with C6 Kaeya Melt. 6N3D combo. 17s rot. No Arle Q. Totm buff is a little stronger than instructor on Zhongli.

furina-ororon-varesa-xilonen.desc: Varesa Ororon Furina Xilonen. ~25s rot. 8 Plunge Combos. Ororon splits his E and Q, casting E before Varesa and his Q after 4 Plunge Combos. Xilonen refreshes her buffs after 4 Plunge Combos. 100% Collisions.

escoffier-furina-wriothesley-yelan.desc: Wrio Furina Yelan Escoffier. Yelan 2E 22s rot. 5[N3CJ] N3 and Q every 2rot at the seperate field time(which means his A4 and C2 buff isn't utilized). Wrio does ~ 32% of the team DPS.

clorinde-emilie-mavuika-ororon.desc: Clorinde Emilie Ororon Mavuika. ~16s Rot. Whimsy Clorinde Quickburn. Emilie bursts every other rot after the first. Mavuika bursts every other rotation, with 2 CA after the first rotation.

arlecchino-bennett-kaeya-lanyan.desc: Arlecchino Kaeya LanYan Bennett. Arlecchino melt with C6 Kaeya. 6N3D combo. ~18s rot. Scroll better than instructor on Kaeya if Arlecchino has enough EM. LanYan's C6 is not necessary.

bennett-furina-navia-xilonen.desc: Navia-Xilonen with 2 Xilonen Es per rotation. Have to be careful of the Geo application which isn't abundant.

sara-varesa-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Varesa Sara Xianyun Xilonen. 19s rot. 7 Plunge Combos. NO on Sara is ~2k less DPS. EoSF on Sara ~4k less DPS. 100% Collisions.

ayaka-escoffier-furina-mona.desc: Ayaka Furina Mona Escoffier. 21s rot. Escoffier batteries Ayaka. freeze_resist=1 loses 4.5k(5.5%) team DPS. Escoffier has 2nd field time between Ayaka's field time to trigger Fav.

clorinde-emilie-fischl-xiangling.desc: TF Clorinde Quickburn. 25s rotations. High Quicken uptime with lots of Overloads.

bennett-ganyu-mavuika-xilonen.desc: Ganyu Xilonen Bennett Mavuika. ~18s rot. Shieldless, so it needs precision/skill. Benefits from Aim cancels. Mavuika ends with unmelted Charge Attacks. Mauvika's Burst catches the tail of Bennett's Burst buff.

bennett-mavuika-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Mavuika Xiangling Bennett Xilonen. ~18s Rot. Mono Pyro Mavuika, Q 6C2D C E. Xilonen bursts every rotation.

bennett-furina-gaming-sucrose.desc: VV setup is ping dependent. Make pyro aura on enemy by Ben QE or QEN1, swirl using N1 on Sucrose. Press Gaming E as soon as possible, but plunge only when Man Chai is extremely close to u midair such that u catch it while ur plunging. Always dash to the enemy closest to Man Chai before pressing E so u have a higher likelihood of catching Man Chai midair instead of autotargetting onto a faraway enemy and becoming unable to do so. 8 E plunges.

arlecchino-bennett-chevreuse-xilonen.desc: Arle Chev Xilonen Bennett. 16s rot. No Arle Q, N3D combo. Chev used for C6 buff and 4AP

charlotte-furina-rosaria-skirk.desc: [N5D] Skirk Furina Rosaria Charlotte. 21s rot. tE N2Q 3[N5D] N2CD N5D N2. First rot Nuke included, 2.5k loss otherwise. Freeze Immunity loses 2.5k(~3%) DPS.

bennett-citlali-diluc-xianyun.desc: Diluc Citlali Bennett Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Diluc Plunge Melt with Citlali. 6 Melted plunges, 5 covered by VV, the final 2 plunges are not melted, just used to fill time. Double fav is needed to not encounter ER issues.

furina-kazuha-xilonen-yelan.desc: Yelan on field carry. Swaps to Xilonen and Kazuha to refresh buffs and generate energy multiple times per rotation.

furina-jean-luminepyro-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Jean PMC. 4CA 26s rot. PMC hE for ranged attack.

escoffier-furina-neuvillette-zhongli.desc: Neuv Furina Escoffier Zhongli. 4CA 26s rot. Zhongli > Escoffier EQ > Furina Q > Neuv C E C Q

furina-neuvillette-xilonen-zhongli.desc: Neuv Furina Zhongli Xilonen. 4CA 28s rot. Xilonen using Q every rot. Zhongli can simply pickup the shard for 4AP generated from Xilonen in-game, buffing both of Neuv's field time.

arlecchino-ayaka-bennett-citlali.desc: Arlecchino Ayaka Citlali Bennett. ~20s Rot. Arlechinno Melt with Ayaka. Unimpressive melt count, with Arlechinno doing the melting.

arlecchino-chevreuse-fischl-yaemiko.desc: Arle Fischl Yae Chev. 16s rot (very tight). No Arle Q. 6[N3D] N1. also not using yae Q, just 3[E]. there is no burst reliant teammates so chev can reach 40k HP relatively easier, by not using fav lance

furina-kuki-nahida-yelan.desc: double hydro hyperbloom. With more of a focus on non transformative damage Nahida N2E/N2CD combo on field. 2 Yelan E rotation. Kuki bursts every rotation separate from her e cast for higher electro app uptime . Nahida doesn't burst.

lynette-mualani-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Mualani Vape with Lynette. Mualani alternates between 3 sharky bites and 2 sharky bites + Q. Assumes her Burst hits practically instantly. Xiangling burst every other rot, Xilonen and Lynette never burst. Xiangling's C4 is roughly 4k less DPS.

furina-neuvillette-ororon-sayu.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Sayu. 4CA 26s rot. Furina Q > Sayu EQ > Neuv

arlecchino-bennett-navia-xilonen.desc: Arle Navia Xilonen Bennett. 19s rot. No Arle Q, Arle deals the main damage, Navia occasionally enters the field to perform a skill, Xilonen increases the damage of both.

diona-mavuika-mualani-xilonen.desc: Mualani Mavuika Xilonen Diona. 21s rot. 3[3-stacked bites]. Mualani Q every 2rots. Mavuika Q J C2D, melting Q and the first CA hit. If the timing unlucky, you can lose Pyro aura because of Diona's Cryo app.

citlali-escoffier-furina-mualani.desc: Mualani Furina Escoffier Citlali. 33s rot. 3[3-stacked bites]. Furina Q after Citlali E offers more generous Furina Q uptime for Mualani Q.

nahida-ororon-varesa-xilonen.desc: Varesa Ororon Nahida Xilonen. 16s rot. 6 Plunge Combos. Xilonen casts her Q when ready before her E to still funnel particles to Varesa. Skipping Xilonen's Q is ~3k more DPS. 100% Collisions.

chasca-escoffier-furina-skirk.desc: Chasca Furina Skirk Escoffier. 32s rot. Chasca does 4[C], Q in the 1st half of the rotation. Furina casts her E and Q once per rotation. Escoffier casts her E twice per rotation, and her Q once per rotation. Skirk cast her Q twice per rotation. Hydro Swirl is inconsistent. Unfreezable enemy is ~4.5k less DPS. Scroll over VV is ~1k less DPS. Chain Breaker + Codex is ~2.5k less DPS.

baizhu-fischl-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Raiden ED > Baizhu EQ > Fischl EN1 > Xingqiu EDQN2 > Baizhu N2D 2N3D E > Fischl N2Q > Baizhu 5N3D N2D > Raiden N1

baizhu-furina-raiden-yelan.desc: Baizhu Furina Yelan Raiden. ~21s Rot. On-Field Baizhu Hyperbloom. 2E Yelan. Yelan's burst is active into Furina's N1 in the next rotation.

chevreuse-clorinde-sara-xiangling.desc: Overload Clorinde w/ Kujou Sara, Xiangling and Chevreuse. 16s Rotation. Hyper-optimized.
