Chevreuse's hold Skill is slotted between Sara's Aimed Shot and Clorinde's Burst in order for Sara and Chevreuse to funnel particles to Clorinde.

furina-jean-neuvillette-ororon.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Jean. 4CA 26s rot. Furina Q > Jean EQ > Neuv

chasca-citlali-mavuika-shenhe.desc: Chasca Shenhe Citlali Mavuika. Avg ~19s rot. Very tight Chasca combo EQ 4[CA]. Chasca and Shenhe cast their Burst together every other rotation. Wait at the end for Chasca's CA to land.

clorinde-mavuika-nahida-ororon.desc: Clorinde Nahida Ororon Mavuika. ~16s Rot. Whimsy Clorinde Quickburn. Nahida bursts every other rot after the first. Mavuika bursts every other rotation, with 1 CA after the first rotation. Everyone but Clorinde builds full EM.

chiori-furina-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Chiori Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Neuv pickup the hydro shard for Geo Resonance.

furina-neuvillette-sigewinne-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Xilonen Sigewinne. 4CA 25s rot. No Xilonen Q. Sigewinne pickup the hydro shard for 4AP twice. Due to low field time of the teammates, sigewinne could enter the field to pickup the shard for 4AP again.

chasca-furina-mavuika-skirk.desc: Chasca Furina Skirk Mavuika. 32s rot. Chasca does 4[C], Q in the 1st half of the rotation, while C_4b in the 2nd half of the rotation. Furina casts her E at the start of the rotation, and only casts her Q in the 1st rotation. Mavuika casts her Q once in the 2nd half of the rotation. Skirk casts her Q twice per rotation. Cryo Scroll is inconsistent against unfreezable enemies. Unfreezable enemy is ~4k less DPS.

bennett-furina-kokomi-lyney.desc: Lyney vape with Kokomi. Kokomi gives more reliable AOE hydro app for Lyney to vape than just Furina.

bennett-chevreuse-mavuika-raiden.desc: Raiden Chevreuse Mavuika Bennett. ~16 Rots. Raiden Mavuika Overload, in which Raiden and Mavuika burst in alternate rotations to compensate for the lack of Resolve/Fighting spirit generation. Q 6[C2D] Mavuika/Q N4E 3N4D Raiden. ToM Raiden is slightly better.

chasca-furina-mavuika-ororon.desc: Chasca Furina Mavuika Ororon. 20s rotation. No healing or any form of defensive utility, Furina only bursts on first rotation. Mavuika on field a bit after her burst.

chevreuse-citlali-gaming-xilonen.desc: Gaming Citlali Chevreuse Xilonen. ~19s Rot. Gaming Melt Plunge with 7 plunges, 6 melted. Gaming juggles Man Chai, using burst into skill + plunge and waiting on the ground before catching Man Chai mid descent. Chevreuse provides Pyro Buffing without circle impact. Unmelted final plunge is delayed for Gaming's particle ICD. No burst Xilonen. Option for 7 melted plunges included.

furina-kokomi-xingqiu-yelan.desc: On field Kokomi 21s 2 Yelan E rotation Kokomi alternates Walk and Dash cancels

furina-kazuha-neuvillette-yaemiko.desc: variation of the standard neuv - furina - kaz hyper team with burstless yae as flex. widsith is better than hakushin. includes rot without yae totem refresh for slower players, only ~400 dps worse.

arlecchino-bennett-ororon-yelan.desc: Arle Yelan Ororon Bennett. 18s rot. No Arle Q. N3C 5[N3D] N1. Scroll setup: Yelan EQ N1 > Ororon E N2 > Bennett Q E > Ororon Q N1

bennett-chasca-mavuika-mualani.desc: Chasca Mavuika Mualani Bennett. 18s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Mavuika Q vape enabled by Mualani.

furina-hutao-lisa-yelan.desc: Furina ed q > Lisa hE q > Yelan q n1 e > Hu Tao e combo > q (when available) > Yelan e aim

bennett-chasca-mavuika-yelan.desc: Chasca Yelan Mavuika Bennett. ~18.5s. Chasca does a shorter combo of E 4[CA] or E 2[CA] Q CA. Delaying Q to stack Yelan Burst. Low chance Mavuika misses Burst Vape. Yelan Burst expires after Chasca 3rd CA after the first rotation.

chasca-chevreuse-citlali-mavuika.desc: Chasca Mavuika Citlali Chev. 20s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Not having Chev C6 is ~5.5k(7%) DPS loss.

citlali-furina-jean-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Citlali Jean. 4CA 26s rot. Jean Q between Furina Q and Neuv field time, and refreshing VV before 2nd Neuv field time.

chevreuse-clorinde-sara-thoma.desc: OL Clorinde w/ Thoma. 17s rotations. Sara and Chevreuse funnel particles to Clorinde to lower Clorinde's ER reqs while also still buffing Clorinde's Burst. Clorinde makes use of her Skill movement to extend Sara's buff from her Burst

bennett-emilie-kinich-xiangling.desc: Kinich Emilie Xiangling Bennett. ~ 18s Rot. E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo with consistently NA clockwise. 5 Quickscope Scalespiker Cannon Combo. No Kinich short can leads to missed a cannon shots, resulting in significant DPS loss. Kinich, Emilie and Xiangling burst every other rotation. KQMS Stats.

chevreuse-ororon-sara-varesa.desc: Varesa Sara Ororon Chevreuse (C4+). ~23s rot. 7 Plunge Combos (+1 in opening rotation). Opening rotation is different and extended by starting with 1 extra Plunge Combo. Chevreuse uses her hE (only doable with C4+) after 3 Plunge Combos to refresh her RES Shred. Chevreuse is on a healing build. EoSF on Sara is ~1k less DPS. 100% Collisions.

alhaitham-raiden-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Deepwood XQ; Option to weave NAs during setup (on); Energy drops based on 12-3 Icewind Suite; KurtC except the LoFI; Random frame delays with min and max - swap: 6-18, mean 10.5, stddev 1.5; other actions: 0-6, mean 3, stddev 1.

albedo-furina-kazuha-neuvillette.desc: Albedo can provide some minor interrupt resist with Crystallize. DPS-wise, Albedo is similar to Zhongli, making up for the loss of Res Shred with his personal DMG. 4GT Albedo is around a 2k DPS loss.

chevreuse-mavuika-ororon-raiden.desc: Raiden Mavuika Ororon Chevreuse. ~23s rotation, both Mavuika and Raiden use their entire burst duration. Raiden does 5N1CD N1C, doing 4N4D is dps neutral but results in lower raiden damage contribution. R5 catch is ~1k worse than R1 deathmatch

escoffier-furina-rosaria-yelan.desc: Yelan Furina Escoffier Rosaria. 22s rot. On-field Yelan N4D. Rosaria 3E per rot.

chevreuse-hutao-mavuika-ororon.desc: Hutao Chevreuse Mavuika Ororon. ~19s Rot. Hutao Mavuika Dual DPS. Hutao bursts when ready, needed to conserve stamina. Mavuika does Q2C2D to fill time. Full EM Ororon. Full Healing Chevreuse.

bennett-furina-hutao-yelan.desc: Bennett on full healing build (HP HP HB). Rotation distributes healing to everyone for fanfare generation and survivability. Ocean Hued Clam and Song Of Days Past are interchangeable Bennett sets. Hutao Start HP=1.

bennett-diona-furina-lyney.desc: Lyney vape/melt with Diona. Diona provides 200 EM buff at c6 as well as a shield and healing for more fanfare generation and some melts. Team doesnt work very well against unfreezable enemies

chiori-mualani-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Mualani double Geo vape. Xiangling burst every other rotation (note that guoba might be insufficient in AoE or against mobile enemies), Chiori and Xilonen alternate burst use. Xiangling uses AP and pick up the shard created by the Geos.

arlecchino-furina-xilonen-yelan.desc: Arle Furina Yelan Xilonen. ~23s rot. No Arle Q, 7[N2C] N2 combo. Arle uses ATK/ATK/CRIT.

diona-furina-kazuha-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Diona. 4CA 26s rot. Use Diona hE Q before Furina Q.

furina-luminepyro-neuvillette-xianyun.desc: Neuv Furina Xianyun PMC. 4CA 26s rot. PMC hE for ranged attack. Xianyun 2E per rot.

ayaka-citlali-escoffier-furina.desc: Ayaka Furina Citlali Escoffier. 22s rot. Citlali before Escoffier for better Scroll proc. Citlali E > Escoffier Q E > Ayaka to lower down Ayaka's ER needs. Citlali has 2nd field time between Ayaka's field time to trigger Fav.

fischl-furina-lynette-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Fischl Lynette. 4CA 26s rot. In the 1st half, you need to use Fischl's Burst (instead of Skill), previous rot's Oz is still active. It works for Pre-C4 Lynette.

bennett-emilie-mavuika-ororon.desc: Mavuika Emilie Ororon Bennett with random delays. Mavuika does 6C2D combo + 2 charged attacks out of burst to maximize her field time. Emilie does not burst. Ororon builds full EM after his high ER needs are met.

kinich-nahida-ororon-yelan.desc: Kinich Nahida Yelan Ororon. ~19s Rot. Kinich with Hyperbloom Ororon. Kinich seeks blindspots. No Kinich short hold is -3K DPS. Nahida's burst is a DPS loss.

furina-klee-xilonen-yelan.desc: Klee 2Hydro Vape with Xilonen. Klee does 5N1C first rot and 6N1C after, vaping ~75% of her CAs. Yelan 2E and Xilo burst + 2E rotation makes ER reqs relatively low. Pyro scroll on 1st rotation only.

furina-kazuha-neuvillette-xiangling.desc: Neuv Furina with Xiangling. Xiangling+pyro absorb Kazuha burst enable some vapes, but not much. Amount of vapes can increase significantly with double hit Xiangling. 27s 4CA rotation.

citlali-furina-neuvillette-xianyun.desc: Neuv Furina Citlali Xianyun. 4CA 26s rot. Xianyun doesn't use E before Q and uses it only once between Neuv field time to reduce her field time and maximize Furina Q uptime on Neuv.

chevreuse-clorinde-fischl-xiangling.desc: Clorinde Chev OL w/ Fischl and Xiangling. 16s rotation. Xiangling burst every other rotation to keep rotation length short and reduce ER needs.

clorinde-fischl-furina-nahida.desc: Clorinde Fischl Furina Nahida. 4TF 25s rot. w/o using clorinde burst. assuming you use her E when over 100% BoL not spamming N3E and Fischl can steal hyperbloom with small enemy size. 4TotM on furina is slightly better

bennett-fischl-hutao-yelan.desc: Hu Tao overvape. 18s 1 Yelan E 2 Bennett E rotation. Hutao starting HP=1.

furina-hutao-jean-yelan.desc: Double E Yelan rotation. First rotation does not VV pyro. Hutao start HP = 10000.

escoffier-furina-shenhe-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Furina Shenhe Escoffier. Shenhe 2 tE 23s rot. 5[N3CJ] N3 Q or C.

citlali-furina-hutao-yelan.desc: Hutao Furina Yelan Citlali. ~21s Rot. VapeMelt Hutao with PAmber Healing Bonus Citlali. E 8N1CJ N2CJ N1 Hutao. 2E Yelan. Freeze immunity is -3K DPS.

furina-luminepyro-neuvillette-sucrose.desc: Neuv Furina Sucrose PMC. 4CA 26s rot. PMC hE for ranged attack. Sucrose ER sands Burst every rot for C6 DMG Bonus and PAmber healing.

clorinde-fischl-kirara-xiangling.desc: TF Clorinde quickburn with Kirara. 25s~ rotation, everyone use 2 skills per rotation. Kirara doesn't burst. High quicken uptime.

escoffier-furina-neuvillette-ororon.desc: Neuv Furina Escoffier Ororon. 4CA 26s rot. Ororon can trigger both Cryo and Hydro Scroll.

furina-neuvillette-ororon-xianyun.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Xianyun. 4CA 26s rot. Xianyun EPQ > Furina Q > Neuv C E C Q. You can instead build more ER on Xianyun and do Furina Q > Xianyun Q > Neuv C Q E C.

fischl-kazuha-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Yae Fischl Agg 25s Rot. Yae does higher dmg than Fischl first rotation and in AOE situations. Swaps to Nahida 3 times per rotation for near 100% hakushin ring and instructor uptime.

kokomi-luminedendro-nahida-nilou.desc: Nilou Bloom with Kokomi Nahida and Ins DMC

escoffier-furina-luminepyro-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Escoffier PMC. 4CA 26s rot. PMC hE for ranged attack. Escoffier Q every rot. PMC enters the field to trigger Fav between Neuv field time.

arlecchino-bennett-furina-kazuha.desc: Arlecchino-Furina vape. Furina sees the field every other rotation. KQMS stats.

escoffier-furina-lanyan-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Escoffier Lan Yan. 4CA 27s rot. C6 Lan Yan rotation. Lan Yan 2[E] > Escoffier EQ > Furina Q > Neuv C E C Q covers both of the CA part and expires right before Neuv Q cast.

kazuha-neuvillette-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Neuv vape, 28s 4CA rotation. Xiangling burst provides pyro for first half of the rotation and Guoba+Kazuha burst for the second half. Timings might be tight for Hydro swirl on second half. Xiangling picks up crystallize twice for AP. Second crystallize might be unreliable and depends on Zhongli pillar hitting.

emilie-mavuika-mualani-xilonen.desc: Mualani Emilie Mavuika Xilonen. 32s rot. 3[3-stacked bites]. Everyone Q every 2rots. Mavuika triggers hydro scroll only in the first rot.

fischl-nahida-sethos-xilonen.desc: Sethos Nahida Fischl Xilonen. ~15-16s Rot. Sethos Aggravate. Different first rotation so that Electro Crystallize can be generated. Xilonen never bursts. Nahida dashes for crystallize.

bennett-furina-gaming-yelan.desc: Yelan does not do 2 E's. Gaming does 6 Ep N1. Ingame, press Skill after attacking and catch or almost catch Man Chai before plunging.

arlecchino-bennett-xilonen-yunjin.desc: Arle YunJin Xilonen Bennett. 16s rot. No Arle Q C 6[N3D]. 4Husk (instead of 4AP) Yunjin is 6k loss.

chasca-escoffier-furina-ororon.desc: Chasca Escoffier Furina Ororon. ~34s rotation. Chasca does 4CA(6) + CA(4) and ends with her Burst in the first phase of the rotation. Furina and Escoffier Burst once per rotation. Ororon Bursts twice per rotation. Chasca on VV + Scion is ~2.5k less DPS against freezable enemies and about ~5k less DPS against unfreezable ones. Chain Breaker + Codex is ~1.5k less DPS against unfreezable enemies.

bennett-lanyan-mavuika-ororon.desc: Mavuika Bennett Lan Yan Ororon. ~19s rot. Mono Pyro Mavuika with Ororon as the Fighting spirit generator instead of Xilonen. Uses 5[C2D] combo . 2p Scroll/Emblem for Benett's ER issues. NO Benett is +2k DPS.

bennett-chasca-chevreuse-citlali.desc: Chasca Citlali Chev Bennett. 16-17s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Not having Chev C6 is 10k(13%) DPS loss. Chasca prefers Pyro% Goblet.

alhaitham-fischl-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Deepwood XQ; Energy drops based on 12-3 Icewind Suite; KurtC; Customized random frame delays. Options for LoFI & HoD and Deepwood Alhaitham in config.

arlecchino-bennett-chevreuse-ororon.desc: Arle Chevy Ororon Bennett. 16s rotation. Ororon is a significant downgrade over Fischl in this team due to overall worse damage and energy production that scroll buff doesn't make up for. Arle E > Ororon EQ > Bennett EQ > Chevy Q hE N1 > Arle CA 6N3d.

candace-mualani-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Mualani Candace (C5-) Xilonen Xiangling. 13 and 17s rot with Xiangling and Candace Burst every other rotation. When Guoba is used for Pyro application, Candace does not use her Burst to not steal the Pyro aura. 4pc AP on Xiangling is a big increase. You lose ~6k DPS w/o 4pc AP proc here. Candace's Instructor only procs every other rotation. Using Favonius on Xiangling leads to lower team DPS but higher Mualani DPS since Candace can build more HP for her passive. Candace's C6 is a ~4.5k DPS loss.

alhaitham-fischl-lisa-nahida.desc: Alhaitham spread with Fischl+Lisa, well optimized. Using some variance in swap delay (see config). Also no healing or damage mitigation + Harbinger of Dawn, good luck.

furina-lisa-lynette-neuvillette.desc: "cheaper" variant of neuvis hypercarry team with furina. rot works with pre-c4 lynette. pamber lisa burst and lynette skill before furina burst for better uptime at the price of losing some fanfare.

clorinde-sara-xilonen-yunjin.desc: Clorinde Hypercarry w/ Sara YunJin Xilonen. Two separate 16s rotations (or a large 32s rotation). YunJin splits up her Skill and Burst in between Xilonen's field time to ensure that 3 Crystallizes occur each 16s rotation in order to max Clorinde's A1.

arlecchino-bennett-candace-xilonen.desc: Arle Candace Xilonen Bennett. 16s rot. No Arle Q C 6[N3D]. Candace can trigger 2pc scroll thanks to Xilonen, using only 1E per rot, reducing rot length

fischl-nahida-neuvillette-raiden.desc: Neuv HB with Fischl as flex. Team does marginally more HB damage than Neuv damage. 4CA ~26s rot.

fischl-mavuika-nahida-sethos.desc: Sethos Nahida Fischl Mavuika. ~16 Rot. Sethos looses a Shadowpeircing shot at the start of the chamber and 2 after a second skill at the end of his burst. Mavuika bursts every other rotation. Nahida fills time for Sethos skill CD on subsequent rotations.

bennett-mavuika-wriothesley-xilonen.desc: [MEME] Wrio Mavuika Xilonen Bennett. 18s rot. 4[N3CJ] w/o using Wrio Q. Pyro Scroll. Mavuika Q melt w/ Bennett buffed + 5CAs after Q. "Technically" N3C combo can melt a bit like this sim but its not reliable so if Cryo overtakes Pyro earlier, swap to Mavuika.

arlecchino-bennett-layla-rosaria.desc: Arlecchino Melt. 17s rotation. This rotation is somewhat reliant on C6 Layla for cryo application

furina-luminepyro-lynette-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Lynette PMC. 4CA 25s rot. PMC hE for ranged attack. Lynette 2E and requires Lynette C4.

bennett-furina-kazuha-xianyun.desc: Kazuha Furina Bennett Xianyun. ~19s Rot. Kazaha Vapeplunge, VV-less. Kazuha uses tap skill off CD and bursts if available at the end of the rotation to vape during the downtime. 100% collisions for E plunges, 70% for starwicker plunges. OHC > SoDP > Scroll Xianyun, but Bubbles may miss.

emilie-fischl-mavuika-sethos.desc: Sethos Emilie Fischl Mavuika. ~16 Rot. Sethos Quickburn. Sethos looses a Shadowpeircing shot at the start of the chamber and 2 after a second skill at the end of his burst. Mavuika bursts every other rotation. Mavuika fills time for Sethos skill CD on subsequent rotations when she can burst.

mavuika-navia-ororon-xilonen.desc: Navia Mavuika Ororon Xilonen. ~19s Rot. SubDPS Navia with On field Mavuika. Mavuika Q 4CD ED. Navia uses an extra skill every 3rd rotation. Xilonen uses burst every rotation. Xilonen uses skill twice per rotation, particles funneled to Navia. Navia also catches Mavuika's skill particles, funneled *over* Xilonen.

arlecchino-chevreuse-fischl-xiangling.desc: Arlecchino Chevreuse Fischl Xiangling. ~16s Rot. Arlechinno Overload with Xiangling providing buffs. Arlecchino 5N3 N3. Xiangling uses burst every other rotation.

fischl-nahida-xiangling-yaemiko.desc: Yae Nahida Fischl Xiangling. ~25s Rot. Yae Quickburn. Yae uses burst every rotation after 3N1CD to regen stamina. Constant Electro application from Yae & Fischl skills leads to high Overload count accross the team, as full EM Xiangling uses skill twice per rotation. Nahida uses burst every rotation.

clorinde-fischl-kazuha-yaoyao.desc: Aggravate Clorinde (FoHW) w/ Fischl Kazuha Yao Yao. Yao Yao's low maintenance and skill-based Dendro application makes her a great carrier of TotM for this team.

mualani-nahida-xiangling-yelan.desc: Mualani burn vape. 2 vaped Yelan E rotation, all of her particles go to Mualani so she can burst every rotation.

aethergeo-furina-kazuha-neuvillette.desc: Hyper Neuvilette with Geo MC who increases interruption resistance, crit by 10% and 35% dmg from 4 pc AP

arlecchino-bennett-sucrose-xilonen.desc: Arle Sucrose Xilonen Bennett. 16s rot. No Arle Q. N1C 5[N3D] N4. Xilonen and Sucrose comes after Bennett Q. Sucrose Q every 2rots. TTDS proc every 2rots.

baizhu-furina-kazuha-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Baizhu. 4CA 27s rot. Baizhu with only 1E, reducing rotation length. Use Baizhu EQ before Furina Q to maximize Furina Q uptime on Neuv.

bennett-gaming-layla-rosaria.desc: Gaming Melt 20s rotation with a shield. 2 sources of cryo app makes the team easier/more consistent to play. Subsequent rotations include + 3s of funneling.

amber-furina-gaming-xianyun.desc: Gaming Furina Xianyun Amber. 21s rot. Favmen. Elegy isn't particularly better than Fav. Copied from the sim using C6 Chev instead of Amber: https://gcsim.app/db/qpHRrCLThtQn

arlecchino-bennett-emilie-kazuha.desc: Arle Emilie Kazuha Bennett. No Arle Q 16s rot. Both Emilie and Kazuha on Bennett Q. Emilie Q if ready and if she didn't use her Q, use Kazuha Q.

charlotte-furina-kazuha-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Charlotte. 4CA 26-27s rot. Charlotte Q every rot healing everyone.

alhaitham-raiden-xingqiu-yaoyao.desc: Alhaitham hyperbloom team with yaoyao 21s rotation. KQMS stats. Improved config for better deepwood coverage. Yaoyao E -> XQ EDQN -> Alhaitham QN -> Raiden EN -> Alhaitham onfield. Easy to play as long as ping is low.

arlecchino-bennett-kaeya-lynette.desc: arle melt with C6 kaeya. very precise. works with C0 lynette

bennett-mavuika-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Mavuika Xilonen Bennett Xianyun. ~18s Rot. Mavuika pure Pyro Plunge with Xianyun. Mavuika Q 8[JhPD] 2CD CD. 7 plunges are covered by Xianyun's VV. Burstless Xilonen.

chasca-chevreuse-furina-ororon.desc: Chasca Furina Ororon Chev, 16s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b]. Chasca & Furina Q every 2 rot. 4NO Healer build Chev. The HPS(Healing Per Sec) is 3K here. Even with more rotations, the DPS falls by just 1k. Not having Chev C6 is ~10k(12%) DPS loss.

furina-kazuha-kokomi-yelan.desc: Kokomi mono hydro. Alternates Kokomi dash and walk cancels. 2 Yelan E rotation; Optimized first rotation

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-hutao.desc: Hutao Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~17s Rot. Hutao Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. Hu Tao overload with Chevreuse. Hutao E N3CJ 5N2CJ N3C(JQ/JN3CJ). Hutao bursts if available.

bennett-hutao-kazuha-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Yelan VV Vape . 19s 1 Vaporized Yelan E Very energy demanding rotation pray your favs proc. Hutao Start HP = 1.

fischl-kuki-nahida-yelan.desc: High Quicken uptime Kuki Hyperbloom with Desynced rotation to accommodate Fischl's cooldowns

kazuha-neuvillette-ororon-xilonen.desc: Neuv Ororon Kazuha Xilonen. 4CA 28s rot. Ororon triggers Scroll, so Xilonen can hold 4AP. Team Fav weapons lower Neuv ER needs.

furina-navia-sigewinne-xilonen.desc: Navia Xilonen Sigewinne Furina. ~20s rot. 2 Xilonen Skills per rot. Xilonen and Sigewinne don't use their Bursts. Crystallize picked up on every Dash + twice during Xilonen's Skill fieldtime (for a total of 11 Crystallize pickup attempts). Navia does her N2D combo (picking up Crystallizes often). Navia always uses tap Skill. Navia uses an extra Skill at the end of every third rotation.

arlecchino-furina-xianyun-yelan.desc: Arle Furina Yelan Xianyun. Yelan 2E 24s rot. No Arle Q. 8[N1JhP] N1 with 50% collision rate.

clorinde-collei-fischl-kazuha.desc: Aggravate Clorinde (FoHW) w/ Fischl Kazuha Collei. Collei provides consistent Dendro application to maintain Quicken. Instructor Collei also works, it's ~400 DPS behind.

chevreuse-mavuika-ororon-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Mavuika dual carry with Chev and Ororon. Mavuika does Q 2C2D before Yoimiya takes the field. Yoimiya burst when ready. HP build chev.

furina-jean-neuvillette-zhongli.desc: Neuvillette-Furina with Resistance to Interruption 4CA rotation

fischl-furina-navia-xilonen.desc: Navia Xilonen Fischl Furina.~21s rot. Use Navia 3rd E if available. 2 Xilonen E. ATK% Goblet on Navia.

baizhu-furina-mualani-xiangling.desc: Mualani burn vape. 20s rotation Mualani bursts every rotation. Baizhu provides more healing and comfort than Nahida however less dendro app causes less consistent vapes Baizhu also lacks Nahida's EM buff. Energy based on lv100 icewind suite.

bennett-furina-gaming-zhongli.desc: Gaming plunges 9 times. To do this ingame, Press E immediately after Q and each plunge. Wait till Man Chai is extremely close to you, then plunge.

fischl-mavuika-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Yae Nahida Fischl Mavuika. ~25s Rot. Yae Quickburn. Yae uses burst every rotation after 3N1CD to regen stamina. Full EM Mavuika uses QE. Nahida uses burst every rotation.

fischl-nahida-sucrose-yaemiko.desc: Yae Fischl aggravate. No healing or shielding. Swap to sucrose multiple times to refresh buffs and proc c4 skill cooldown reduction

furina-kazuha-neuvillette-sigewinne.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Sigewinne. 4CA 26s rot. Sigewinne uses her E between Furina Q and Neuv's first field time.

chasca-furina-mavuika-sigewinne.desc: Chasca Furina Sigewinne Mavuika. 20s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready.

mualani-xiangling-xilonen-zhongli.desc: Mualani vape with Shield. Mualani and Xiangling burst every other Mualani skill. Xilonen and Zhongli never burst. When Mualani bursts, she skips her third NA. Assumes burst hits almost Instantly,

citlali-furina-lynette-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Citlali Lynette. 4CA 25s rot. For pre-C4 Lynette, skip her 1st E and build more ER on her.

bennett-dehya-emilie-kinich.desc: Kinich Emilie Dehya Bennett. ~18s Rot. E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo with consistently NA clockwise. 5 Quickscope Scalespiker Cannon Combo with Interruption Resistance. No Kinich short can leads to missed a cannon shots, resulting in significant DPS loss. Dehya uses SacGS to lower her skill cd for a shorter rotation. KQMS Stats.

emilie-fischl-xiangling-yaemiko.desc: Yae Emilie Fischl Xiangling. ~25s Rot. Yae Quickburn. Yae uses burst every rotation after 3N1CD to regen stamina. Constant Electro application from Yae & Fischl skills leads to high Overload count, as Xiangling uses skill twice per rotation.

bennett-chevreuse-clorinde-sara.desc: Clorinde Sara Bennett Chevreuse.  ~13s opener + ~16s ongoing rot with higher emphasis on Clroinde's personal DMG.  Sara and Chev both funnel to clorinde to help with her steep er needs. Using ER sands on Clorinde and bursting every rot is ≥ using Clorinde's burst every other rot. Team/Rotation is not recommended on high ping.

furina-lanyan-neuvillette-ororon.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Lan Yan. 4CA 25s rot. Requiring Lan Yan C6+Sac Fragments. Simply use her E right before Neuv field times.

kinich-nahida-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Kinich Nahida Raiden Xingqiu. ~21s Rot. Kinich Hyperbloom from range accounting for distance (ommiting Xingqiu's rainswords during his combo). Kinich bursts every other rotation. No short hold E on Kinich is -6K DPS. Nahida fills time after Kinich's field time.

chevreuse-furina-hutao-yelan.desc: Hu Tao double hydro. Chevreuse provides healing and pyro dmg% to Hu Tao. 2 Yelan E 21s Rotation. Hutao Bursts on the first and last rotation only. Hutao Start HP 80%.

bennett-chevreuse-gaming-rosaria.desc: Gaming Rosaria Bennett Chevreuse. ~19s Rot. Gaming Melt with Triple Pyro. Gaming waits on the ground between plunges, timed to catch Manchai while descending for the juggle.

arlecchino-bennett-lynette-rosaria.desc: arle melt; simple N3D combo with extra N1 at the end, fieldtime is split so rosa can reapply cryo with E. rot works with C0 lynette. timings are strict for consistency since solo cryo applier w/o assistance from lynette cryo burst, so ymmv depending on skill & content faced. C2+ lynette Q after rosa EQ makes melt very consistent but ER reqs are atrocious.

alhaitham-kirara-nilou-xingqiu.desc: Alhaitham Nilou Xingqiu Kirara. 24s rot. Nilou Bloom with Alhaitham on-field against 2 targets. Split uptime rotation with dash cancels instead of jump cancels. Alhaitham picks up the Sapwood Leaf. Kirara on HP build for maximum shield. Xiphos refinements help Alhaitham to build less ER or end his second uptime earlier for higher DPS over several rotations (+2.2k DPS).

fischl-kinich-nahida-ororon.desc: Kinich double Electro double Dendro quicken. Nahida and Kinich alternate burst use. Nahida uses some CAs to fill time. Kinich spins to catch blindspots and uses short hold E, gets 3 canons per skill.

furina-neuvillette-shenhe-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Xilonen Shenhe. 4CA 26s rot. Shenhe hold E provides 15% CA DMG Bonus to Neuv via her A4. 4AP on her is ~3.5k(~4%) increase. 4MH or 4BS can be good for Fav proc increasing CR.

emilie-neuvillette-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Emilie does not burst, only skill's after Zhongli has held E. Deepwood using Zhongli is easy to maintain as he refreshes using tap E after Neuv does 2 Charge attacks. Wish u luck farming EM/EM/Crit AP set for Xiangling!

furina-neuvillette-sayu-zhongli.desc: Neuvillette-Furina with Resistance to Interruption 4CA rotation

arlecchino-bennett-kazuha-rosaria.desc: Arlecchino melt with Rosaria. Very precise. Uses a Rosaria skill mid Arlecchino combo to reapply cryo. KQMS stats.

clorinde-fischl-lynette-nahida.desc: Clorinde with Lynette for VV Shred and Taunt. Lynette splits her Skill and Burst first half to maximize VV uptime. EM and ATK% sands perform similarly on her.

bennett-chasca-mavuika-ororon.desc: Chasca Ororon Mavuika Bennett. 18s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Pyro Goblet is 1% better than ATK% Goblet.

kokomi-nahida-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Xingqiu E d Q N1, Nahida E N1 Q N1C, Raiden E N1, Kokomi E N1, Nahida E 3N3CJ N3, Kokomi Q N1, Nahida E N3CJ N1C

clorinde-fischl-heizou-nahida.desc: FoHW Clorinde Aggravate w/ Heizou. 16s rotations. Alternative Anemo to Kazuha and Sucrose.

furina-lynette-neuvillette-zhongli.desc: variation of neuv - furi hypercarry with lynette on HB% for fanfare. rot also works for pre-c4 lynette.

arlecchino-bennett-lanyan-xilonen.desc: Arle Lan Yan Xilonen Bennett. 16s rot. No Arle Q. N2C 6[N3D]. N2 before CA for E mark 5s condition. The 1st rot has 69k, 2 rots has 72k DPS

bennett-furina-lynette-lyney.desc: Lyney vape with Lynette. 1st rotation swirls pyro ingame but not in sim because weapon swirl is not implemented. Lyney 6C and Burst every rotation.

clorinde-furina-xilonen-yelan.desc: Clorinde Double Hydro (Furina Yelan Xilonen).  21s rotation. A lot of NA weaving to maximize Yelan's Burst.

furina-neuvillette-xianyun-zhongli.desc: Zhongli provides resistance to interruption and 4AP buffs. Xianyun provides healing, 4VV, and energy. Slightly worse than Jean due to Xianyun's longer animations

emilie-mualani-xiangling-yelan.desc: Mualani burn vape. 2 vaped Yelan E rotation, all of her particles go to Mualani so she can burst every rotation. Particle drop HP threshold based on 12-3 Icewind Suite (250% HP Multiplier).

furina-kazuha-neuvillette-shenhe.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Shenhe. 4CA 26s rot. Shenhe hold E provides 15% CA DMG Bonus to Neuv via her A4. Here, her hE is used before Kazuha to allow ~1s more generous VV uptime but using it before Furina Q also works and it's not that different.

alhaitham-kuki-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Alhaitham double hydro. Split uptime 2 Yelan E rotation. Very low quicken uptime and Alhaitham damage. Kuki Start HP: 30%.

arlecchino-chevreuse-fischl-yelan.desc: Arle Yelan Fischl Chev. 18s rot. No Arle Q, 5[N3C] N3. Chev can provide ATK% and C6 DMG bonus. The 1st rotation has 67.5k DPS, and the 2 rotations has 73.5k DPS.

escoffier-furina-mualani-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Furina Escoffier Mualani. 20s rot. 5[N3CJ] N4 Q or C. 4Scroll TTDS Mualani.

baizhu-nahida-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Raiden Xingqiu Nahida Baizhu. Baizhu 2E 22s rot. this 2E helps raiden to have enough energy w/o ER sands. Raiden on-field hyperbloom. it is crucial to weav NAs between actions for XQ's Q proc

kazuha-mavuika-mualani-xilonen.desc: Mualani Kazuha Xilonen Mavuika. 18s rot. 3[3-stacked bites]. Mavuika C0. Mualani and Xilonen alternates their burst. Mavuika Q every rot.

citlali-emilie-neuvillette-xiangling.desc: Neuv Citlali Emilie Xiangling. 4CA 27s rot. Citlali provides a bit of shield and has option for good vertical investments.

escoffier-freminet-furina-yelan.desc: Freminet Furian Yelan Escoffier. ~23s Rot. Cryo Shatter Freminet with Escoffier. 2E Yelan. Freminet does a lvl 1 Shattering Pressure before Yelan uses burst and does an abbreviated burst between Yelan skills. Yelan's burst lasts into Furina's skill in the next rotation.

fischl-kazuha-kirara-yaemiko.desc: Yae, Fischl, Kazuha, Kirara - Ur gonna have significantly worse results ingame because first rotation dps is lower and u'd likely kill enemies in one and a half rotation

chevreuse-clorinde-xiangling-yaemiko.desc: Overload Clorinde w/ Yae Miko, Xiangling and Chevreuse. 16s Rotation. XL uses her Burst every other rotation. Chevreuse builds towards damage instead of HP, since her increased personal damage contributes more than what additional ATK% her A4 buff would provide.

hutao-lisa-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Hutao Over vape with Double Hydro and Lisa

fischl-sucrose-tighnari-yaemiko.desc: Yae Fischl aggravate with Tighnari to enable quicken and do some dmg. Yae tighnari and sucrose share field time

chongyun-escoffier-furina-yelan.desc: Yelan Furina Escoffier Chongyun. 21s rot. On-field Yelan. NA spam

bennett-furina-xianyun-yelan.desc: c0 pyro furina vape plunge. her own application together with yelan enable vapes. using NAs between plunges perform worse because it take significantly more time than dash.

fischl-kokomi-nahida-raiden.desc: fischl NE - nahida NEQ - kokomi NED - raiden NE - kokomi 3N2C N2 - fischl NQ - kokomi N2CN2 Q 10N2W N2

ororon-varesa-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Varesa Ororon Xianyun Xilonen. 18s rot. 7 Plunge Combos. 100% Collisions.

baizhu-clorinde-fischl-kazuha.desc: Clorinde Fischl Kazhua Baizhu. ~24s Rot. Baizhu with scroll and Clorinde TF team. Hakushin buffs does not buff Fischl.

fischl-nahida-raiden-yelan.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Nahida Yelan Fischl

clorinde-fischl-nahida-thoma.desc: Clorinde Nahida Fischl Thoma. ~26s Rot. TF Clorinde Quickburn. Clorinde closes the rotation with burst. Deepwood Thoma maximizes Nahida's damage. Nahida skips burst sans ER.

kazuha-sara-varesa-xilonen.desc: Varesa Sara Kazuha Xilonen. ~13-15s rot. 4 Plunge Combos (+1 in opening rotation). Skipping Xilonen's Q is ~2k more DPS. NO and TotM on Sara are ~6k less DPS. 100% Collisions.

alhaitham-nilou-xingqiu-yaoyao.desc: Marechaussee Hunter Alhaitham in Nilou bloom team. KQMS. Yaoyao E -> Nilou EN2E -> Alhaitham Q swap XQ QN -> Alhaitham longest combo -> XQ EDN2.

fischl-kazuha-neuvillette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Fischl Kazuha Xilonen. 4CA 27s rot. Assuming 2nd Xilonen E being mostly hydro scroll. Check out the samples to see how the setup works, noting that Oz has ~12s duration.

furina-mavuika-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Mavuika Furina Xilonen Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Mavuika Pyro Vape Plunge with Xianyun. Mavuika Q 8[JhPD] CD; Zero attempts made to delay actions for Hydro aura; Mavuika plunges have standard ICD. 7 plunges are covered by Xianyun's VV. Xilonen uses burst every rotation. Xilonen reliably Scrolls Pyro & Hydro at the start of every rotation. and either element later in the rotation.

furina-kokomi-mavuika-yelan.desc: Kokomi Furina Yelan Mavuika. ~21s Rot. Kokomi uses her skill before Furina and refreshes it with her burst, which is sandwiched by Yelan skills. Mavuika provides vaped SubDPS and Scroll after Yelan uses her burst. Not hyperoptimized.

furina-navia-xianyun-zhongli.desc: Navia does not hold E, only taps it. 4 High plunges per E, 50% collision. Furina swap in between Navia E's to proc Fav.

furina-kazuha-mika-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Mika. 4CA 26-27s rot. Mika Q every rot healing everyone.

arlecchino-kaeya-xilonen-yunjin.desc: Arlecchino Kaeya Xilonen YunJin. Arlecchino with C6 Kaeya Melt. 6N3D combo. 16s rot. No Arle Q. C2+ Arle needs a different rotation.

bennett-fischl-navia-xilonen.desc: Navia Fischl Xilonen Bennett. Xilonen 1E 17-18s rot. Start with Bennett E dash for the scroll setup in the first rot. Navia keep herself on-field w/o swapping out.

bennett-mavuika-ningguang-xilonen.desc: Tight 18s rot, Ningguang, Xilonen, Mavuika, Bennett. Expects crystalise to be picked up for Geo resonance and Nighttimes set. Xilonen 2E per rot and no burst. Ningguang does much more damage than Mavuika here. Ningguang prefers geo% over atk% goblet by ~2k dps. Mavuika ult + 2CA inside Bennett Q before Ningguang field time.

chevreuse-diluc-furina-xianyun.desc: Diluc Xianyun Furina Chevreuse. Diluc Vape Plunge with Xianyun VV swirling Pyro off of Chevreuse. Diluc uses burst before plunging. 100% Collisions.

fischl-furina-luminepyro-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Fischl PMC. 4CA 25s rot. PMC hE for ranged attack.

furina-neuvillette-ororon-zhongli.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Zhongli. 4CA 26s rot. Zhongli takes 2nd field time between Neuv field time using tE for Sac Jade passive, picking up Hydro Shards for 4AP, and Fav proc.

furina-kazuha-kirara-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Kirara. 4CA 27-28s rotation. Kirara provides 12+12% DMG Bonus from her C6 and 4pc Scroll, with her shield for Interruption to resistance.

fischl-kuki-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with 4DW Xingqiu and 4Ins Nahida. Enemy radius=3

clorinde-fischl-furina-kazuha.desc: Clorinde Fischl Kazuha Furina. 17s rotation. Furina and Kazuha alternate their Bursts each rotation to reduce ER requirements and rotation length.

gaming-rosaria-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Gaming Rosaria Xilonen Xianyun. ~21s Rot. Gaming does 6 melted plunges + 1non reacted plunge (for energy), slower plunges after the first 4. Scroll covers 5 plunges and Xilonen's RES shred covers 6.

arlecchino-bennett-kazuha-xiangling.desc: Arle mono pyro w Xiangling for c1 and c6 buffs as well as some dmg. Xiangling bursts every other rotation 16s rotation N3D combo.

arlecchino-bennett-chiori-zhongli.desc: Arle Chiori Zhongli Bennett. 16s rot (very tight). No Arle Q, 3[N5D] N3. chiori's short field time allows bennett to catch arle E particles. no 4AP is about 3k behind.

bennett-emilie-ganyu-mavuika.desc: Ganyu Emilie Mavuika Bennett. ~18s rot. Ganyu Melt. 6 aimed 100% weakspot hits. -4K DPS with Chainbreaker and no weakspot hits. Ganyu uses burst if available. Mauvika uses burst if available and funnels partices to Bennett.

alhaitham-baizhu-nilou-xingqiu.desc: Marechaussee Hunter Alhaitham in Nilou bloom team with Baizhu as healer. KQMS. Alhaitham uses split fieldtime combo to accomodate 2 baizhu's skills (and favonius).

arlecchino-bennett-kazuha-zhongli.desc: Arle mono pyro w a shield. 15/16s rotation N3D combo. Funell Arle skill particles to bennett. Alternates Kazuha skill and burst usage

bennett-furina-gaming-sigewinne.desc: Gaming Furina Bennett Sigewinne. ~20s Rot. Gaming Vaporize ft. Sigewinne. Gaming does Q7EP with a delay before every skill, intended to catch Man Chai in midair. Sigewinne just does EN1. Sigewinne offers enough energy for a damage weapon on Furina. Near 100% Vape consistency.

furina-luminepyro-neuvillette-zhongli.desc: Neuv Furina Zhongli PMC. 4CA 26s rot. PMC hE for ranged attack. 4AP Zhongli triggering it twice for two Neuv field time, both of his field time can use his hE to refresh shield.

fischl-furina-jean-neuvillette.desc: Neuvillette Electrocharge with no interruption resistance - Unoptimised random delay sim - 2-4 frames delay between non-bufferable actions, 9-15 frames of swap delay

chongyun-diluc-nahida-xianyun.desc: Diluc Chongyun Nahida Xianyun. ~16s Rot. Diluc Melt Plunge. Uses Diluc E to (re)establish Burning aura to Melt plunge. Nahida bursts every other rotation. Chongyun uses E before Xianyun. 50% Collisions.

fischl-hutao-xilonen-yelan.desc: Hutao Yelan Fischl Xilonen. ~18s Rot. Hutao Overvape with 9N2CJ Hutao. No burst Hutao or Xilonen.

bennett-gaming-rosaria-zhongli.desc: Plunge fast after Rosaria bursts, but slower after 4 plunges, in order to keep up with the slow cryo application Rosaria has. Bennett does his skill before Zhongli in first rotation to apply pyro.

arlecchino-bennett-chevreuse-kazuha.desc: Arle mono pyro w chevreuse for c6 and small amt of dmg. 15/16s rotation N3D combo. Funell Arle skill particles to bennett. Alternates Kazuha skill and burst usage

bennett-emilie-kinich-zhongli.desc: Kinich Emilie Zhongli Bennett. 18s rot. E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo with consistently NA clockwise. Assuming Zhongli pillar consistently hit the enemy for 4Deepwood.

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-yaemiko.desc: Yae Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~16s Rot. An easier on-field Yae Rotation. Bennett funnels DPS Chevreuse and bookends Chev A1 RES shred for on-field Yae. Fischl alternate skill and burst just after Chevreuse.

alhaitham-kuki-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Alhaitham Nahida Xingqiu Kuki. 22s rotation. XQ EDQN -> Kuki Q if ready -> Nahida EN -> Alhaitham Q -> Kuki NE -> Alhaitham 2N3D NE N3D N3C 3N3D N3 (C)

furina-hutao-sucrose-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Yelan Furina team that fits grouping. Prototype Amber Healing Bonus Sucrose as sole healer makes this team very fragile.

bennett-chiori-lyney-xilonen.desc: Lyney Bennett Chiori Xilonen. 16s rotation. Lyney does 5 CA or 6 if burst isn't available. Chiori's C1 is around 11% team dps increase.

escoffier-eula-furina-yelan.desc: Eula Furina Yelan Escoffier. ~23s Rot. Eula Freeze Shatter Double Hydro. 2E Yelan passes particles to Eula twice. -5K DPS with Freeze immunity.

fischl-nahida-xilonen-yaemiko.desc: On field Yae aggravate with optional healing. Swaps to Nahida and Xilonen multiple times to refresh buffs as well as to Fischl for full uptime.

chevreuse-kazuha-varesa-xilonen.desc: Varesa Chevreuse Kazuha Xilonen. ~16s rot. 6 Plunge Combos. Chevreuse is on a healing build. NO on Chevreuse is ~4.5k less DPS. Not having C6 Chevreuse is ~10k less DPS. 100% Collisions.

arlecchino-bennett-xilonen-zhongli.desc: Arle Zhongli Xilonen Bennett. 16s rot. No Arle Q. C 3[N5D] N1. Xilonen and Zhongli comes after Bennett Q.

bennett-furina-gaming-xingqiu.desc: Gaming does 6 Ep N1. Juggle Man-Chai's ingame by pressing Skill after attacking and catching/almost catching it before plunging.

emilie-mavuika-ororon-sethos.desc: Sethos Emilie Mavuika Ororon. ~16s Rot. Defenseless Sethos Quickburn. Full EM Ororon & Mavuika & EM goblet Sethos. Emilie and Mavuika burst every other rotation after the first. Sethos does EQ 8EN2W EC, doing more than one aimed shot at the end to fill time for cds isn't worth the energy cost.

ororon-sara-varesa-xilonen.desc: Varesa Sara Ororon Xilonen. 23s rot. 7 Plunge Combos (+1 in opening rotation). Opening rotation starts with 1 extra Plunge Combo. Xilonen refreshes her buffs after 3 Plunge Combos. Skipping Xilonen's Q is ~1.5k more DPS. EoSF on Sara is ~5.5k less DPS. 100% Collisions.

arlecchino-bennett-tartaglia-yelan.desc: Arlecchino Double Hydro with Tartaglia. 5[N3C] N3, 18s rotation. Instructor over scroll on Tartaglia is ~1.5k less dps.

bennett-kazuha-lyney-xiangling.desc: Lyney Monopyro. Xiangling bursts every other rotation.

bennett-furina-luminepyro-xianyun.desc: PMC Furina Bennett Xianyun. ~22s Rot. PMC VapePlunge with VV. Xianyun tries to swirl Pyro after Bennett EQ, & PMC hEQ. Uniformly distributed variable delay up to 1/4th second before plunging. ~57% Vaped plunges. 50% Collisions.

diona-gaming-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Gaming Diona Rosaria Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Melt Gaming with a Cryo Venn diagram. 6 buffed skill plunges melted + 1 unbuffed plunge melted. Mind your Cryo aura, 4 delayed plunges + 2 immediate plunges

arlecchino-bennett-kaeya-rosaria.desc: Arlechinno Rosaria Kaeya Bennett. ~16s Rot. Arlechinno Double Cryo Melt with N3D. Rosaria and Keaya use EQ within Bennett's field & Arlechinno cancels her CA. Works with lower constellations on Keaya.

furina-hutao-kuki-yelan.desc: Hu Tao overvape. First rotation starts with Kuki E whereas subsequent ones don't

fischl-kaveh-raiden-xingqiu.desc: kaveh double electro HB with instructors kaveh, fairly easy rotation for kaveh, only 1 walk cancel, no dash cancels

emilie-mavuika-mualani-nahida.desc: Mualani Emilie Nahida Mavuika. Everyone except Nahida Q every 2rots. 3[3-stacked bite]. Nahida PrototypeAmber for sustain.

bennett-furina-gaming-lanyan.desc: Gaming Furina Lanyan Bennett. ~20s Rot. Gaming catches Man Chai in midair, doing 7 skill plunges with delay to maintain Hydro Aura. The final plunge is unbuffed. Bennett does EQN1; Lanyan skill picks up Pyro and VV swirls Pyro. Lanyan does not burst. Hydro VV is MIA.

fischl-kazuha-neuvillette-ororon.desc: Neuv Ororon Fischl Kazuha. 4CA 26s rot. Fischl deals impressive damage thanks to high Oz uptime and a lot of buffs.

bennett-chasca-escoffier-furina.desc: Chasca Furina Escoffier Bennett. 20s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Escoffier Q every 2 rot. She can be used before Bennett to allow more generous Bennett uptime on Chasca

neuvillette-xiangling-xilonen-zhongli.desc: Neuv Vape with Xiangling Xilonen Zhongli. 4CA 27s rot. AP Xiangling is better than AP Zhongli and EoSF Xiangling. Zhongli barely procs Instructor but better than nothing.

arlecchino-bennett-emilie-xilonen.desc: Arle "Mono Pyro" with Emilie and Xilonen. ~16s rotation. Arle 3[N5D] N1 and no Burst. Setup is just barely long enough for Arle's skill to be upgraded. Bennett dashes for AP after skill & burst.

furina-raiden-xilonen-yelan.desc: Raiden Yelan Furina Xilonen. 21s rot. Xilonen gets both Electro and Hydro Crystallize shards rather consistently.

bennett-citlali-mavuika-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Mavuika Citlali Bennett. 18s rot. No Yoimiya Q. Mavuika Q C Melted on Bennett Q. Yoimiya has poor Bennett uptime and has no access to Melt.

ayato-citlali-escoffier-furina.desc: Ayato Furina Citlali Escoffier. ~25s rot. Citlali uses her Burst after Ayato's 1st Skill. Ayato's 2nd Skill does N14 instead of N15 for ~500 more team DPS at the expense of Ayato's personal DPS.

furina-kazuha-navia-neuvillette.desc: Neuvillette Furina Kazuha Navia. Navia hold E is used for Archaic Petra, Kazuha does not use his burst.

arlecchino-bennett-candace-yelan.desc: Arlechinno Yelan Cadance Bennett. ~19s Rot. Arlechinno Vape with 7N2C. Double Hydro to increase Vape consistency. 1E Yelan & Candace. ER req is still high on Candace.

arlecchino-bennett-emilie-escoffier.desc: Arlecchino Escoffier Emilie Bennett. ~16s Rot. Arlecchino Burning with Escoffier Melt. Arle N1C 5N3D N3. Escoffier bursts every other rotatation.

alhaitham-baizhu-fischl-furina.desc: AlHaitham Furina Fischl Baizhu. ~26s Rot. AlHaitham Quickbloom. Baizhu skills twice for team energy. Fischl uses burst during Alhaitham's burst window. Good Quicken uptime.

ayato-escoffier-furina-yelan.desc: Ayato Furina Yelan Escoffier. 26s rot. bennett-furina-hutao-xingqiu.desc: Hu Tao Furina Bennett Xingqiu. Uses Xingqiu's Skill in Bennett's Burst.

arlecchino-bennett-emilie-lanyan.desc: Arlecchino Emilie Lanyan Bennett. ~16s Rot. Arlechinno Burning with Emilie. Arlecchino 5N3D N3. Lanyan's shield buffed by Bennett, No Lanyan Burst.

luminedendro-nahida-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Onfield Raiden Hyperbloom with Nahida DMC and Xingqiu

fischl-kirara-sucrose-yaemiko.desc: Yae Fischl aggravate with ins Kirara and hakushin Sucrose. Yae frontloads a lot of damage with q thanks to numerous em buffs. (25s rot)

chevreuse-clorinde-fischl-klee.desc: Clorinde OL w/ Support Klee. 16s rotations. Klee buffs Clorinde and Fischl with Hakushin Ring and Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City. Jumpy Dumpty is able to extend Chevreuse's A1 for the entirety of Clorinde's field time.

furina-lanyan-luminepyro-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Lan Yan PMC. 4CA 26s rot. PMC hE for ranged attack. Lan Yan C6 + Sac Fragments for the skill uses.

arlecchino-bennett-emilie-zhongli.desc: Arle Emilie Zhongli Bennett. No Arle Q 16-17s rot. Emilie Q every 2rot. Both Emilie and Zhongli come after Bennett Q.

kazuha-neuvillette-xilonen-yelan.desc: Neuv Yelan Kazuha Xilonen. 4CA 28s rot. Yelan 2E. Yelan provides hydro particles, and A4 DMG Bonus. 4EoSF on Yelan is ~9% low.

bennett-escoffier-navia-xilonen.desc: Navia Xilonen Escoffier Bennett. 18s rot. Escoffier w/ her sig would use her Burst every 2rots.

fischl-hutao-ororon-yelan.desc: Hutao Yelan Fischl Ororon. ~17s Rot. Hutao double Electro Overvape. 7N3CJ Hutao. GD is very close to SR.

bennett-diona-gaming-rosaria.desc: 4* melt gaming. 6 plunges + 1 non-buffed plunge. pay attention to cryo aura ingame. Needs good positioning for overlapping diona and rosaria burst

citlali-furina-kokomi-yelan.desc: Kokomi Furinna Yelan Citlali. ~21s Rot. Kokomi "Mono" Hydro with Citlali. 2E Yelan. Kokomi's skill heals through Furina's burst animation.

chiori-neuvillette-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Neuv Xiangling Chiori Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Sac Jade R5 used, better than Tome R1 by 2k(5% personal). Sac Jade R1 is 67k team DPS. 4AP on Xiangling is 6k(9%) more Team DPS. When playing this team, try to pick up the Crystallize Shard for Geo Resonance buff uptime.

escoffier-furina-mona-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Furina Escoffier Mona. 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] N4 Q or C.

dori-fischl-furina-nahida.desc: Dori Furina Fischl Nahida. ~24s Rot. Psuedo-APL. Dori Quickbloom sans TF. Dori and Nahida quickswap in the rear half of the rotation.

bennett-chasca-chevreuse-furina.desc: Chasca Furina Chev Bennett. 16s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b]. Chasca & Furina Q every 2 rot. Chasca prefers Pyro Goblet. Chev batteries Bennett. Not having Chev C6 is ~9k(12%) DPS loss.

bennett-furina-kinich-ororon.desc: Kinich "Quickbloom". Kinich with 3 characters focused on buffing him, with ororon also providing some quicken uptime. and occasionally triggering hyperblooms. 29s rotation. Kinich spins to catch blindspots and uses short hold E, gets 3 canons per skill.

bennett-emilie-mavuika-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Emilie Mavuika Bennett. 20s rot. N3CJ combo. Emilie & Wrio Q every 2 rots. Scroll is powerful on Mavuika. Mavuika Q before Bennett, sometimes you can melt her Q if you can leave Cryo on the enemy.

arlecchino-bennett-yelan-zhongli.desc: Shielded Arle does N3C N14, 18 second rotation. Very comfy, works in multiwave content without the faff of swapping off Arle. No threat of death hanging over your head like the Sword of Damocles as long as ur dodging even a little bit.

chasca-furina-mavuika-xilonen.desc: Chasca Furina Mavuika Xilonen. Xilonen 2E 21s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. 4AP Xilo, 4Scroll Mav, trying to buff Chasca more. Mostly Hydro Scroll. Assuming Xilonen dashes for 4AP.

bennett-citlali-escoffier-lyney.desc: Lyney Citlali Escoffier Bennett. ~17s Rot. Lyney double Cryo Melt. No wait for Aura at all. Assumes 50% Headhsots with Crescent, -1K DPS with FWF. Escoffier & Lyney burst only when available.

bennett-chasca-furina-ororon.desc: Chasca Furina Ororon Bennett. 16-17s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b]. Chasca & Furina Q every 2 rot. Not having Ororon C6 is ~4.5k (~6.5%) DPS loss here.

bennett-chasca-mavuika-nilou.desc: Chasca Mavuika Nilou Bennett. 18s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Mavuika Q vape enabled by Nilou. Nilou provides off-field Hydro app.

furina-heizou-neuvillette-zhongli.desc: Pamber Heizou is also an option for a 4VV healer, with very minor grouping. Not being able to hold Favonius means that Neuv/Furina have slightly higher ER reqs.

bennett-kazuha-lyney-xilonen.desc: Lyney "Mono" with 2 shredders and no IR. 15s 4CA rotation

arlecchino-bennett-chiori-xilonen.desc: Arle Chiori Xilonen Bennett. 16s rot No Arle Q, C 3[N5D] N1. 4NO on Bennett is ~3k loss.

bennett-furina-gaming-kazuha.desc: Gaming Furina Kazuha Bennett. ~20s Rot. Gaming catches Man Chai in midair, doing 7 skill plunges with delay to maintain Hydro Aura. The final plunge is unbuffed. Kazuha does not burst. Hydro VV is MIA.

clorinde-emilie-fischl-thoma.desc: Clorinde Emilie Fischl Thoma. ~24s Rot. TF Clorinde Quickburn. Clorinde closes the rotation with burst. Deepwood Thoma maximizes Emilie's damage. Emilie bursts every other rot after the first. EM build Thoma.

escoffier-furina-ganyu-mualani.desc: Ganyu Furina Escoffier Mualani. 5CA 20s rot. 4Scroll TTDS Mualani. Ganyu uses 1CA before EQ to snapshot all the 3 stacks of 4MH.

dehya-furina-kazuha-neuvillette.desc: Dehya provides resistance to interruption. Neuv E > Furina N1 E d N1 > Kazuha EPQ > Dehya N1 E N1 > Furina Q > Neuv CA E CA Q > Kazuha EP > Neuv CA CA

chevreuse-furina-gaming-ororon.desc: Gaming Furina Ororon Chevreuse. ~20s Rot. Gaming Overvape. Gaming does 7 E plunges with delays. Healing > DPS Chevreuse. Ororon goes before Furina to minimize Overload disruptiveness.

bennett-chasca-furina-skirk.desc: Chasca Furina Skirk Bennett. 33s rot. Chasca does 4[C], Q in the 1st half of the rotation. Furina casts her E and Q once per rotation. Bennett and Skirk cast their Q twice per rotation. Cryo Scroll occasionally occurs in the 2nd half of the rotation against freezable enemies only. Unfreezable enemy is ~2.5k less DPS.

escoffier-navia-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Navia Xilonen Escoffier Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Navia Plunge. 2 Xilonen skills, one funneled to Navia. Rotation gives TTDS to Navia for both skills and all plunges. C0 Xilonen doesn't provide RES shred but is worth using for energy and Scroll.

nahida-raiden-xingqiu-zhongli.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Nahida Xingqiu Zhongli

bennett-kinich-ororon-xinyan.desc: Kinich Ororon Xinyan Bennett. Kinich using shE. ~20s rot. Start with Kinich Q for Scroll proc in the first rot. -1 Cannon shot with no shE.

furina-navia-ningguang-xianyun.desc: Navia Plunge 50% collisions. 2 Ningguang e to battery Navia.

chevreuse-fischl-xiangling-yaemiko.desc: Yae Chevreuse Fischl Xiangling. ~25s Rot. Yae Overload. Yae uses burst every rotation after 3N1CD to regen stamina. Constant Electro application from Yae & Fischl skills leads to high Overload damage and constant Chev A1 RES shred coverage from Xiangling, who uses skill twice per rotation.

furina-jean-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Mono hydro onfield "carry yelan"  2 Yelan e rotation very simple to execute.

furina-gaming-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Gaming Furina Xilonen Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Gaming does 7 E plunges with no delay for the final plunge. Xilonen's Scroll set buffs Pyro on the first rotation. Xilonen does not use Q.

fischl-hutao-yelan-zhongli.desc: Hu Tao overvape Zhongli Hold E> Yelan QEN4> Fischl E/Q> Hu Tao N2C 8N1C N2.. Hutao Starting HP=1.

clorinde-furina-kazuha-ororon.desc: Clorinde Furina Kazuha Ororon. 16s rot. Clorinde Q every other rot. When Furina E is on cd, use Kazuha Q instead.

furina-lynette-neuvillette-yaemiko.desc: standard neuvi - furina hyper with lynette as anemo and yae as flex. no totem refresh for max furina Q uptime. lynette uses HB% circlet to stack fanfare and EM build is best for damage. widsith yae is better than hakushin. rot is for C4+/sacsword lynette, but alternate rot is included.

bennett-furina-navia-ningguang.desc: Navia-Ningguang first rotation with sustainable ER through multiple rotations

furina-mona-navia-xilonen.desc: Navia Furina Mona Xilonen. 20-21s rot. Navia 3rd E if available. First Navia E uses long 3[N2D] combo to benefit from Mona's omen buff.

chasca-chevreuse-escoffier-furina.desc: Chasca Escoffier Furina Chevreuse. 32.5s rotation. Chasca does 4CA(6) + CA(4) and ends with her Burst in the first phase of the rotation. Furina and Chevreuse Burst once per rotation. Escoffier never Bursts. Chevreuse is on a damage build, a healer build is ~2k less DPS. Unfreezable enemy is a loss of about ~4k DPS.

baizhu-furina-lynette-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Lynette Baizhu. Baizhu 1E 4CA 26s rot. Lynette EQ between Baizhu EQ and Furina Q (It works for Pre-C4 Lynette). Make sure you swirl Hydro with her E or Q, Lynette's C6 gives you one more chance with Anemo N1. You can guarantee Hydro swirl by using her before Baizhu but it's difficult to manage Lynette E cd with Pre-C4 Lynette.

bennett-ororon-varesa-xianyun.desc: Varesa Ororon Bennett Xianyun. ~19s rot. 7 Plunge Combos. 100% Collisions.

fischl-kinich-ororon-zhongli.desc: Kinich double electro quicken with Zhongli for survivability and res shred. Deepwood uptime rely on the pillar hitting (lol). 18s~ rotation. Kinich seeks blindspots and uses short hold E, still reaches 3 cannon shots when blindspots with normal E, but -3K DPS.

emilie-nahida-neuvillette-xiangling.desc: Emilie bursts every rotation AFTER Xiangling so that Xiangling has her skill off cooldown by the time Neuv has done 2 Charge attacks. Xiangling funnels Fav particles to Neuv for lower energy requirements.

emilie-furina-neuvillette-xiangling.desc: Neuv Furina Emilie Xiangling. 4CA 27s rot. Emilie Q every rot but long rot length and Xiangling's Fav lowers the ER req.

citlali-escoffier-furina-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Furina Escoffier Citlali. 20s rot. 5[N3CJ] N4 Q or C. Citlali before Escoffier for better Scroll proc.

escoffier-eula-furina-shenhe.desc: Eula Furina Shenhe Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Phys Eula with Escoffier. Eula does Eula EQE N4D N2 hE N2 for superior energy an better utilization of Shenhe quils. Shenhe passes skill & fav particles to Eula before & after Eula's burst. Shenhe's RES shred usually expires just before Eula's Lightfall sword can drop.

bennett-fischl-kinich-ororon.desc: Kinich quicken, with Benny as a buffer. No off field Pyro so no burning uptime. Kinich spins to catch blindspots and uses short hold E to get 3 canons per skill. Still 3 cannons without shE, but -7K DPS from additional loops shots and reactions.

nahida-neuvillette-xiangling-yaemiko.desc: neuvi nahida xl yae. ~30s optimized rot, 9-15f random swap delay, 2-4f random action delay. neuvi waits for nahida E to fall off -> shCA at the end for 3 A1 stacks every rot

chevreuse-keqing-mavuika-ororon.desc: Keqing Chevreuse Ororon Mavuika. ~19s rot. Opens with Ororon while Mavuika does tE later in the rotation for a faster rotation benefitting Keqing's damage.

chevreuse-fischl-lyney-yaemiko.desc: Lyney Overload. Yae does not burst in this rotation but she often wants to in-game. Low pyro aura uptime makes C6 Chev a more significant DPS increase for Lyney. Building Chev for more healing allows Lyney to more comfortably stack mare and prop surplus in-game. 15s rotation.

bennett-lyney-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Lyney Monopyro with AP Xiangling and 2 weakspots

albedo-arlecchino-bennett-chiori.desc: arle double geo. 16s~ rotation. chiori and albedo alternate burst use to fill downtime. both get burst and initial skill buffed by bennett. 6n3d no burst arle, crystallize can provide some survivability.

emilie-fischl-sethos-xiangling.desc: Sethos Emilie Fischl Xiangling. ~15s Rot. Sethos Quickburn. Emilie & Xiangling burst every other rotation; Fischl alternates skill and burst. Sethos prefers Fischl just before himself. Sethos does 8N2W and uses a shadow peicing shot every other rotation for energy reasons.

arlecchino-bennett-kazuha-nilou.desc: arle vape with nilou. nilou does not deal damage but enable vapes in AoE without having er requirements. r5 sac sword nilou to shorten rotation to 16s. n3d arle, no arle burst.

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-yoimiya.desc: yoi overload. yoi uses 4pc TF to reduce her skill cooldown and fit into 16s rotation. yoi uses few phys NAs to fill time on rotations she doesn't burst.

escoffier-furina-nilou-yelan.desc: Nilou Furina Yelan Escoffier. ~21s Rot. Hydro DPS MH HDC Nilou onfield in Escoffier Freeze. Nilou does EN2QN1 to funnel her burst. Yelan Catches her own particles. Not heavily optimized.

arlecchino-bennett-furina-yelan.desc: Arle Double hydro. Bennett and Yelan recieve healing. Low Fanfare generation with C0 Furina

chongyun-diluc-emilie-xianyun.desc: Diluc Chongyun Emilie Xianyun. ~16s Rot. Diluc Melt Plunge. Uses Diluc E to (re)establish Burning aura to Melt plunge. Chongyun uses E before Xianyun. 50% Collisions.

bennett-chasca-chevreuse-ororon.desc: Chasca Ororon Chevreuse Bennett. ~16s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. DPS build Chevreuse hEQ on Bennett Q. If Chevreuse is not C6, Pyro Goblet is ~700 DPS (~1.5%) better. Not having Chevreuse C6 is ~10k (19%) DPS loss.

alhaitham-furina-kokomi-nilou.desc: Triple Hydro Bloom team. Bloom is ~80% of the total damage, but Furina's buffs enable herself and Alhaitham to do decent raw damage.

clorinde-fischl-kinich-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Kinich Fischl Xilonen. ~26s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Aggravate with Kinich. Kinich shoots 1 loop shot before burst; Kinch burst lasts into Clorinde's second skill, providing Dendro in multiwave. Scroll Kinich enables AP Xilonen, who picks up Crystallize before Clorinde's skill. Clorinde closes every rotation with burst.

furina-navia-xianyun-yelan.desc: Navia double hydro plunge. Very low Yelan dmg as Navia sacrifices Yelan dmg to do 4 geo plunges. 2 Yelan E and fav proc to help Navia's solo geo ER req

clorinde-fischl-nahida-xingqiu.desc: TF Clorinde Quickbloom w/ Xingqiu. 26s rotation. Xingqiu provides IR for Clorinde to limit rotation disruption. Clorinde partially builds into EM due to the increased Bloom production and lower Quicken uptime relative to Furina.

fischl-furina-kazuha-kokomi.desc: Kokomi Electrocharge - There is a lot of dead time before Fischl refresh and subsequent Kokomi burst so read the config for the specifics- Hyperoptimised sim

clorinde-nahida-sara-xilonen.desc: Aggravate Clorinde (FoHW) w/ Sara, Nahida and Xilonen. 16s rotation. Clorinde uses her Burst every other rotation due to ER constraints. Nahida and Xilonen use their Bursts when Clorinde cannot use hers.

bennett-furina-xianyun-xingqiu.desc: Bennett Furina Xingqiu Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Bennett Double Hydro Vape Plunge. 8 plunges high plunges with N1 after each plunge and Bennett skill as available. Xingqiu's rainswords provide excellent Vape consistency.

fischl-hutao-xingqiu-yelan.desc: TF Hu Tao with Double Hydro and Fishcl

furina-hutao-xianyun-xingqiu.desc: Xianyun lets Hu Tao do charge attacks followed by low plunges.. Between the Bennett and Jean variants of this team, this Xianyun variant is both not constrained to an area and allows for slightly larger AOE than her normal charge attack playstyle.

chasca-mavuika-sara-yelan.desc: Chasca Yelan Mavuika Sara. ~18s. Sara swaps in twice each rotation to buff both Mavuika and Chasca. Sara and Chasca Burst when ready.

bennett-gaming-sucrose-xingqiu.desc: VV setup is a bit tricky, ensure u dash away from enemy and apply pyro before attacking with Sucrose. Gaming juggles his Man Chai while weaving attacks between E plunges. Ingame, press Skill after attacking and while mid-air, wait till Man Chai has reached extremely close to Gaming before plunging

dori-furina-kazuha-yelan.desc: Dori Double Hydro EC. Not much time is spent on-fielding dori herself

mavuika-navia-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Navia Mavuika Xilonen Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Navia Plunge. After the first rotation, Mavuika uses 2CDFD to fill time.  Xianyun TTDS covers all plunges for Navia. C0 Xilonen doesn't provide RES shred but is worth using for Scroll and energy; 2 Xilonen skills are funneled to Navia.

bennett-chevreuse-clorinde-xiangling.desc: clorinde overload with triple pyro. 16s~ rotation with xiangling burst every other rotation to fit into shorter rotation and reduce er needs. clorinde burst when ready.

ayaka-chongyun-escoffier-furina.desc: Ayaka Furina Escoffier Chongyun. 19s rot. Start with Chongyun EQ so that CDR affects Furina's E cooldown. His A4 Cryo RES Shred will be applied during Ayaka's Q animation and her Q will snapshot his 4NO buff. Escoffier feeds her Cryo particles to Ayaka.

hutao-xilonen-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Hu tao C0 double hydro with Xilonen. Hutao starting HP=1.

escoffier-furina-wriothesley-xingqiu.desc: Wrio Furina Escoffier Xingqiu. 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] N3 Q/N1C. Starts with Xingqiu Q E N1, and 4Scroll is better on Xingqiu for team DPS, 4NO has low uptime on Wrio.

furina-kokomi-yelan-zhongli.desc: Kokomi mono hydro with Zhongli. Kokomi alternating dash and walk cancels.  ~21s 2 Yelan E rotation. Very comfortable/safe team

clorinde-fischl-nahida-yelan.desc: TF Clorinde w/ Nahida, Yelan, Fischl. No Clorinde Burst. Yelan does 2 Skills for lower ER requirements, allowing her to use offensive weapons instead of Fav-adjacent ones.

chiori-furina-neuvillette-zhongli.desc: Neuv Furina Chiori Zhongli. 4CA 26s rot. No grouping but less issue thanks to neuv's AoE.

bennett-kinich-ororon-thoma.desc: Kinich Ororon Thoma Bennett. Kinich using shE. 18-19s rot. Kinich Q if available. Ororon for Scroll trigger, build EM for Overloaded damage.

bennett-chiori-lyney-zhongli.desc: Lyney double geo. 5CA 16s rotation. 4Petra on Bennett. Lyney 4CA + E doesn't quite fit within Petra uptime, in practice you may want to 3CA + E + 1CA but the last CA gets cut off unless you adjust config.

alhaitham-kuki-xingqiu-yaoyao.desc: Energy drops based on 12-3 Icewind Suite; Customized random frame delays; No jump cancels; KurtC. Many alternative build options.

bennett-chasca-chongyun-mavuika.desc: Chasca Mavuika Chongyun Bennett. 17-18s rot. 4[C] and Q if available. This rot requires Chongyun C6 to melt Mavuika Q.

arlecchino-bennett-sucrose-xingqiu.desc: Does not swirl hydro. Arle N3C N16 combo. Sucrose Ed N2 after Bennett Ed Q. Needs to stall for time by using Xingqiu and Sucrose normal attacks since Xingqiu E cd is 21s long.

bennett-emilie-kinich-thoma.desc: Kinich Emilie Thoma Bennett. 19s rot. E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo with consistently NA clockwise.

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-keqing.desc: pyro keqing with chev and c6 benny. note that keqing has no IR and is left with very little stamina to dodge

emilie-fischl-mavuika-yaemiko.desc: Yae Emilie Fischl Mavuika. ~25s Rot. On-field Yae Quickburn. Mavuika does Q 2[C2FD] E under Electro aura before Yae uses burst every rotation. Even with this, some Emilie L2 case uptime is sacrificed so DM is near even with UR. After Fischl refreshes her burst, Yae does N2CJ.

arlecchino-bennett-chiori-navia.desc: arle double geo dual carry with navia. 17-19s rotation. navia burst every other rotation to reduce er requirements. navia get 2 bennett buffed Es. n3d no burst arle. ap on chiori or bennett very slightly better.

clorinde-furina-ororon-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Furina Ororon Xilonen. ~27s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Taser with Furina. AP Xilonen almost always Crystallizes Electro before and after Clorinde's skill. Xilonen's burst isn't nessesary on the first rotation.

alhaitham-fischl-furina-kuki.desc: Deepwood Furina. 90%/70%/70%/60% Starting HP respectively; Energy drops based on 12-3 Icewind Suite; KurtC; Customized random frame delays. Many alternative build options.

candace-escoffier-furina-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Furina Candace Escoffier. 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] N3 Q/N1C. Candace 2E, one of them batterying Furina directly. Candace EQ with 4NO right before Wrio field time.

bennett-chasca-ororon-xiangling.desc: Chasca Ororon Xiangling Bennett. ~17s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Xiangling casts her Q every other rotation. Chasca prefers Pyro% Goblet by ~1.1k (~2%).

clorinde-fischl-furina-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Furina Fischl Xilonen. ~27s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Taser with Furina. AP Xilonen almost always Crystallizes Electro before and after Clorinde's skill. Xilonen's burst isn't nessesary on the first rotation.

bennett-emilie-lyney-xilonen.desc: Lyney Mono Pyro w/ Emilie and Xilonen. ~17.5s rotation. Lyney does 4 charged shots or 5 if burst isn't available.

baizhu-citlali-furina-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Citlali Baizhu. 4CA 26s rot. Baizhu QE right before Furina Q. Baizhu EQ after Furina Q is also viable.

bennett-freminet-furina-xianyun.desc: Freminet Furina Bennett Xianyun. ~21s Rot. Freminet Vape plunge without VV. Freminet uses skill and Pers damage between plunges to maintain his passives. -3K DPS vs Freeze Immunity. 50% Collisions.

arlecchino-bennett-emilie-fischl.desc: Arle Emilie Fischl Bennett. 16s rot. No Arle Q 6[N3D] N1. Emilie Q every 2 rots on Bennett Q. Few aggravate counts, but Fischl triggers a lot of overloaded.

nahida-neuvillette-raiden-xiangling.desc: Rotation is highly optimized using delays to increase the number of vapes. Additionally, AFKing occurs at the end of the rotation to make sure Nahida E drops off so there is an EC for Neuv A1.

chasca-escoffier-furina-shenhe.desc: Chasca Furina Shenhe Escoffier. 32s rot. Escoffier and Shenhe uses their E twice. Chasca uses a Cryo Goblet.

ayato-furina-xilonen-yelan.desc: Ayato Furina Xilonen Yelan, Yelan's using 4pc AP to buff herself, Furina and Ayato; 2pc2pc HP Yelan is -4K DPS. 2E Ayato per rot, 25s rotation.

bennett-fischl-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya overvape. 18 s rotation. Yelan NEQN -> Bennett QNE -> Fischl E/Q -> Yoimiya EN... -> Bennett NE. High theoretical damage but no shields.

clorinde-furina-kazuha-sara.desc: Clorinde EC w/ Sara. Two split 16s rotations (or a large 32s rotation). Sara always takes the field before Clorinde to buff Clorinde's Skill combo and Burst.

chevreuse-fischl-mavuika-yaemiko.desc: Yae Chevreuse Fischl Mavuika. ~25s Rot. On-field Yae Overload. Mavuika does Q2[C2FD]E under Electro aura before Yae uses burst every rotation. After Fischl refreshes her burst, Yae does N2CJ. Healer Chevreuse.

kaveh-raiden-xingqiu-yelan.desc: kaveh xingqiu raiden yelan with triple favge

furina-mavuika-ningguang-xilonen.desc: 21.5s rot, Ningguang Furina Xilonen Mavuika. KQMS stats, ATK goblet on Ningguang. Expects Crystallize to be picked up for Geo Resonance. Nighttime set is very similar to MH.

escoffier-furina-raiden-yelan.desc: Raiden Furina Yelan Escoffier. ~21s Rot. Raiden Taser with Escoffier. 2E Yelan bookends Raiden's full burst with N4D.

furina-kokomi-nahida-raiden.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Kokomi Nahida Furina in ST. Kokomi Onfeild, n2dw, using walk for dash cooldown. Using event weapons, Kokomi replacable with PA, Furina with Pipe.

alhaitham-baizhu-furina-raiden.desc: Split uptime Alhaitham rotation. 2 Baizhu skill uses for energy healing and fanfare generation

chevreuse-fischl-hutao-yelan.desc: Hutao Yelan Fischl Chevreuse. ~18s Rot. Overvape Hutao doing 6N3CJ. Chevreuse bursts every rotation. Chevreuse's slow healing enables MH to outpace SR. Burstless Hutao.

clorinde-fischl-nahida-zhongli.desc: Clorinde Fischl Nahida Zhongli. 16s rot. Easy and straightforward. High ER req on Nahida. 4TotM Nahida, 4GT is ~1k less and 4DM is ~1.5k less.

lynette-neuvillette-xilonen-yelan.desc: Neuv Yelan Lynette Xilonen. 4CA ~27s rot with Yelan 2E. Yelan provides hydro particles, and A4 DMG Bonus, Lynette provides a Taunt. Rot works with pre-C4 Lynette.

bennett-emilie-lyney-zhongli.desc: Lyney Emilie Zhongli Bennett. 16s rot. Emilie and Zhongli before Bennett Q. Emilie Q if ready.

fischl-furina-xianyun-yelan.desc: On field MH Yelan is slightly better than on field XY. 26s rotation, KQMS.

furina-hutao-kokomi-yelan.desc: Hu Tao triple Hydro. Kokomi Q 3N2 + Her Elemental skill is enough healing to sustain Furina's drain and max fanfare stacks every rotation

chevreuse-furina-gaming-xilonen.desc: Gaming Furina Xilonen Chevreuse. ~20s Rot. Gaming does 7 E plunges. Xilonen's Scroll buffs Pyro nearly every rotation with Chevreuse, who can overwhelms Hydro aura. Xilonen's burst is not optimal vs funneling particles to Furina. Scroll covers 6 plunges while Xilonen's RES shred covers all of Gaming's Field time.

chevreuse-fischl-hutao-yaemiko.desc: Hutao Chevreuse Fischl Yae. ~17s Rot. Overload Hutao doing 6N3CJ. Hutao & Chevreuse burst every other rotation. Yae does not burst. EM build options for Hutao in config.

bennett-emilie-kinich-ororon.desc: Kinich Emilie Ororon Bennett. Kinich using shE. 18-19s rot. Kinich and Emilie Q if available. Ororon for Scroll trigger, build EM for Overloaded damage. Deepwood on Emilie is ~14% Team DPS increase over 4UR. 4 Cannon shots is inconsistent without ShE, No ShE is 7K DPS.

furina-sethos-xilonen-yelan.desc: Sethos Furina Yelan Xilonen. 21s Rot. Sethos Taser. Yelan and Xilonen use E 2x with no attempt made to obtain Electro Scroll buff.

bennett-chasca-citlali-furina.desc: Chasca Furina Citlali Bennett. 20s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Trying to do Pyro Scroll. -3K DPS with Freeze Immunity.

nahida-neuvillette-ororon-xiangling.desc: Neuv Nahida Xiangling Ororon. ~29s 4CA rot. 9-15f random swap delay, 2-4f random action delay. Neuv waits for Nahida E to fall off -> shCA at the end for 3 A1 stacks every rot

furina-xilonen-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Furina Yelan Xilonen. ~21s Rot. Yelan skill just before and after Yoimiya field time. Xilonen uses skill twice and bursts before Furina. Yelan has the highest damage share. No burst Youmiya.

furina-jean-navia-neuvillette.desc: Neuvillette Furina Navia Jean. Navia hold E is used for Archaic Petra. Up to 4 fav procs per rotation makes the ER reqs very comfortable.

kuki-nahida-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Raiden Kuki hyperbloom with Nahida Xingqiu

chiori-furina-xilonen-yelan.desc: Yelan Furina Xilonen Chiori. 21-22s rot. 2 Yelan E and 2 Xilonen E per rotation. Chiori Q every rot.

chevreuse-gaming-mavuika-ororon.desc: Gaming Chevreuse Mavuika Ororon. ~18s Rot. Gaming Overload with Natlanteans. Does 7 plunges, Juggling Manchai using wait on the ground to catch it while descending.  Mavuika just does EQD. Full EM Ororon. Full Healing Chevreuse. LNO ends up being best here. At lower con Gaming you would want to Mavuika to QE to pass particles to Gaming.

baizhu-kaveh-raiden-xingqiu.desc: kaveh baizhu xq raiden with a simple kaveh string, ins kaveh

baizhu-furina-neuvillette-ororon.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Baizhu. 4CA 26s rot. Ororon EM build for the Hyperbloom damage. Baizhu EQ instead of Q E is 1k behind.

furina-gaming-xianyun-yelan.desc: Gaming juggles his Man Chai while weaving attacks between E plunges. Ingame, press Skill after attacking and while mid-air, wait till Man Chai has reached extremely close to Gaming before plunging

bennett-clorinde-fischl-nahida.desc: Clorinde Fischl Nahida Bennett. ~16s Rot. Clorinde prefers crit weapons. 2E Bennett. Nahida bursts every other rotation after the first and fills time while Bennett's skill is on CD.

chevreuse-fischl-hutao-mavuika.desc: Hutao Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~17s Rot. Hu Tao Overload with Mavuika. Hutao E N3CJ 5N2CJ N3C(JQ/JN3CJ). Hutao bursts if available. Fischl leads with an aimed shot for Chevreuse's A1 RES Shred. Mavuika uses one CA when burst is ready.

albedo-furina-neuvillette-zhongli.desc: Neuv Furina Albedo Zhongli. 4CA 26s rot. No grouping but less issue thanks to neuv's AoE. Albedo's flower can be broken. shruge

arlecchino-bennett-candace-kazuha.desc: Arle Candace Kazuha Bennett. 17s rot. No Arle Q, 5[N3D] N2. Using 2 Candace E per rot for her high ER needs.

hutao-luminepyro-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Yelan Xingqiu PMC. 21s rot. Hu Tao N2J and N1J mix combo. PMC Bursts every rotation. Hu Tao start HP%=1.

baizhu-fischl-kazuha-yaemiko.desc: yae N1EN1EN1E; kazuha Ep; fischl E; kazuha Q; baizhu EQ; yae N1QN1EN1EN1E; kazuha Ep; fischl Q; baizhu E; yae N2CJ; kazuha Ep; yae N2CJ N2d N1;

chasca-fischl-furina-ororon.desc: Chasca Fischl Ororon Furina. ~16.5s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b], Q every 2 rot. Furina Burst only used on first rotation. First rotation also does Ororon -> Fischl to snapshot 4pc Scroll. VV outperforms Codex even at higher Chasca investment.

chasca-chevreuse-citlali-furina.desc: Chasca Furina Citlali Chev. 16-18s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b]. Chasca & Furina Q every 2 rot. Since TTDS is not triggered every rot, Prototype Amber can be used on Citlali if you want more healing, its not that different. It tries Pyro Scroll but you may not succeed in that in practice. Not having Chev C6 is ~6.5k(9%) DPS loss. -3K DPS with Freeze Immunity.

escoffier-ganyu-rosaria-shenhe.desc: Quickswap Mono Cryo team with fixed rotation. 3 Rosaria's Skills for reduced ER requirements.

bennett-kaeya-mavuika-rosaria.desc: Mavuika Rosaria Kaeya Bennett. ~19s Rot. Mavuika double Cryo Melt without Natlan. Mavuika Q 6[C2D], Q 11C D is -6K DPS.

cyno-kaeya-mavuika-xilonen.desc: Truely a Cyno hypercarry team, Mavuika is here for emotional supports. ~18sec rotation. Mavuika 4 (CA D N1) CA Combo. 1 Q Melt 5 CA Melts. Precise Setup. KQMS. Picking up the pyro shards with Cyno could be hard with Xilonen almost auto-picking up the shards herself in game. Cyno N2 E D to trigger OL and Warning CD on Mavuika. Omit Mavuika CD5CD from final rotation for higher avg DPS.

dori-furina-nahida-yelan.desc: Nahida Furina Yelan Dori. ~22s Rot. On-field Nahida double Hydro Hyperbloom. 1E Yelan, 2E Dori, swapping in to use skill again. Heavy CA usage on Nahida. Nahida burst isn't worth the animation time.

ayaka-furina-shenhe-xilonen.desc: Ayaka Xilonen Shenhe Furina. Ayaka freeze without grouping. 22s rotation. Xilonen uses her burst at the start of the rotation to heal everyone. 2 Xilonen skills, 2 Shenhe skills. Fav Impact.

itto-kaeya-mavuika-xilonen.desc: New Itto's best team (Mavuika Melt with C6 Kaeya. Mavuika 5 (2CA D) Combo. 5 CA Melts) KQMS Stats. Omits Mavuika CD5CD in the final rotation; leading to higher DPS.

fischl-kazuha-tighnari-yaemiko.desc: Yae Fischl aggravate with tighnari enabling quicken. Tighnari swaps in and out multiple times for quicken and instructor uptime

clorinde-fischl-lumineanemo-nahida.desc: Clorinde Fischl Nahida with AMC on an EM/Electro/Crit build. Assumes Tornado hits full duration.

furina-wanderer-xilonen-yelan.desc: VV Fav Codex Wanderer driving double hydro with Xilonen. 21s rotation

bennett-navia-xilonen-yelan.desc: Navia Yelan Xilonen Bennett. Yelan 1E 18s rot. Starts with Yelan maxing out her A4.

chevreuse-raiden-sara-xiangling.desc: Raiden carry. Healing/ HP Chevreuse build. Sara buffs her own burst Xiangling and Raiden's bursts. Chevreuse funnels particles to Xiangling.

alhaitham-furina-kuki-yelan.desc: Deepwood: Yelan > Furina > Alhaitham. No jump cancels. Customized random frame delays + Starting HP%s; Hurt interval; 12-3 Icewind Suite energy.

bennett-gaming-kazuha-rosaria.desc: Gaming Rosaria Kazuha Bennett. ~20s Rot. Gaming Melt. Gaming does 4 Fast plunges following Rosaria burst, then 7 slow plunges. Kazuha does not burst, as Pyro absorbtion is guaranteed.

citlali-escoffier-furina-hutao.desc: Hutao Furina Citlali Escoffier. ~20s Rot. Hutao MeltVape.-7K DPS with Freeze immunity, Melt count is more than halved. Citlali Pyro Scroll is incidental.

bennett-raiden-xiangling-xingqiu.desc: Raiden National. Bennett particle delay changed to allow Xiangling to N1Q for Rainswords and still catch funneled Bennett particles; this is difficult or impossible at low ping.

kaveh-kirara-raiden-xingqiu.desc: kaveh kirara xingqiu raiden hyperbloom, instructors kaveh and deepwood kirara is sliightly better than deepwood kaveh and instructors kirara

furina-lynette-neuvillette-sigewinne.desc: Neuv Furina Lynette Sigewinne. 4CA 25s rot. Fontaine tea party. Sigewinne uses her E after Furina Q.

fischl-lynette-neuvillette-xiangling.desc: Neuv Fischl Lynette Xiangling. 4CA 27s rot. Simply [Lynette > Fischl > Xiangling > Neuv] order twice. Xiangling built EM for Overloaded damage.

alhaitham-bennett-fischl-nahida.desc: 25s rot with Alhaitham Q mid-combo to refresh oz; Pretty optimized strings with no jump cancels; Energy drops based on 12-3 icewind suite; KurtC; Random frame delays: 9.5f mean 1.5 stddev (+1f base) for swap, 3 mean 1 stddev other actions

bennett-gaming-sucrose-yelan.desc: Bennett uses hold E lvl 1 to apply pyro. Sucrose does not swirl hydro here. Gaming juggles his Man Chai while weaving attacks between E plunges. Ingame, press Skill after attacking and while mid-air, wait till Man Chai has reached extremely close to Gaming before plunging

arlecchino-bennett-candace-sucrose.desc: Arle Candace Sucrose Bennett. ~18s Rot.Standard Vaporize command, Sucrose strengthens harlequin with the use of Viridescent Venerer, Bennett strengthens with his burst, Candace gives hydro status.

bennett-chasca-citlali-escoffier.desc: Chasca Escoffier Citlali Bennett. 17s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Escoffier E N1D > Bennett EQ N1 > Citlali EQ > Chasca combo. Cryo Resonance provides CR buff.

bennett-escoffier-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Escoffier Rosaria Bennett Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Escoffier Double Cryo Melt plunge with VV. Escoffier doesn't cancel her plunges. Rosaria passes partcles to Xianyun at the end.

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-gaming.desc: Gaming Fischl Chevreuse Bennett. 15s rot. Q N1 6EP. Chevreuse feeds her pyro and fav particles to gaming.

baizhu-furina-hutao-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Burgeon. 2 Yelan E 1 Baizhu E rotation. Hutao does N1C to reduce pyro application and vapes about 80% of her Charged Attacks on avg

nahida-raiden-xingqiu-yaoyao.desc: Onfield Raiden hyperbloom with yaoyao. Rotation is XQ -> Nahida -> Yaoyao -> Raiden -> Nahida. Rotation is simple. It has a healer, and unlike nahida onfield, raiden in her Musou Isshin state won't get interrupted. Easier to reach theoretical dps in game.

collei-kokomi-nahida-nilou.desc: Nilou with Kokomi, Nahida and Collei

bennett-lynette-lyney-xilonen.desc: Lyney Mono Pyro with double RES Shred. ~15s rotation. C4+ Lynette uses Burst if available, extra Skill charge otherwise. Assumes Lyney consistently hits weakspots.

furina-jean-kirara-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Jean Kirara. 4CA 26s rotation. Kirara provides 12+12% DMG Bonus from her C6 and 4pc Scroll, with her shield for Interruption to resistance.

arlecchino-bennett-fischl-zhongli.desc: Arle Fischl Zhongli Bennett. 16s rot (very tight). No Arle Q, 6[N3D]
