arlecchino-chevreuse-clorinde-fischl.desc: Arle and Clorinde dual dps w/ Chev and Fischl. 2nd Clorinde field time onwards does not have Oz.

bennett-chiori-navia-xianyun.desc: navia plunge, 18s~ rotation. navia does not build er and burst when ready, otherwise chiori bursts. 4 geo high plunges per skill, very tight. fav totm chiori and higher base atk weapon benny have a bit higher sim dps. no off field application, but navia still get decent number of shards on her skills.

bennett-emilie-kinich-venti.desc: Kinich Bennett Emilie Venti, E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo, ~18-19s rotation. Venti on deepwood, his energy refund significantly reduces Benny's ER requirements, and his grouping is tight enough for Kinich to easily hit multiple enemies in aoe. -7K DPS without shE.

hutao-xiangling-xingqiu-yelan.desc: "Funerational" Hu Tao Double Hydro. Delays Yelan's Burst cast to use 2 Elemental Skills while her Burst is active one of which is with fully stacked A4 DMG%

kirara-nahida-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Xingqiu Nahida Kirara

chasca-furina-xilonen-yelan.desc: Chasca Furina Yelan Xilonen. ~22s rotation. Chasca uses 4VV to drive onfield using a mix of NAs and CAs and occasionally trigger Yelan's Q. Chasca casts her Q when ready. Hydro% Goblet is better than ATK% Goblet.

fischl-navia-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Navia Xilonen Fischl Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Navia Plunge. 2 Xilonen skills, one funneled to Navia. Rotation gives TTDS to Navia for both skills and all plunges. C0 Xilonen doesn't provide RES shred but is worth using for energy and Scroll.

chevreuse-mavuika-raiden-yaemiko.desc: Raiden Chevreuse Yae Mavuika. ~24s Rot. Raikou with Mavuika, where Mavuika & Yae/Raiden burst in alternate rotations. Q 6[C2D] Mavuika/Q N4E 2N4D N3 Raiden. Healer build Chevreuse.

cyno-fischl-furina-nahida.desc: No healing except Pamber so bad survivability. MH is better than TF for Cyno.

furina-ningguang-xilonen-yelan.desc: 21~ Rot Ningguang Yelan Furina Xilonen. KQMS stats. Expects crystalize to be picked up for Geo Resonance. Can be tough on stamina if at a distance, but tried to mitigate with 2NA and Burst for Star Jades.

furina-nilou-xilonen-yelan.desc: Nilou Furina Yelan Xilonen. ~22s Rot. Hydro DPS MH HDC Nilou onfield in mono Hydro. Nilou does EN2QN1 to funnel her burst. AP Yelan is ~3K over other options.

candace-mualani-sucrose-xiangling.desc: Mualani Candace(C6) Sucrose Xiangling. 31s rot. 3[3-stacked bites]. On the first half Candace, XL, and Mualani uses their Q, and the 2nd half Sucrose uses her Q for AoE Pyro app. Sucrose can hold Prototype Amber for some healing. Candace doesn't need that much of high HP.

baizhu-furina-luminepyro-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Baizhu PMC. 4CA 26s rot. PMC hE for ranged attack. Baizhu Q E right before Furina Q.

fischl-lanyan-nahida-sethos.desc: Sethos Nahida Fischl Lanyan. ~16s Rot. A simple Sethos Aggravate rotation. Sethos burst is enclosed by skill uses. Lanyan's shield lasts the duration of Sethos's field time. Sethos leads with a CA to establish Quicken.

bennett-chasca-furina-xiangling.desc: Chasca Furina Xiangling Bennett. 20s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Pyro Goblet (ATK% Goblet is ~2% worse).

chongyun-escoffier-navia-xilonen.desc: Navia Xilonen Chongyun Escoffier. 2E 17s + 3E 20s rot. Either Xilonen or Escoffier uses Burst every rot. It can be difficult in practice to make Navia's 3rd E to be used before Chongyun field expires.

ayato-bennett-furina-gaming.desc: For us Ayato owners. Dude just does E N1 Q N1 before Furina burst. Bennett does not skill. Gaming plunges 9 times. To do this ingame, Press E immediately after Q and each plunge. Wait till Man Chai is extremely close to you, then plunge.

baizhu-kokomi-nahida-nilou.desc: nilou baizhu nahida kokomi with kokomi n2c

furina-hutao-mona-yelan.desc: Clam Healing Bonus Mona. 2 Yelan E on first rotation only

chevreuse-clorinde-fischl-thoma.desc: Clorinde Fischl Thoma Chevreuse.  17s rotation. EM Thoma for additional reaction damage, but weaker shield. Chevreuse Burst when available to let her build more HP.

baizhu-fischl-sucrose-xingqiu.desc: Baizhu salad with good sucrose hyperbloom ownership

charlotte-citlali-furina-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Citlali Charlotte. 4CA 26s rot. More freeze uptime for comfort and Cryo resonance. Charlotte can use either hE or tE before her Q.

alhaitham-baizhu-furina-kuki.desc: GT Furina slightly higher than Deepwood Furina + Instructor/Clam Baizhu. Relatively comfy for HoD as far as Furina teams go. Customized random frame delays; Starting HP%s; Hurt interval; 12-3 Icewind Suite energy.

lynette-neuvillette-ororon-xilonen.desc: Neuv Xilonen Ororon Lynette. 4CA 27s rot. Lynette C6 N1 for reliable Hydro Swirl. Not having 4AP on Xilonen is ~5k(~8%) DPS Loss.

bennett-furina-xiangling-xingqiu.desc: Bennett on field vape. Xiangling does majority of team's damage. Furina recieves no healing from Bennett. Bennet Bursts, then swaps to Xiangling and Xingqiu so they can buff their burst and skill respectively. Then he goes on field for remainder of the rotation.

furina-lisa-neuvillette-ororon.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Lisa. 4CA 25s rot. Lisa w/o using hold E. Ororon has 2nd field time to feed Fav particles to Neuv.

clorinde-ororon-xilonen-yelan.desc: Clorinde Ororon Yelan Xilonen. ~17s Rot. Clorinde Taser. Emblem > NO Yelan. AP Xilonen consistently picks up Electro Crystallize before and after Clorinde's skill. Xilonen does not burst, but high ping players may want to.

hutao-kazuha-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Hu Tao double hydro with grouping. Rotation emphasises Yelan's dmg output by doing 2 skills while her Burst is active for increased Exquisite Throws.

arlecchino-fischl-xilonen-yelan.desc: Arlechinno Yelan Fischl Xilonen. ~18s Rot. Arlecchino Overvape with N5D. Scroll can land one of the three if Xilonen before Yelan.

escoffier-navia-rosaria-xilonen.desc: Navia Xilonen Escoffier Rosaria. 19s rot. Either Xilonen or Escoffier will use their Burst in each rot to heal the team while not having high ER needs. Do note that Cryo Resonance and Rosaria's A4 provides a lot of CR.

bennett-chevreuse-mavuika-yaemiko.desc: Yae Chevreuse Mavuika Bennett. ~16s Rot. On-field Yae Overload. Mavuika funnels skill particles into DPS Chevreuse who only does Q 2hE for rotation length reasons.

furina-jean-raiden-yelan.desc: Raiden double hydro. Electro VV is inconsistent past first rotation.

escoffier-furina-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Furina Yelan Citlali. ~22s Rot. VapeMelt Yoimiya. 2E Yelan, Yelan ensure she catches her own particles. Freeze immunity is -3K DPS. Fav on one of Furina, Yelan, or Escoffier results in similar DPS.

clorinde-furina-nahida-ororon.desc: Clorinde Nahdia Furina Ororon. ~16 Rot. Clorinde Quickbloom with EM Ororon. Furina does her thing every other rotation. Nahida fills time in Furina's place and uses her burst. Nahida's combo's can likely be optimized.

fischl-kazuha-xingqiu-yelan.desc: 22s Yelan onfield taser carry -- Hyperoptimized with 4TF Fischl, high margin of error from frame delays

chevreuse-diona-gaming-rosaria.desc: Gaming Diona Rosaria Chevreuse. ~20s Rot. Melt Gaming with a Cryo Venn diagram and C6 Chevreuse. 6 buffed skill plunges melted + 1 unbuffed plunge melted. Mind your Cryo aura, 4 delayed plunges (waiting on the ground) + 2 immediate plunges. Double SoDP is ideal.

kazuha-neuvillette-xilonen-xingqiu.desc: Neuv Xingqiu Kazuha Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Xingqiu provides hydro particles, IR, and C2 Res Shred. 4EoSF on Xingqiu is ~5% low.

fischl-kinich-ororon-xilonen.desc: Kinich quicken with TF to shorten his skill cd to fit into shorter rotation. Xilo buffs the electros and minorly buffs kinich via a4. kinich spins to catch blindspots and uses short hold E. he gets 3 canons per skill.

diona-furina-hutao-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Yelan Furina. With a shield and (not a lot of) healing. Hu Tao makes rare use of Diona C6

arlecchino-bennett-furina-sucrose.desc: Arle Furina Sucrose Bennett. 20s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 3[N5D] N2. Bennett Q C4 hE to leave pyro for sucrose to swirl it. Sucrose N1 E N3 to double swirl.

fischl-lynette-nahida-xingqiu.desc: hyperbloom driver lynette. deepwood xingqiu and instructor nahida. 25s rotation.

alhaitham-furina-lisa-nahida.desc: Alhaitham Hyperbloom with Nahida Furina Lisa. use 2 prototype amber

bennett-navia-xianyun-zhongli.desc: navia plunge with shield. 18s~ rotation. crystallize pick up on dash. navia does not build er and burst when ready.  energy for bennett and xianyun can be a little tight if zl pillar breaks, can refresh pillar between navia skills for minimal dps loss. bennett skill between navia skills for energy and crystallize. clam might be a little unreliable.

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-klee.desc: Klee overload with Chevy. 17s-ish rotation with psuedo APL. swap_delay has some random variance instead of fixed 12 frames. Klee really needs the particles from Chev, don't miss that timing. Klee is using Echoes, Lavawalker is close but pyro uptime is only ~73%. Blame hyv for not printing a good set for her

bennett-navia-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Navia Xiangling Xilonen Bennett. Xilonen 2E 21s rot. Navia 3rd E if available. Start with Bennett E dash for the scroll setup in the first rot.

citlali-escoffier-furina-ganyu.desc: Ganyu Furina Escoffier Citlali. 5CA 20s rot. Ganyu uses 1CA before EQ to snapshot all the 3 stacks of 4MH. Citlali before Escoffier for better Scroll proc.

fischl-furina-xilonen-yelan.desc: APL Yelan onfield with Fischl+Furina+Xilo. N4 spam, no cancels.

kokomi-nahida-nilou-xingqiu.desc: Nilou Bloom with Triple Hydro Kokomi Xingqiu and Nahida

escoffier-furina-rosaria-shenhe.desc: Rosaria Furina Shenhe Escoffier. ~20s Rot. Triple Cryo Freeze on-field Rosaria. 2E Shenhe. Rosaria uses skill off CD and really makes use of that Phys RES Shred. -2K DPS vs a Freeze immunity.

citlali-hutao-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Hutao Yelan Xingqiu Citlali. ~21s Rot. Hutao VapeMelt. 2E Yelan. Citlali shield covers most of Hutao's skill. Burstless Hutao. -3K DPS with Freeze immunity.

clorinde-furina-lynette-ororon.desc: Clorinde Taser with Ororon and Lynette. 4 rotations alternating between starting with Furina ED Q and Lynette EQ. Requires C4/sac sword Lynette, and starts running into Skill cd if sim continues for more rots. Lynette's ER requirements are low so she builds for damage

furina-kuki-nahida-xingqiu.desc: KQMS. WolfFang r1 >= Festering r5 > Pipe r5 for Furina. Widsith Nahida + Fav furina and Fav Nahida + Festering Furina result in near identical simulated dps.

chongyun-escoffier-furina-ganyu.desc: Ganyu Furina Escoffier Chongyun. 5CA 21s rot. Ganyu uses 1CA before EQ to snapshot all the 3 stacks of 4MH. Chongyun provides Cryo RES Shred.

candace-nahida-nilou-yaoyao.desc: Nilou with Candace, Nahida, and Yaoyao. Candance does a surprising number of blooms

bennett-furina-klee-yelan.desc: Klee Double Hydro Vape with Klee, Furina, Yelan, Bennett. Yelan 2E Rotation. Klee Vapes ~60% of her CAs. The whole team recieves at least 1 tick of bennett healing per rotation after the first rotation.

escoffier-furina-navia-yelan.desc: Navia Furina Yelan Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Navia Double Hydro with Escoffier. Navia does 2[E3N2D] between 2 Yelan skills. Navia bursts every rotation mid rotaion. The shatters can cause a deffiency in Crystalize shards in some cases, but freeze immunity decreases DPS due to lost Shatters. A 3rd Navia skill is used overy other rotation.

bennett-gaming-xianyun-xingqiu.desc: Easy VV setup. Bennett E dash backwards Q, Xianyun N1 Ep Q N1. Gaming juggles his Man Chai while weaving attacks between 7 E plunges. Ingame, press Skill after attacking and while mid-air, wait till Man Chai has reached extremely close to Gaming before plunging.

albedo-nahida-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Raiden hyperbloom with Nahida Xingqiu Albedo

alhaitham-furina-raiden-xianyun.desc: # AlHaitham Furina Raiden Xianyun. ~29s Rot. AlHaitham Hyperplunge. Raiden refreshes E during Alhaitmam burst uptime. AlHaitham spends high plunges then does mirror combos. 70% collisions after E plunge, 50% after burst.

chiori-clorinde-sara-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Sara Geo Wheelchair Team. Two separate 16s rotations (or a large 32s rotation). Xilonen uses her Burst at the start of every large rotation (except the first) to fill time.

dehya-fischl-kinich-ororon.desc: Kinich quicken with Dehya providing some burning uptime and IR. Dehya uses r5 sac to shorten rotation to 18s~. Kinich spins to catch blindspots and uses short hold E. 4 Cannon shots isn't 100% consistent even with shE.

charlotte-furina-lynette-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Lynette Charlotte. 4CA 25s rot. Kazuha is on vacation. Lynette is free and has a taunt better than nothing.

chiori-kinich-ororon-zhongli.desc: Kinich quicken with double geo. Ororon provides scroll buff and some personal damage. open with Chiori to weave NAs to proc her a1, since Kinich can't proc it. Kinich spins to catch blindspots and use short hold E.

fischl-nahida-xianyun-yaemiko.desc: Yae Nahida Xianyun Fischl. ~24s Rot. Yae Aggravate plunge. Yae bursts every rotation after her first plunge. Xianyun refeshes VV mid rotation. 50% Collisons.

baizhu-furina-thoma-yelan.desc: Thoma burgeon featuring some furina forward vapes

escoffier-furina-sethos-yelan.desc: Sethos Furina Yelan Escoffier. ~21s Rot. Sethos Taser with token Superconduct. 2E Yelan bookends Sethos burst mode. Sethos does 1 shadowpiecing shot and 1 level one aimed shot after Yelan's second skill, weaving N1 in between for Yelan's dice. Freeze immunity results in the same DPS.

clorinde-fischl-tighnari-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Tighari Fischl Xilonen. ~16s Rot. Clorinde Tighnari Aggravate. Tighnari applies enough Dendro for Quicken to last for duration of Clorinde's field time. Clorinde and Fischl burst in alternate rotations. Xilonen does not burst.

bennett-citlali-escoffier-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Escoffier Citlali Bennett. 18-19s rot. 3[N5] No Yoimiya Q. Yoimiya melting every possible hits of 3[N5]. Escoffier and Citlali should apply Cryo back to back so that you have 1 Cryo app per second. You need to find that sweet spot in game.

escoffier-navia-shenhe-xilonen.desc: Navia Xilonen Escoffier Shenhe. Shenhe 2 tE 22s rot. Navia use her 3rd E every 2 rot at the end.

baizhu-fischl-furina-yaemiko.desc: Yae Fischl hyperbloom. Baizhu is given some additional field time to make up for his lower off field application

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-raiden.desc: Raiden Fischl Chevreuse Bennett. 18s rot. DPS build Chev. Q 2[hE] on bennett Q. Use Fischl N3Q to get Chev C6 buff and N1E at the end of the rot if available. Use Bennett E right before raiden to refresh Chev A1 res shred.

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-lisa.desc: Bennett Chevreuse Fischl Lisa. ~16-18s Rot. TF Bennett DPS generates partcles for DPS build Chevreuse. Lisa bursts every other rot before Oz within Bennett Q. Chevreuse Q3E every rot in Bennett Q. Bennett 3EM>EDC>ADC.

kokomi-nahida-raiden-yelan.desc: Kokomi Nahida Yelan Raiden. ~22s Rot. Kokomi on-field Hyperbloom. Kokomi's skill heals over the setup period and is freshed with her burst. Kokomi's burst is wrapped by Yelan skill uses.

charlotte-escoffier-furina-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Furina Escoffier Charlotte. 20s rot. 5[N3CJ] N3 Q or C. Charlotte Q every rot for healing, Escoffier Q every 2 rot.

alhaitham-dori-furina-nahida.desc: Alhaitham Nahida Furina Dori. ~22s Rot. AlHaitham Dori Hyperbloom. Nahida refreshes skill during AlHaitham's burst window. Dori's unexceptional Electro application causes Quicken to wear off toward the end of AlHaitham's Field Time. Room for optimization with AlHaitham's combo.

alhaitham-fischl-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Yae Fischl Nahida

alhaitham-dori-furina-yelan.desc: Alhaitham Furina Yelan Dori. ~22s Rot. AlHaitham Double Hydro Hyperbloom. Dori just before AlHaitham to maximize energy gained, then Yelan uses her 2nd E in Alhaitham's burst window. Harbinger of Dawn nearly matches WF. Low Quicken uptime.

candace-fischl-nahida-raiden.desc: Double electro hyperbloom with Candace driver, ~15s rotation

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-yelan.desc: overvape dps chev with c6 bennett, 19s rotation

aetherpyro-escoffier-furina-yelan.desc: PMC Furina Yelan Escoffier. ~22s Rot. On-Field PMC Vape/Melt. 2E Yelan. Scroll > OC PMC. Same DPS with Freeze immunity.

escoffier-furina-kaeya-shenhe.desc: Kaeya Furina Shenhe Escoffier. ~20s Rot. Triple Cryo Freeze on-field Kaeya. 2E Shenhe. Kaeya uses skill off CD. Freeze immunity changes ER requirements thanks to Kaeya A4.

furina-kazuha-sigewinne-yelan.desc: Sigewinne mono hydro with R5 sac bow, allowing to refresh her E stacks for furina

citlali-escoffier-hutao-yelan.desc: Hutao Furina Citlali Escoffier. ~18s Rot. Hutao MeltVape. -4K DPS with Freeze immunity. Escoffier bursts every other rotatation.

hutao-xingqiu-yelan-zhongli.desc: Classic double hydro Hu Tao.  2 Yelan E. Xingqiu E with AP and Yelan A4 buff

chasca-emilie-furina-mavuika.desc: Chasca Furina Emilie Mavuika. Chasca BurngeonVape. ~33s rotation. Chasca does 5[C] with Burst every other rotation. Furina casts her Burst once. Furina Skill, Mavuika Burst and Emilie Burst every other rotation.

furina-xianyun-xingqiu-yelan.desc: On field MH Yelan is slightly better than on field XY. 25s rotation, KQMS.

bennett-gaming-kazuha-yelan.desc: Gaming Yelan Kazuha Bennett. ~20s Rot. Gaming Vape; Gaming weaves Pyro infused normal attacks between 7 skill plunges. Kazuha does not burst. No Hydro VV. Yelan burst expires before the last plunge, but plunge anyway for energy reasons.

bennett-furina-kinich-xiangling.desc: Kinich Furina Xiangling Bennett. 20s rot. Kinich Burst if available. Everyone except Kinich Burst every rot. -4K DPS with no Kinich short hold; 4 cannon shots is consistent even with no short hold. Serpent Spine exceeds Earthshaker, Burgeon count is very low (~4 per rotation).

bennett-furina-klee-xilonen.desc: Kleerina with Bennett and Xilonen. Xilonen bursts and uses 2 skills every rotation. 22-23s rotation.

diluc-furina-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Diluc Furina Xilonen Xianyun. ~23s Rot. Diluc Vape plunge. 2E Xilonen, with Xilonen attempting to Scroll Pyro during Diluc's burst. Uniform 1/6s midair wait for plunges to reduce incidence of overtaking Hydro aura; plunging as fast as possible severely compromises vape consistency. ~75% plunges Vaped. 50% Collisions.

charlotte-furina-hutao-yelan.desc: Hutao Furina Yelan Charlotte. ~21s Rot. Hutao Vape with token Melts. Freeze immunity is -3K DPS.

furina-gaming-xilonen-yelan.desc: Gaming Furina Yelan Xilonen. ~20s Rot. Gaming Double Hydro with Gaming weaving NAs between plunges. VH > CW. 2E Xilonen only Crystallizes Hydro. Doing a Gaming EhP at the start to get Pyro Scroll in the first rotation is the same DPS.

fischl-furina-nahida-raiden.desc: Raiden quickbloom with Furina, with Prototype Amber Nahida as the sole survivability source. 20s rotation, Fischl burst rotation and skill every other rotation, Nahida attacks on field to fill time otherwise. GD, FOPL, MH, and emblem are similar on Raiden.

bennett-hutao-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Double Hydro with Bennett

dehya-nahida-neuvillette-raiden.desc: Neuvillette with vapes, hyperblooms and resistance to interrruption

baizhu-furina-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Yae Hyperbloom. 2 Baizhu E rotation. GT Furina is as good if not better, TOM is just funny.

freminet-nahida-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Freminet Nahida Raiden Xingqiu. ~21s Rot. Freminet Hyperbloom without Healing. Freminet weaves rainswords between skill uses. Freminet bursts every rotation. Nahida does not burst.

fischl-kazuha-nahida-raiden.desc: Raiden aggravate with GT Fischl and no heal

clorinde-furina-navia-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Double Geo w/ Furina. 16s rotations. Furina takes the field every other rotation, as her Skill lasts for two Clorinde Skill combos. Navia uses her Burst in Furina's place on even numbered rotations. Clorinde uses her Burst when available.

bennett-fischl-furina-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Furina Fischl Bennett. ~19s rot. Yoimiya casts her Q when ready.

arlecchino-bennett-mona-yelan.desc: Arle Yelan Mona Bennett. Yelan 1E 18s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 6[N3D]. Mona's omen buffing Arle's high BoL hits

ayaka-escoffier-furina-xianyun.desc: Ayaka Furina Escoffier Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Ayaka Cryo Plunge. 7 Cryo Plunges, 6 canceled with N1 to avoid the slow special dash. Xianyun does two skills per rotation, refreshing VV before Ayaka's second skill. 50% Collisions.

chasca-chevreuse-fischl-furina.desc: Chasca Furina Fischl Chev. 16s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b]. Chasca & Furina Q every 2 rot. 4NO Healer build Chev. Not having Chev C6 is ~8k(11%) DPS loss.

escoffier-eula-furina-rosaria.desc: Eula Furina Rosaria Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Phys Eula with Escoffier. Rosaria passes particles to Eula after Eula's burst finishes.

lynette-nahida-neuvillette-raiden.desc: neuvi HB with NA weaving for E cd and more hydro app. lynette applies some hydro, triggers some HB, and shreds hydro RES fairly consistently. r5 fav for energy.

alhaitham-fischl-kuki-yelan.desc: Double electro Alhaitham hyperbloom. Good alternative for if you do not own Nahida.

escoffier-furina-rosaria-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Furina Escoffier Rosaria. 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] N4 Q or C. Rosaria provides CR buff.

arlecchino-furina-xianyun-xingqiu.desc: Arlechinno Furina Xingqiu Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Arlechinno Plunge Vape. Note the lack of healing without the use of Arlechinno's burst. 50% Collisions.

alhaitham-fischl-nahida-razor.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Fsichl Nahida razor

nahida-raiden-sethos-yelan.desc: Sethos Yelan Raiden Nahida. ~18s Rot. Sethos Hyperbloom with Raiden. Nahida Supplies the only Healing with Pamber. Sethos's tries dashes between N2s for better repositioning to hit bloom cores. Sethos encloses his burst with skill uses for better energy and looses two Shadowpeircing shots at the end of his field time.

cyno-fischl-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Cyno Hyperbloom with Fischl Nahida and Xingqiu

bennett-chevreuse-raiden-xiangling.desc: Raiden Overload 20s rotation .3 Chevreuse skills. 2 Bennett skills funneled to Xiangling.

bennett-hutao-sucrose-yelan.desc: Hu Tao VV Vape with Sucrose. Requires using Bennett's Hold Skill to swirl pyro. Rotation does not swirl Hydro

baizhu-furina-mavuika-varesa.desc: Varesa Furina Mavuika Baizhu. ~24s rot. 7 Plunge Combos (+1 in opening rotation). Opening rotation is extended by starting with 1 extra Plunge Combo. Baizhu uses 2 Es. FavCodex Baizhu is ~200 less DPS. 100% Collisions.

fischl-kokomi-kuki-nahida.desc: Kokomi Fischl Nahida Kuki with random delays. Uses Kuki burst early in the rotation then onfields Kokomi without burst for a while. Right before Fischl burst, uses Kuki skill and only after that does Kokomi burst. Stays on her beyond her burst duration till Fischl Oz expires

fischl-nahida-razor-xingqiu.desc: Fischl EN1 > Kusanali QEN1 > Xingqiu EDQN1 > Fischl N2Q > Razor EDN1Q N3ED 2N3D N3ED 2N3D N3EDN1.

candace-clorinde-fischl-nahida.desc: Clorinde Fischl Candace Nahida. Candace 1E 16s rot. Catch her hydro particles during her on-field. Nahida Q every 2 rots. Her Q every rot with PAmber/Fruit is ~3k lower.

alhaitham-kuki-ororon-yelan.desc: Alhaitham Hyperbloom solo dendro. 2 Yelan E Split uptime 21/22s rotation. Kuki Start HP: 50%.

bennett-fischl-hutao-xingqiu.desc: Hu Tao Overvape | Fill the time from 16s to 21s with just Bennett

arlecchino-chevreuse-emilie-fischl.desc: Arle Emilie Fischl Chev. 16s rot. No Arle Q 6[N3D] N1. more mobile than bennett variant. Chevreuse provides ATK% and C6 DMG%. Fischl can hold either 4DM, 4UR, or 4GT.

chongyun-escoffier-furina-shenhe.desc: Chongyun Furina Shenhe Escoffier. ~21s Rot. Chongyun onfield uses his burst whenever it is ready. 2E Shenhe.

chevreuse-fischl-yaemiko-yanfei.desc: double electro overload yanfei. 25s rotation with 2 chev skills to refresh c6 buff and healing, as well as for energy. em build is similar to crit build on yanfei. yanfei buffs the team via hakushin ring.

furina-neuvillette-sigewinne-zhongli.desc: Neuv Furina Zhongli Sigewinne. 4CA 25s rot. Sigewinne pickup the hydro shard for 4AP twice. On the 2nd half, Zhongli uses tE to trigger 4pc Scroll while providing Hydro Shard for 4AP Sigenwinne. 4th CA isn't protected by his shield, use hE if uncomfortable.

fischl-keqing-nahida-xiangling.desc: TF Keqing Fischl Nahida Xiangling. ~26s rot. NOT my sim, made by haafr. Very little difference between ToTM and Deepwood on Nahida. Overload is a huge part of the team's damage, which is not great for vertical investment. If Keqing is 4UR instead of 4TF, her second combo should be QEE 4N1C.

beidou-kokomi-nahida-raiden.desc: On field kokomi hyperbloom with nahida burst talent lvl 8

fischl-kinich-nahida-yelan.desc: Kinich Nahida Yelan Fischl . ~18s Rot. Kinich seeks blindspots. No Kinich short hold is -6K DPS. Codex > Scroll Kinich.

clorinde-fischl-xilonen-yunjin.desc: Clorinde Fischl YunJin Xilonen. 16s rot. Alternate Clorinde Q and Xilonen Q at the end. YunJin right before Clorinde to pick up the Electro shard for 4AP and Geo resonance. 4Husk on YunJin is ~5% less.

kazuha-kokomi-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Kokomi mono hydro. Yelan uses 2e and gets 2 fav procs to enable extremely low er requirements on teammates

dori-fischl-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Dori Furina Fischl Nahida. ~24s Rot. Dori Hyperbloom with Xingqiu sans TF. Nahida takes the field during infusion downtime using N1C.

chevreuse-furina-gaming-lynette.desc: gaming vv vape without circle impact. chev provides her c6 buff,  easy vv setup, healing, and energy.gaming does 7 skill plunges. vha similar to cw. r5 fav lynette to get 2 procs

bennett-furina-jean-yelan.desc: benny vape dps. jean provide extra healing for furina and guaranteed pyro swirl via self swirl. 2e yelan 22s rotation.

furina-kazuha-mualani-xilonen.desc: Mualani Furina Kazuha Xilonen. 31s rot. 1st half starts with Xilonen Q and Furina Q and ends with Mualani Q, 2nd half has Kazuha Q. Furina's E lasting 30s is really nice.

hutao-nahida-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Vape+Burgeon with Xingqiu Yelan Nahida

dori-fischl-nahida-yelan.desc: Dori Yelan Fischl Nahida. ~24s Rot. Full EM Dori Hyperbloom. 2 E Yelan. Slingshot Yelan is viable.

bennett-faruzan-xianyun-xiao.desc: Xiao triple anemo with Bennett (50% collision). Bennett only makes an E.

clorinde-furina-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Clorinde Furina Yelan Xingqiu. ~25s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Mono Hydro. Fanfare peaks at 34 DMG% in the third rotation. Clorinde does not burst to avoid wasting coordinated attacks. 2E Yelan.

ayato-fischl-nahida-raiden.desc: ayato fischl raiden nahida hyperbloom, ayato 2E on a 25s rot

ayato-escoffier-furina-shenhe.desc: Ayato Furina Shenhe Escoffier. ~26s rot. Shenhe casts her abilities early to proc Scroll for Ayato's 1st Skill. Ayato's 2nd Skill does N14 instead of N15 for ~200 more team DPS at the expense of Ayato's personal DPS.

chongyun-escoffier-furina-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Furina Chongyun Escoffier. 21-22s rot. 5[N3CJ] N4 Q/C. Chongyun batteries Escoffier.

bennett-candace-furina-gaming.desc: Gaming Furina Candace Bennett. ~20s Rot. Gaming Vape plunge with Gaming weaving Hydro infused NAs between plunges, with Bennett's C6 overriden. Candace's C6 adds more reliable Hydro application in AoE.

escoffier-freminet-furina-rosaria.desc: Freminet Furina Rosaria Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Physical Freminet Shatter. PF + Serpent Spine > MH + Tidal.

chiori-furina-navia-xianyun.desc: Navia Chiori Furina Xianyun. 20s rot. total 8 high plunge (50% collision) with perfect dash canceling all being geo dmg. Furina comes between navia E to funnel fav particles. Chiori Q every other rot, receiving max furina fanfare.

escoffier-furina-ganyu-mona.desc: Ganyu Furina Escoffier Mona. 5CA 21s rot.  Ganyu uses 1CA before EQ to snapshot all the 3 stacks of 4MH.

bennett-kazuha-lyney-zhongli.desc: Lyney Monopyro with crowd control and shield. AP Bennett and shorter rotation

arlecchino-bennett-layla-yelan.desc: Arle Yelan Layla Bennett. 18s rot. No Arle Q, N1 CA cancell 6[N3D]. CA cancel is DPS neutral (a few hundred DPS) here. not necessary.

alhaitham-dori-fischl-nahida.desc: Alhaitham Nahida Fischl Dori. ~20s Rot. Long field time Alhaitham with Dori supplying enough energy to Alhaitham to avoid additional ER investment. Fischl deploys Oz during Alhaitham's burst window, alternating skill and burst. Nahida's bursts every other rotation.

bennett-gaming-kaeya-xianyun.desc: first rotation, swap to Xianyun after Bennett and trigger a pyro swirl. Kaeya's cryo application may not be reliable. On second+ rotation, don't swap to Xianyun after Bennett. Gaming does 7 Skill plunges.

bennett-fischl-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Bennett's pyro application doesnt interfere largely with quicken uptime. Fischl snapshots Bennett buff onto both uptimes which can be tight. Swap to Bennett 3 times for energy generation and Instructor uptime

alhaitham-fischl-nahida-varesa.desc: Alhaitham Varesa Nahida Fischl. Alhaitham Spread utilizing Scroll Varesa with no sustain. 26s rotation. Iron Sting = 63.5k. Split rotation. Refresh Scroll buff mid rotation. N3D / N3CD on Alhaitham. TTDS on Varesa outputs slightly more DPS but results in energy problems occasionally.

baizhu-clorinde-furina-nahida.desc: furina nahida baizhu clorinde with TF clorinde. 27s~ rotation with 2 baizhu e. clorinde burst when ready. damage build baizhu with noblesse, clam is similar. em sands better than atk sands on clorinde.

bennett-chevreuse-sara-yaemiko.desc: Yae carry with Chevreuse. 16s rotations Yae and Sara Burst every other rotation

alhaitham-dori-fischl-xingqiu.desc: Alhaitham Xingqiu Fischl Dori. ~21s Rot. Long field time Alhaitham with Dori supplying enough energy to Alhaitham to avoid additional ER investment. Deploys Oz during Alhaitham's burst window. 50% Quicken uptime; Alhaitham combo focuses on driving rainswords. Aquamarine Dori is technically better here, but less comfortable for ER.

arlecchino-bennett-hutao-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Arle dual carry. 5N2CD Hutao then swap

beidou-kazuha-neuvillette-ororon.desc: Neuv Taser with Ororon, 2 targets. ~26s 3CA rot. Ororon is on R5 fav but ER requirements are still higher compared to Fischl variant. R3 fav is barely behind if Ororon does E N2 instead of E N1

beidou-clorinde-fischl-nahida.desc: Clorinde Nahida Fischl Beidou. ~27s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Triple Electro. Nahida bursts every other rotation after the first. Eshu is techincally functional. Within narrow distance for Beidou C6, RES shred may be inconsistent in practice. 10 % counter; 20% Perfect counter.

citlali-furina-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Furina Yelan Citlali. ~22s Rot. VapeMelt Yoimiya with PAmber Healing Bonus Citlali. Citlali does not scroll Pyro. 2E Yelan. 2 ATK% mainstats for Yoimiya performs similarly to ATK%+EM and performs better than Pyro DMG%. Freeze immunity is -2.5K DPS.

chevreuse-fischl-mavuika-raiden.desc: Raiden Chevreuse Mavuika Fischl. ~18 Rot. Raiden Mavuika Overload, Raiden bursts every rotation, Mavuika every other with 2[C2D] ED. Fischl burst every rotation before raiden and uses skill after Raiden burst if available. Sometimes Raiden is best off covering burst CD downtime with NA alongside Fischl C6.

nahida-xingqiu-yaemiko-yelan.desc: 25s Yae onfield hyperbloom -- Double hydro, Yelan 2E, Yae NA spam no cancels

bennett-gaming-kazuha-xingqiu.desc: VV setup is... simple enough. Bennett EQ N1, Kaz N1 Ep needs to happen super quickly. Hydro swirls are a bonus that sometimes happen, not a requirement. Gaming juggles his Man Chai while weaving attacks between E plunges. Ingame, press Skill after attacking and while mid-air, wait till Man Chai has reached extremely close to Gaming before plunging

bennett-faruzan-furina-wanderer.desc: wanderer furina. burst at start of wanderer's field time if available

arlecchino-bennett-furina-xiangling.desc: Mono pyro arle with furina vaping. Furina bursts every other rot, and do extra normals with arle if not bursting. N14 Arle combo for simplicity

bennett-furina-itto-xianyun.desc: Itto Furina Bennett Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Itto Vape plunge with VV. Bennett EQN1 Xianyun N2. 50% Collisions.

arlecchino-chevreuse-fischl-thoma.desc: Arle Fischl Chev Thoma. 18s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D]. read the comments inside for the detailed fischl setup.

fischl-furina-keqing-nahida.desc: Quickbloom Keqing with Furina. ~27s rotation. Note that at some point Fanfare gains diminish as Pamber is not enough to keep everyone above 50%

escoffier-furina-ganyu-rosaria.desc: Ganyu Furina Escoffier Rosaria. 5CA 21s rot. Ganyu uses 1CA before EQ to snapshot all the 3 stacks of 4MH. Rosaria provides CR buff and Cryo particles diretly to Ganyu to lower her ER needs.

bennett-emilie-kinich-kirara.desc: Kinich Emilie Kirara Bennett. 20s rot. E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo with consistently NA clockwise. You can technically swap Kirara and Emilie's place with lower shield uptime and slightly less deepwood uptime on Kinich.

nahida-navia-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Raiden Nahida Navia Xingqiu.~21s Rot. Classic Hyperbloom where the main damage is hyperbloom. On-field Raiden. Navia occasionally comes out of the pocket and makes an burst and skill.

clorinde-fischl-kirara-nahida.desc: Clorinde Fischl Nahida Kirara. 16s rot. Kirara for shield, dendro resonance, C6 damage bonus, potentially C4 dendro app for wave contents.

chasca-furina-ororon-sigewinne.desc: Chasca Ororon Furina SigeWinne; Sigewinne uses sac bow in order to not run into that many CD issues, VV is better than Codex for chasca.

alhaitham-kirara-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Triple Dendro Alhaitham spread. No Yae Burst. 2 Kirara shields for higher uptime as well as Instructor uptime

chevreuse-fischl-keqing-mavuika.desc: Keqing Chevreuse Fischl Mavuika. ~17s Rot. Keqing Overload. Mavuika just uses burst and skill every rotation. Keqing does EQE then N1C spam until skill refresh into more N1C. Fischl misses out on snapshotting Chevreuse's ATK buff in the first rotation.

kinich-kirara-nahida-ororon.desc: Kinich Ororon Nahida Kirara. ~18s Rot. Triple Dendro Spread. Kinich seeks blindspots. No Kinich Short Hold E is -2K DPS. Kinich bursts every other rotation; Nahida bursts in the other rotations for Kinich skill cd.

baizhu-nahida-raiden-yelan.desc: Yelan Baizhu hyperbloom with on field Raiden

ayaka-furina-rosaria-xilonen.desc: Ayaka Furina Rosaria Xilonen. ~22s Rot. Ayaka Freeze, no grouping. Ayaka, Rosaria, and Xilonen do 2 skills per rotation, with Xilonen Scrolling both Hydro and Cryo. Xilonen heals the whole team. Crit rate buffs and low ER req lead to high Furina DPS. -4K DPS with Freeze Immnuity & MH.

nahida-ororon-sethos-yelan.desc: Sethos Yelan Ororon Nahida. ~18s Rot. Sethos with an EM Hyperbloom Ororon. Nahida Supplies the only healing with Pamber. Sethos uses dashes to reposition to better hit bloom cores after N2D. Sethos ends the rotation with 2 level 2 aimed shots.

chasca-citlali-escoffier-furina.desc: Chasca Furina Escoffier Citlali. 22s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b], Q if available. Citlali before Escoffier for better Scroll proc. Citlali E > Escoffier EQ > Citlali Q.

fischl-nahida-sethos-yelan.desc: Sethos Yelan Fischl Nahida. ~18s Rot. Sethos Quickbloom. Sethos repositions with dash to hit seeds between N2s. Sethos encloses his burst with skill uses and fires 2 Shadowpiecing shots after burst ends. PAmber supplies the only healing and allows Nahida to burst every rotation. Ownership of hyperbloom for Sethos and Fischl is affected by opponent size.

chevreuse-clorinde-thoma-yaemiko.desc: Clorinde Yae Chev Thoma. 17s rot. No Yae Q, just 3[E] once. with 4NO on Thoma, you can do Q every 2rots on Chev and stack more HP on her.

furina-gaming-xianyun.desc: Birb. Gaming plunges 9 times. To do this ingame, Press E immediately after Q and each plunge. Wait till Man Chai is extremely close to you, then plunge.

fischl-nahida-sucrose-xingqiu.desc: Sucrose hyperbloom - this is an alternative rotation that maximizes Sucrose HB procs

kuki-nahida-sethos-yelan.desc: Sethos Nahida Yelan Kuki. ~18s Rot. Sethos Hyperbloom with Kuki. Yelan ER needs are high. Sethos encloses his burst with skill uses. Sethos uses dash instead of walk to reposition to hit boom cores between N2s.

fischl-furina-nahida-sayu.desc: Sayu Hyperbloom with Fischl Furina Nahida. ~25s rot.

chasca-escoffier-ororon-shenhe.desc: Chasca Escoffier Ororon Shenhe. ~16.5s rotation. Chasca alternates E 5[CA] and EQ 4[CA] (very tigh combo). Doing E 4[CA] Q instead is ~1k loss. Shenhe and Chasca bursts every other rotation. VV ~1k ahead of Codex. TotM Escoffier also ~1k worse than GT. Cryo% Goblet is ~700 worse than ATK% Goblet.

alhaitham-fischl-kirara-nahida.desc: AlHaitham Nahida Fischl Kirara. ~20s Rot. Long Field time Alhaitham Spread. Fischl alternate skill and burst during Alhaitham's burst window. Kirara builds full hp and doesn't burst at all, though she has enough ER to do so. Nahida bursts nearly every rotation.

collei-fischl-sucrose-yaemiko.desc: Yae Fischl Aggravate with Collei and Hakushin Sucrose

alhaitham-fischl-kuki-nahida.desc: Alhaitham Spread with nahida Kuki and Fischl

bennett-lyney-xilonen-zhongli.desc: Lyney "Mono" with Zhongli shield and geo resonance. Xilo and Zhongli force a fav proc each rotation. Lyney bursts every other rotation. 16s 4/5CA rotation

clorinde-fischl-nahida-tighnari.desc: Clorinde Tighnari Fischl Nahida. ~17s Rot. Clorinde Tighnari Dual DPS. Alternates Fischl Skill and Burst. Nahida, Clorinde & Tighnari burst only if available.

kazuha-neuvillette-ororon-yaemiko.desc: Neuv Ororon Yae Kazuha. 4CA 27s rot. EM build Ororon

bennett-furina-mavuika-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Furina Mavuika Bennett. 20s rot. 5[N3CJ] + ( Q or N3 ). A bit shorter combo than usual but its DPS gain. Mavuika deals impressive personal damage. Wrio C1 + C1 combo isn't team DPS gain.

nahida-qiqi-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Nahida Xingqiu Qiqi

bennett-raiden-xiangling-yelan.desc: Raiden National with Yelan. Bennett particle delay changed to allow Xiangling to N1Q for Yelan dice and still catch funneled Bennett particles; This is difficult or impossible at low ping.

chevreuse-gaming-rosaria-sucrose.desc: Gaming Melt with C6 chevreuse for dmg bonus buff. ~19s rotation. Utilizes wait(x) to line up gaming plunges with rosaria burst ticks. 7 total plunges, of which 6 are melted, with the last plunge being used for energy.

furina-lisa-nahida-sethos.desc: Sethos quickbloom with Furina, Pamber Nahida and Pamber Lisa for healing. 20s 2E Sethos rotation, Sethos does 8N2W and 2 Shadow Piercing Shots. Lisa uses hold E for energy.

bennett-furina-kinich-thoma.desc: Kinch / Thoma / Bennett / Furina. Kinich Burgeon. ~21s. Kinich bursts every other rotation.  4 Cannons with short holds, inconsistent 4 without short holds.

escoffier-ganyu-layla-shenhe.desc: Ganyu Shenhe Escoffier Layla. ~25s rot. Layla uses a DPS build and casts her Burst twice per rotation. Ganyu hits a weakspot at the start of each of her 2 field-times. If enemy has no weakspots or both are missed then Song of Stillness is preferred and is ~2k DPS behind.

fischl-luminedendro-sucrose-yaemiko.desc: Yae Fischl Aggravate with DMC and Sucrose

arlecchino-bennett-kazuha-mona.desc: Arle Mona Kazuha Bennett. 18s rot. No Arle Q, N3D combo. kazuha 2E per rot. used Pamber on mona for energy.

fischl-nahida-sara-yaemiko.desc: On field Yae aggravate. Both Fischl Summons buffed by Sara. Only 1 Yae field time buffed by sara.

chasca-furina-mavuika-nahida.desc: Chasca Furina Nahida Mavuika. Chasca BurgeonVape. ~31s rotation. Chasca does 4[C] ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Furina casts her Burst once and casts her Skill every other rotation. Mavuika Bursts every odd rotation. Nahida does not Burst.

bennett-chasca-furina-xilonen.desc: Chasca Furina Xilonen Bennett. 20s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Double Scroll with Xilonen 2E per rot. 1st rot has low DPS.

escoffier-furina-nahida-raiden.desc: Raiden Furina Nahida Escoffier. ~21s Rot. On-Field Raiden Hyperbloom. Raiden builds significant ER for optimal team DPS. Nahida fills time for Furina's skill CD after Raiden's burst. Superconduct comprises ~15% of Raiden's DPS.

fischl-furina-heizou-yelan.desc: Heizou Furina Fischl Yelan. ~25s Rot. Heizou Taser in ST w/ P-Amber Heizou bursting twice per rotation to heal the team. Transformative > Talent Damage.

fischl-sara-sucrose-tighnari.desc: tighnari fischl sucrose sara with 2E sara, hunter's path is as always a massive dps increase

bennett-navia-yelan-zhongli.desc: Navia Yelan. 4E first rot (3 w buffs, one to prefunnel energy ). First rotation does higher dps than subsequent ones. 2 Yelan e. Navia does some pyro/vaped NA to fill downtime

bennett-kinich-lynette-ororon.desc: kinich quickburn with lynette as off field pyro applier via her burst absorption. ororon provides scroll buff and some overload damage, while not completely ruining burning aura. kinich spins to catch blindspots and use quick hold E.

clorinde-fischl-furina-yelan.desc: Clorinde Furina Yelan Fischl. ~26s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Taser. Clorinde does not burst to avoid wasting coordinated attacks. 2E Yelan. Fischl skill and burst every rotation; Fischl skill before and after Furina is similar.

bennett-furina-xiangling-yelan.desc: On-field Vape Bennett. Very evenly split dmg distribution. Xiangling only vapes around 60% of her dmg in exchange for more forward vape Furina hits. Furina does not recieve any of Bennett's healing.

citlali-nahida-neuvillette-raiden.desc: Neuv Citlali Nahida Raiden. 4CA 25s rot. Fav for Solo Hydro Neuv ER req. Its difficult to trigger Hydro Scroll.

chevreuse-fischl-mavuika-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Fischl Mavuika Chev. 18s rot. Yoimiya Q every 2rot. Starts with Fischl E in the first rot for Chev setup. Healer build Chev w/ 40k+ HP.

emilie-mualani-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Mualani Emilie Xiangling Zhongli. 31s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. 2nd half relies on Guoba and Burning. 4pc UR is comparable to 4pc Obsidian with Sac Jade here.

furina-noelle-xilonen-yelan.desc: Petra Noelle driving double hydro with Xilonen. 22s rotation

bennett-fischl-kinich-nahida.desc: Kinich Fischl Nahida Bennett. ~18s rot. Kinich burst is a tiny DPS gain. Scroll Kinich is -2K DPS. Nahida bursts every other rotation after the first and fills time while Bennett's skill is on CD. No Kinich short hold is -3K DPS.

faruzan-furina-lynette-xianyun.desc: Hyperbuffed plunge Lynette with Furina, Faruzan, Xianyun. Lynette dash-cancels after each plunge. No IR, but has Lynette's taunt. 100% collision rate. 21s rotation.

clorinde-furina-ororon-yelan.desc: Clorinde Furina Yelan Ororon. ~26s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Taser. Emblem > NO Yelan. Clorinde bursts following her first skill to catch relevant buffs; Burst with Clorinde is slightly better than filling skill cd downtime with Yelan Normal attacks.

arlecchino-bennett-kazuha-layla.desc: Arle Layla Kazuha Bennett. 16-17s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 6[N3D]. Do note that arle's first NA melted here. See the timing in samples tab. it will have lower performance w/o it.

furina-kuki-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Yae Kuki hyperbloom. Desynced rotation for Kuki Skill/4PC instructor uptime. Split field time between Nahida and Yae. Yae burst every other rotation

bennett-chongyun-kinich-xiangling.desc: Kinich burning with Chongyun dealing burst melt nuke. his cd reduction is not used. 18s~ rotation with Xiangling bursting every other rotation. Kinich spins to catch blindspots and use short hold E to reach 5 canon shots, minus one cannon shot and 7K DPS with no ShE.

fischl-kinich-ororon-thoma.desc: Kinich quickburn with thoma. Despite the double electro, there is still alright burning uptime, kinich spins to catch blindspots and uses short hold E to get around 4 canons per skill, 3 cannons per hit with no short hold, -10K DPS.

hutao-kirara-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Double Hydro With Kirara for Burgeons and Shielding (HuTao mix of N1CJ and N2CJ)

furina-wriothesley-xilonen-yelan.desc: Wrio Furina Yelan Xilonen. Xilonen & Yelan 2E 22-23s rot. 3[N5CD]. Skip Wrio Q due to team DPS loss (~6%).

ayato-escoffier-furina-rosaria.desc: Ayato Furina Rosaria Escoffier. ~24s rot. Rosaria's Scroll procs from off-field during Ayato's 1st Skill field-time. Ayato's 2nd Skill does N10 instead of N15 for ~2k more team DPS at the expense of Ayato's personal DPS.

bennett-furina-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya double hydro. Rotation heals everyone. 2 Yelan E and 2 Bennett E rotation. Optimized first rotation with different rot

albedo-furina-navia-xianyun.desc: Navia Albedo Furina Xianyun. 21s rot. total 8 high plunge (50% collision) with perfect dash canceling all being geo dmg. Furina comes between navia E to funnel fav particles. Albedo recasts his E between navia E. but you still need to add ER subs on navia and furina if one of the casts are broken. which reduces the DPS.

nahida-thoma-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Thoma Burgeon wtih Nahida Xingqiu Yelan

alhaitham-diona-fischl-nahida.desc: Alhaitham Nahida Fischl Diona. ~25s Rot. Alhiaitham Spread in a spit rotation with C6 Diona providing 200 EM. NO Diona with Deepwood Nahida isn't far behind.

bennett-emilie-fischl-razor.desc: Razor Emilie Fischl Bennett. ~20s Rotation with 2E Sapwood Bennett. Razor Quickload w/ ~70% Quicken Uptime. Razor maintains burning with Bennett C6 infusion. SS may be inconsistent, but exceed TS without refines. Emilie Q every other rot after the first. Deepwood and & NO Bennett are similar. Self-Overloads not implemented; Real gameplay may prefer more EM to Razor/Bennett.

furina-itto-xilonen-yelan.desc: Itto Xilonen with Furina Yelan. 2 Xilo Es on the second rotation onward greatly eases up energy requirements. Modified combo allows for Ushi to get hit without losing Itto Burst. Whiteblind R5 outperforms Serpent R1.

escoffier-furina-ganyu-layla.desc: Ganyu Furina Escoffier Layla. 5CA 21s rot. Ganyu uses 1CA before EQ to snapshot all the 3 stacks of 4MH. Layla provides shield for Ganyu.

bennett-fischl-navia-zhongli.desc: Navia Zhongli Fischl Bennett, Navia uses immediate E in first rotation. Fischl's E and Q alternated in rotation.

arlecchino-chiori-kaeya-zhongli.desc: Arlechinno Kaeya Chiori Zhongli. ~16s Rot. Double Geo Arlecchino Melt with 6N3D. Chiori's doesn't meaningfully disrupt C6 Kaeya's Cryo application.

ayaka-furina-shenhe-xianyun.desc: Ayaka Furina Shenhe Xianyun. ~21s Rot. Ayaka Cryo Plunge. 6 Plunges, canceled with N1 to avoid the slow jumps from special dash. Shenhe does 2 tE per rotation. Xianyun does not refresh the Cryo VV; damage is frontloaded damage and Shatter may make it annoying anyway. With MH, -9K DPS vs Freeze immunity.

emilie-kuki-mavuika-sethos.desc: Sethos Emilie Kuki Mavuika. ~16 Rot. Sethos Quickburn. Mavuika bursts every other rotation. Mavuika fills time for Sethos skill CD on subsequent rotations when she can burst. Kuki burst when available. Full EM and Quicken Kuki result in similar overall DPS.

baizhu-fischl-furina-lynette.desc: Hyperbloom with Lynette as the on-field driver, though Fischl deals more damage. Furina and Baizhu's lacking elemental application limit the amount of Hyperblooms triggered. Lynette uses mostly N1CD

clorinde-emilie-nahida-thoma.desc: Clorinde Nahida Emilie Thoma. ~18s Rot. (TF) Clorinde Quickburn. Clorinde owns most of the Overloads, so Thoma builds HP. Nahida omits burst while Emilie bursts every rotation.

arlecchino-bennett-rosaria-shenhe.desc: Melt Arlecchino with Shenhe and Rosaria. Shenhe buffs Rosaria and slightly buffs Arlecchino while providing some off-field Cryo application.

ayato-escoffier-furina-mualani.desc: Ayato Furina Mualani Escoffier. ~25s rot. Mualani casts her Skill twice per rotation and does 1 bite each time. Sacrificial Jade on Mualani is ~300 more team DPS but ~2k less Ayato DPS. Ayato's 2nd Skill does N14 instead of N15 for ~1.5k more team DPS (~500 with Festering Desire on Furina) at the expense of Ayato's personal DPS.

hutao-layla-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Hu Tao vape melt. Layla's shield lasts whole of Hu Tao's field time

arlecchino-bennett-kazuha-kokomi.desc: Arle Kokomi Kazuha Bennett. 20s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D] N1. the N5 at the end is used for waiting kokomi's 20s cd.

furina-nahida-sethos-xilonen.desc: Sethos Furina quickbloom with Xilonen as healer and buffer. 20s~ rotation with 2 Sethos E, Sethos does 8N2W and 1 Shadow Piercing Shot. Note that Sethos might not be reliable in hitting bloom cores

chasca-chevreuse-citlali-ororon.desc: Chasca Citlali Ororon Chevreuse. ~17s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Chevreuse uses HP% Goblet for comfort, Pyro% Goblet is 700 more DPS. Not having Chevreuse C6 is ~7k (~12%) team DPS loss.

bennett-chiori-fischl-navia.desc: Navia burst in alternate rotation, allowing her to build more crit. In rotation #2 forward burst is not as important for navia as she has leftover crystallize from last rot. However, starting a new chamber with no navia burst will be a huge dps loss for the first rot.

kazuha-neuvillette-sigewinne-xilonen.desc: Neuv Sigewinne Kazuha Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Sigewinne provides hydro particles wow

escoffier-furina-layla-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Furina Escoffier Layla. 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] N4 Q or C. Layla provides shield for Wrio.

baizhu-fischl-furina-sucrose.desc: Sucrose hyperbloom trigger - Furina supplies low enough hydro application that electro aura is very consistent thus Sucrose swirls it and triggers hyperbloom - Hyperoptimised sim

fischl-furina-nahida-sethos.desc: Sethos Furina quickbloom with Pamber Nahida for healing. 20s rotation. MH slightly ahead of DPC and WT. Sethos does 8N2W + 3 Shadow Piercing Shots.

baizhu-fischl-furina-raiden.desc: Raiden Furina Fischl Baizhu. ~25s Rot. Raiden Hyperbloom with Baizhu. Fischl used skill and burst every rotation.

faruzan-xianyun-xiao-zhongli.desc: Xiao triple anemo with Zhongli (50%collision). Rotation: Zh EHDN1 > Xianyun EQ > Faruzan N1Q > Xiao E2 J12.

chevreuse-raiden-xiangling-yaemiko.desc: Raiden Chevreuse Yae Xiangling. ~22s Rot. Raikou with Xiangling. Yae uses burst every rotation: 2N2CD Q 3E, Then Raiden takes the field: Q 3N4D N3. Healing build Chevreuse. ToM Raiden is very close to Emblem. Despite the Q every rotation with a low ER requirement, EM Xiangling is quite a lot better than ADC.

arlecchino-bennett-sucrose-zhongli.desc: Arle Sucrose Zhongli Bennett. 16s rot (very tight). Sucrose Burst if available. you can put 4AP on bennett instead but not that much different.

bennett-furina-raiden-xiangling.desc: Raiden Furina Xiangling Bennett. Furina doesn't get bennett's healing. You can try 4NO on bennett in the config.

arlecchino-bennett-furina-xianyun.desc: Arle Furina Xianyun Bennett. 20s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 6[N3D] N1 (No plunges). Bennett Q C4 hE to leave pyro for xianyun to swirl it. bennett has longer field time while tEQ(N1) setup is shorter but inconsistent for pyro vv.

bennett-chasca-fischl-furina.desc: Chasca Furina Fischl Bennett. 20s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b]. Q every 2 rot.

arlecchino-chevreuse-sucrose-yelan.desc: Arle Yelan Sucrose Chev. 18s rot. No Arle Q, 3[N5D]. Chev's pyro app is enough for swirl pyro. no more bennett circle impact

kinich-ororon-thoma-yelan.desc: Kinich Yelan Ororon Thoma. ~18-20s Rot. Kinich Chaos. Kinich seeks blindspots. No Kinich short hold is -4K DPS. DMG% and EM Ororon are close.

furina-hutao-yelan-zhongli.desc: Hu Tao Furina w no healing. Surprisingly close to Xingqiu team dmg output. C1 Furina is a large increase to guarantee some fanfare consistently

chevreuse-sara-xiangling-yaemiko.desc: Yae overload. Sara buffs yae twice per rotation. Yae, Sara and Xiangling burst every other roation. Sara only buffs Xiangling on rotations she bursts

fischl-furina-kokomi-sayu.desc: 25s rot for Fischl, we do a bit of rolling. Kokomi N2Ds; options for N2C/N2W. Customized random frame delays; 90% Start HP; Energy drops based on 12-3 Icewind Suite.

clorinde-dehya-emilie-fischl.desc: Clorinde Emilie Fischl Dehya. ~15s/20s Rot. Clorinde closes the rotation with burst. Deepwood Dehya maximizes Emilie's damage. Emilie bursts every other rot after the first. EM build Dehya.

clorinde-kazuha-ororon-yelan.desc: Clorinde Ororon Yelan Kazuha. ~18s Rot. Clorinde Taser. Kazuha skill before and after Clorinde skill. Kazuha bursts when Clorinde cannot. Misses some Yelan waves.

citlali-furina-raiden-yelan.desc: Raiden Furina Yelan Citlali. ~21s Rot. Raiden Taser with healer Protoype Amber Citlali. 2E Yelan bookends Raiden's full burst with N4D.

chevreuse-fischl-furina-gaming.desc: Gaming Furina Fischl Chevreuse. ~20s Rot. Gaming Overvape. Gaming does 7 E plunges with delays. Healing & DPS Chev perform similarly. Oz leaves the field before Gaming's burst ends.

ayaka-ganyu-shenhe-xilonen.desc: Mono cryo. Ganyu and Ayaka share equal field time. Everyone uses their skills twice causing very low er requirements all round. BP and Wep banner options are ~3K behind P.Crescent R5 without headshot.

alhaitham-dori-fischl-furina.desc: Alhaitham Furina Fischl Dori. ~21s Rot. Long field time Alhaitham with Dori supplying energy. Deploy's Oz during Alhaitham's burst window.

bennett-dehya-furina-xianyun.desc: Dehya Furina Bennett Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Dehya Vape plunge with VV. You know the drill; Bennett EQN1, point blank Xianyun N3. Deyha should use her skill, worthwhile for energy even with (very little) vape disruption. 50% Collisions.

bennett-chasca-furina-luminepyro.desc: Chasca Furina PMC Bennett. 20s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b]. Chasca Q every 2 rot. PMC hEQ casted on Bennett Q to deal more damage and get healing from Bennett.

arlecchino-xilonen-yelan-yunjin.desc: Arle Yelan YunJin Xilonen. 18s rot. No Arle Q. C N16 (3[N5D] N1 is similar). Hydro scroll every rot. YunJin pickup the shard for Geo resonance.

aetherelectro-fischl-nahida-sethos.desc: Sethos Nahida EMC Fischl. Vs ASIMON. APL. CAs exclusively, CA lvl 2, then CA lvl 1 at low energy.  No Nahida burst.

furina-luminepyro-xianyun-yelan.desc: PMC Furina Yelan Xianyun. ~22s Rot. PMC Double Hydro VapePlunge. Leads with hold skill, then 8 low plunges, with burst as available inbetween. 1E Yelan. No Pyro VV. Scroll and LNO lead to the same team DPS. 50% Collisions.

dori-emilie-fischl-xiangling.desc: Dori Emilie Fischl Xiangling. ~15s Rot. Dori Quickburn; she stays oz field as long as Oz is onfield. Emilie & Xiangling burst every other rotation; Fischl alternates skill and burst. Xiangling goes after Fischl and bursts every other rotation.

alhaitham-kokomi-nilou-xingqiu.desc: Nilou Bloom with Alhaitham Xingqiu Kokomi

bennett-chiori-navia-zhongli.desc: navia chiori zhongli bennett with bennett using E twice for pyro application, chiori uses her Burst every other rotation

baizhu-nahida-xingqiu-yaemiko.desc:
Sac. Yae hyperbloom. Yae E3 -> Nahida N1EQ -> Baizhu EQ -> Xq EdQN1 -> Yae N2 E N1 E N1 E  d CA d ->  Nahida N1 E -> Yae N3Q
 If Yae ult si not charged (or in cd) -> Yae d N2 CA

luminedendro-nahida-xingqiu-yaemiko.desc: Yae Hyperbloom with Xingqiu Nahida DMC

kinich-kuki-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Kinich Xingqiu Nahida Kuki. 21s rot. Accounting for Kinich combo making him get away from the enemy so that Xingqiu's orbital doesn't apply hydro.

diona-escoffier-furina-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Furina Diona Escoffier. 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] N4 Q/C. SacBow Diona 2[hE] batteries Escoffier and uses her Q before Wrio for high 4NO uptime. You can use one of her hE at her Q usage and build more ER on Escoffier if high uptime shield is needed

fischl-keqing-kirara-sucrose.desc: Hyperoptimized Keqing aggravate with Kirara. Note Wolf-Fang is very similar to HoD

bennett-furina-navia-zhongli.desc: First rotation is different from second+ rotation. Navia does 3 E's on 1st and 4th rotations. Bennett does QE and Zhongli does E on Bennett burst in second+ rotaiton. Check config, differences are clearly laid out.

bennett-chasca-citlali-xiangling.desc: Chasca Citlali Xiangling Bennett. ~18s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Xiangling casts her Q every 3rd rotation due to low Energy generation. Chasca prefers Pyro% Goblet by ~2k (~4%).

bennett-gaming-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Gaming Xingqiu Yelan Bennett. ~21s Rot. Gaming Double Hydro Vape with Gaming weaving Pyro infused normal attacks inbetween 7 skill plunges. Support set options in config.

chasca-emilie-mavuika-ororon.desc: Chasca Ororon Emilie Mavuika. Chasca BurningLoad team. ~17.5s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b], Q every 2 rot. Chasca Mavuika Burst every other rotation. Emilie casts her Burst once every 3 rotations. Ororon on Fav is slightly worse.

chevreuse-fischl-hutao-kuki.desc: Hutao Chevreuse Fischl Kuki. ~17s Rot. Overload Hutao doing 7N3CJ. Hutao & Chevreuse burst every other rotation.

alhaitham-fischl-kirara-sara.desc: Sara buffs both Fischl and Alhaitham. DMG Build Kirara + WF Alhaitham is higher dps than Full Shield Kirara + HoD Alhaitham. See config for notes on shield uptime/stacking. Custom random frame delays, 12-3 Icewind Suite energy.

dori-furina-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Yae dori hyperbloom 25s rot Yae burst every rot. Dori gets small amount of field time to use c6 healing

fischl-furina-ningguang-xilonen.desc: Ningguang Fischl Furina Xilonen. 26s (15s + 11s) Rot. Furina casts her abilities once per rotation (or once every other short rotation) while Ningguang casts her abilities twice.

furina-xianyun-yaemiko-yelan.desc: Yae does not build any ER and alternates between Burst and extra N2JlP. Assumes 50% collision. 25s rotation, KQMS.

clorinde-furina-lisa-nahida.desc: Clorinde Nahida Furina Lisa. ~24s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Quickbloom with Lisa. Clorinde burst is better than Lisa hold skill between Clorinde skill uses. Lisa burst before Furina is better.

ayaka-citlali-furina-xilonen.desc: Ayaka Xilonen Citlali Furina. ~21s rot. TTDS scroll citlali to buff ayaka and provide interruption resistance by shield; however, ayaka's er requirement is not quite low.

arlecchino-chiori-emilie-zhongli.desc: Arle Emilie Chiori Zhongli. No Arle Q 16-17s rot. Alternate Emilie Q and Chiori Q during waiting Arle E 5seconds

bennett-fischl-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Bennett Nahida Fischl Xingqiu. ~21s Rot. Bennett Burgeon on-field with Fischl snapshotting his buff and adding Overload. Nahida omits burst if unavailable.

arlecchino-ayaka-bennett-shenhe.desc: arle-ayaka melt.  Provides frontloaded damage when ayaka burst is up. Arle is the one mostly melting here.

dori-fischl-nahida-sucrose.desc: Nahidori aggravate with Sucrose. c6 Dori is a decent Fischl a4 driver and dps in her own right and also heals her entire team! Sucrose drives Fischl a4 in between Dori's combos. (25.7s rot)

emilie-keqing-mavuika-ororon.desc: Keqing Quickburn without defensive utility. Mavuika does minimal damage outside of overloads, so she holds Deepwood to buff Emilie's damage. Very high quicken uptime.

charlotte-furina-neuvillette-zhongli.desc: Neuv Furina Charlotte Zhongli. 4CA 25s rot. Charlotte using hE and burst every rot. she enters between neuv FT to trigger fav and small freeze QoL.

chongyun-escoffier-eula-furina.desc: Eula Furina Chongyun Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Cryo Eula with MH and an ATK goblet infused by Chongyun. Chogyun passes particles to Eula. Eula does E(N1)QE N4D N2 hE N4 for team energy reasons.

bennett-chasca-citlali-mona.desc: Chasca Citlali Mona Bennett. ~17s rotation. Chasca does only 4 actions (Q 3CA or 4CA). Alternate rotation that can work better with higher ER stats in substats. Citlali uses her Q when available. Bennett has high ER requirements. Unfreezable enemy is a loss of about ~4.5k DPS.

bennett-citlali-dehya-xianyun.desc: Dehya Bennett Citlali Xianyun. 21s Rot. Dehya Melt Plunge with VV. 6 Melted Plunges. Citlali uses her N1 to re-establish Cryo in case Dehya's Skill was still active. Deyha uses her Skill at the start of the rotation, as it's worthwhile for Energy and is timed to not steal Melts. 50% Collisions.

ayato-charlotte-escoffier-furina.desc: Ayato Furina Charlotte Escoffier. 24s rot. Escoffier does not cast her Burst. Charlotte casts her Skill after Ayato's 1st Skill. Scroll procs from off-field during Ayato's 1st Skill field-time.

baizhu-furina-sethos-yelan.desc: Sethos Yelan Furina Baizhu. ~21s Rot. Sethos Taser with token Hyperbloom. 2E Yelan bookends Sethos burst mode. Sethos does 1 shadowpiecing shot and 1 level one aimed shot after Yelan's second skill, weaving N1 in between for Yelan's dice.

ororon-raiden-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Raiden Double Hydro. 2 Yelan E 21s rotation. Raiden N4D for more Yelan/Xingqiu burst dmg

fischl-furina-xianyun-yaemiko.desc: Yae Furina Fischl Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Yae Taser Plunge. Xianyun refeshes VV after Fischl uses burst. Yae may want to drop weaving N1 between plunges/skills to ensure she reaches 8 plunges per rotation. Yae uses bust skill immediately after all plunges spent when available(usually). 50% Collisons.

nahida-raiden-xiao-xingqiu.desc: Raiden Hypberloom wth Nahida Xingqiu xiao

bennett-emilie-navia-zhongli.desc: Start of the chamber, do Emilie skill then Bennett skill. This makes a pretty large difference.  First rotation of every chamber, Navia can do an additional skill before her burst to alleviate energy issues across the team including herself, without losing anything for it.

alhaitham-dori-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Alhaitham spread with Dori. Split rotation to refresh Yae's turrets and Instructor on Dori

bennett-fischl-furina-yelan.desc: Bennett DPS. 1 Fischl uptime 2 Yelan E rotation. Bennett healing distributed to fischl and yelan also.

citlali-escoffier-furina-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Furina Citlali Escoffier. ~20s Rot. Yoimiya MeltVape.-6K DPS with Freeze immunity, Melt count is more than Halved. Citlali Pyro Scroll is incidental.

aetherpyro-furina-xilonen-yelan.desc: PMC Furina Yelan Xilonen. ~23s Rot. PMC double Hydro Vape with OC. 2E Yelan, 2E Xilonen. PMC bursts every rotation as available.

bennett-furina-xingqiu-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya double hydro. Rotation heals Bennett Xingqiu and Yoimiya.

charlotte-layla-skirk-xingqiu.desc: [N5D] Skirk Xingqiu Layla Charlotte. 21s rot tE N2Q 3[N5D] N2CD N5D N2. First rot Nuke included, 1k loss otherwise. Freeze Immunity loses 4k(~6%) DPS.

furina-kazuha-layla-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Layla. 4CA 28-29s rot. if you mess up the hydro swirl you lose about 3-6k DPS. 9-15f Random swap delay + 2-4f random action delay.

furina-gorou-navia-xianyun.desc: Navia Gorou Furina Xianyun. 21s rot. total 8 high plunge (50% collision) with perfect dash canceling all being geo dmg. Furina comes between navia E to funnel fav particles. Gorou feeds both Geo and Fav particles to navia.

fischl-nahida-raiden-sucrose.desc: Golden Troupe Raiden using q 2n4d n4 in an extended rotation to maximize single target damage via Fischl a4 procs. For gigachads only.

kirara-kokomi-luminedendro-nilou.desc: Nilou 2H2D with Kokomi, DMC, and Kirara

fischl-kazuha-keqing-nahida.desc: Keqing Fischl Aggravate with Kazuha and Nahida

beidou-fischl-sucrose-tighnari.desc: tighnari beidou fischl sucrose, 3E TF beidou, 1 perfect parry, 1 normal parry, 1 normal E

fischl-kazuha-kirara-lisa.desc: Lisa Aggravate with Instructor Kirara and Golden Troupe on Fischl

furina-ororon-xianyun-yaemiko.desc: Yae Furina Ororon Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Yae Taser Plunge. Xianyun refeshes VV mid rotation. Yae uses burst every other rotation, immediately after all plunges are spent, otherwise she fills time for skill CD. Ororon goes before Furina; Ororon A4 is more important for Furina's Energy. 50% Collisons.

bennett-chevreuse-lisa-xiangling.desc: Lisa Chevreuse Xiangling Bennett. ~20s Rot. Lisa Overload, with Bennett on field skill spam generating particles for the team and Maintaining Pyro Aura. Bennett passes particles to DPS build Chev. Similar damage in single target.

furina-kokomi-nahida-xiangling.desc: Kokomi double hydro burgeon. Xiangling is on full EM build. Kokomi, Furina, and Xiangling trigger some vapes.

kazuha-raiden-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Raiden Double Hydro Taser -- Note limited healing, Yelan 2Es and optimal Raiden NA string for rainswords

ayaka-charlotte-furina-yelan.desc: Ayaka double hydro. 21s Rotation. 2 Yelan and Ayaka E. Ayaka stays on field while burst doing damage to benefit from Yelan A4.

fischl-nahida-thoma-xingqiu.desc: Thoma BUrgeon with Nahida Xingqiu fischl

bennett-chiori-navia-yelan.desc: Navia Yelan. 4E first rot (3 w buffs, one to prefunnel energy ). First rotation does higher dps than subsequent ones. 2 Yelan e. Navia does some pyro/vaped NA to fill downtime

fischl-kirara-lisa-sucrose.desc: Lisa Aggvt with Sucrose and Kirara (Lisa NA on first rotation to proc vv and hakushin with Sucrose)

chongyun-escoffier-freminet-furina.desc: Freminet Furina Chongyun Escoffier. ~20s Rot. E-Spam Cryo Freminet w/ Chongyun. Freminet makes use of Chongyun C2 CDR. VS Freezable opponents, BS over MH, even considering Shatter.

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-xiangling.desc: Chevreuse Xiangling Bennett Fischl with action priority list vs 12-3 Aeonblight Drake (300% HP).

bennett-mavuika-wriothesley-xiangling.desc: Triple Pyro Wrio melt. Xiangling provides some damage and more consistent melts. Mavuika triggers scroll every rotation. 21s rotation. N3CJ Combo.

furina-klee-xianyun-yelan.desc: Klee Furina Yelan Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Klee Double Hydro Vape Plunge. 8 low plunges canceled by N1C, stamina permitting. Klee uses skill again at the end of the rotation if available. 1E Yelan. Klee prefers MH to LNO, less crits cause ER issues for the team from less sparks. 50% Collisions.

chevreuse-fischl-mavuika-sethos.desc: Sethos Chevreuse Fischl Mavuika. ~16s Rot. Sethos Overload with Mavuika providing significant Overload damage. Sethos uses skill twice per rotation for damage reasons, even if waiting is nessesary.

arlecchino-bennett-sucrose-xiangling.desc: Arle Xiangling Sucrose Bennett. 20s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D] N1. TTDS every rot since its already 20s

bennett-chasca-mavuika-shenhe.desc: Chasca Shenhe Mavuika Bennett. ~19s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b], Q if available. Shenhe does not build ER and uses Q every 3 rotations. When Shenhe uses Q, Mavuika attempts to Melt her Q.

aethergeo-bennett-fischl-navia.desc: Navia GMC Fischl Bennett. GMC provides a crit rate buff and with 2Es, a signficant number of particles for Navia. The rotation is quite short, at 17s, but spreading out Navia's E allows her to still 2E every rotation

collei-kuki-nahida-xingqiu.desc: On field nahida Hyperbloom with Collei (note that ER problems can be solved with R5 favge

chevreuse-clorinde-fischl-yoimiya.desc: Clorinde Fischl Yoimiya Chev. 16s rot. Yoimiya Burst provides 10% ATK and off-field Pyro app for better Chev Res Shred uptime. Chev Burst every 2rots and stacks more HP

escoffier-furina-keqing-yelan.desc: Keqing Yelan Furina Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Phys Keqing on-field spamming CA. Keqing bursts after Yelan's burst expires for stamina reasons. 2E Yelan.

kirara-nahida-neuvillette-nilou.desc: Neuvillette Nilou bloom with kirara shield. 4CA 26s rot

chevreuse-fischl-keqing-xiangling.desc: Keqing Chev Fischl Xiangling. ~30s rotation. Xiangling builds full EM for overload damage and skips burst on the 2nd half of the rotation. Keqing utilizes Finale's bond and uses 4pc Whimsy due to the lack of better options.

furina-nahida-raiden-sigewinne.desc: Raiden Furina Nahida Sigewinne. ~21s Rot. EM Raiden Hyperbloom with on-field Raiden. Given the low ER req and dead space, Sigewinne uses her burst every rotation.

furina-kokomi-kuki-nahida.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with Kokomi Nahida Furina in ST. Kokomi Onfeild, n2dw, using walk for dash cooldown. Using event weapons, Kokomi replacable with PA, Furina with Pipe.

arlecchino-bennett-fischl-xingqiu.desc: Arle Xingqiu Fischl Bennett. 21s rot. No Arle Q, 3[N5D] N1. the N4 at the end is used for waiting xq's 21s cd.

fischl-lisa-nahida-xilonen.desc: Lisa Nahida Fischl Xilonen. ~24s Rot. Lisa Aggravate. Lisa attack strings not optimized; The dash cancels are a gain, but stamina heavy. 2E Xilonen. Xilonen bursts every rotation after the first. AP Nahida ~= GT Nahida.

chasca-fischl-nahida-ororon.desc: Chasca Ororon Fischl Nahida. Chasca Aggravate. Avg 17s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b], Q every 2 rot. Nahida Burst when possible, not using it is a slight DPS gain. Codex Chasca much worse.

alhaitham-fischl-nahida-zhongli.desc: Haitham spread with nahida/zhongli with non 4TF fischl

fischl-nahida-thoma-yaemiko.desc: Yae Nahida Fischl Thoma. ~25s Rot. Shielded Yae Quickburn. Yae uses burst every rotation after 3N1CD to regen stamina. Nahida uses burst every rotation.

fischl-furina-lynette-xilonen.desc: Lynette Furina Fischl Xilonen with Lynette on-field. Furina and Fischl deal the majority of the damage while Xilonen and Lynette buff them. Lynette uses N2C first then mostly N1C after her next E. Gets both Hydro and Electro crystallize during the rot

furina-xianyun-yanfei-yelan.desc: Yanfei Furina Yelan Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Yanfei Double Hydro VapePlunge. 8 low plunges, weaving N1 & 2 skill uses inbetween. 1E Yelan. Yanfei does not burst or CA. No Pyro VV. 50% Collisions.

fischl-xilonen-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Fischl Xilonen. ~18s Rot. Yoimiya Overvape. Xilonen bursts every rotation & Yoimiya bursts every other.

arlecchino-chiori-rosaria-zhongli.desc: Arle Rosaria Chiori Zhongli. 16s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 5[N3D] N4.

baizhu-kaveh-nilou-xingqiu.desc: kaveh nilou bloom with baizhu. EN12EN4 combo

fischl-kinich-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Kinich Nahida Yae Fischl. ~18s Rot. QuicKinich on-field. Scroll > OC/ToM > GT Kinich/Yae for team dps. Fischl alternates skill and burst. Yae & Kinich burst if available. No Kinich short hold is -5k DPS.

baizhu-fischl-furina-kinich.desc: Kinich Furina Fischl Baizhu. ~20s Rot. Kinich Quickbloom with Baizhu. Scroll is slightly worse than Codex for team DPS. Fischl alternates skill and burst. No Kinich short hold E is -5k DPS.

arlecchino-bennett-chongyun-rosaria.desc: Arle Rosaria Chongyun Bennett. 17s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 5[N3D] N1 (2[N6D] N1 was also fine). Careful NA combo execution is required to consistently melt Arle NAs. Rosa can hold catch R5, Chongyun can hold 4Instructor to buff Arle. KQMS Random Frame Delay

alhaitham-fischl-mualani-nahida.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Scroll TTDS Mualani. 30s Rotation with split field time with ~10s of field per phase. Scroll buffs for Alhaitham and Nahida only. Fischl has high ER requirements. Nahida bursts once per rotation. TTDS buffs Alhaitham once per rotation. Alhaitham primarily does N3CD or N3CJ and ends his field time with N3 or N2 . Mualani refreshes Scroll before the second phase. Slight Changes in rotation lead to ~3k DPS loss, probably due to Mirrors, Spread count, and TTDS rotation syncing. R1 Wolf Fang and R5 Iron Sting are both ~5k worse than HoD. Swap Delay = 8s.

kuki-mavuika-nahida-sethos.desc: Sethos Nahida Mavuika Kuki. ~16 Rot. Sethos Quickburn. Mavuika, Kuki and Nahida burst every other rotation and fill time for Sethos skill CD. Full EM and Quicken Kuki result in similar overall DPS.

clorinde-fischl-kazuha-yelan.desc: Clorinde Fischl Yelan Kazuha. 18s rot. Clorinde Q every rot. Kazuha Q every 2rots.

faruzan-lynette-xianyun-xiao.desc: Xiao Faruzan Lynette Xianyun. 23s rot. 12 high plunges with 50% collision. Lynette Q E N1 before Xiao. She doesn't need to use 2nd E if holding Fav. She can hold DMG oriented weapon at the cost of lower Xiao DPS.

furina-itto-mavuika-xilonen.desc: Itto Xilonen with Furina Mavuika. 2 Xilo Es used to fuel Itto and Mav bursts. Mav uses C1D to fill for Xilo E downtime. Whiteblind R5 outperforms Serpent R1

clorinde-emilie-sara-thoma.desc: Clorinde Emilie Sara Thoma. ~22s Rot. TF Clorinde Quickburn with Sara. Emilie is not buffed by Sara. Burstless Clorinde. Burning uptime is acceptable even without extra NAs outside of Clorinde.

arlecchino-bennett-chiori-lynette.desc: Arle & Chiori team with Lynette. Arle uses simple N3D combo and rot works with C0 Lynette. Uses Chiori Q to fill time in rot if Lynette Q is unavailable. R5 fav is not needed for energy, its only a luxury.

faruzan-furina-jean-xiao.desc: Xiao Faruzan Furina Jean. KQMS. C4 Jean is +4K DPS. Jean passes particles to Xiao. 12 Plunges. 100% collisions.

chevreuse-mavuika-ororon-sethos.desc: Sethos Mavuika Chev Ororon. Sethos uses burst/NA playstyle, and 18s rotation with 2 Sethos skills, lowering his ER requirements to minimum. Sethos does 8N2W, then one Shadowpiercing shot. Chev builds hp.

bennett-escoffier-furina-yelan.desc: Bennett Furina Yelan Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Benentt Vape/Melt. 1E Yelan. MH ~= CW Bennett. -2K DPS with Freeze immunity. Escoffier bursts every other rotation after the first; building enough ER to burst every rotation results in similar DPS.

chiori-furina-klee-xilonen.desc: Kleerinonen team (20s Rot) Benefits heavily from investment. Chiori c1 alone is 71k dps, while c2 Furina is huge not just for the team buff but also for her personal damage, as Furina is significantly buffed in this team comp. Config utilizes doible scroll on the first rot and Chiori q on every rot.

bennett-furina-xingqiu-yelan.desc: benny vape dps with triple hydro. yelan and xingqiu get healed, furina does not. 23s 2e yelan rotation. nymph outperforms other options on xingqiu.

bennett-chasca-mualani-ororon.desc: Chasca Mualani Ororon Bennett. 16s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Mualani does a quick bite in her E form then an N1 outside her E form.

clorinde-fischl-xilonen-yelan.desc: Clorinde Fischl Yelan Xilonen. ~16s Rot. Clorinde taser. NO > Emblem Yelan for team DPS. Xilonen uses skill twice and does not burst, but high ping players may want to for Bond of Life.

alhaitham-barbara-fischl-nahida.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Fischl Barabara Nahida

chiori-clorinde-furina-zhongli.desc: clorinde double geo with furina. 16s~  rotation. furina sees the field every other rotation. alternating between furina skill+burst to zl burst, and between clorinde burst to chiori burst.

bennett-chasca-ororon-rosaria.desc: Chasca Ororon Rosaria Bennet. 16s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Not having Ororon C6 is ~3.5k(6%) DPS Loss.

escoffier-eula-furina-xianyun.desc: Eula Furina Escoffier Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Eula bursts every third rotation; she fills time with NA on non-burst rotations. OHC > SoDP Xianyun, but bubbles may miss. 50% Collisions.

cyno-kirara-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Cyno hyperbloom 24s rotation. Uses short hold Kirara skill for stronger shield. Very low aggravate and spread counts. Cyno's dmg is mainly hyperblooms

alhaitham-kuki-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Alhaitham - Yae Miko - Nahida - Kuki without Yae ulting

fischl-keqing-nahida-xilonen.desc: Keqing Fischl Nahida Xilonen. ~25s rotation. TF Keqing Aggravate with Nahida, healed by Xilonen's burst. Nahida burst with less actions introduces ~4k dps loss.

bennett-chasca-ororon-shenhe.desc: Chasca Shenhe Ororon Bennett. ~17s Rot on average. 4[C] + C with 4 bullets. Chasca Q every other rotation. Shenhe Q and 4pc Noblesse effect every other rotation. Bennett uses 2pc Scroll + 2pc EoSF to reduce his high ER Requirements since he uses 1 Skill.

chevreuse-mavuika-raiden-sara.desc: Raiden Chevreuse Mavuika Sara. ~18/20s Rot. Raiden Mavuika Overload, Raiden bursts every rotation, Mavuika every other with 2[C2D] ED. Sara buffs both Mavuika and Chevreuse with her skill.

furina-xilonen-yanfei-yelan.desc: Yanfei Furina Yelan Xilonen. ~22s Rot. Yanfei Double Hydro Vape with 2xE Yelan/Xilonen. Yanfei bursts every other rotation.

fischl-lynette-ororon-yelan.desc: Lynette taser driver. APL. Lynette combo default to N1CD if has enough stamina and N3J otherwise.

bennett-faruzan-wanderer-yelan.desc: Wanderer Yelan. Wanderer N2C/D if A4 dash available. Bursts at start of field time if available

escoffier-furina-heizou-yelan.desc: Heizou Furina Fischl Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Heizou Freeze Wheelchair in ST. Heizou uses P-Amber so Escoffier doesn't have to burst every rotation.

bennett-navia-ororon-xilonen.desc: Navia Xilonen Ororon Bennett. 1 Xilonen E 18s rot. Ororon triggers Overloaded on Bennett's Pyro app to self buff with Scroll.

escoffier-faruzan-furina-xiao.desc: Xiao Faruzan Furina Escoffier. ~23s Rot. Xiao Freeze Plunge with 12 High plunges. 50% Collisions.

ayato-fischl-furina-xilonen.desc: Ayato Furina Fischl Xilonen. ~24s Rot. Ayato Taser with Xilonen shredding RES between skill uses.

albedo-bennett-navia-yelan.desc: Navia Yelan. 4E first rot (3 w buffs, one to prefunnel energy ). First rotation does higher dps than subsequent ones. 2 Yelan e. Navia does some pyro/vaped NA to fill downtime

arlecchino-bennett-lynette-xiangling.desc: Monopyro Arle using N3D combo ending with an N1. R5 fav and an extra Bennett skill after Arle combo helps with Xiangling's ER reqs. Lynette bursts if available and uses her extra C4 skill charge otherwise, but rotation can be adjusted for C0 Lynette by either bursting every rot (higher ER reqs) or NAing if burst is unavailable.

bennett-fischl-furina-klee.desc: Klee "Overvape", but she barely does any reaction damage: Klee, Fischl, Furina, Bennett. The whole team recieves at least 1 tick of bennett healing per rotation after the first rotation.

bennett-furina-gaming.desc: Just these 3 units. Gaming plunges 9 times. To do this ingame, Press E immediately after Q and each plunge. Wait till Man Chai is extremely close to you, then plunge.

albedo-alhaitham-furina-kuki.desc: ~30s split rotation with 2 Kuki skills. Well optimized Alhaitham combos without jump cancels (allowing for dashes). 12-3 Icewind Suite's base stats used for energy drops and the incoming damage instances every 4-6s. Dashes pick up crystallizes. Customized random action delays and starting HPs.

alhaitham-nahida-yaemiko-zhongli.desc: Alhaitham spread with Zhongli. No Yae burst. 25s rotation

clorinde-fischl-kuki-nahida.desc: Clorinde Nahida Fischl Kuki. ~16s Rot. Clorinde Triple Electro Aggravate. Nahida bursts every other rotation after the first. Kuki attempts to burst every rotation. Fischl aternates skill and burst.

baizhu-kuki-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Comfy HB. APL, KQMS. Kuki Xiphos r1 has 1% higher simulated DPS than Iron Sting r5. Nahida GT Xingqiu DW has marginally higher simulated DPS than Nahida DW Xingqiu EOSF despite default Nahida action. Nahida default has higher simulated DPS than Kuki default, but might be difficult to execute in practice.

fischl-navia-xilonen-yaemiko.desc: Navia Fischl Yae Xilonen. ~16s Rot. Navia Double Electro. Xilonen feeds partcles to Navia's burst. Navia does shorter combos when Xilonen uses burst every other rotation for sustain. Assumes Fischl/Yae/Xilonen pick up crystalize with Q/E/E.

bennett-emilie-mavuika-raiden.desc: Raiden Emilie Mavuika Bennett. ~17/19s Rot. Raiden Emilie with Mavuika, who prefers Scroll to Deepwood. Bennett refeshes deepwood with skill just before Raiden burst, beating out NO. Emilie only uses burst.

diluc-furina-lynette-xianyun.desc: Diluc Furina Lynette Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Diluc Vape plunge. Lynette feeds mass Anemo particles to Xianyun then bursts after Xianyun, absorbing Hydro. Xianyun can use TTDS if Lynette bursts prior. Skill uses bookend Diluc's field time, needed for energy. 50% Collisions.

kazuha-kirara-neuvillette-ororon.desc: Neuv Kirara Ororon Kazuha. 4CA 26-27s rot. PrototypeAmber R5 is ~6.5k(10%) lower. You can instead do Kazuhe tEPQ > Ororon EQ > Kirara shE with some potentially lower Kazuha uptime in practice.

dori-furina-nahida-sethos.desc: Sethos quickbloom with Furina. 20s~ rotation. Dori heals and provides energy for Sethos, with Pamber Nahida supplementing healing. 8N2W Sethos+ 2 Shadow Piercing Shots.

furina-luminehydro-xilonen-yelan.desc: HMC Furina Xilonen Yelan, with Yelan holding Fav and Petra. HMC uses full Hold E and dashes to pick up Sourcwater Droplets. Enemy size is adjusted so that HMC maximizes their Burst hits.
