fischl-furina-xilonen-yaemiko.desc: Yae Furina Fischl Xilonen. ~24s Rot. Yae on-Field Taser. Yae bursts every rotations before refreshing her skill. Fischl uses skill and burst every rotaiton. Fischl want to use skill after Furina burst recieve Xilonen healing. 2E Xilonen. Hydro Scroll is very rare.

chiori-clorinde-nahida-zhongli.desc: clorinde double geo aggravate. 16-17s rotation. zl burst every rotation, nahida burst when ready, chiori and clorinde alternate burst use.

bennett-chasca-citlali-ororon.desc: Chasca Citlali Ororon Bennett. ~18s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b], Q every 2 rot.

bennett-citlali-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Citlali Bennett. 20s rot. No Yoimiya Q. TTDS every rot. Pyro Scroll setup as Bennett E > Yelan Q E N4 > Bennett Q E > Citlali EQ. It can be difficult to melt/vape N#5 of the 3rd N5 string in practice. -11K DPS with Freeze Immunity.

chevreuse-fischl-yaemiko-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Chevreuse Fischl Yae. ~17s Rot. Yoimiya uses TF to fit into the shorter rotation length. Yoimiya & Chevreuse burst every other rotation. Yae does not burst.

fischl-kirara-tighnari-yaemiko.desc: Tighnari Fischl Yae Miko Kirara; Kirara built for DPS with Yae using 4pc ToTM for buffs+stronger shield, using 4gilded on Yae isnt a massive DPS loss, kirara uses her hold E to get the first hit to generate a particle, then ends the E before the 2nd hit, not frame perfect

bennett-furina-kazuha-yelan.desc: vape dps benny. kazuha swirl both pyro and hydro. kazuha and yelan get healed, furina does not. 23s 2e yelan rotation.

chevreuse-furina-hutao-kazuha.desc: hu tao vv vape. chev provides her c6 buff, healing for furina, and easy vv setup. hu tao vapes around 75% of her CAs. kazuha uses r5 fav to get 2 procs per rotation.ins slightly better than sodp on chev at the cost of lower healing.

bennett-chasca-fischl-ororon.desc: Chasca Fischl Ororon Bennett. ~17s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b], Q every 2 rot. Ororon before Bennett to reduce Bennett's ER requirements enough for 4pc NO. Not having Ororon C6 is 5k (~8%) DPS loss here. Electro% Goblet is ~400 DPS (~1%) better than ATK% Goblet.

bennett-chiori-furina-navia.desc: Navia Chiori Furina Bennett. 21s rot. Use 3rd navia E if available. Chiori Q between navia's E to get bennett buff and heal.

cyno-emilie-fischl-mavuika.desc: Cyno Quickburn without defensive utility. 25s rotation. Mavuika and Emilie burst every other rotation.

ayato-escoffier-furina-mika.desc: Ayato Furina Mika Escoffier. 24s rot. Escoffier uses her Burst starting from the 2nd rotation when it's available. Mika uses his Skill after Ayato's 1st Skill so he procs Scroll late in the rotation. Despite Mika provides an Attack Speed buff for Ayato's 2nd Skill, Ayato only performs N15.

bennett-lynette-lyney-zhongli.desc: lyney lynette with zl for comfort. R5 favs for energy + assumes lyney regularly hits weakspots.

fischl-furina-nahida-xianyun.desc: Xianyun Nahida Furina Fischl. ~26s Rot. Xianyun Salad, using low plunges with Xianyun's burst to Swirl more frequently.

fischl-hutao-yaemiko-yelan.desc: Hutao Fischl Yae Yelan. ~16s Rot. Hutao Overvape. 6N3CJ N2CD Hutao. No burst Yae. 1E Yelan.

ayaka-furina-kaeya-xilonen.desc: Ayaka Furina Kaeya Xilonen. ~22s Rot. Ayaka Freeze, no grouping. Ayaka, Kaeya, and Xilonen do 2 skills per rotation, with Xilonen Scrolling both Hydro and Cryo. Xilonen heals the whole team. -5K DPS with Freeze Immnuity & MH.

fischl-kirara-lisa-xilonen.desc: Lisa Kirara Fischl Xilonen. ~24s Rot. Lisa Aggravate. Lisa attack strings not optimized; The dash cancels are a gain, but stamina heavy. 2E Xilonen. Xilonen doesn't burst. Ins Kirara is a ~3K DPS loss.

bennett-diluc-emilie-xianyun.desc: Diluc Emilie Xianyun Bennett. VS Icewind suite w/ 375% HP Multiplier (2 Rots). Diluc plunge with Emilie, Diluc uses his Es after the first plunge, Unfinished Reverie is BIS.

bennett-chasca-mona-ororon.desc: Chasca Ororon Mona Bennett. 17-18s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Ororon funnels particles to Bennett. Not having Ororon C6 is 4.5k (~7%) DPS loss here.

escoffier-furina-wanderer-yelan.desc: Wanderer Yelan Furina Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Wanderer Double Hydro Freeze. Wanderer typically Swirls Cryo with E. Wanderer Q at the end of this field time if available. 1E Yelan. MH Wanderer is -3K DPS. -4K DPS with Freeze immunity.

bennett-chiori-navia-xiangling.desc: 16-17s rotation. 0 ER subs Navia, Bursts when ready. Xiangling Burst every other rotation.

baizhu-furina-kazuha-yaemiko.desc: >50% Quicken uptime Yae hyperbloom with grouping. Clam and Deepwood Baizhu perform similarly

chevreuse-clorinde-xinyan-yaemiko.desc: Clorinde Yae Chev Xinyan. 16s rot. No Yae Q and just 3[E]. No Xinyan E (18s cd), leading to lack of particles. Chev Q every 2rots and stacks more HP and feeds her E particles into Xinyan.

clorinde-furina-nahida-yelan.desc: Clorinde Yelan Furina Nahida. ~24s Rot. TF Clorinde with 2 skills per rotation and a Yelan skill inbetween.

fischl-kazuha-keqing-kirara.desc: Keqing Fischl Aggravate with Kirara and Kazuha

alhaitham-dori-fischl-yelan.desc: Alhaitham Yelan Fischl Dori. ~20s Rot. Long field time Alhaitham with Dori supplying enough energy. Yelan does one E. Deploys Oz during Alhaitham's burst window. 70% Quicken uptime

fischl-nahida-xiangling-xingqiu.desc: Xiangling Burgeon with Fischl Xingqiu and Nahida

dori-fischl-mavuika-nahida.desc: Dori Nahida Fischl Mavuika. ~25s Rot. Dori Quickburn with UR. Nahida fills time while Dori's skill is on CD.

escoffier-eula-furina-raiden.desc: Eula Furina Raiden Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Eula Raiden with Escoffier's personal damage. Raiden does Q 2N4D N2.

arlecchino-fischl-yelan-zhongli.desc: Arle Yelan Fischl Zhongli. 18s rot. No Arle Q, 3[N5D] N3.

fischl-kazuha-yaemiko-yaoyao.desc: Yae Fischl Aggravate with Kazuha Yaoyao

arlecchino-bennett-kazuha-nahida.desc: short rotation burn arle. dangerous to play this shieldless. 3N5D combo for simplicity

hutao-lanyan-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Hutao Yelan Xingqiu Lanyan. ~21s Rot. Hutao Vape. 2E Yelan. Lanyan shield covers most of Hutao's skill. Lanyan can optionally burst at the end.

bennett-navia-rosaria-xilonen.desc: Navia Rosaria Xilonen Bennett. 21s rot. Navia 3rd E if available. Starts with Rosaria E to setup cryo scroll.

freminet-furina-xilonen-yelan.desc: Freminet Yelan Furina Xilonen. ~23s Rot. Phys Freminet Shatter with Xilonen and Yelan using 2Es per rotation. Freminet primes his shattering pressure before doing his burst combo every rotation between Yelan skills.

clorinde-lisa-nahida-yelan.desc: Clorinde Nahida Lisa Yelan. ~25s Rot. (TF) Clorinde Quickbloom with Lisa. Clorinde does not burst. Lisa uses hold skill between Clorinde skill uses. 2E Yelan on Fav contributes to very low ER reqs for Lisa.

furina-klee-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Klee Furina Xilonen Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Klee Plunge, Furina Vape; Hydro VV only, Inconsistent Pyro Scroll after the first Rot. Xilonen does 2Es after the first rotation, Xianyun uses her triple jump to fill time. Klee bursts as available and does CAs between plunges, stamina permitting; meaningful affect on team energy. 50% Collisions.

bennett-emilie-ganyu-xiangling.desc: Ganyu aimshots 5-7 times depending on if Xiangling burst or not and whether she herself has the energy to burst or not. Check config to know how many in each scenario.

collei-kokomi-luminedendro-nilou.desc: Nilou Bloom with kokomi Collei and DMC

bennett-chasca-citlali-raiden.desc: Chasca Raiden Citlali Bennett. 17s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Raiden only uses her E.

bennett-faruzan-fischl-wanderer.desc: Faruzan QE > Bennett EQ > Fischl Skill/Q > Wanderer Q (if Ava) N1EN1Q N2D (if A4 Ava), else N2C > without funneling Bennett E on last rot.

furina-rosaria-xianyun-yanfei.desc: Yanfei Furina Rosaria Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Yanfei Melts or Vapes catalyst plunges(No Shatter) with slight delays when lacking Aura. 50% Collisions.

escoffier-furina-layla-shenhe.desc: Lore accurate sleeping onfield Layla. Layla sleeps 2.5s and bursts twice per 25s rotation. Blizzard strayer is 2k (3%) worse. Freeze_resist=1 loses 2k (3%) team dps.

arlecchino-bennett-lynette-zhongli.desc: Arle Lynette Zhongli Bennett. 16s rot (very tight). Lynette burst if available. you can put 4AP on bennett for 1k upgrade.

furina-nahida-nilou-sigewinne.desc: Nilou Sigewinne bloom, with nahida mostly onfield. Does not need to stay into any circles, and nahida can reapply E as necessary for comfy multi wave contents

kazuha-neuvillette-yaemiko-zhongli.desc: Neuvillette Guide Weapons (No Furina) R5 Sacrificial Jade

fischl-nahida-sethos-tighnari.desc: Sethos Tighnari Fischl Nahida. ~18s Rot. Sethos Tighanri Aggravate. Sethos uses a Shadowpiercing shot to apply Electro at the start of the rotation. Fischl alternates skill and burst. Sethos uses burst.

fischl-nahida-sara-tighnari.desc: Tighnari Nahida Fischl Sara. ~28s Rot. Tighnari Sara AggraSpread. Sara tries to buff Fischl and Tighnari. Nahida on-fields in during downtime. Nahida actions can likely be optimized.

alhaitham-beidou-fischl-nahida.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Beidou Fischl Nahida in ST

lynette-neuvillette-xiangling-zhongli.desc: neuv vape with KQMS subs. xiangling QE provides pyro first half and lynette Q/xiangling E provides pyro second half. only gets hydro VV first half.

bennett-fischl-xiangling-yelan.desc: shime CA overvape dps xiangling with c6 bennett

chasca-furina-nahida-ororon.desc: Chasca Ororon Furina Nahida. Chasca Quickbloom. Avg ~16.5s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b], Q every 2 rot. Nahida Burst when available. Furina does not Burst. Chasca on Scion + VV very similar.

arlecchino-chiori-yelan-zhongli.desc: Arle Yelan Chiori Zhongli. 18s rot. No Arle Q, 3[N5D] N3

bennett-chasca-chevreuse-rosaria.desc: Chasca Rosaria Chev Bennett. 16s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Chev simply batteries Bennett with minial field time. Pyro Goblet is 4% better than ATK Goblet (6% with Pre-C6 Chev). Not having Chev C6 is ~8k (13%) DPS loss.

bennett-furina-jean-raiden.desc: 4MH Raiden Sunfire with Furina. Performs better with 4MH than Emblem here. Uses ER clock + The Catch to meet ER requirements.

kirara-lynette-neuvillette-xiangling.desc: Neuv Vape with Xiangling Kirara Lynette. 4CA 28s rot. DPS build is slightly better than Instructor on Xiangling. Rot works for C0 Lynette.

bennett-chiori-mavuika-ningguang.desc: Ningguang Mavuika Chiori Bennett. ~18s Rot. Ninguang double Pyro. Ninguang walk cancels her NAs. Mavuika's particles are funneled to Bennett over Chiori, using Chiori skill in Bennett Q is similar. Mavuika does just one CA.

baizhu-cyno-fischl-furina.desc: Cyno Furina Fischl Baizhu. ~25s Rot. Cyno Hyperbloom with Baizhu. Fischl uses skill and burst every rotation.

bennett-furina-kazuha-klee.desc: Standard Kleerina. Aprox 23s rot. Furina forward vape + tryhard Klee combo abusing CdC and stamina usage.

arlecchino-bennett-yunjin-zhongli.desc: Arle YunJin Zhongli Bennett. 17s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D]. you can put 4AP on bennett or yunjin to get 1 or 2k upgrade.

furina-xianyun-xilonen-yaemiko.desc: Yae Furina Ororon Xianyun. ~22-25s Rot. Yae Taser Plunge. Xianyun & Xilonen refesh VV & Scroll mid rotation. Yae uses burst every other rotation, immediately after all plunges are spent, otherwise she fills time for skill CD. 50% Collisons.

arlecchino-chevreuse-xiangling-yaemiko.desc: Arle Yae Xiangling Chev. 20s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D]. the N4 at the end is used for waiting xl's 20s cd. you can use EQE instead

fischl-sucrose-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Sucrose Tazer with Double Hydro and Fischl

fischl-furina-jean-yelan.desc: 4MH onfield Yelan with Furina+Jean+Fischl. Just NA spam, no cancels.

ayato-bennett-fischl-xiangling.desc: ayato xiangling fischl bennett, 2E ayato and 2E xiangling, 1EQ/rot fischl

bennett-chevreuse-dehya-raiden.desc: Raiden (C6)Dehya Chevreuse Bennett. ~20s Rot. Full length Dehya burst. Raiden does not catch Bennett burst buff. Chev Bursts in Bennett Q.

citlali-escoffier-furina-klee.desc: Klee Furina Citlali Escoffier. ~20s Rot. Klee MeltVapeShatter? Whatever, it's messy and this isn't optimized. -1.5K DPS with Freeze immunity. Klee's CA crit energy makes a very noticable difference to team energy requirements.

baizhu-clorinde-furina-yelan.desc: Clorinde Yelan Furina Baizhu. ~25s Rot. TF Clorinde with 2 skills per rotation and a Yelan skill inbetween.

fischl-kazuha-neuvillette-zhongli.desc: Remember to retry till you get hydro absorption on Kazuha burst. Zhongli and Kazuha buff Neuvillette while Fischl provides energy to Neuv and does decent damage; 9-12f swap delay, 2-4 others

bennett-faruzan-lynette-xianyun.desc: Lynette Faruzan Bennett(C5) Xianyun. ~21s Rot. Lynette Hyperplunge Plunge with Benentt C5. Lynette does CA if she encounters CD for her skill. OHC > SoDP Xianyun, but bubbles may miss. 70% collisions.

chiori-furina-gaming-zhongli.desc: gaming double geo. 20s~ rotation. chiori uses her burst if ready at the end  if ready, otherwise gaming uses another skill. gaming vapes most plunges, but not all.

dori-furina-nahida-tighnari.desc: Dori Furina Nahida Tighnari. ~25s Rot. Thundering Fury Dori uses skill 3x per rotation while her lamp triggers hyperbloom while she is off-field. Tighnari uses skill/burst just twice/once per rotation. Nahida omits burst in the first rotation.

fischl-ororon-sucrose-xingqiu.desc: Sucrose Ororon Fischl Xingqiu, APL. Sucrose as driver when no skills or bursts are available.

fischl-kazuha-sethos-yaoyao.desc: Sethos Fischl Kazuha Yaoyao. ~17s rotation.  Sethos uses 8N2W N1E (last N1 is physical) combo. DPC is a viable artifact set on Sethos due to its high Charged Attack DMG% bonus and Attack Speed increase.

bennett-chasca-layla-ororon.desc: Chasca Layla Ororon Bennet. ~17s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Not having Ororon C6 is ~3.5k(6%) DPS Loss.

baizhu-nahida-razor-xingqiu.desc: Razor Nahida Xingqiu Baizhu. ~24s Rot. Razor Double Dendro Hyperbloom. Deepwood Nahida w/ OHC Baizhu is nearly the same.

ayato-escoffier-furina-sigewinne.desc: Ayato Furina Sigewinne Escoffier. ~24s rot. Escoffier casts her Burst when it's available, otherwise, Sigewinne casts her Burst instead. Skipping Escoffier's Burst is ~500 DPS less.

citlali-escoffier-hutao-xianyun.desc: Hutao Citlali Escoffier Xianyun. ~18s Rot. Hutao Melt Plunge. 6 High plunges > 7 low plunges. OHC over SoDP but bubbles may miss.

albedo-arlecchino-bennett-lynette.desc: Arle & Albedo team with Lynette. Arle uses simple N3D combo and rot works with C0 Lynette. R5 fav for energy. Uses Albedo Q to fill time in rot if Lynette Q is unavailable. No delay included for picking up crystallize shard for AP.

kuki-mona-nahida-tighnari.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with Nahida Tighnai Mona, using R5 4 stars and R1 Hunters Path, vs Maguu Kenki

dori-emilie-fischl-mavuika.desc: Dori Emilie Fischl Mavuika. ~20s Rot. Dori Quickburn with long field time Dori & 42% Burning uptime. Emilie bursts every other rotation after the first. Fischl alternates skill and burst, then Dori stays on field for 3 skill uses, as her C6 infusion downtime is near eliminated. Deepwood Fischl narrowly edges out GT for team DPS.

furina-raiden-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Raiden Furina Xiangling Xilonen. ~20s Rot. Raiden Overvape with Furina. 2E Xilonen. Xilonen Scrolls and Electro Hydro every rotation and Pyro rarely. EM Xiangling exceeds Talent Damage.

collei-kaveh-nilou-xingqiu.desc: Kaveh Nilou bloom with collei. EN12EN4 combo

bennett-lynette-lyney-xiangling.desc: Lyney Lynette Mono Pyro.  Lyney does 4 charged attacks and bursts every rotation. Lynette uses either burst if up otherwise skill right before Lyney does his combo.

baizhu-fischl-furina-lisa.desc: Lisa Furina Fischl Baizhu. ~25s Rot. Lisa Hyperbloom. Lisa hE misses Furina Q, but catches her own particles. Hyperbloom owner may vary with target size. Baizhu Deepwood > Scroll >= OHC.

escoffier-faruzan-furina-wanderer.desc: Wanderer Faruzan Furina Escoffier. ~21s Rot. Wanderer Q at the end of FT if available. Wanderer swirls Cryo with E. Easy to overcap CR.

ayaka-charlotte-furina-shenhe.desc: ayaka furina triple cryo. OHC Charlotte

furina-kazuha-kokomi-xingqiu.desc: F2P weapons team. Iron Sting and Kazuha bursting every other rotation results in marginally higher DPS than Fav r3. If available, Ballad + FD + Xiphos r1 produces 4% increase.

fischl-furina-ororon-xianyun.desc: Xianyun Furina Ororon Fischl. ~25s Rot. Plunge Xianyun Tazer. Xianyun E twice per rot. ADC > 3EM.

furina-sara-xianyun-yaemiko.desc: Yae Furina Sara Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Yae Taser Plunge. After 5 plunges, Xianyun refeshes VV, then Sara burst. Yae bursts every other rotation. Yae always catches Sara's Crowfeather. 50% Collisons.

faruzan-lumineanemo-xianyun-xiao.desc: Xiao Faruzan AMC Xianyun. 23-24s rot. 12 high plunges with 50% collision. AMC Q shE before Xiao. Providing RES Shred from C6.

bennett-dehya-kazuha-lyney.desc: Lyney Monopyro with Crowd Control and Res to interruption with R5 Sac Greatsword on Dehya

baizhu-furina-nahida-raiden.desc: Quickbloom Nahida with EM Raiden. 24s rotation. MH on Nahida is an increase over Gilded.

dehya-fischl-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Yae Nahida Fischl Dehya. ~25s Rot. Yae Quickburn. Yae uses burst every rotation after N1CD/N2CDs to regen stamina. Nahida uses burst every rotation.

arlecchino-bennett-kirara-sucrose.desc: Arle Bennett Sucrose Kirara. 16s rotation. Burning's only purpose is enabling Unfinished Reverie. Kirara Bursts every rotation for C6, Sucrose Bursts if available with her Burst easily picking up Pyro for C6. Arle 6[N3D] and no Burst.

dehya-emilie-mualani-nahida.desc: Mualani Emilie Dehya Nahida. Q every 2rots + 3[3-stacked bite]. Nahida Q every rot. Emilie w/o Q. 4Deepwood Dehya + 4GD Nahida also works

citlali-escoffier-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Furina Citlali Escoffier. ~19s Rot. Yoimiya MeltVape. -6K DPS with Freeze immunity. Escoffier bursts every other rotation.

bennett-citlali-furina-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Furina Citlali Bennett. 20s rot. Yoimiya Q every other rot. TTDS every rot. Trying to do Pyro Scroll. Freeze immunity is -12K DPS.

baizhu-fischl-furina-navia.desc: Navia Furina Fischl Baizhu. Navia 3E 26s rot. Used radius=2 for a few hyperbloom dmg. 4GT Furina and 4NO Baizhu is slightly weaker at this level of investment. 9-15f random swap delay

faruzan-furina-kokomi-xiao.desc: Xiao Faruzan Furina Kokomi. TTDS to Xiao. ToTM is > Scroll for Faruzan. 12 Plunges. 50% Collisions.

freminet-nahida-raiden-yelan.desc: Freminet Nahida Yelan Raiden. ~20s Rot. Defenseless Phys Freminet driven Hyperbloom. No burst Nahida.

mualani-sucrose-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Mualani Zhongli Sucrose Xiangling. 34s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. 1st half Xiangling Q and uses Mualani Q, 2nd half Sucrose Pyro Q from Guoba.

chiori-faruzan-xiao-zhongli.desc: Xiao Faruzan double Geo with Chiori. KQMS. Zhongli and Faruzan force Favonius. 12 Plunges. 50% collisions.

bennett-citlali-escoffier-furina.desc: Bennett Furina Citlali Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Benentt MeltVape. MH > CW Bennett. -5K DPS with Freeze immunity. Citlali does not use burst within Bennett burst, but can Scroll incidentally. Escoffier only bursts as available from the 2nd rotation onward; building enough energy to burst every rotation is a DPS loss.

bennett-furina-xiangling-xianyun.desc: Bennett Furina Xiangling Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Xianyun Furinational. Furina -> XL -> Bennett -> Xianyun -> Bennett; No Hydro VV. Pyro Application is overwhleming with XL EQ + Bennett's special fast plunge spam & skills off CD for XL energy. Few Bennett plunge Vapes. CW > MH Bennett. 50% Collsions.

kaveh-kirara-nilou-xingqiu.desc: kaveh nilou bloom with c6 kirara. EN12EN4 combo

clorinde-fischl-ororon-yelan.desc: Clorinde Yelan Fischl Ororon. ~18s Rot. Clorinde triple Electro Taser. Ororon uses Q N1 E. Yelan tries to catch Ororon's energy restoration on field before Clorinde.

arlecchino-bennett-emilie-thoma.desc: Arle Emilie Thoma Bennett. No Arle Q 17s rot. 4DM on Thoma provides high RES Shred uptime for Emilie. Emilie Q if ready, outside of Bennett Q

bennett-eula-furina-xianyun.desc: Eula vape plunge. KQMS. Eula Shime4 slightly better than MH4; Bennet Ins slightly better than NO.

furina-mona-navia-xianyun.desc: Navia Furina Mona Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Navia Plunge with Mona Providing ATK% and DMG bonus just before Navia unloads skill and plunge. Navia bursts every other rotation. Navia fills some time with Phys NA at the end of the rotation.

alhaitham-fischl-kirara-raiden.desc: Double carry Quicken: Alhaitham hE LP combo and 2-Mirror Burst, full Raiden combo (~25s rot). Low ER Raiden (energy not needed); ToTM is higher DPS than EoSF and the Shield Strength is useful. DMG Build Kirara. KurtC

diluc-furina-kokomi-xianyun.desc: Diluc Furina Kokomi Xianyun. ~21s Rot. Diluc Vape Plunge. Kokomi just uses skill right before Diluc. Skill uses bookend Diluc's Field time, needed to meet ER requirements. OHC > SoDP Xianyun. 50% Collisions.

arlecchino-chevreuse-fischl-xinyan.desc: Arle Fischl Chev Xinyan. 18s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D]. read the comments inside for the detailed fischl setup. Xinyan can hold 4TotM instead.

bennett-chongyun-gaming-rosaria.desc: Gaming Chongyun Rosaria Bennett. ~16s Rot. Gaming Melt. Chongyun melts his Q on Bennett's Q. 5 Skill Plunges.

nahida-neuvillette-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Vape Neuvillette using Nahida Dendro and XL's Q/E to apply pyro. Rotation is 29s long to allow Nahida E to expire so Neuv can apply hydro for Zhongli's hydro crystallize on subsequent rotations.

alhaitham-furina-kuki-sucrose.desc: Deepwood Furina. Sucrose doesn't burst, owns ~10% of HBs. Energy drops based on 12-3 Icewind Suite; Customized random frame delays & Starting HP%s. Many alternative build options.

alhaitham-fischl-lumineelectro-nahida.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Fischl Nahida and EMC

escoffier-ganyu-mavuika-xiangling.desc: Ganyu Mavuika Xiangling Escoffier. ~20s Rot. On-field Melt Ganyu. Ganyu does 2 Es per rotation. Mavuika feeds particles to Xiangling, who bursts every rotation. Mavuika and Escoffier burst every other in alternate rotations; Mavuika's burst is melted. Not heavily optimized.

arlecchino-bennett-xingqiu-zhongli.desc: Arle Xingqiu Zhongli Bennett. 21s rot. No Arle Q, N5D combo, its using more NAs waiting for xq's 21s cd.

chevreuse-cyno-fischl-mavuika.desc: Cyno Fischl Chevreuse Mavuika. ~25s Rotation. HP Build Chevreuse, Echoes is ping dependant.

chongyun-escoffier-furina-kaeya.desc: Kaeya Furina Chongyun Escoffier. ~20s Rot. Cryo infused on-field Kaeya w/ Chongyun using mostly N3CD/N3D. Kaeya uses skill 3 times, passing the 3rd's particles to Furina. -5K DPS with Freeze immunity and MH on Kaeya.

bennett-kinich-thoma-yelan.desc: Kinich Yelan Thoma Bennett. 18s rot. No Kinich Q. 4EoSF on Yelan isn't that far behind.

fischl-ororon-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Fischl Ororon. ~18s Rot. Yoimiya Overvape; Yoimiya prefers EEC > 3EM >= EDC. Yoimiya bursts as available. Fischl alternates skill and burst.

bennett-ganyu-mavuika-zhongli.desc: Ganyu Melt Team w/o using Ganyu Q. ~17-20s rot. Ganyu does 6 Charged Shots. Zhongli 4pc Petra picks up Cryo Shard and Zhongli's pillar no hit. Mavuika Burst every other rotation. Mavuika Burst catches Bennett buff at the end within 1 frame.

fischl-hutao-kuki-yelan.desc: Hutao Yelan Fischl Kuki. ~18s Rot. Hutao Overvape with Kuki enabling MH to edge out SR. 9N2CJ Hutao. No burst Kuki. 1E Yelan.

ayato-dori-furina-kazuha.desc: ayato dori furina kazuha taser vs 3T, kazuha infuses electro into his burst.  Targets are tighly clustered; all are struck by Ayato's NA/E/Q together.

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-sara.desc: "Hyper" fischl. KQMS. Fischl can be improved with prototype crescent if you are insane. C6 Chev is worth 15% dps.  C6 Sara is worth 8% dps.

chevreuse-emilie-fischl-hutao.desc: Hutao Emilie Fischl Chevreuse. ~16s Rot. Burning Hutao doing 6N3CJ. Burstless Hutao. Near Zero Quicken uptime, 3EM Fischl is more damage.

bennett-fischl-ororon-yelan.desc: Bennett Yelan Fischl Ororon. ~18s Rot. Thundering Fury Bennett with Yelan. Ororon uses skill and burst in Bennett's burst; No Pyro Scroll. Fischl alternates skill and burst in Bennett's burst.

bennett-furina-navia-xianyun.desc: Navia Furina Xianyun Bennett. total 8 high plunge (50% collision) with perfect dash canceling all being geo dmg. Xianyun has to weave NAs to trigger fav. w/o Geo particles, Navia uses ER sands to allow more crit subs.

faruzan-furina-heizou-xianyun.desc: Heizou Faruzan Furina Xianyun. 100% collision. Furina EQ > Xianyun E lP Q > Faruzan Q > Heizou N1C Q E 8JhP N1C E

furina-itto-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Itto "Lamentto" plunge with Xilonen, Furina, Xianyun. Itto Q E 8DJHP C2F E CF, 50% plunge collision rate. Without C2, Xilonen's source samples do not activate and she only provides energy and 4pc Scroll. Energy requirements are greatly eased by Xilonen 2E on the second rotation onwards.

ayato-nahida-neuvillette-xiangling.desc: Neuvillette vapes a little, but mostly Xiangling burgeons. Ayato is used solely for his Q, with his skill just providing some energy - Hyperoptimised sim

fischl-keqing-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Keqing Hyperbloom with Nahida Xingqiu Fischl

kazuha-neuvillette-yelan-zhongli.desc: Neuv Yelan Kazuha Zhongli. 4CA 26s rot. Kazuha Q every rot. you can test low ER on kazuha to alternate Q and tEP. Yelan 2E rot. Yelan Q is triggered 7 times.

furina-kokomi-navia-zhongli.desc: Navia Kokomi Furina Zhongli. To assist with enabling Furina, Kokomi bursts in the middle of the rotation, refreshing Jellyfish and healing the entire party. It's not strictly necessary to drive, but does help.

baizhu-furina-thoma-xingqiu.desc: Furina and Xingqiu maintains a good hydro aura uptime - Hyperoptimised sim

cyno-escoffier-furina-nahida.desc: Cyno Furina Nahida Escoffier. Long field time Cyno with long duration off field abilitiies; Cyno is on field for as long as Nahida's skill lasts. 6% of Cyno's damage is superconduct.

fischl-keqing-lanyan-nahida.desc: Keqing Nahida Fischl Lanyan. ~26s Rot. Shielded (TF) Keqing Aggravate with Nahida. Lanyan's Shield covers Keqing's field time. Nahida does not burst.

chevreuse-clorinde-fischl-xinyan.desc: Clorinde Fischl Chev Xinyan. 16s rot. No Xinyan E (18s cd), leading to lack of particles. Chev Q every 2rots and stacks more HP and feeds her E particles into Xinyan. Started with Fischl aim for healthy energy economy during the rotation.

cyno-escoffier-furina-yelan.desc: Cyno Furina Yelan Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Physical Cyno N3CD spam, skilling off CD. 2E Yelan.

fischl-freminet-furina-xianyun.desc: Freminet Furina Fischl Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Freminet Phys plunge with Superconduct. Executes 1 Shattering Pressure combo while plunging. 50% Collisions. PF > MH on Freminet.

clorinde-lanyan-ororon-yelan.desc: Clorinde Yelan Ororon Lanyan. ~18s Rot. Clorinde Taser. Lanyan's shield covers Clorinde's field time. Lanyan applies VV again before Clorinde uses her burst. Ororon uses Q -> E.

freminet-kuki-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Freminet Nahida Xingqiu Raiden. ~20s Rot. Freminet Hyperbloom with Xingqiu. Freminet bursts every rotation.

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-razor.desc: Razor Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~17 or 20s Rot. Ignoring Razor's burst cooldown is ideal for DPS given fewer rotations. Pyro Infused Razor deals slightly more Pyro DMG; Echoes + Pyro > TS + ATK Goblet. Fischl & DPS build Chevreuse use Q/E in Bennett Q. Self overloads not implemented.

cyno-fischl-nahida-xilonen.desc: Cyno Fischl Nahida Xilonen. ~25s rot. Cyno Aggravate without TF. Xilonen 2 E cast. AP and TotM are close on Nahida.

bennett-furina-kazuha-xiangling.desc: kazuha xiangling furina benny. 20s rotation. kazuha absorb hydro with his burst, but xiangling still doesn't vape most of her damage. kazuha uses e often for grouping and energy

navia-rosaria-shenhe-xilonen.desc: Navia Rosaria Shenhe Xilonen. ~20s Rot. Navia Double Cryo. Slight buffs from crit rate and Shenhe A4. Navia uses a 3rd skill in the first rot. Xilonen burts every other rotation. Crystallize shards are picked up with dashes and character movement skills.

escoffier-freminet-furina-ororon.desc: Freminet Furina Ororon Escoffier. ~21s Rot. Phys-Shatter Freminet. MH and PF are within 1%. EM sands also trails by less than 1% if the opponent is Freezable. Ororon goes before Furina to assist Furina's ER and sees low EC uptime in the rear of the rotation. If the opponent is not freezable, Ororon should go just before Freminet, as Freminet otherwise sees very low Superconduct count for his passives.

chevreuse-fischl-gaming-mavuika.desc: Gaming Chevreuse Fischl Mavuika. ~17s Rot. Gaming Overload. Gaming does 7 skill plunges, waitinng on the ground before juggling Man Chai in the air. Fischl does an aimed shot in the first rotation for Chevreuse A1 RES shred. Chevreuse bursts every other rotation.

dori-fischl-kazuha-nahida.desc: C6 Dori Aggravate with Fischl Kazuha Nahida, no TF set ver. ~26s rot.

nahida-ororon-raiden-yelan.desc: Raiden Yelan Ororon Nahida. 18s rot. PrototypeAmber R5 on Nahida is ~3k behind. Ororon can also focus on EM for Hyperbloom damage.

aetherpyro-bennett-chevreuse-fischl.desc: PMC Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~16s Rot. PMC on-field DPS, uses burst when available to fit the rotation length. PMC uses hE. PMC does CAs, stamina permitting. Chevreuse bursts every other rot.

clorinde-furina-ororon-yunjin.desc: Clorinde Furina Ororon YunJin. 16s rot. Clorinde Q every 2 rot. Characters have low enough field time to allow YunJin to spend time on using Level 2 hold E for her ER. Ororon also funnels his particles to YunJin.

bennett-furina-nahida-rosaria.desc: rosaria burgeon melt. on field rosaria with c6 bennett, dealing mix of cryo, pyro, and burgeon damage.

bennett-fischl-nahida-raiden.desc: Raifish Nahida Bennett. 18-19s rot. Fischl E at the end of the rot(=every other rot). Bennett triggers 4Ins twice! Nahida can snapshot that 120EM into her A1. You can try 4NO bennett in the config. its slightly weaker.

bennett-gaming-lynette-rosaria.desc: Gaming Lynette Rosaria Bennett. ~18s Rot. Gaming Melt. 6 plunges, 5 melted plunes, or 6 with a slight delay for the final Vivid shot. Lynette spends her skills all at once. Lynette's burst absorbs Cryo. Weapon swirl not implemented; In-game you should obtain an easy Pyro VV from Lynette's C6 with Bennett C6.

bennett-chiori-emilie-navia.desc: Navia Chiori Emilie Bennett. 16s rot. Navia Q every other rot alternating with either Emilie or Chiori Q. Bennett comes between Navia's Field time but it is not necessarily required to refresh burning. you can send him at the end of the rot.

chiori-clorinde-tighnari-zhongli.desc: clorinde double geo with tighnari to enable quicken and as quickswap dps. clorinde and tighnari alternate burst use, clorinde burst before tighnari field time to enable spread for him. zhongli and chiori alternate burst use to fill rotation time. 16s rotation.

bennett-citlali-rosaria-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Citlali Rosaria Bennett. 18s rot. No Yoimiya Q. Avg ~7.7 out of 10 Meltable hits are melted here.

furina-kokomi-navia-yelan.desc: Navia Furina Yelan Kokomi. Even with the high amount of Hydro damage, Nighttime is still better than AP due to timing of Crystallize Shard pickups. Kokomi Bursts and then Normal Attacks in the middle of the rotation to refresh the Jellyfish and heals Yelan and Furina.

arlecchino-bennett-kazuha-xingqiu.desc: Arle Xingqiu Kazuha Bennett. 21s rot. No Arle Q, N1 CA dash cancel 3[N5D] N1. use dash after bennett E for xingqiu vv setup.

bennett-gaming-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Gaming Nahida Xingqiu Bennett. ~21s Rot. Gaming Burgeon Vape with infused normal attacks in between 7 skill plunges; Burgeon is mostly incidental. Assumes rainsword contact for 100% Vape consistency. Nahida merely does EN1 to not waste time.

baizhu-cyno-furina-nahida.desc: Cyno-Furina quickbloom, but with a longer and more optimized rotation

albedo-alhaitham-fischl-nahida.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Fischl Nahida Alhaitham

hutao-xianyun-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Xianyun Yelan Xingqiu. 6N1CJP with high plunges and 50% collision rate.

beidou-nahida-xingqiu-yaemiko.desc: (Note: Beidou has 10% chance of perfect counter) Nahida EQ > Xingqiu ED Q N1 > Yae E2 N1 E > Beidou EQ > Yae N19 > Beidou E

kokomi-nahida-neuvillette-xiangling.desc: Mainly vaporice with some burning and burgeon Neuvillete with Xiangling Kokomi and Nahida

bennett-furina-xiangling-yoimiya.desc: Vape Furina with key, driven by yoi; burst with furina every other rot; Furina burst actually don't bring much dps due to the low stack counts.

faruzan-furina-sigewinne-wanderer.desc: Wanderer Faruzan Furina Sigewinne. 20s rot. Wanderer Q at the end of FT if available.

bennett-fischl-furina-ororon.desc: Bennett Furina Fischl Ororon. ~20s Rot. Overvape Thundering Fury Bennett with Furina. Fischl alternates skill and burst in Bennett field. EDC > EEC > 3EM Bennett.

emilie-lynette-mavuika-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Emilie Lynette Mavuika. 4CA 25-26s rot. At Mavuika C0, alternates between Mavuika Q and Emilie Q. Mavuika C1 will make her Burst every rot. Mavuika C1 makes 76k DPS, 22% team DPS increase. Emilie can hold 4pc UR.

bennett-furina-luminegeo-navia.desc: Navia with Furina and Geo MC.  Sim picks up a shard if available on dash.  Geo MC and Bennett do 2 Skills each.  Geo MC does an additional conditional Skill. Note that in-game Geo MC's pillar blocks Furina's pets, so it is kinda scuffed in practice.

clorinde-lisa-nahida-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Nahida Lisa Xilonen. ~25s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Aggravate with Lisa. Clorinde burst over lisa skill is a DPS gain. Nahida bursts every other rotation. Xilonen does not burst.

baizhu-fischl-kazuha-keqing.desc: KeqingFischl Aggravate with Kazuha and 4Instructor Hakushin Baizhu. you can use 4NO but its weaker

alhaitham-fischl-nahida-xianyun.desc: Alhaitham Nahida Fischl Xianyun. ~28s Rot. AlHaitham Spread plunge in a split rotation with Fischl Q during AlHaitham's Q window. Spends high plunges then does mirror combos until Nahida E expiration. 70% collisions after E plunge, 50% after burst.

kuki-nahida-wriothesley-xingqiu.desc: Wrio Nahida Xingqiu Kuki. 21s rot. N3CJ combo. Wrio skips his Q for better team DPS. Kuki Q every 2 rot at the end of the rot. PAmber Nahida also works.

freminet-furina-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Freminet Furina Rosaria Xianyun. ~20s Rot. PF Freminet Phys plunge with C6 Rosaria Phys shred. Executes 1 Shattering Pressure combo while plunging. chongyun-escoffier-furina-rosaria.desc: Rosaria Furina Chongyun Escoffier. ~20s Rot. Cryo infused on-field Rosaria w/ Chongyun doing mostly N2CD and skill as available. Rosaria uses skill 3 times, passing the 3rd's particles to Furina. -2K DPS with Freeze immunity and MH

ayato-baizhu-nahida-nilou.desc: Nilou Bloom with Ayato Baizhu Nahida

chevreuse-fischl-raiden-xiangling.desc: Raiden Fischl Xiangling Chevreuse. 20s rot. Use Chev E mainly at the end of the rot. Use Fischl E at the end of the rot if available, if not, spam NA to get chev healing for C6.

beidou-furina-neuvillette-ororon.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Beidou. 4CA 26s rot. 2 Targets in a row.

On field Bennett spams skill off CD for the rest of the rotation.

fischl-keqing-kokomi-nahida.desc: 25s Keqing quickbloom w/Instructors Kokomi, enemy radius=3

bennett-emilie-fischl-hutao.desc: Hutao Emilie Fischl Bennett. ~16s Rot. Burning Hutao doing 6N3CJ. Burstless Hutao. Near Zero Quicken uptime, 3EM Fischl is more damage.

bennett-kinich-nahida-zhongli.desc: Kinich Nahida Zhongli Bennett. 18s rot. E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo with consistently NA clockwise. Fav Nahida w/o using Burst. Assuming Zhongli pillar consistently hit the enemy to proc Nahida's Skill for 4Deepwood.

chiori-fischl-navia-zhongli.desc: Navia Chiori Fischl Zhongli. 16s rot. Zhongli feeds fav particles into navia. Used 3[N2D] navia to make it 16s rot length.

arlecchino-xingqiu-yelan-zhongli.desc: Yelan 2E ~21s rot. No Arle Q. N14 is easier to execute and more DPS than 6[N3D] mainly due to more Q procs from XQ and Yelan.

chongyun-diluc-xianyun-yaoyao.desc: Diluc Chongyun Yaoyao Xianyun. ~16s Rot. Diluc Melt Plunge. Uses Diluc E to (re)establish Burning aura to Melt plunge. Chongyun uses E before Xianyun. 50% Collisions. The 8th high plunge isn't melted and the timing for the 7th is tight.

arlecchino-chevreuse-thoma-yaemiko.desc: Arle Yae Chev Thoma. 18s rot. No Arle Q, 3[N5D] N2.

chasca-chevreuse-furina-sara.desc: Chasca Furina Chevreuse Sara. ~33s rotation. Chasca does tight E Q 4[C] when Burst available. Furina Bursts twice per rotation. Chevreuse Bursts when ready. Sara decides between Burst and Skill + CA during her field time.

bennett-chevreuse-cyno-fischl.desc: pyro cyno ft. c6 benny and chev. n2cd cyno. 15s rotation.

albedo-bennett-lynette-lyney.desc: lyney lynette with totm albedo. R5 favs to help with energy issues + assumes lyney repeatedly hits weakspots.

charlotte-escoffier-furina-shenhe.desc: Charlotte Furina Shenhe Escoffier. 21s Rot. On field Charlotte. Charlotte uses Hold E. Charlotte uses burst whenever it is available. 2E Shenhe. bennett-xiangling-xingqiu-yelan.desc: National with Yelan and Bennett on field

fischl-nahida-yaemiko-zhongli.desc: Yae Fischl Aggravate with Nahida and Zhongli. Yae drives when possible to maximise Fischl's A4. This team is very easy to play and you can basically AFK. The team is mostly unaffected by Nahida's Q Talent Level

cyno-dori-furina-nahida.desc: Cyno hyperbloom with full EM Dori. 28s rotation

hutao-mona-xingqiu-yelan.desc: HuTao triple hydro with xingqiu yelan mona

candace-kazuha-mualani-xiangling.desc: Mualani C5 Candace Kazuha Xiangling. 36s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. 1st half Xiangling Q and uses Mualani Q, 2nd half Kazuha Pyro Q from Guoba. Candace C6 is ~10% team DPS loss from C5. Candace can hold 4Instructor here(first half will have better dmg with it)

fischl-lanyan-nahida-yelan.desc: Lanyan Nahida Fischl Yelan. ~25s Rot. Lanyan Salad with Lanyan triggering hyperbloom with Swirl. 2E Yelan; Fischl skill and burst every rotation. Lanyan uses burst first, then spends skill off CD while weaving normal attacks.

bennett-furina-klee-sigewinne.desc: Kleerina with Sigewinne. Thanks to Sigewinne Furina deals more dmg and Klee can use all of Bennett's field time.

fischl-furina-kazuha-sigewinne.desc: Sigewinne tazer, 25s rot with fischl. R5 Sac bow to refresh E stacks. Sigewinne got to burst since nobody needs fieldtime

arlecchino-bennett-furina-sigewinne.desc: Arle double hydro with sigewinne. Sigewinne party heal gives decent stacks for furina buff.

bennett-fischl-tighnari-yaemiko.desc: tighnari double electro with benny's buff and healing. 25s rotation. fischl snapshot benny's buff with both her skill and burst, tighnari only get his buff for his first dps window. yae burst is buffed. hakushin similar to widsith on yae.

aetherpyro-chevreuse-fischl-ororon.desc: PMC Chevreuse Fischl Ororon. ~16s Rot. PMC double electro on field. PMC uses burst when available to fit the rotation length. PMC uses hE. PMC does N3D as available. PMC want a bit of EM. Chevreuse bursts every rot.

cyno-fischl-kazuha-nahida.desc: Cyno Aggravate with Fischl Kazuha Nahida

emilie-fischl-mavuika-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Emilie Fischl Mavuika. ~18s Rot. Yoimiya Burningload. Emilie & Yoimiya burst every other rot. Yoimiya does a few extra normal attacks when she doesn't burst just for fighting spirit generation. Fischl alternates skill/burst. Near 0 Quicken uptime. Full EM Fischl Preffered.

citlali-escoffier-wriothesley-yelan.desc: Wrio Yelan Citlali Escoffier. ~20s rot. 5[N3CJ] N4 Q/C. Weave NAs to trigger Yelan Q.

arlecchino-chevreuse-dehya-fischl.desc: Arle Fischl Chev Dehya. Swap off arle's fieldtime to refresh fischl E every other rotation. ER sands fischl to accomodate increase in er reqs

furina-kazuha-sigewinne-yaemiko.desc: Yae Sigewinne Furina Kazuha, Sacwinner to refresh her buff, Sigewinne uses her burst here to fill fieldtime. Yae bursts every other rotation.

bennett-faruzan-xiao-zhongli.desc: The popular 2 Burst/Enemy Xiao with adjusted ER and energy assumption. 50% collission rate. It doesn't work after 2 rotations.

alhaitham-emilie-mavuika-xianyun.desc: Alhaitham Emilie Mavuika Xianyun. ~19s Rot. Alhaitham Burning Plunge. AlHaitham NAs after each plunge for mirror triggers. Xianyun adds extra N1s before and after ElPQ to clear burning so Mavuika can trigger Scroll again. 60% Collisions.

escoffier-furina-itto-xilonen.desc: Itto Xilonen with Furina Escoffier. Energy requirements are greatly eased by Xilonen 2E on the second rotation onwards. Escoffier burst used when available.

arlecchino-bennett-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Arle Xiangling Zhongli Bennett. 20s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D] N1. bennett 2E per rot feeding xiangling directly.

nahida-raiden-tartaglia-xingqiu.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Xingqiu Nahida and Childe Driver

bennett-furina-navia-yelan.desc: Navia Furina Yelan Bennett. Furina doesn't recieve healing.

escoffier-freminet-furina-xianyun.desc: Freminet Furina Escoffier Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Freminet Phys plunge with Escoffier subDPS. Executes 1 Shattering Pressure combo while plunging. Escoffier bursts as available. OHC > VV Xianyun, but bubbles may miss. 50% Collisions.

kazuha-lisa-neuvillette-ororon.desc: Neuv Ororon Lisa Kazuha. 4CA 26s rot. Lisa w/o using hold E. Ororon has 2nd field time to feed Fav particles to Neuv.

furina-kokomi-mavuika-nahida.desc: Kokomi Furina Nahida Mavuika. ~20s Rot. Kokomi Burgeon-Vape with Mavuika. Kokomi's skill heals over the setup period and is freshed with her burst. Kokomi stays on field until her burst expires before Nahida attemts to trigger fav. Burstless Nahida.

bennett-furina-klee-xingqiu.desc: Hyperbuffed Klee Double Hydro Vape with Klee, Furina, Xingqiu, Bennett. Klee Vapes ~92% of her CAs and uses a mix of N1Cs and N2Cs. Bennett only heals himself and Klee.

fischl-heizou-keqing-nahida.desc: Keqing Nahida Fischl Heizou. ~26s Rot. Keqing Aggravate with Nahida a healer Heizou bursting twice a rotation.

escoffier-mualani-shenhe-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Mualani Shenhe Escoffier. 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] N4 Q/C. 4Scroll TTDS Mualani.

bennett-chasca-chongyun-escoffier.desc: Chasca Escoffier Chongyun Bennett. 17-18s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Chongyun batteries Bennett at the start. Cryo% goblet is 1% better than ATK% goblet.

chevreuse-fischl-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Fischl Chevreuse. ~18s Rot. Yoimiya Overvape with Chevreuse. Chevreuse bursts every rotation and NAs between (c4) skill uses. Yoimiya uses burst as available.

bennett-furina-hutao-xiangling.desc: furina forward vape with hu tao. 20s rotation with burst every other rotation furina,  few fuirna NAs to fill time on rotations she doesn't burst. hu tao uses mix of n3c and n2c, and burst when ready

eula-furina-xilonen-yelan.desc: Fav Eula driving double hydro with Xilonen. 23s rotation. Eula bursts every rotation.

hutao-mona-yelan-zhongli.desc: Hu Tao Yelan Zhongli Mona. Greatly benefits from Mona's C1 and C4. 18s rotation. Hutao Starting HP=1.

dori-fischl-nahida-xiangling.desc: Dori Nahida Fischl Xiangling. ~16s Rot. Dori Quickburn. Xiangling bursts every other rotation, Nahida does not burst, & Fischl alternates skill and burst. Nahida establishes burning just after Xiangling. Dori stays on-field while Oz is on-field.

fischl-hutao-xingqiu-zhongli.desc: TF Hu Tao with Xingqiu Zhongli Fischl

bennett-citlali-kaeya-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Kaeya Citlali Bennett. ~18s Rot. Yoimiya Melt, with a shielded Yoimiya standing point blank vs an opponent. Yoimia never uses burst. Kaeya just after Citlali for burst uptime; Citlali uses Evenstar. Fav Kaeya is close.

candace-luminedendro-nilou-yaoyao.desc: nilou candace yaoyao dmc but using the same pos as other nilou sims

collei-fischl-kazuha-keqing.desc: Keqing Fischl Aggravate with Collei and Kazuha

cyno-furina-kuki-nahida.desc: Cyno hyperbloom with Furina, Kuki, Nahida. 28s rotation

chevreuse-clorinde-sara-xinyan.desc: Clorinde Sara Chev Xinyan. 18s rot. Sara Q every 2rots for rot length. Starts with Sara E for Electro app and use it before Clorinde Q afterwards.

baizhu-furina-raiden-tighnari.desc: Comfy Tighnari Quickbloom with on-field Favonius Raiden to fill time + generate energy. Low overall ER requirements due to Raiden holding R5 Favonius Lance.

barbara-luminedendro-nahida-nilou.desc: Barbara bloom with desynced rotation to account for Barbara's 27s E cooldown

cyno-furina-xilonen-yelan.desc: Cyno Furina Yelan Xilonen. ~22s Rot. Cyno Taser Double Hydro. 2E Xilonen, 1E Yelan. Electro scroll is merely incidental on subsequent rotations and does not last the duration of Cyno's field time. Yelan should use a breakthrough barb to apply Hydro for Xilonen at the start.

bennett-fischl-furina-xingqiu.desc: Bennett Furina Fischl Xiagqiu. ~21s Rot. Bennett Overvape, less dank edition. Bennett stays on-field. Xingqiu uses burst after Furina; his burst expires just before Furina's burst on the next rotation. Fischl alternates skill and burst in Bennett's burst.

chiori-furina-itto-xianyun.desc: Itto "Lamentto" plunge with Chiori, Xianyun, Furina. Itto N1 Q E 8DJHP C2F E CF, 50% plunge collision rate.

bennett-chasca-citlali-mualani.desc: Chasca Citlali Mualani Bennett. 18-19s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Both Mualani and Citlali holds 4pc Scroll to get all three elements DMG bonus. But Chasca A4 app can ruin a setup if unlucky.

bennett-furina-raiden-xianyun.desc: Raiden Furina Bennett Xianyun. Pyro Raiden overvape plunge, raiden does 8 plunges every ~21.5s rot with 50% collision rate. Xianyun on OHC as she is unable to swirl pyro due to furina and raidens off field app. GT furina is ~1k worse.

bennett-fischl-kinich-thoma.desc: Kinich Fischl Thoma Bennett. 18s rot. E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo with consistently NA clockwise. Simple rotation with Thoma's IR. Scroll on Fischl is better for team DPS. 5 cannon shots not consistent past the first rotation.

cyno-fischl-nahida-yelan.desc: Cyno Hyperbloom with Fischl Nahida Yelan

alhaitham-fischl-kirara-yaemiko.desc: alhaitham spread w no burst yae (using burst in st is dps neutral for sustain)

fischl-furina-mizuki-xilonen.desc: Mizuki Fischl Furina Xilonen. 2E Xilonen, Mizuki uses skill on first half of rotation, does normal attacks to drive fischl on second half. Fischl has highest dmg contribution in ST, Mizuki in aoe. R3 Stringless is <1k worse than R5 Chainbreaker.

bennett-chasca-escoffier-xilonen.desc: Chasca Escoffier Xilonen Bennett. ~16s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Escoffier Q every 2 rot. Xilonen mostly Pyro Scroll.

furina-jean-layla-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Jean Layla. 4CA 27s rot. incredibly defensive with healing, shield, and freeze. Random delay as 9-15f and 2-4f action.

chevreuse-furina-raiden-xiangling.desc: Raiden Furina Xiangling Chevreuse. 20s rot. 4GT furina or 4MH raiden has similar result. 4SoDP chev was a bit weaker. Xiangling do some NAs to stack chev c6 before burst snapshot. also for rotation length.

bennett-faruzan-lynette-xiao.desc: xiao hypercarry with lynette.21s~  rotation. lynette feed skill and fav particles to xiao when needed

furina-klee-xianyun-xingqiu.desc: Klee plunge vape with Furina, Xingqiu, Xianyun. Klee does not use her burst in order to get 8 buffed plunges. The vast majority of klee's plunges and charged attacks are vaped. 50% collision rate.

baizhu-thoma-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Thoma Burgeon with Xingqiu Yelan and Baizhu

fischl-kirara-sara-sucrose.desc: Sara Fischl Sucrose Kirara. ~26 Rot. On-Field Sara Aggravate with a Shielder Kirara. Sara buffs herself and Fischl. Hakushin only buffs Sara.

arlecchino-yelan-yunjin-zhongli.desc: Arle Yelan YunJin Zhongli. 18s rot. No Arle Q, N1 CA dash cancel 3[N5D]. weave NA on yunjin for fav proc. 4NO on YunJin is ~1k more DPS.

furina-jean-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya double hydro with Furina and Jean. No interruption protection

fischl-furina-itto-xilonen.desc: Itto Xilonen with Furina Fischl. Energy requirements are greatly eased by Xilonen 2E on the second rotation onwards. Rotation length allows for a Fischl E every rotation, unlike conventional Itto teams.  Recasts Oz with Q when available for uptime & to snapshot buffs.

alhaitham-dori-furina-ororon.desc: Alhaitham Furina Ororon Dori. ~21s Rot. Long field time Alhaitham with High energy restoration. Ororon doesn't trigger Scroll in the first rotation.

hutao-sucrose-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Double Hydro with Sucrose

lumineelectro-nahida-xingqiu-yelan.desc: EMC Hyperbloom with Nhaida Xingqiu Yelan

dori-emilie-mavuika-ororon.desc: Dori Emilie Ororon Mavuika. ~20s Rot. Dori Quickburn with long field time Dori & 30% Burning uptime. Full EM Maviuika and Ororon. Emilie & Mavuika burst every other rotation after the first. then Dori stays on field for 3 skill uses, as her C6 infusion downtime is near eliminated with TF.

bennett-chevreuse-diluc-fischl.desc: Diluc Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~17s Rot. Diluc Chevreuse Overload. Fischl aim shot for Chev A1 in the first rotation. Chevreuse passes her Fav proc to Fischl. Diluc's burst snapshots Bennett buff.

bennett-furina-lynette-xiangling.desc: xl benny furina lynette. 20s rotation. uses benny hold E with c4 to guarantee pyro swirl. lynette absorb hydro to help with vapes,xl vapes around 75% of her damage. lynette helps stack fanfare with her skill. r5 fav to get multiple procs.

fischl-heizou-kirara-sethos.desc: Sethos Fischl Heizou Kirara. ~16s Rot. A simple Sethos Aggravate rotation.

furina-klee-sigewinne-xilonen.desc: "hypercarry" off-field Furina with on-field enabler Klee. ~20s rot bc Furina cd. It has good vertical investment.

chevreuse-clorinde-dehya-fischl.desc: Clorinde Fischl Chev Dehya. 18s rot. Fischl use some NAs to get 1 Chev healing and C6 stack. SacGS R5 on Dehya to make the rot shorter than 20s, which is crucial.

bennett-fischl-ningguang-xilonen.desc: Ningguang Xilonen Fischl Bennett. Ningguang uses 2 skills and does N1C combo.  Bennett energy requirements are very high as only doing 1E per ~18s rot (2E with Alley Flash is ~1k dps worse). Viridescent Hunt is ~0.5k better than Alley hunter on fischl.

fischl-kinich-kuki-nahida.desc: Kinich Nahida Kuki Fischl. ~18s Rot. QuicKinich on-field. Scroll > OC/ToM > GT Kinich/Kuki for team dps. Fischl alternates skill and burst. Kuki & Kinich burst if available. No Kinich short hold is -3k DPS. Assumes that Kinich remains in range for Kuki's kill to land.

alhaitham-lisa-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Lisa hyperbloom with on-field Al Haitham

furina-hutao-lynette-xianyun.desc: Hutao Furina Lynette Xianyun. ~19s Rot. Huto Vape plunge (5N2CJHP) with Lynette feeding Xianyun Anemo particles if possible, then using dropping her burst after, absorbing Hydro.

chiori-clorinde-fischl-zhongli.desc: clorinde double geo double electro. zhongli and clorinde burst every rotation, chiroi burst every other rotation. ap similar to totm on zhongli. low fischl damage due to the lack of buffs and a4 triggers, but she batteries clorinde.

bennett-faruzan-furina-xiao.desc: Sustainable ER for indefinite rotations. 50% collision rate

clorinde-nahida-yaemiko-zhongli.desc: Clorinde Yae Nahida Zhongli. 16-17s rot. No Yae Q. Clorinde Q every rot at the end. High ER req on Nahida. 4TotM Nahida, 4GT is ~0.8k less and 4DM is ~1.7 less

bennett-emilie-furina-klee.desc: Klee Furina Emilie Bennett. 20s rot. Different first rot with klee 2nd E. 4MH on Klee is beneficial for high A4 proc rate. Furina Q every rot, Emilie Q if ready on Bennett Q

fischl-keqing-nahida-tighnari.desc: Keqing Tighnari Fischl Nahida. ~16s Rot. Keqing Tignari Dual DPS Aggraspread. Alternates Fischl Skill and Burst. Nahida & Tighnari burst only if avalable.

fischl-kinich-thoma-yelan.desc: Kinich Yelan Fischl Thoma. ~18s Rot. Kinich with Overload, Burgeon, Spread, etc. Kinich seeks blindspots. No Kinich short hold is -6K DPS. Kinich burst is a DPS loss. Scroll and Obsidian Codex go even.

furina-gorou-navia-yelan.desc: Navia Gorou (C4+) Furina Yelan. Gorou is on a healing build. 2 Yelan E, 2 Gorou E rotation.

bennett-hutao-sucrose-xingqiu.desc: Hu Tao Xingqiu Sucrose Bennett. 21s rot. Sucrose Swirls both Pyro and Hydro. Uses 2 dashes during setup to avoid Hydro application from Xingqiu's Rain Swords. Hu Tao uses 4[N1CJ] 4[N2CJ] combo due to stamina issues not allowing her to do 8[N1CJ] N2CJ.

bennett-dehya-kinich-rosaria.desc: Kinich Dehya Rosaria Bennett. ~20s Rot. Kinich with Rosaria Melting off of Burning. Kinich does not intentionally seek blindspots. N2 (wait) E Kinich. No Kinich short hold is -10K DPS (missed cannon). Kinich uses burst if available at the end of the rotation after Rosaria and bennett use skill again.

escoffier-eula-fischl-xianyun.desc: Eula Fischl Escoffier Xianyun. ~18s Rot. Eula bursts every 3rd rotation; she fills time with NA on non-burst rotations. OHC > VV Xianyun, but bubbles may miss. Escoffier only bursts if available. 50% Collisions.

charlotte-escoffier-freminet-furina.desc: Freminet Furina Escoffier Charlotte. ~23s Rot. Cryo Freminet with Escoffier & TTDS. Escoffier and Charlotte burst in alternate rotations. Charlotte's TTDS lands on Freminet.

fischl-kazuha-kirara-raiden.desc: Raiden E > Kaz E > Kirara EQ > Fish Q > Kaz N2Q > Raiden Combo > Fish E (if active). Make sure you have electro aura on kaz Q since timing is tight

bennett-chasca-rosaria-xiangling.desc: Chasca Rosaria Xiangling Bennett. 17s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Xiangling casts Q every other rotation and snapshots both Rosaria's CR and Bennett's buff. Chasca has lower uptime on Rosaria's CR buff. Pyro% Goblet is ~1k DPS (~2.5%) better than ATK% Goblet.

furina-itto-xilonen-xingqiu.desc: Itto Xilonen with Furina Xingqiu. 2 Xilo Es on the second rotation onward greatly eases up energy requirements. Whiteblind R5 outperforms Serpent R1

ayato-fischl-furina-jean.desc: Ayato Furina Fischl Jean. 4MH 2Es 26-27s rot. Ayato Q at the end of his first combo, waiting his E cd. Jean has EM build in the config for AoE combat. With Finale of the Deep on Ayato, 4pc Whimsy set is ~1k better here.

bennett-xingqiu-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya double hydro with bennett. KQMS. 21s rotation: XQ EQ -> Yelan Q -> Bennett EQ-> XQ  -> Yelan E -> Yoimiya -> Yelan E -> back to XQ.

bennett-nahida-razor-xingqiu.desc: Razor Nahida Xingqiu Bennett. ~24s Rotation. Razor Hyperburgeon with C6 Bennett using just one E. Self-Overloads not implemented.

freminet-furina-ororon-xianyun.desc: Freminet Furina Ororon Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Freminet Phys plunge with Superconduct. Ororon prefers NO to Scroll. Executes 1 Shattering Pressure combo while plunging. 50% Collisions. PF > MH on Freminet.

fischl-kokomi-nahida-thoma.desc: Thoma Burgeon with Fischl Kokomi Nahida

bennett-chevreuse-raiden-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Raiden Chev Bennett. 18s rot. DPS build Chev. Raiden off-field. just use her E and gg.

chongyun-escoffier-rosaria-shenhe.desc: Rosaria Chongyun Shenhe Escoffier. ~20s Rot. Rosaria on-field Mono Cryo. 2E Shenhe. Rosaria uses skill off CD while spamming doing N3CD (stamina permitting) until Chongyun's field expires. Escoffier tries to burst every rotation after the first.

bennett-furina-klee-xiangling.desc: Kleerina w/ Xiangling. Very easy to play - Furina edq > Bennett q e > Xiangling q ed > Klee combo > Bennett e

escoffier-fischl-freminet-furina.desc: Freminet Furina Fischl Escoffier. ~21s Rot. Physical Freminet with Superconduct. Fischl alternates skill and burst.

chiori-fischl-luminegeo-navia.desc: navia geoMC fischl chiori, using chiori Q and navia Q every rotation, totm fischl is slightly better than gt

bennett-emilie-furina-gaming.desc: Gaming Furina Emilie Bennett. ~21s Rot. Gaming Burning with Furina Vape. Gaming juggles Manchai, catching him in midair and filling time on the ground with infused normal attacks. Bennett passes particles to Gaming. Deepwood Emilie narrowly edges out UR thanks to Burgeon.

kazuha-nahida-sara-yaemiko.desc: "Hyper" Yae Aggravate with Nahida kauzha Sara

fischl-sethos-sucrose-tighnari.desc: Sethos Tighnari Fischl Sucrose. ~18s Rot. Sethos Tighanri Aggravate. Sethos uses a Shadowpiercing shot to apply Electro at the start of the rotation. Fischl alternates skill and burst. Tighnari uses burst after CA if available. Sucrose buffs both Sethos and Tighnari.

cyno-lisa-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Lisa Cyno quickbloom. KQMS. TF Cyno generates enough energy that Lisa bursts with minimal ER. Lisa has high Hyperbloom ownership in Sim, not consistent in game. Scales well with hyperinvestment.

chevreuse-fischl-gaming-yaemiko.desc: Gaming Chevreuse Fischl Yae. ~17s Rot. Gaming does 7 skill plunges, juggling Man Chais in the air. Chevreuse bursts every other rotation. Yae does not burst.

alhaitham-baizhu-fischl-yaemiko.desc: Alhaitham Double Electro with baizhu. 4GT Yae w/o burst

clorinde-fischl-lanyan-yelan.desc: Clorinde Yelan Fischl Lanyan. ~18s Rot. Clorinde Taser. Lanyan's shield covers Clorinde's field time. Lanyan applies VV again before Clorinde uses her burst. Room for optimization.

fischl-lisa-nahida-xianyun.desc: Lisa Nahida Fischl Xianyun. ~25s Rot. Lisa Aggravate Plunge. Xianyun refeshes VV after Fischl uses burst. Lisa uses hold skill after all plunges are spent to meet energy requirements.

bennett-dehya-lyney-xiangling.desc: Mono Pyro Lyney bennett xiangling dehya

bennett-chevreuse-kazuha-xianyun.desc: Kazuha Chevreuse Bennett Xianyun. ~18s Rot. Mono Pyro Plunge with grouping featuring C6 Chev. Skill plunges bookend Kazuha's field time. 100% collisions for E plunges, 70% for starwicker plunges.

escoffier-eula-furina-mika.desc: Eula Furina Escoffier Mika. ~22s Rot. Eula Mika with Escoffier. Escoffier and Mika burst in alternate rotations. Mika C6 will expire before the lightfall drop if Eula's burst is not ready immediately

bennett-emilie-wriothesley-xiangling.desc: Wrio Emilie Xiangling Bennett. N3CJ combo 20s rot. Emilie and Wrio Q every 2 rots.

bennett-fischl-nahida-razor.desc: Razor Nahida Fischl Bennett. ~20s Rotation with 2E Sapwood Bennett. Razor Quickload w/ ~73% Quicken Uptime. SS may be inconsistent. Self-Overloads not implemented. Bennett must mind burning damage.

eula-furina-ororon-xianyun.desc: Eula Furina Ororon Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Eula bursts every other rotation; she fills time with NA on non-burst rotations. OHC > SoDP Xianyun, but bubbles may miss. Ororon uses No over Scroll. 50% Collisions.

bennett-chevreuse-dori-fischl.desc: Bennett Chevreuse Fischl Dori. ~16s Rot. TF Bennett quickswapping with Dori. Dori Q & E as available. Chevreuse Q3E every rotation in Bennett's Q. Fischl snapshots Bennett's buff. Bennett 3EM>EDC>ADC. Self-Overloads not implemented.

bennett-kazuha-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Kazuha Bennett. 18s rot. reliable double swirl setup. lack of interruption resistance.

bennett-faruzan-layla-wanderer.desc: Wanderer Layla Bennett Faruzan, 3 rotations only, setups can consistently allow wanderer to infuse both cryo and pyro from his A1 passive. R5 Favs are critical to performance; Another rotation sheds ~2K avg DPS from Bennett ER issues. If you run into ER issues, 1 Bennett E is needed after Wanderer's fieldtime ends. The final rotation omits Faruzan battery actions to display higher DPS.

emilie-fischl-raiden-xinyan.desc: Raiden Emilie Fischl Xinyan. ~18s Rot. Raiden Emilie Quickburn, with Emilie using Raiden's energy restoration to burst every rotation. Xinyan's shield uptime is very suspect in practice. ToM Raiden is marginally better.

emilie-fischl-razor-xiangling.desc: Razor Emilie Fischl Xiangling. ~20s Rot. Razor Quickburn with ~15s Field time. Emilie bursts every other rotation. Fischl alternates skill and burst, prioritizing burst. Xiangling goes after Fischl and bursts every other rotation. Razor has the most Overload ownership.

bennett-furina-lynette-yoimiya.desc: yoi-furina vape. lynette helps sustain vapes with hydro absorb burst and stack fanfare with her skill. her taunt is also helpful. with c6, and c6 bennett she can weapon swirl (not implemented), which make swirl setup much easier. rotation for that on the config.

faruzan-raiden-xianyun-xiao.desc: Xiao Faruzan Raiden Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Xiaoden Faruzan. Even with triple Anemo, Raiden can contribute to lowering energy requirements. TTDS Xianyun is the same. 11 plunges. 50% collisions.

fischl-keqing-sucrose-tighnari.desc: Keqing Tighnari Fischl Sucrose. ~16s Rot. Keqing Tignari Aggraspread. Alternates Fischl Skill and Burst. Tighnari uses skill before Keqing and spends 2 CAs after her field time. Sucrose & Tighnari burst only if avalable.

furina-noelle-xingqiu-yelan.desc: AP Favge Noelle driver with triple hydro. Very comfy to play and surprisingly effective

alhaitham-nahida-raiden-xianyun.desc: Alhaitham Nahida Raiden Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Alhaitham Quicken Plunge. AlHaitham uses skill, spams JlPN1, then bursts, followed by Raiden quickly generating energy for the next rotation. OHC > SoDP Xianyun, but Bubbles may miss. 60% Collisions.

arlecchino-chiori-mona-zhongli.desc: Arle Mona Chiori Zhongli. 16s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 3[N3D] 2[N4D]. Mona can hold prototype amber instead.

bennett-chiori-emilie-ningguang.desc: ningguang emilie bennett chiori, 4p Deepwood bennett, swaps in during ningguang's field time to apply pyro again, to benefit emilie. 12-3 icewind suite energy drops.

fischl-kuki-navia-xilonen.desc: Navia Xilonen Fischl Kuki. Xilonen 1E 16s rot. Kuki E as a healing source. Navia uses long 3[N2D] combo to fill the rotation length considering her E cd. you can use shorter combo if you use Kuki Q or Xilonen Q

escoffier-furina-ororon-raiden.desc: Raiden Furina Ororon Escoffier. ~20s Rot. Raiden and Ororon and Electro Resonance lead to Low team ER reqs; Raiden uses Emblem for a more consistent first slash. Escoffier fills time on field for Furina's skill cd after Raiden's burst.

arlecchino-xilonen-yelan-zhongli.desc: Arle Yelan Xilonen Zhongli. Pyro Scroll 18s rot. No Arle Q. C 5[N3D] N1 and Zhongli Q to remove aura, come back to Arle E to apply pyro for 4pc Scroll. You can also use Arle QE to leave pyro like this. Not using 4AP is ~4.5k loss

barbara-bennett-chasca-ororon.desc: Chasca Ororon Barbara Bennett. ~16s rot achieved by virtue of more consistent Oro to Ben funnel, forcing Oro Fav proc, and Bennett on a poopy butt 2/2 set for energy. You can run Bennett on 4NO if you ignore KQMS. Oro Q E Ben E Q N1 Barb (E N1/N2 every other rot) Chasca E 4C ( Q / C_4b depending on energy).

faruzan-furina-sigewinne-xiao.desc: Xiao with Sigewinne. 2 rotations. 50% collisions. Good potential for upgrades.

collei-kuki-nahida-neuvillette.desc: Neuvillette hyperbloom - Collei and Kuki have a 15s cd burst and skill respectively so a 30s rotation is made. Spend some time with Nahida while you wait for Kuki skill to come out of cooldown - Optimised random delay sim - 2-4 frames delay between non-bufferable actions, 9-15 frames of swap delay

ayaka-navia-shenhe-xilonen.desc: Navia Ayaka Shenhe Xilonen. ~21s Rot. Navia Ayaka Dual DPS; compromises on elemental application in the second half of the rotation. Navia uses a 3rd skill when available. Xilonen burts every other rotation. Crystallize shards are picked up with dashes and character movement skills.

chasca-citlali-furina-sigewinne.desc: Freeze chasca with simple rotation (~19s rot), chasca burst every other rot.

bennett-chevreuse-raiden-sara.desc: Raiden/Sara/Chevreuse/Bennett team, with a focus on supports' damage. Triple buffs three characters, but requires low ping to execute.

bennett-gaming-kaeya-lynette.desc: melt gaming with kaeya and lynette that gets pyro vv 2nd rot onwards, uses R5 fav to help energy issues. rot works with pre-C4 lynette. noticable damage loss with more "accessible" C0 lynette + C0 kaeya, but will clear fine.

chevreuse-raiden-xiangling-xingqiu.desc: "Raiden National" with chev replacing bennett. No circle impact; Rotation has extra fieldtime for xl to try get more c6 chev stacks.

bennett-ororon-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Ororon Bennett. 18s rot. Pyro Scroll setup Yelan > Ororon E N1 > Bennett Q E > Ororon Q.

dehya-fischl-nahida-sethos.desc: Sethos Nahida Fischl Dehya. Sethos Quickburn. Sethos looses a Shadowpeircing shot at the start of the chamber and end of his field time. Deyha uses Sacgs to fit he rotation length and is skipped if she isn't ready. Nahida fills time when SacGS fails to proc. Scroll > Deepwood Deyha.

nahida-razor-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Razor Hyperbloom with Double Hydro and Nahida

ayaka-chiori-shenhe-xilonen.desc: Monocryo Ayaka with Xilonen Chiori core. Xilonen burst is only used to proc finale passive, it shouldn't be used with a 5 star weapon on Ayaka. Chiori Burst at the end of the rotation is a slight dps increase compared to no Burst.

bennett-furina-klee-xianyun.desc: Klee Furina Bennett Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Klee Plunge, Furina Vape; Hydro VV, No Pyro VV. Klee bursts as available and does CAs between plunges, stamina permitting. Klee's CAs assist with team energy. 50% Collisions.

bennett-chasca-citlali-shenhe.desc: Chasca Citlali Shenhe Bennett. 18s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Shenhe hE(Q) is done before Bennett EQ for Citlali's Pyro Scroll setup. Shenhe Q every 2 rots. Bennett needs high ER due to using only 1E per rot for shorter rot length.

dehya-emilie-mona-mualani.desc: Mualani Mona Emilie Dehya. 35s rot. Q if available + 3[3-stacked bite]. Mona C1 is beneficial. Mona uses her E at the rotation downtime.

charlotte-escoffier-shenhe-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Charlotte Shenhe Escoffier. 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] N3 Q/N1C. Escoffier Q every 2 rot, E N3 to catch her own particles when not using Q.

escoffier-freminet-furina-yaemiko.desc: Freminet Furina Yae Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Physical Freminet with Superconduct/Shatter. Freminet inserts additional normal attacks, causing his burst to expire before the final Shattering pressure. Fav/Lamppost vs FD/Fav Furina/Esco are very similar. Full EM Evenstar Yae outperforms Purity/Widsith Yae.

albedo-bennett-fischl-navia.desc: Navia Albedo Fischl Bennett. 17.5s rot. Albedo's E can be broken in game. then he can't generate geo particles until he recasts it. Used ER sands to allow more crit subs on navia.

escoffier-rosaria-shenhe-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Shenhe Escoffier Rosaria. 19-20s rot. Rosa 2E per rot. Wrio Shime is a little bit better than MH and Blizzard because of Cryo reso having a 100% uptime and Rosa providing a ton of Crit Rate.

bennett-emilie-thoma-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Emilie Thoma Bennett. N3CJ combo 20s rot. Emilie and Wrio Q every 2 rots. 4DM on Thoma provides high RES Shred uptime for Emilie.

alhaitham-chiori-fischl-zhongli.desc: alhaitham double geo. 18s rotation. alhaitham and chiori alternate burst use. alhaitham does some phys attacks on rotations without burst. uses alhaitham burst swap, but if it isn't possible, the dps loss from not doing burst swap is minimal.

bennett-furina-gaming-xiangling.desc: 20s rotation. gaming does 7 skill plunges. mostly furina vape, xiangling and gaming get few random vapes.

fischl-furina-sayu-yaemiko.desc: Sayu Furina Yae Fischl. ~25s Rot. Sayu Taser with a max duration roll. Yae bursts every rotation.

ayaka-charlotte-furina-kazuha.desc: Ayaka Charlotte Kazuha Furina. Charlotte with TTDS. swirl cryo & hydro. ~20s rotation

escoffier-furina-razor-yelan.desc: Razor Furina Yelan Escoffier. ~25s Rot. Hybrid Razor deals 40/60 Electro/Phys Damage and since he has access to a lot of DMG% sources, he prefers an ATK% goblet. Razor should lead with tap skill for energy reasons. 1E Yelan.

chasca-chevreuse-ororon-sara.desc: Chasca Sara Ororon Chevreuse. ~17s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. EoSF on Sara is ~100 less DPS. Chevreuse uses HP% Goblet for comfort, Pyro% Goblet is ~500 more DPS. Not having Chevreuse C6 is ~8.5k (~16%) team DPS loss. Due to abundance of DMG% buffs and lack of Bennett, ATK% Goblet is preferred by ~1k DPS (less with Hamayumi and Electro%=ATK% Goblet with Chain Breaker).

lisa-nahida-xingqiu-zhongli.desc: Lisa Xingqiu Nahida Zhongli. ~21s Rot. Lisa Hyperbloom. Xingqiu Hyperbloom. Lisa uses burst at the end of the rotation; she skips burst entirely if ER deficient. XQ burst continues into the next rotation.

chasca-chevreuse-furina-mualani.desc: Chasca Furina Mualani Chev. ~16-17s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b], Q every 2 rot. Not having Chev C6 is 5.5k(~10%) DPS loss.

chevreuse-furina-klee-lynette.desc: kleerina without circle impact. chev provides her c6 buff, easy vv setup, and healing. lynette helps stack fanfare with her skill. r5 fav on lynette to get 2 procs. lynette absorbs hydro and klee gets few vapes

bennett-furina-keqing-xianyun.desc: Keqing Furina Bennett Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Keqing Vape plunge, no VV, No delays for aura. Keqing uses skill twice for team energy reasons, clearing electro aura with the first use. 50% Collisions.

bennett-chasca-diona-ororon.desc: Chasca Ororon Diona Bennet. 16s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Diona Q every 2 rot for shorter rotation length. Not having Ororon C6 is ~4k(7%) DPS Loss. Note that you must aim cancel Chasca skill very quickly to be low enough for Diona C6 to apply.

dori-fischl-nahida-xianyun.desc: Dori Nahida Fischl Xianyun. ~26s Rot. Dori Aggravate with Xianyun plunge support. The CD on Dori's skill/infusion is nearly eliminated by Aggravate on no ICD plunges. 50% Collisions.

chongyun-escoffier-kaeya-shenhe.desc: Kaeya Chongyun Shenhe Escoffier. ~20s Rot. Kaeya on-field Mono Cryo. 2E Shenhe. Kaeya uses skill off CD while spamming doing N2CD (stamina permitting) until Chongyun's field expires. Escoffier tries to burst every rotation after the first.

bennett-emilie-escoffier-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Escoffier Emilie Bennett. 18s rot. Bennett 2E, 4pc UR Yoimiya Q every 2rot. Emilie Q if available on Bennett Q. Escoffier doesn't use her Q.

diluc-furina-xianyun-yelan.desc: Diluc Furina Yelan Xianyun. ~25s Rot. Diluc weaves normals between low plunges while Yelan burst is active, then dash dancels high plunges. No Pyro VV.

bennett-chevreuse-yaemiko-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yae chevreuse Bennett. 18s rot. Yoi and Yae don't use their burst. DPS chevreuse with 4EoSF.

escoffier-furina-ganyu-kazuha.desc: Ganyu Furina Kazuha Escoffier. ~22s Rot. On-field Freeze DPS Ganyu in 2 Target, featuring stronger grouping. Ganyu does 2 Es per rotation. Assumes freezable enemies. Kazuha does not glide cancel. -6K DPS with Stillness, MH, & Non Freezable Opponents.

ayaka-lynette-shenhe-yelan.desc: Ayaka Freeze with Yelan. Pretty ST locked thanks to Yelan Hydro app but Lynette helps by absorbing Hydro with Q. Pre-C4 Lynette can do Q N2 instead of E N1 Q for about 2.5k less DPS; 3 favs keep her ER reqs low enough to use ATK sands even with 1E

chevreuse-fischl-raiden-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Raiden Fischl Chevreuse. 31s rot. Simply [ Chev > Fischl > Yoi or Rai ] 15s rot twice. Don't forget to use Yoimiya burst for Off-field pyro app (chev A1 res shred) and 20% ATK buff. Chev C6 is highly recommended, you lose about 9-10k w/o it.

arlecchino-furina-jean-yelan.desc: Arle Furina Yelan Jean. Yelan 1E 21s rot. No Arle Q, 3[N5D]. Arle ATK/ATK/CRIT was slightly better due to high DMG% buffs. Jean uses 2nd E at the end for VV refresh and lowering furina's ER.

bennett-citlali-furina-yelan.desc: Bennett Furina Yelan Citlali. ~22s Rot. Benentt Vape/Melt. 1E Yelan. Mostly reliable Pyro Scroll. MH > CW Bennett. -5K DPS with Freeze immunity.

chevreuse-fischl-luminepyro-ororon.desc: PMC Chevreuse Fischl Ororon KMQs. ~15.5s rot. TF reduce PMC E's CD to get shorter rotation than 18s Lumine does more dmg than Aether (~1.5K) here due to her better CA's MV. Rotation: Ororon EQ > Chevreuse Q EE > Fischl N1 Q/E > PMC EQ 2[N2C N3C]

alhaitham-kuki-yelan-zhongli.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with Alhaitham Spread with Yelan Zhongli

arlecchino-bennett-diona-yelan.desc: Arle Yelan Diona Bennett. Yelan 1E 21s rot. No Arle Q, N1 CA dash cancel 6[N3D]. KQMS Random Frame Delay

bennett-emilie-furina-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Emilie Furina Bennett. 20s rot. Burnvape Furina Q every 2 rots to maximize her damage. Emilie and Yoimiya also Q every 2 rots. Bennett can hold either 4DM, 4NO, or 4SoDP.

furina-xilonen-yoimiya-yunjin.desc: Yoimiya Furina YunJin Xilonen. 20s rot. Picking up the shard is required for Geo Resonance buff. YunJin can easily hold DEF% weapon thanks to team Fav and Xilonen's Geo particles.

dehya-furina-lynette-nahida.desc: ''Burngeon'' in AoE (3T) w. full EM C6 Lynette. N2C+N1C combo. Tightly packed small mobs maximizes AoE damage. In practice the self damage from burgeon and burning + Furina's pet HP drain + ins Dehya's lower sustain = hope the enemy dies before you do. Pamber is ~5k DPS loss and full HP dehya is ~15k dps loss but both are strongly recommended ingame. Does worse against ST and/or very big enemies.

bennett-clorinde-emilie-thoma.desc: Clorinde Emilie Thoma Bennett. 18s rot. Emilie & Clorinde Q when available, on Bennett Q. EM sands on Clorinde, for Aggravate and Overloaded.

bennett-fischl-furina-yanfei.desc: yanfei overvape. 20s~ rotation. yanfei vapes around 2/3 of her CAs. yanfei doesn't build er and burst when ready.

fischl-raiden-sucrose-xingqiu.desc: Raiden Taser w/ Sucrose on fielding during Raiden's downtime. And yes, the single target dps would be slightly better with tenacity Raiden instead.

eula-raiden-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Eula Raiden Rosaria Xianyun. ~18s Rot. Eula bursts every third rotation; When burst is ready: tEQN1hE, otherwise tE and hE after plunging once available. OHC > SoDP Xianyun, but bubbles may miss.

bennett-jean-raiden-yelan.desc: Raiden Yelan Bennett Jean. ~21s Rot. Raiden Sunfire Overvape with Yelan. Raiden uses ER Sands to Meet ER Reqs.

bennett-fischl-kazuha-raiden.desc: RaiFish -- Raiden N4D combos with E cancel, Fischl E at the end of every other rotation

bennett-chasca-ororon-sara.desc: Chasca Sara Ororon Bennett. 17s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Chasca prefers Electro% Goblet by ~1.5k (~3%).

bennett-furina-yanfei-yelan.desc: Yanfei Vape. Yanfei bursts every other rotation. Furina does not get healed

arlecchino-bennett-kazuha-thoma.desc: Arle Thoma Kazuha Bennett. 17s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D] N1.

dori-furina-navia-yelan.desc: Navia Furina Yelan Dori. Dori regenerates Energy for Navia, allowing her to run close to zero ER. In addition, Dori also heals the entire party, enabling Furina. ATK% is slightly better than Geo DMG% Goblet.

baizhu-nahida-neuvillette-raiden.desc: Neuvillette hyperbloom with Interruption Resistance and some multiwave dendro application - Optimised random delay sim - 2-4 frames delay between non-bufferable actions, 9-15 frames of swap delay

baizhu-cyno-fischl-mavuika.desc: Cyno Quickburn with defensive utility. Quicken uptime almost 100%. Mavuika bursts every rotation despite not having full fighting spirit. 25s rotation.

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-kuki.desc: Kuki Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. Kuki on-field DPS. 8x CA leaves little stamina to dodge.

ayato-bennett-furina-mavuika.desc: Ayato Furina Mavuika Bennett. 25s rot. Mavuika Q C3D. She can nuke w/ Bennett Q buff.

escoffier-freminet-furina-mika.desc: Freminet Furina Escoffier Mika. ~22s Rot. Physical Freminet Shatter with Mika. Mika and Escoffier burst in alternate rotations. Mika attack speed is used to fit more normal attacks into Freminet's combo, but Freminet's burst expires before the 4th shattering pressure.

navia-raiden-sara-xilonen.desc: Raidenavia dual carry! This team is synergistic for lots of reasons, such as Raiden's flexible and consistent application and Sara's buff being long enough for Navia. Scales better with investment, especially when you have PPS on Xilo. Favge barely helps here.

bennett-furina-kazuha-raiden.desc: baal hypercarry with furina instead of sara

hutao-nahida-raiden-xingqiu.desc: hutao/raiden soup, team with funny reaction

kirara-lynette-neuvillette-ororon.desc: Neuv Kirara Ororon Lynette. 4CA 26s rot. PrototypeAmber R5 is ~7k(12%) lower. It works Pre-C4 Lynette.

bennett-faruzan-furina-xiangling.desc: Faruzan Furina Xiangling Bennett. ~21s Rot. Faruzan Furinational, Fav Bow Faruzan strikes an ideal balance of team energy. Similar damage share between Furina, Xiangling and Faruzan. 10% Weakspot chance.

chevreuse-raiden-sara-yaemiko.desc: ~22s Ei Miko Sara Chevreuse, first rot is altered, requires either low ping or a large enemy, requires Chevreuse c4.

bennett-faruzan-fischl-xiao.desc: Xiao Fischl Faruzan Bennett. 19s Rot. 11 High plunges. Faruzan burst leads the rotation. Fischl catches Bennett's buff. 50% Collisions.

chevreuse-hutao-xilonen-yelan.desc: Hutao Yelan Chevreuse Xilonen. ~18s Rot. 9N2CJ Hutao Vape with Chevreuse enabling MH. Chev bursts every roation to reliably allow Xilonen to Crystallize Pyro. 1E Yelan.

bennett-fischl-klee-xingqiu.desc: Klee Overvape, APL rotation, note frame delays can cause a much different reaction chain

bennett-escoffier-wriothesley-xiangling.desc: Wrio Escoffier Xiangling Bennett. 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] N3 Q or C. You lose Pyro aura due to N3CJ combo

nahida-razor-xingqiu-yaoyao.desc: Nahida QE > Xingqiu EDQN1 > Yaoyao QDED (If the Q is ready, if not E) > Razor EDQ N3ED 2N3D N3ED 2N3D N2ED > Nahida N1

chevreuse-mavuika-raiden-xiangling.desc: Raiden Chevreuse Xiangling Mavuika. ~20s Rot. Raiden Overload with double Pyro providing good AoE. Mavuika passes particles to Xiangling. Xiangling fills time for her burst CD with C2 when Mavuika cant fill time on Flamestrider. Healer Chevreuse.

fischl-tighnari-yaemiko-zhongli.desc: Yaefischl Aggravate with Tighnari and Zhongli

escoffier-furina-xiao-yelan.desc: Xiao Furina Yelan Escoffier. ~23s Rot. VV Fav Xiao in Freeze Plunge with 8 low plunges and 1 High plunge, with NAs inbetween for Yelan waves. 1E Yelan. 50% Collisions.

fischl-lisa-sucrose-yaoyao.desc: Lisa Aggravate with Yaoyao. Energy issues; very high substats on instructors

furina-ororon-raiden-xilonen.desc: Raiden Furina Ororon Xilonen. 20s rot. Raiden ATK Goblet. Xilonen uses 4AP, mostly for Electro due to EC aura.

candace-furina-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Furina Candace Xilonen Xianyun. ~20s Rot. C0 Furina Hydro Plunge. 2E Xilonen and Candace. Xilonen does not burst. NO instead of AP Candace is -2K DPS.

nahida-raiden-razor-xingqiu.desc: Razor and Raiden fight to see who explodes the seeds. only defensive support by Xingqiu.

baizhu-furina-keqing-yelan.desc: Keqing Yelan Furina Baizhu. ~22s Rot. Hyperbloom Keqing on-field spams electro CAs while weaving N1. You can burst with Keqing bursts after Yelan's burst expires to regen stamina. 2E Yelan.

bennett-fischl-furina-kirara.desc: ~22s rotation with near-full Oz uptime thanks to 4TF, quickswapping between Fischl N2D spam, Bennett Skills, and a 3s Kirara hE. Oz consistently snapshots Bennett's buff on each summon. Fischl triggers Hyperbloom on ~60% of Blooms. Kirara and Bennett built for dmg. 12-3 Icewind Suite's base stats used for energy drops and incoming damage instances every 4-6s. Customized random action delays and starting HPs.

bennett-chasca-furina-layla.desc: Chasca Furina Layla Bennett. 20s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Layla Triple scroll with Bennett C6 infused N1 Melt.

bennett-kazuha-mavuika-xianyun.desc: Kazuha Mavuika Bennett Xianyun. ~18s Rot. Mono Pyro Plunge with grouping. Skill plunges bookend Kazuha's field time. Kazuha's burst is DPS neutral. Xianyun freshes VV after Mavuika uses burst; she catches Bennett's particles. OC Mavuika performs similarly. 100% collisions for E plunges, 70% for starwicker plunges.

bennett-chevreuse-keqing-mavuika.desc: Keqing Chevreuse Mavuika Bennett. ~18s Rot. Electro Keqing Overload. Keqing Spams N1C during and out of Bennett burst.
