Keing leads with EE in the first rotation for Chev A1. DPS Chevreuse bursts every rotation in Bennett Q. C6 Bennett is DPS Neutral; Pyro & Electro Goblet see similar performance.

bennett-chasca-furina-ganyu.desc: Chasca Furina Ganyu Bennett. 20s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b]. Q every 2 rot. Ganyu requires more ER than usual as Solo Cryo off-field.

bennett-chasca-diona-furina.desc: Chasca Furina Diona Bennett. 20s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Furina > Diona > Bennett > Chasca. Note that you must aim cancel Chasca skill very quickly to be low enough for Diona C6 to apply.

chasca-chevreuse-citlali-xiangling.desc: Chasca Citlali Xiangling Chevreuse. ~17s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Xiangling casts her Q every other rotation. Chevreuse uses HP% Goblet for comfort, Pyro% Goblet is ~700 more DPS. Not having Chevreuse C6 is ~8k (~15%) team DPS loss. Due to abundance of DMG% buffs and lack of Bennett, ATK% Goblet is preferred by ~1.5k DPS (a lot less so with Chain Breaker).

albedo-bennett-furina-navia.desc: Navia Albedo Furina Bennett. 21s rot. Albedo's E can be broken in game. then he can't generate geo particles until he recasts it. In worst scenario when his E is broken at its creation, you lose not only his personal DPS, since you need to use ER sands on both navia and furina for that scenario.

dehya-neuvillette-sucrose-xiangling.desc: Neuv Vape with Dehya for some interruption resistance. 4CA ~26s rot. 3 favs + long rot lets Xiangling use ATK% sands.

kuki-nahida-tighnari-yelan.desc: Tighnari Hu Tao style quickbloom with Kuki Nahida Yelan

hutao-xingqiu-xinyan-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Double Hydro with Xinyan

bennett-wriothesley-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Wrio Xiangling Xilonen Bennett. 21s rot. Alternating Cryo and Pyro Scroll depending on Wrio Q usage. Check the config for the detailed setup about scroll. It can be difficult to follow this setup, rather you may waste more time or lose desired aura in-practice.

cyno-fischl-nahida-thoma.desc: Cyno Nahida Fischl Thoma. ~24s Rot. Cyno Quickburn with UR, featuring Nahida and an EM build Thoma. Nahida skips Q on first rotation, then bursts as available.

kokomi-luminedendro-nahida-raiden.desc: Raiden Hypberloom with kokomi DMC and Nahida

mona-mualani-sucrose-xiangling.desc: Mualani Mona Sucrose Xiangling. ~34s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. Mona C1 is beneficial. 1st half Xiangling Q and uses Mualani Q, 2nd half Sucrose Pyro Q from Guoba. Using Mona E is beneficial to allow her hold 4intructor. Check the config and 4Scroll mona is ~1k behind.

fischl-sucrose-xiangling-xingqiu.desc: 4 star variant of Sukokomon. 25 second rotation, with two Oz and two Guoba per rotation. Primary damage source is Overload.  Guoba Swirls included. KQMC valid.

escoffier-faruzan-furina-lynette.desc: Lynette Faruzan Furina Escoffier. ~20s Rot. DPS Lynette with Escoffier providing healing for Furina. Faruzan rarely swirls Hydro vs Freezable opponents.

bennett-emilie-gaming-xianyun.desc: Gaming applies pyro at the start of the chamber by doing Ep. He plunges 8 times per rotation. Emilie uses her skill on the first rotation then bursts every other one.

chiori-furina-kokomi-zhongli.desc: Onfield kokomi with double geo core and furina. Uses N2DN2W combos for kokomi strings

bennett-dehya-emilie-zhongli.desc: C6 Dehya, Zhongli, Emilie, Bennett. 20s rot. Emilie bursts if ready, otherwise uses skill. bennett picks up crystalize

escoffier-layla-shenhe-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Layla Shenhe Escoffier. 20s rot. 5[N3CJ] N3 Q/N1C. Layla on DPS Build. Escoffier Q every rot. Every 2 rot can be an option.

bennett-chasca-chongyun-citlali.desc: Chasca Citlali Chongyun Bennett. 18s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Chongyun batteries Bennett at the start.

fischl-nahida-raiden-zhongli.desc: Raiden Fischl Nahida Zhongli. Avg 18s rot. Fischl E or Zhongli Q at the end of the rot. zhongli Q every rot was dps loss due to its long animation.

ayato-fischl-kuki-nahida.desc: Ayato Nahida Fischl Kuki. ~25s. Rot. Ayato double Electro Hyperbloom. Kuki uses burst in the 1st half of the rotation and burst in 2nd.

bennett-emilie-klee-xianyun.desc: Klee Emilie Bennett Xianyun. ~19s Rot. Klee Burning Plunge. Plunges are canceled with skill, NA, or CA, stamina permitting. Klee uses burst if available before plunging. Klee prefers UR > LNO.  50% Collisions.

bennett-fischl-furina-kazuha.desc: bennett "soup". 20s rotation. fischl with fav burst every rotation on most iterations. bennett vapes about half of his skills.

ayaka-kazuha-rosaria-shenhe.desc: Ayaka Rosaria Shenhe kazuha Mono Cryo

barbara-furina-kazuha-neuvillette.desc: Neuvillette Mono Hydro. Roughly 26s Rotation, KQMS, 12-3 Kenki Particles. Clam and Sodp on Barbara have similar performance.

ayaka-furina-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Ayaka Furina Rosaria Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Ayaka Cryo Plunge. 6 Plunges(one phys), canceled with N1 to avoid the slow jumps from special dash. Xianyun does not refresh the Cryo VV; damage is frontloaded damage and Shatter may make it annoying anyway.

ayato-candace-escoffier-furina.desc: Ayato Furina Candace Escoffier. 25s rot. Ayato's 2nd Skill does N13 instead of N15 for ~900 more team DPS at the expense of Ayato's personal DPS.

arlecchino-chevreuse-fischl-lisa.desc: Arle Fischl Lisa Chev. 20s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D] N1. Lisa not using hE but instead NAs, mainly used to waiting particle uptake and her 20s cd. with maxed subs that kqms allows she can hold TTDS.

emilie-klee-mavuika-xianyun.desc: Klee Emilie Mavuika Xianyun. ~19s Rot. Klee Burning Plunge. Plunges are canceled with skill, NA, or CA, stamina permitting. Klee uses burst if available before plunging. Klee prefers UR > LNO. Xianyun adds an extra N1s before ElPQ in an attempt to clear Burning so Mavuika can trigger Scroll again. 50% Collisions.

arlecchino-mavuika-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Arlecchino Mavuika Xiangling Xilonen. Mavuika provides support via Burst, and Arlecchino on-fields. Both Mavuika and Arlecchino funnel their Skill particles to the true Pyro queen Xiangling allowing low ER.

eula-fischl-furina-xianyun.desc: Eula physical plunge, 50% collision. KQMS. Eula does not build ER and burst when possible. MH4 slightly better than Shime4.

bennett-fischl-ororon-xingqiu.desc: Bennett XIngqiu Fischl Ororon. ~21s Rot. Overvape Thundering Fury Bennett. Fischl alternates skill and burst in Bennett's field. EDC > EEC > 3EM Bennett.

hutao-lisa-xiangling-xingqiu.desc: Lisa n1 q > Xingqiu ed q n1 > Xiangling n1q ed > Hu Tao n1 e n[1,2,1,2,1,1,2,1]cj n4 > Lisa n1hE n3

bennett-chevreuse-furina-raiden.desc: Raiden Furina Chevreuse Bennett. ~20s Rot. Raiden alongside DPS Overvape Chevreuse. Bennett feeds particles to Chevreuse.

arlecchino-fischl-thoma-yelan.desc: Arle Yelan Fischl Thoma. Yelan 1E 18s rot. No Arle Q, N1C 3[N5D] (N13 spam is similar). Thoma's pyro app is not problem here thanks to Yelan Fischl Overvape. KQMS Random Frame Delay.

bennett-emilie-gaming-zhongli.desc: Gaming Ep at the start of chamber. He plunges 9 times. Bennett does not use E. Every other rotation from the second, Emilie bursts.

alhaitham-beidou-kuki-xingqiu.desc: AlHaitham Xingqiu Beidou Kuki. ~21s Rot. AlHaitham Hyperbloom with good interruption resistance. Kuki uses skill in Alhaitham's burst window.

fischl-lanyan-nahida-raiden.desc: Raiden Nahida Fischl Lanyan. ~18s Rot. Shielded Raiden Aggravate with Lanyan. Swirling Electro reliably is pretty easy even without Fischl C6. Fischl uses skill after Raiden burst if available.

kokomi-nahida-nilou-yaoyao.desc: Nilou Bloom with Nahida Yaoyao Kokomi

furina-raiden-sara-xilonen.desc: Raiden Furina Sara Xilonen. ~20s Rot. Raiden Taser. 2E Xilonen with particles passed into Sara, who also buffs herself. Xilonen Scrolls Electro reliably, Hydro less so.

fischl-keqing-nahida-xianyun.desc: Keqing Nahida Xianyun Fischl. ~24s Rot. Non-TF Keqing Aggravate plunge. Keqing cancels a few plunges with N1 for more Aggravtes- Close the rotation with burst. Sensitive Electro aura, steps are taken to ensure VV. Nahida touches the field once. Hold skill aerial plunge not used. 50% Collisons.

bennett-emilie-raiden-xiangling.desc: Raiden Emilie Xiangling Bennett. 20s rot. Emilie Q every rot on Bennett Q. 4DM on someone else other than bennett would have similar DPS in ST.

fischl-kazuha-nahida-sara.desc: KQMS stats, no random delays. On-Field Sara aggravate team, Fischl variant with Nahida as a healer. ~26 sec rotation

chongyun-escoffier-eula-xianyun.desc: Eula Chongyun Escoffier Xianyun. ~17s Rot. Eula Cryo Plunge. Chongyun uses Skill just before Xianyun and the Cryo infusion lasts for all 8 plunges. Xianyun VV also lasts for all 8 plunges. Eula immediately uses hold skill with Grimheart stacks to shred Cryo RES and her skill returns agains before her field time ends thanks to Chongyun's CDR. Escoffier's burst is a slight DPS loss. 50% Collisions.

dori-fischl-furina-kazuha.desc: Dori Furina Fischl Kazuha. ~22s Rot. Dori Taser with Kazuha E as available.

nahida-razor-xingqiu-zhongli.desc: Razor Nahida Xingqiu Zhongli. ~24s Rotation. Hyperbloom Razor with ZL.

ayato-chongyun-escoffier-furina.desc: Ayato Furina Chonyun Escoffier. ~2s Rot. Ayato Freeze with Chongyun. Chongyun A1 gets Ayato 1 extra skill normal attack & C2 reduces CD between skill uses. Ayato only does 12 attacks in the second skill.

fischl-kazuha-neuvillette-yaemiko.desc: Neuvillette Electrocharge - Kazuha buffs everyone and everyone does damage. Only burst on Yae when you want to finish off a wave of enemies in AOE - Optimised random delay sim - 2-4 frames delay between non-bufferable actions, 9-15 frames of swap delay

bennett-kazuha-lyney-tartaglia.desc: Lyney-Tartaglia team without double VV setup

chevreuse-fischl-lisa-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Chevreuse Fischl Lisa. ~27s Rot. (TF) Yoimiya Overload. Chevreuse passes particles to Lisa if possible. Hamayumi doesn't justify not using burst.

ayaka-lanyan-shenhe-yelan.desc: Ayaka Freeze with Lanyan shielding. Prioritizes shield strength over damage contribution, does not make use of her C6's extra charge.

fischl-raiden-xingqiu-yelan.desc: TF Fischl Double Hydro with totm Raiden

escoffier-furina-nahida-razor.desc: Razor Nahida Furina Escoffier. ~25s Rot. Hybrid Razor's damage is split between Dendro, Electro, and Phys. At KQMS, EM/EM/CD & ATK/ATK/CD with Serpent Spine perform over 3EM with Aquamarine.

fischl-kazuha-kinich-yaemiko.desc: Kinch Yae Fischl Kazuha. ~36s Rot. Kinich on-field Aggravate with Scroll. Yae & Kinich burst every rotation. No Kinich short hold is -5k DPS.

escoffier-hutao-kaeya-yelan.desc: Hutao Yelan Kaeya Escoffier. ~18s Rot. Hutao MeltVape. -5K or more DPS with Freeze immunity. Escoffier bursts every other rotatation.

ayaka-lynette-mona-shenhe.desc: Ayaka Freeze with Mona. Amenoma and Wolf-fang perform similarly on Ayaka, ToTM and Scroll perform simlarly on Mona. Rot can be adapted for pre-C4 Lynette by changing EQ to N1 Q

arlecchino-bennett-diona-rosaria.desc: Arle Rosaria Diona Bennett. 21s rot. No Arle Q, N3D combo and CA cancelling. Rosaria 2E per rot. KQMS Random Frame Delay

fischl-keqing-nahida-zhongli.desc: Keqing aggravate with Zhongli Fischl Kazuha

fischl-heizou-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Heizou Nahida Fischl Xingqiu. ~25s Rot. Heizou Salad with Heizou triggering hyperbloom with swirls and bursting twice per rotation to heal the team. Heizou will eventually be stamina constrained. Nahida skips Burst without ER.

freminet-furina-lisa-xianyun.desc: Freminet Furina Lisa Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Freminet Phys plunge with Superconduct & 15% DEF Shred. Executes 1 Shattering Pressure combo while plunging. Lisa uses hold skill and really needs that Pamber. 50% Collisions. PF > MH on Freminet.

fischl-yelan-yoimiya-zhongli.desc: Yoimiya Overvape with yelan Fishcl Zhongli

fischl-furina-heizou-nahida.desc: Heizou Nahida Furina Fischl. ~25s Rot. Heizou Salad with an EM build P-Amber Heizou triggering Hyperbloom with Swirls and bursting twice per rotation to heal the team.

escoffier-nahida-razor-xingqiu.desc: Razor Nahida Xingqiu Escoffier. ~24s Rotation. Hyperbloom Razor with Escoffier. Few Shatter occurences.

kirara-nahida-nilou-yelan.desc: Single target focused Nilou. On field Nahida. 2E Yelan 21s rotation. Hydro characters get almost all bloom ownership. HP Hydro Crit Yelan build

charlotte-escoffier-eula-furina.desc: Eula Furina Escoffier Charlotte. ~22s Rot. Eula with Escoffier & TTDS. Escoffier and Charlotte burst in alternate rotations. Charlotte's TTDS lands on Eula.

baizhu-furina-lisa-nahida.desc: Lisa Furina Nahida Baizhu. ~21s Rot. Lisa Quickbloom. Full EM lisa trails in performance. Baizhu does 2Es. Combo may have room for optimzation.

bennett-kinich-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Kinich Zhongli Xiangling Bennett. 21s rot. E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo with consistently NA clockwise. Xiangling Burst every rot

bennett-chiori-fischl-ningguang.desc: Ningguang Fischl Bennett Chiori. ~18s Rot. Ninguang does N1 ED N2C Q ED N3C N1C (N1C), rotation is reasonable on stamina even when opponent is not point blank. Bennett wants fav to meet ER reqs here.

bennett-faruzan-lanyan-wanderer.desc: Wanderer Faruzan Bennett Lanyan. Lanyan builds for damage, Widsith>ttds GT>scroll. Lanyan uses burst when ready before Bennett, but uses her skill(s) inside Bennett field.

escoffier-furina-raiden-sara.desc: Raiden Furina Sara Escoffier. ~21s Rot. Raiden with a low Energy requirement & Escoffier's personal damage on top.

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-sethos.desc: Sethos Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~16s Rot. Sethos loses a lvl 1 aimed shot for Chev A1 on the first rotation. Sethos does 8N2W N1 (Last n1 is Phys). Chevreuse builds for damage.

fischl-hutao-kazuha-yelan.desc: hu tao yelan fischl overvape w kazuha

albedo-neuvillette-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Neuv Xiangling Albedo Zhongli. 4CA 26s rot. Closer to Neuv forward vape. Random frame delay on swap and unbufferable actions.

chasca-dori-furina-ororon.desc: EC chasca with VV. 2 Dori E/rot to fill rotation. Dori allows chasca to burst every rot

furina-noelle-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Noelle plunge with Xilonen, Furina, Xianyun. 20 sec rot. Noelle Q 8DJHP, E if possible, 67% plunge collision rate. 2 E Xilonen, 1 E Xianyun (C0) or 2 E Xianyun (C1+) per rotation. C0 Xilonen doesn't give resistance shred but provides energy and Scroll set. In game, Xianyun's clam can explode in the air, be careful or change it to NO/VV/SODP. KQMS.

bennett-furina-kazuha-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya vape with hydro infused Kazuha burst - Hyperoptimised sim

cyno-luminedendro-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Cyno Hyperbloom with DMC XQ and Nahida

bennett-yelan-yoimiya-yunjin.desc: Yoimiya Yelan YunJin Bennett. 20s rot with YunJin 2E. Rust R5 is worse than Slingshot R5 here. Note that solo hydro yelan's ER need is really high. make sure yunjin catches geo particles while she is on-field. she can hold favlance if you have enough CR and weav NAs for reliable proc.

furina-raiden-tighnari-yaoyao.desc: Tighnari Furina Raiden Yaoyao. ~25s Rot. Tighari Quickbloom with Yaoyao. Tighnari does ECQ2C twice per rot before and after Full EM Raiden, who on-fields to generate energy for the team. Yaoyao does QN3DN3E every rotation to ensure adequate healing and Dendro coverage.

arlecchino-chevreuse-dehya-yaemiko.desc: Arle Yae Chev Dehya. 18-19s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D]. Yae Q if available, or N2C catching chev particles. Sac R5 on dehya for reliable Interruption Resistance.

escoffier-eula-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Eula Rosaria Escoffier Xianyun. ~19s Rot. Eula bursts every 3rd rotation; she fills time with NA on non-burst rotations. OHC > VV Xianyun, but bubbles may miss. Escoffier only bursts if available. 50% Collisions.

bennett-emilie-fischl-lisa.desc: Bennett Emilie Fischl Lisa. ~18s Rot. On-Field Bennett Burning w/ Overload; 59/51% Burning/Quicken uptime. All characters Q/E catch Bennett's buff. Lisa Burst as every rotation as available. Deepwood on Bennett vs Lisa is the same.

furina-gorou-itto-xianyun.desc: Itto "Lamentto" plunge with Gorou, Furina, Xianyun. Itto N1 Q E 8JDHP C3F E CF, 50% plunge collision rate.

bennett-emilie-furina-xiangling.desc: 21sec rotation, Emilie onfield for bennet buff

albedo-furina-itto-xianyun.desc: Itto Furina Albedo Xianyun. Itto Plunge with Albedo, bookended by skill uses. 50% Collisions.

bennett-fischl-xingqiu-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Xingqiu Fischl Bennett. 21s rot. due to xq's long cd, doing some NAs at the end of the rot

clorinde-nahida-yelan-zhongli.desc: Clorinde Yelan Nahida Zhongli. 18s rot. Clorinde Q if available at the end, use NAs to trigger Yelan Q otherwise.

baizhu-fischl-kazuha-lisa.desc: Fischl Aggravate with Baizhu Kauzha Lisa

escoffier-furina-keqing-xianyun.desc: Keqing Furina Escoffier Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Keqing Phys Plunge. LNO>MH>PF Keqing. Rarely Keqing may burst to conserve stamina. Hold skill aerial plunge not implemented. 50% Collisions.

bennett-chasca-citlali-xilonen.desc: Chasca Citlali Xilonen Bennett. 16-17s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. 4AP Xilonen since Citlali already holds it.

alhaitham-fischl-kazuha-raiden.desc: Raiden Alhaitham with Kazuha and Fischl (Its mostly Fischl)

arlecchino-bennett-fischl-nahida.desc: burnload arle. N16 combo. Good burn uptime to be using UR.

chiori-navia-yelan-zhongli.desc: Navia Chiori Yelan Zhongli. Yelan 1E 18s rot. Start with EQ navia in the first rot for her energy. Used 3[N2D] navia to make it 18s rot length(yelan 18s cd).

fischl-nahida-sara-sethos.desc: Sethos Sara Fischl Nahida. ~18s Rot. Sethos Sara Aggravate. Sara bursts for Fischl and aims for Sethos. Sethos uses Q 8N2WN1 2C.

chiori-clorinde-furina-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Furina Xilonen Chiori. 17-18s rot. Double Geo Clorinde Taser. Hydro Scroll. Furina uses skill every other rotation. Clorinde and Chiori alternate bursts every rotation. Xilonen picks up a crystallize shard to simulate realistic gameplay and activate Geo Resonance. 4GT on Furina and 4HoOD on Chiori are both a negligible damage loss (<1k DPS).

furina-kazuha-xianyun-yaemiko.desc: Yae Furina Kazuha Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Yae Taser plunge with grouping. Kazuha takes one Starwicker plunge. Xianyun refeshes VV/Hakushin mid rotation. Yae bursts every other rotation immediately after all plunges are spent, otherwise she fills time for the next rotation. 50% Collisons.

ayato-furina-xilonen-yunjin.desc: Ayato Furina Yunjin Xilonen. ~25s Rot. Ayato does a physical NA at the end of his first skill and cuts his second skill short. Ayato prefers crit weapons. Yunjin dashes to pick up Crystalize shards for AP. Damage build Xilonen is more damage.

fischl-furina-keqing-xilonen.desc: Keqing Furina Fischl Xilonen. ~25s Rot. Keqing Taser. Keqing bursts twice per rotation between Oz and Scroll refreshes.

chongyun-escoffier-shenhe-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Shenhe Escoffier Chongyun. 19s rot. Chong use burst in the middle of the rotation to make a little frontload thanks to Shenhe Icy Quill

cyno-emilie-fischl-thoma.desc: Cyno Fischl Emilie Thoma. 4UR Cyno 25s rot. EM focused 4DM Thoma, dealing high Overloaded damage with lower shield HP. Emilie Q every 2 rots.

aetherpyro-bennett-chevreuse-ororon.desc: PMC Chevreuse Ororon Bennett. ~18s Rot. PMC on-field DPS, uses burst when available. PMC uses hE. PMC does N2C/N3D as available. Chevreuse bursts every other rot. Ororon does more damage on full EM.

furina-nahida-raiden-xiangling.desc: Raiden Furina Nahida Xiangling. ~21s Rot. Raiden makes a mess of reactions. P-amber Nahida supplies the only healing. The Burgeon count is thankfully low.

ayaka-kazuha-shenhe-xilonen.desc: Ayaka Shenhe Kazuha Xilonen. ~21s Rot. Ayaka Hypercarry with 87% RES Shred. 2 Skills per rotation from all team members. Xilonen uses burst every rotation.

bennett-furina-sucrose-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Furina Sucrose Bennett. 20s rot. Sucrose burst if available to absorb hydro and provide consistent hydro aura. Yoimiya burst if available during the downtime.

alhaitham-fischl-kuki-yaemiko.desc: Deepwood: Yae > Kuki > Alhaitham. ~28s rotation with 1 Kuki E (low survivability). Alhaitham N1Cs before starting the loop (to enable Hakushin) and uses tap E over hE LP. Customized random delays, 12-3 Icewind Suite energy.

chiori-escoffier-ganyu-zhongli.desc: Ganyu Escoffier Zhongli Chiori. ~18s Rot. Ganyu double Geo with Escoffier. Attempts 50% weakspot hits with Protoype Crescent; FWF without headshots is -2K DPS. Ganyu & Escoffier only bursts when available & Chiori bursts to fill time for her skill CD. With full uptime, ToM Zhongli is less than 1K behind AP.

bennett-emilie-fischl-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Emilie Fischl Bennett. ~17s Rot. Emilie bursts every other rot. Fischl alternates skill/burst. Near zero Quicken uptime. Deepwood > NO Bennett.

ayaka-charlotte-furina-lynette.desc: Ayaka Freeze with Furina. Charlotte Q E to funnel particles to Ayaka. Current rotation absorbs Cryo with Lynette Q, but she can do E N2 Q to absorb Hydro and help with Freeze consistency. Pre-C4 Lynette skips first E

collei-dori-fischl-sucrose.desc: Dori Aggravate wtih Sucrose Fischl Collei

kazuha-mualani-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Mualani Zhongli Kazuha Xiangling. 35s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. 1st half Xiangling Q and uses Mualani Q, 2nd half Kazuha Pyro Q from Guoba.

bennett-furina-nahida-razor.desc: Razor Furina Nahida Bennett. ~25s. Razor Hyperburgeon with C6 Bennett infusion. Nahida runs P-Amber to counteract Furina's HP drain, fanfare decreases in later rotations. 2E Bennett builds EM. Self-Overloads not implemented.

alhaitham-raiden-yelan-zhongli.desc: Alhaitham Hyperbloom with Zhongli and Yelan

cyno-fischl-kinich-xilonen.desc: Cyno Kinich Fischl Xilonen. ~25s Rot. Cyno Aggravate with a Kinich shooting one cannon shot before burst to provide Dendro in multiwave. Xilonen runs AP and picks up Crystallize easily.

arlecchino-beidou-chevreuse-fischl.desc: Arle Fischl Beidou Chev. 20s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D] N1. its not impressive in ST bcuz of beidou but it can be good for AoE content. Beidou 2E per rot for better energy and she catches fav from chev.

fischl-nahida-raiden-sara.desc: Raiden, Fischl, Nahida, Sara. 20s rotation. VV-less Aggravate, very easy to play, very low ER requirements. Other weapon options for Nahida in Config.

fischl-furina-mizuki-ororon.desc: Mizuki Ororon Fischl Furina. APL priorities furina skill/burst and oz uptime. Mizuki does normal attacks when teammates skill/burst on cd. PA on Mizuki to help with furina stacks.

bennett-sucrose-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Sucrose Bennett. 18s rot. Only swirl pyro for short sucrose field time. Bennett Q level1 hE > Sucrose E dash N1. High DPS when TTDS is activated. Check the DPS on the first rot to see that.

beidou-clorinde-nahida-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Nahida Beidou Xilonen. ~24s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde with Beidou. Clorinde burst is optional. Nahida bursts every other rotation after the first. Eshu is techincally functional Copium. Within narrow distance for Beidou C6, RES shred may be inconsistent in practice. 10% counter; 20% Perfect counter.

arlecchino-baizhu-furina-yelan.desc: Arle Furina Yelan Baizhu. Yelan 2E 21s rot. No Arle Q, 3[N5D] N1 (4[N4D] is similar). Arle ATK/ATK/CRIT was slightly better due to high DMG% buffs. Baizhu 4OHC(Clam) > 4SoDP > 4NO but used 4SoDP here.

bennett-dehya-emilie-ganyu.desc: ganyu emilie dehya bennett, using sac gs dehya, emilie bursts if its ready, otherwise uses skill, rotation is hard to do right in game. 12-3 icewind suite energy drops.

fischl-heizou-nahida-yelan.desc: Heizou Nahida Fischl Yelan. ~25s Rot. Heizou Salad with Heizou triggering hyperbloom with swirls and bursting twice per rotation to heal the team. 2 E Yelan. Heizou spams N1C between skill and burst.

diluc-furina-xilonen-yelan.desc: Diluc Furina Yelan Xilonen. ~22s Rot. Yelan skill just before and after Diluc field time. Xilonen uses skill twice and bursts before Furina. Yelan has the highest damage share.

baizhu-furina-nilou-yelan.desc: triple hydro nilou bloom with baizhu driver. 22s~ rotation. baizhu is built em, still but his shields healing are still enough to sustain the team. can also build hp/hb for not a huge lose. on field baizhu apply decent amount of dendro to make blooms, with him owning around half of them. yelan and furina build hp/hydro/crit and deal high non reaction damage.

fischl-lanyan-mavuika-yelan.desc: Lanyan Mavuika Yelan Fischl. ~18s Rot. Lanyan Soup. Mavuika Vapes her burst before Fischl alternates skill and burst. Lanyan uses burst, skills if avialable, then NA Spam for the rest of the rotation. Similar contribution between all members.

furina-mika-wanderer-yelan.desc: Wanderer Yelan Furina Mika. ~21s Rot. Wanderer Double Hydro. Wanderer swirls Cryo with E. Easy to overcap CR. Wanderer Q at the end of FT if available. 1E Yelan. MH Wanderer is -3K DPS.

bennett-chiori-clorinde-zhongli.desc: clorinde double geo with benny's buff. clorinde burst when ready. zhongli burst every rotation to fill time. no chiori burst.

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-yanfei.desc: Yanfei 15-16s rotation, burst every other rot. Can use 4 SR but will have less c4 shield uptime.

fischl-xiao-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Xiao Driver for Double Hydro and Fischl

furina-mavuika-mizuki-ororon.desc: Mizuki Furina Ororon Mavuika overvape 2T. Very tight 20s rotation. Mavuika vapes her burst and does C2D C1D to fill rotation time.

beidou-bennett-chevreuse-fischl.desc: Beidou Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~16s Rot. Beidou on-field Overload; uses NA's only with N2D, assumes Beidou takes damage to activate her C4; Beidou bursts as available. Electro>ATK Goblet. Fischl snapshots Bennett's buff. Bennett buffed Chevreuse bursts every other rot. 25% perfect counter, 25% counter. Self-Overloads not implemented.

kuki-nahida-rosaria-xingqiu.desc: Rosaria Nahida Xingqiu Kuki. ~21s Rot. Phys Rosaria on-field in Hyperbloom. Kuki or Nahida burst at the end of the rotation based on energy.

beidou-chevreuse-clorinde-xiangling.desc: Clorinde Beiodu Xiangling Chev. 20s rot. Beidou is pretty solid in 2T. Beidou can hold Favgs if you want more comfort. Damage weapon on xiangling isn't that good.

furina-keqing-mika-yelan.desc: Keqing Yelan Furina Mika. ~22s Rot. Phys Keqing on-field spamming CA. Keqing bursts after Yelan's burst expires. 2E Yelan. OHC > SODP Mika.

ayaka-bennett-emilie-xiangling.desc: Rev melt solo cryo Ayaka with Emilie. High er reqs for ayaka, and emilie bursts every 2 rotations.

ayato-fischl-nahida-thoma.desc: Thoma Burgeon wtih Nahida Ayato Fischl

furina-ganyu-kazuha-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Furina Ganyu Kazuha. 4CA 31-32s rot. Ganyu's freeze as a defensive utility. 4EoSF on ganyu has similar result. Random delay as 9-15f swap and 2-4f action

beidou-fischl-furina-xianyun.desc: xianyun furina beidou fischl taser with xianyun plunging. SGT, in AoE beidou uses 4pc EoSF. 50% perfect parry chance.

fischl-furina-keqing-xianyun.desc: Keqing Furina Fischl Xianyun. ~25s Rot. Keqing Taser Plunge. Xianyun refreshes VV mid rotation. 4 plunges in each half. Keqing fills some time at the end of the rotation with N1C and Burst. Hold skill aerial plunge not implemented. 50% Collisons.

faruzan-furina-mika-wanderer.desc: Wanderer Faruzan Furina Mika. ~22s Rot. Wanderer Q at the end of FT if available. Wanderer swirls Cryo with E. Easy to overcap CR. SoDP~=OHC Mika.

escoffier-freminet-furina-lisa.desc: Freminet Furina Lisa Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Phys Freminet with Superconduct. MH>=PF Freminet. Lisa prefers EM stats; ensures that she catches her own particles.

furina-lisa-xianyun-yaemiko.desc: Yae Furina Lisa Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Yae Taser Plunge. Xianyun refeshes VV mid rotation. Yae uses bust every other rotation immediately after all plunges spent. Lisa uses hold skill for Team ER, but could theoretically do no skill with a gargantuan ER investment. 50% Collisons.

faruzan-furina-lanyan-xiao.desc: Xiao Faruzan Furina Lanyan. No healing, so Furina only bursts on first rotation, But lanyan shields. Widsith Lanyan outperforms ttds. VV slightly outperforms GT. Lanyan burst when ready.

lanyan-raiden-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Raiden Yelan Xingqiu Lanyan. ~22s Rot. Raiden double Hydro with Lanyan using skill,VV swirling twice per rotation. 2E Yelan.

chevreuse-furina-kazuha-klee.desc: kleerina without circle impact. chev provides easy vv setup, her c6 buff, healing, and energy. 21s rotation. kazuha uses r5 fav to get 2 procs per rotation.

escoffier-faruzan-furina-kazuha.desc: Kazaha Faruzan Furina Escoffier. ~20s Rot. Kazuha-Faruzan Quickswap. Kazuha skills off CD with Faruzan aimed shots in between. MH > LNO Kazuha.

fischl-furina-raiden-xilonen.desc: Raiden Furina Fischl Xilonen. ~20s Rot. Xilonen bursts before Furina and uses skill twice per rotation. Hydro scroll buff is a very rare. All units burst before Raiden.

furina-ororon-sethos-xilonen.desc: Sethos Furina Ororon Xilonen. ~20s Rot. Sethos Taser. Xilonen passes particles to Sethos twice, while picking up crystallize particles. Sethos does one level 2 and two level 2 aimed shots after the second Xilonen skill to meet a 20s rotation.

kazuha-kirara-neuvillette-xiangling.desc: Neuvillette Guide Weapons (Vape) R5 Sacrificial Jade

ayaka-kazuha-shenhe-yelan.desc: Ayaka Kazuha Shenhe Yelan Freeze, Mistsplitter compatible

baizhu-furina-kinich-xiangling.desc: Kinich Furina Xiangling Baizhu. 20s rot. Everyone except Kinich Q every rot. Burnvape Furina.

bennett-chasca-furina-sara.desc: Chasca Furina Sara Bennett. 21s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b]. Q every 2 rot. 2+pc Scroll and Fav Bow on Sara is recommended. [Sara E C > Bennett EQ > Sara Q] can make Sara catches her own particles during on-field after her energy drain. If you can't replicate this in-game then RIP.

bennett-fischl-nahida-yelan.desc: Bennett Nahida Fischl Yelan. ~19s Rot. Bennett Burgeon  with Fischl snapshotting his buff and adding Overload. Nahida omits burst if unavailable.

fischl-furina-mizuki-xiangling.desc: Mizuki Furina Fischl Xiangling. 2E Xiangling, 2 oz casts per ~25s rotation. Fav mizuki uses skill for half the rotation, and drives fischl c6 with normal attacks in the second half. XL mostly does overloaded damage.

bennett-citlali-layla-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Citlali Layla Bennett. 18s rot. No Yoimiya Q. 9 out of 10 Meltable hits are melted here.

bennett-chasca-fischl-mona.desc: Chasca Fischl Mona Bennett. 17s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Fav Bennett to allow shorter rot length.

fischl-xingqiu-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Double Hydro TF Yoimiya with Fischl

fischl-lanyan-tighnari-yaemiko.desc: Yae Tighnari Fischl Lanyan. ~25s Rot. Yae Tighnari Aggravate with a shield. Yae bursts every rotatation. Not optimzed.

fischl-luminedendro-sucrose-xingqiu.desc: Sucrose Hyperbloom with DMC Fischl and Xingqiu

fischl-lanyan-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Lanyan Nahida Fischl Xingqiu. ~25s Rot. Lanyan Salad with Lanyan triggering hyperbloom with Swirl. Fischl skill and burst every rotation. Lanyan uses burst first, then spends skill off CD while weaving normal attacks. Accounts for XQ rainsword contact.

collei-raiden-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Riaden Hyperbloom with Double Hydro and Collei

fischl-lisa-tighnari-zhongli.desc: TIghnari Spread with Fishcl Lisa Zhongli

alhaitham-bennett-emilie-fischl.desc: Alhaitham Emilie Fischl Bennett. ~19s Rot. Allhaitham Burning. Alhaitham bursts every rotation. Bennett refreshes burning with his skill before Alhaitham gains infusion again with skill. Fischl alternates skill and burst. in Bennett Q. Aura is confused, with Burning and Quicken frequently coexisting.

escoffier-furina-ororon-razor.desc: Razor Furina Ororon Escoffier. ~24s Rot. Hybrid Razor dealing ~45/55% Electro/Phys damage. Ororon should go before Furina for her energy Recharge. Razor stays on field until 3 skill are used, with C4 Def shred lingering over the next rotation setup.

cyno-furina-nahida-xilonen.desc: Cyno Furina Nahida Xilonen. ~27s rot. Cyno Quickbloom with Xilonen (5 N4E N4). Xilonen 2 E cast which generates both Electro and Hydro Crystallize shards consistently.

clorinde-ororon-yelan-yunjin.desc: Clorinde Yelan Ororon YunJin. 18s rot. YunJin can have manageable ER req thanks to 2pc Scroll, Ororon and Team Fav. Put Ororon right before Clorinde to feed her particles.

fischl-furina-lisa-xianyun.desc: Lisa Furina Fischl Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Lisa Taser Plunge. Xianyun refeshes VV after Fischl uses burst. Lisa uses hold skill immediately after all plunges are spent to catch furina's burst. 50% Collisons.

baizhu-clorinde-fischl-nahida.desc: Clorinde Fischl Nahida Baizhu. Baizhu 2E 21s rot. Fischl Q every rot with some ER and E every other rot. Nahida 4GT + Baizhu 4DM is a few hundred better for team DPS.

chiori-furina-kokomi-navia.desc: Navia Chiori Furina Kokomi. 20-21s rot. Kokomi refreshes jellyfish and heals the whole team. Use 3rd navia E if available. you may try fav furina to lower navia's ER in the config.

kuki-nahida-tighnari-xingqiu.desc: Tighnari Hu Tao style mainly Hyperbloom with Xingqiu Kuki and Nahida first version

fischl-furina-heizou-ororon.desc: Heizou Furina Ororon Fischl. ~25s Rot. Heizou Taser in ST w/ P-Amber Heizou bursting twice per rotation to heal the team. EM >= ADC Heizou in ST. Fischl skill & burst every rotation. Ororon goes before Furina to assist with her energy.

ayato-furina-ororon-xilonen.desc: Ayato Furina Ororon Xilonen. 24-25s rot. Ororon triggers Scroll, so Xilonen can hold 4AP.

bennett-emilie-furina-rosaria.desc: Burnmelt/Burgeon Rosaria with Furina Vaping. Noblesse Bennett + Deepwood Furina is a bit worse. For Bennett: Deepwood > Noblesse > Scroll >= Instructor. Bennett does not heal himself first rotation but does on subsequent ones. Rosaria does a mix of N2CD and N1CD with Skill inbetween.

alhaitham-bennett-emilie-xianyun.desc: Alhaitham Emilie Bennett Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Alhaitham Burning Plunge. AlHaitham does JPN1 in Bennett burst and uses burst as aailable when mirrors drop below 3. 60% Collisions.

furina-klee-kokomi-xiangling.desc: Kleerina with xl - except this time, Kokomi is here to provide hydro application for xl and then pass on ttds to Klee. Hydro resonance is a nice bonus for Furina, too

nahida-raiden-thoma-xingqiu.desc: Thoma Burgeon with Nahida Xingqiu and a little bit of Raiden hyperbloom

furina-qiqi-xingqiu-yelan.desc: qiqi driver and battery via fav for triple hydro. 23s~ rotation with 2 yelan E.  qiqi alternate between skill and burst use.

ayato-furina-kazuha-xilonen.desc: Ayato Furina Kazuha Xilonen. 25s rot. Kazuha not using Q. simply using E before Ayato's field time

furina-kazuha-raiden-xilonen.desc: Raiden Furina Kazuhaa Xilonen. ~20s Rot. Raiden Taser with Grouping, ODing on %DMG bonus; Raiden wants ATK Goblet. 2E Xilonen mostly Scrolls Electro. High Furina damage share, her C2 is better than Raiden's.

chiori-furina-navia-sigewinne.desc: Navia double hydro with Sigewinne. Sige funnels to furina for lower er reqs. OHC slightly better than totm on sige

bennett-chongyun-gaming-xianyun.desc: Gaming Chongyun (C5)Bennett Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Chongyun melts his Q on Bennett's Q. Xianyun only swirls Pyro at the start of the rotation. Gaming weaves NAs after his skill plunges and burst to apply Cryo. 4 Skill Plunges.

bennett-faruzan-sucrose-xiao.desc: Xiao Faruzan Sucrose Bennett. 21-22s rot. 12 high plunges with 50% collision. Sucrose 1E TTDS is better and works for any Constellations, but Sacfragments with C1+ Sucrose may have better QoL as of low ER.

chiori-furina-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Xilonen Furina Xianyun Chiori. ~20s Rot. Xilonen cancels plunge endlag with NAs as dashes spend nightsoul. Only 6/8 Geo plunges with C0, 8/8 with C1. Xilonen and Chiori alternate skill and burst and to fill time. 50% collisions.

furina-noelle-xilonen-xingqiu.desc: Noelle Furina Xingqiu Xilonen. ~22s Rot. MH > AP Noelle. Crystallize shards are caught with dashes or movement. Noelle Geo DMG > DEF Goblet. Furina's HP remains high through the rotation. AP option in config.

arlecchino-chevreuse-fischl-yanfei.desc: Arle Fischl Yanfei Chev. 20s rot. Arle EQE every rot so that yanfei can hold TTDS without ER sands. the rot is a bit funny catching TTDS and swap out.

citlali-escoffier-wriothesley-xingqiu.desc: Wrio Xingqiu Citlali Escoffier. 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] N4 Q/C. Citlali before Wrio, triggering 4pc Scroll out of Xingqiu's abundant Hydro app.

clorinde-fischl-kazuha-yaemiko.desc: Clorinde Fischl Yae Kazuha. ~16s Rot. Clorinde Mono Electro. Clorinde bursts every rotation. No burst Yae & Kazuha.

kazuha-neuvillette-yaemiko-yelan.desc: Neuv Yelan Yae Kazuha. 3CA 26-27s rot. Yelan 2E. weaving some NAs for her Q proc. 9-15f Random swap delay.

fischl-kazuha-kirara-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Fischl Kazuha Kirara. 4CA 30s rot. Neuv with Kirara's shield. Kazuha swirls hydro in the early rot and electro in the later rot. fischl's ST dmg and kazuha's AoE swirl makes this team good at both ST and AoE. 9-15f Random Swap Delay.

bennett-fischl-navia-ningguang.desc: navia with ningguang. 20s~ rotation. ning uses CA after burst to utilize c6 star jades.

chiori-shenhe-wriothesley-xilonen.desc: Wrio Double Geo N3C combo. Shenhe and Wrio Burst when available, Chiori Bursts when available to fill downtime. 16s rotation

arlecchino-chiori-kazuha-zhongli.desc: Arle Kazuha Chiori Zhongli. 17-18s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D]. Kazuha starts with tEPQ every rot and comes in between arle combos to tEP for refreshing buffs.

furina-keqing-kokomi-nahida.desc: TF Keqing Furina Nahida Kokomi. ~26s rot. Uncomfortably ST-focused, and starting to stretch the definition of Quickbloom. 4TF is notably better than MH because Keqing's damage is so skewed towards Hyperblooms. Nahida's ER req is still unfortunate. Keqing investing into EM can lead to higher team DPS.

alhaitham-fischl-raiden-xianyun.desc: AlHaitham Fischl Raiden Xianyun. ~26s Rot. Alhaitham-Raiden Quicken Plunge. 1st half Alhaitham does EP 7JlPN1 Q, 2nd half Raiden on-field. Quicken persists for the Raiden's field time. 60% Collisions.

fischl-lanyan-sethos-tighnari.desc: Sethos Tighnari Fischl Lanyan. ~18s Rot. Sethos Tighnari Aggravate. Sethos uses a Shadowpiercing at the start of the rotation and after his burst, which is wrapped by skills for energy reasons. Tighnari uses burst after 1 CA, energy permiiting. Fischl alternates skill and burst. Lanyan swirls electro before after and Sethos with skill or burst. AGAIN, Sethos uses his burst.

bennett-faruzan-fischl-furina.desc: Faruzan Furina Fischl Bennett. ~20s Rot. Faruzan on-field DPS spends Burst and Hurricane Arrows as available, with Bennett Es during downtime. Fischl snapshots Bennett Q.

kazuha-nahida-raiden-yaemiko.desc: Yae Raiden Aggravate with Kazuha Nahida

freminet-furina-kuki-nahida.desc: QMS 4MH Freminet Hyperbloom w/ Furina. Furina EdQ > Nahida EQ > Shinobu E / E CA Q > Frem EQ N2 E 3[EN2EN1]. Uses swap_delay=4

beidou-bennett-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Beidou Nahida Xingqiu Bennett. ~22s Rotation. Beidou Burgeon with C6 Bennett in 2T. Beidou C4 is activated by Burgeon, but cannot hit cores, leading to low Hyperbloom count. As CA is not implemented, Beidou does N2D to E (& Q) off CD. 25% perfect counter, 25% counter. Nahida bursts (nearly) every rotation. Self-Overloads not implemented.

eula-fischl-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Eula Rosaria Fischl Xianyun. ~19s Rot. Eula bursts every 3rd rotation, otherwise goes straght into Hold E. OHC > SoDP Xianyun, but bubbles may miss. 50% Collisions.

ayaka-furina-kuki-nahida.desc: Ayaka Furina Nahida Kuki. ~22s Rotation. Ayaka driving Hyperbloom w. Furina and P-Amber Nahida.

cyno-escoffier-furina-ororon.desc: Cyno Furina Ororon Escoffier. ~25s Rot. Cyno Taser with Token superconduct. Ororon uses QE before Furina to reduce her energy requirements.

albedo-alhaitham-fischl-kuki.desc: Deepwood: Albedo > Kuki. Decent amount of Crystallizes and dashes to help with HoD, but low Kuki E uptime. No jump cancels. Customized random frame delays; 12-3 Icewind Suite energy.

bennett-furina-kokomi-xiangling.desc: Xiangling Vape. Very simple comfy team. Has an abundance of healing from Kokomi Bennett and Furina's A1

furina-klee-xiangling-xianyun.desc: Klee Furina Xiangling Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Klee Plunge with Furina Vape. Xiangling uses burst before Xianyun; Pyro VV only. Klee dumps her skill into burst at the start of her field time, bursting in most rotations. Klee does CAs between plunges, stamina permitting. 50% Collisions.

bennett-emilie-kazuha-xianyun.desc: Kazuha Emilie Bennett Xianyun. ~18s Rot. Kazuha Burning Plunge with grouping. Kazuha bookends his field time will skill uses. Kazuha's burst is a small DPS loss. Deepwood is close on Bennett. 100% collisions for E plunges, 50% for starwicker plunges.

fischl-kazuha-keqing-yaoyao.desc: Keqing FIshcl Aggravate with Kazuha Yaoyao

furina-keqing-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Keqing Furina Rosaria Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Keqing Phys Plunge. Keqing does not burst and uses EN1C off cd. LNO>MH>PF Keqing. Hold skill aerial plunge not implemented. 50% Collisions.

collei-kokomi-raiden-yelan.desc: Riaden Hyperbloom with Collei Yelan and Kokomi

candace-lynette-mualani-xiangling.desc: Mualani Vape with C5 Candace. ~36s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. Xiangling Q applies Pyro first half, Guoba and Lynette Q second half. Rot works with pre-C4 Lynette. Only works with C0-C5 Candace

diona-nahida-razor-xingqiu.desc: Razor Nahida Xingqiu Diona. ~24s Rotation. Hyperbloom Razor with Diona. Few Shatter occurences. NO > Ins Diona, as she has issues owning reactions in this rotation. DW > NO Diona with GT Nahida.

bennett-furina-sigewinne-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Furina Sigewinne Bennett. 20s rot. Sigewinne prefunnel Furina, lowering her ER. In single-target, with luck on Furina&Sigewinne timing, Yoimiya can consistently vape her NAs(making EM sands better). Wait a bit(about N2-3) before Yoimiya E, not to ruin the enemy aura. 4SoDP greatly increase Yoimiya's damage, while 4OHC increases Sigewinne's.

bennett-furina-kazuha-nahida.desc: Kazuha Furina Nahida Bennett. ~23s Rot. Kazuha Burgeon/Furina Burn-Vape in 2 Target. Kazuha remains on-field in Bennett's burst. P-Amber Nahida counteracts some of Furina's HP drain; fanfare decreases in later rotations. 2E Bennett builds EM. Fragile, don't get vaped.

clorinde-dehya-emilie-nahida.desc: Clorinde Emilie Nahida Dehya. ~15s/17s Rot. Nahida burst every rotation.

dori-freminet-furina-yelan.desc: Freminet Furina Yelan Dori. ~22s Rot. Phys Freminet on-field with Fav Dori comfortably batterying the team. Yelan loses few dice procs.

chiori-neuvillette-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Neuv Xiangling Chiori Zhongli. 4CA 27s rot. Enemy aura is somewhat unstable due to the geo app. Both of them takes the equal vape ownership. Random frame delay on swap and unbufferable actions.

bennett-emilie-fischl-raiden.desc: Raiden Emilie Fischl Bennett. ~18s Rot. Raiden Emilie Quickburn, with Emilie using Raiden's energy restoration to burst every rotation, sidestepping the lack of Burning uptime. Raiden does NAs in subsequent rotations while her burst is on CD to maintain Emilie's level 2 skill. Deepwood Bennett and Emilie are similar.

baizhu-furina-nahida-yelan.desc: Baizhu Furina Yelan Nahida. ~21s Rot. On-Field Baizhu (Nilouless)Bloom in 2T. 2E Yelan. Yelan's burst is active into Furina's N1 in the next rotation.

furina-navia-noelle-yelan.desc: Navia Noelle Furina Yelan. Noelle main driver, with Navia Furina and Yelan as sub-DPS. DPS of each sub-DPS is almost the same.

alhaitham-kuki-yaoyao-yelan.desc: Alhaitham Quickbloom with yelan and double healer - yaoyao and kuki. Optimised for Alhaitham damage.

bennett-chevreuse-raiden-yelan.desc: Raiden with DPS built overvape Chevreuse, 19s rotation

lanyan-mavuika-ororon-yelan.desc: Lanyan Mavuika Yelan Ororon. ~18s Rot. Lanyan Soup. Mavuika Vapes her burst before Ororon uses skill and burst. Lanyan uses burst, skills if avialable, then NA Spam for the rest of the rotation.

baizhu-fischl-thoma-xingqiu.desc: Thoma BUrgeon with Fischl Xingqiu Baizhu

ayato-fischl-furina-xianyun.desc: Ayato Furina Fischl Xianyun. Xianyun is here for healing and TTDS. Furina EQ > Fischl E > Xianyun EP Q > Ayato E N16 Q > Fischl Q > Xianyun EP > Ayato E N15

escoffier-furina-razor-xingqiu.desc: Razor Furina Xingqiu Escoffier. ~25s Rot. Phys Razor with IR from From Xingqiu. Razor should lead with tap skill for energy reasons.

bennett-rosaria-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Rosaira Bennett. ~18s Rot. Yoimiya VapeMelt. Freeze immunity is -8K DPS.

mavuika-wriothesley-xilonen-yunjin.desc: ⚠️ Wrio Mavuika Yun Jin Xilonen. Xilonen 2E 21s rot. 3[N5CD] ( Q / N3C ). Mavuika melts her Q hit, having high team DPS share. ▶Xilonen uses her Q right before her 2nd E requiring perfect Q->E input to make Q hit after E cast for full 40% Pyro Scroll.◀ if Mavuika is C1+, it can be difficult to do Cryo Scroll. Wrio C1 is only 3k increase

aetherdendro-lisa-xingqiu-yaoyao.desc: Lisa Xingqiu DMC Yaoyao. ~21s Rot. Simple Lisa Hyperbloom. Combo may have room for optimzation. Yaoyao does not burst.

bennett-furina-xianyun-yanfei.desc: Yanfei plunges with Furina Xianyun and Bennett, not easy to vape properly, waits are needed to vape the plunges.

furina-raiden-xilonen-yaemiko.desc: Raiden Furina Yae Xilonen. ~22s Rot. Raikou with Xilonen. Xilonen uses skill again just before Raiden burst.

bennett-chevreuse-lisa-yoimiya.desc: yoi overload with lisa. full em lisa. dps build chev. 21s~ rotation.

escoffier-faruzan-furina-lanyan.desc: Lanyan Faruzan Furina Escoffier. ~19s Rot. Lanyan-Faruzan Quickswap. Sac Lanyan skills twice per rot with Faruzan aimed shots in between. Escoffier provides furina healing and SubDPS.

arlecchino-mona-yelan-zhongli.desc: Arle Yelan Mona Zhongli. Yelan 1E 18s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 6[N3D]. Mona can hold TTDS catching fav particles from zhongli on-field and being double hydro. activated every other rot though.

bennett-kazuha-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Kazuha Xingqiu Nahida Bennett. ~23s Rot. Kazuha Burgeon in 2 Target. Kazuha does NA in Bennett's burst. Assumes XQ rainswords contact opponents. 2E Bennett builds EM.

kazuha-mona-mualani-xiangling.desc: Mualani Mona Kazuha Xiangling. ~18s rot. Q if available + 3[3-stacked bite]. Mona C1 is beneficial. Xiangling Q every 2 rots. Kazuha Q comes in instead of it. Using Mona E is beneficial to allow her hold 4intructor. Check the config and 4Scroll mona is ~3k behind.

fischl-kazuha-kirara-sara.desc: Sara Fischl Kazuha Kirara. ~26 Rot. On-Field Sara Aggravate with a Shielder Kirara.

arlecchino-bennett-layla-xingqiu.desc: Arle Xingqiu Layla Bennett. 21s rot. Arle No Q, N1 CA dash cancel 3[N5D].

albedo-arlecchino-rosaria-zhongli.desc: Arlecchino melt with Rosaria + Albedo Zhongli double geo core. 17s~ rotation. n15 combo arle, no cancels and no burst.

ayato-fischl-xilonen-yelan.desc: Ayato Yelan Fischl Xilonen. ~25s Rot. Ayato Taser. Ayato burst after 1st skill, then Fischl, Ayato, & Xilonen E/Q and refresh uptime. Xilonen uses burst every roation.

escoffier-kazuha-shenhe-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Kazuha Shenhe Escoffier. 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] N3 (Q). Start with Kazuha tEP, use Shenhe and Escoffier, and before Wrio field time, use either Kazuha Q or tEP.

lynette-mualani-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Mualani Vape with Zhongli. ~33s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. Xiangling Q applies Pyro first half and Guoba plus Lynette Q second half. Includes a tiny wait between Mualani Q and N1 to make sure Q hits first. Rot works with pre-C4 Lynette

clorinde-kuki-nahida-yelan.desc: Clorinde Nahida Kuki Yelan. ~25s Rot. (TF) Clorinde Quickbloom with Kuki. Clorinde does not burst. Kuki uses burst between Clorinde skill uses. Slingshot Yelan doesn't exceed Fav bow here.

collei-fischl-yaemiko-zhongli.desc: Yae Fischl Aggravate with Collei and Zhongli

chiori-ningguang-xingqiu-yelan.desc: on field ning apl double hydro. AP and nighttime similar on ning. chiori does not burst.

diona-furina-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Furina Diona. Yelan 2E 22s rot. diona comes back to heal herself later. Utilize diona's C6 200EM and 4SoDP buff while having occasional melt.

arlecchino-chiori-lynette-zhongli.desc: Simple Arle double geo, rot works with C0 Lynette. N3D combo and uses Lynette Q or Zhongli Q to fill time depending on which is available. Lower damage due to losing Bennett, but no circle impact. Zhongli shield provides survivability. R5 finale and R1 wolffang are about the same.

aetherpyro-citlali-escoffier-furina.desc: PMC Furina Citlali Escoffier. ~22s Rot. PMC MeltVape. Citlali scrolls Pyro incidentally. Escoffier bursts every rotation. -4K DPS with Freeze immunity.

beidou-clorinde-nahida-yelan.desc: Clorinde Nahida Beidou Yelan. ~26s Rot. (TF) Clorinde Quickbloom with Beidou. Clorinde does not burst. Beidou bursts before Yelan.

baizhu-furina-keqing-nahida.desc: MH Keqing Furina Nahida Baizhu. ~25s rot. NOT my sim, made by taylor_series19. In my personal estimation, Fav Codex Baizhu is very close DPS-wise and arguably better for comfort.

fischl-raiden-sucrose-yaoyao.desc: Raiden e > Yao Yao q e > Sucrose q n1ed > Fischl n2q > Sucrose n1ed > Raiden q n4e 2n4d n4 > Sucrose n1c > Fischl e n1 > Sucrose n2ed n1c (changes a lot in subsequent rots)

dehya-emilie-fischl-razor.desc: Razor Emilie Fischl Deyha. ~20s Rot. Razor with 16s of Field time. Emilie bursts every other rotation. Fischl alternates skill and burst. Deyha applies Pyro immediately following Emilie.

chevreuse-fischl-klee-yaemiko.desc: Klee Chevreuse Fischl Yae. ~17s Rot. Klee double Electro Overload. Klee and Chevreuse burst if available. Klee remains on field until Yae's totems expire. Yae does not burst. ToM Yae is pretty close to GT.

bennett-chiori-luminegeo-ningguang.desc: Ningguang-Geo MC-Chiori-Bennett APL rotation,  GMC C6 is a slight team dps increase but lower personal DPS

bennett-emilie-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Bennett Nahida Emilie Xingqiu. ~21s Rot. Double Dendro Bennett Burgeon. Nahida does not burst, while Emilie builds a bit of ER to burst every rotation after the first.

bennett-furina-gorou-navia.desc: Navia Gorou Furina Bennett. 22s rot. 4Exile is really good for team energy here. Gorou feeds fav and geo particles to navia. his field time is only once per rot, easier to play.

alhaitham-fischl-lisa-yaoyao.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Yaoyao Lisa Fischl

furina-kuki-nahida-wriothesley.desc: Wrio driving a Hyperbloom comp feat. Furina

bennett-chasca-mualani-xiangling.desc: Chasca Mualani Xiangling Bennett. 21s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Pyro Goblet is 1% better than ATK% Goblet. Mualani as TTDS+Scroll bot.

bennett-escoffier-furina-rosaria.desc: Bennett Furina Rosaria Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Benentt MeltVape. CW >= MH Bennett. -5K DPS with Freeze immunity. Escoffier only bursts as available from the 2nd; building enough energy to burst every rotation is a DPS loss.

cyno-nahida-thoma-xingqiu.desc: cyno 'chaos' team with xingqiu. burgeons + overloads and resistance to interruption

escoffier-shenhe-wriothesley-xilonen.desc: Wrio Xilonen Shenhe Escoffier. 20s rot. 5[N3CJ] N4 Q/C. Use either Xilonen or Escoffier Q for healing.

layla-nahida-razor-xingqiu.desc: Razor Nahida Xingqiu Layla. ~23s Rotation. Hyperbloom Razor with Layla. Few Shatter occurences. DW > ToM Layla with ToM Nahida.

fischl-mizuki-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Mizuki Yae Nahida Fischl. Yae bursts every rotation other than the first. One mizuki skill and 2 oz casts per 25s rot. Nahida and Yae drive fischl on second half of rotation

fischl-lisa-lynette-neuvillette.desc: neuvi double electro with lisa and lynette. rot is for c4+/sac lynette but alternate rot is included. lisa skips skill so fav is r5 to help er.

barbara-bennett-chasca-citlali.desc: Chasca Citlali Barbara Bennett. 21s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b]. Q every 2 rot. Hydro Scroll is inconsistent when Barbara does not have her E.

bennett-luminegeo-navia-xiangling.desc: Navia GMC Xiangling Bennett. GMC 2E 22s rot. GMC feeds geo and fav particles twice into navia, being excellent battery. C1 is snapshottable 10% CR and interruption resistance to the on-fielder. You need to practice short hold E(shorter animation than normal hold E). and good positioning of it

bennett-emilie-lisa-razor.desc: Razor Emilie Lisa Bennett. ~22s Rotation. Razor Quickload w/ 70/46% Quicken/Burning uptime. SS may be inconsistent. Self-Overloads not implemented.

xilonen-yelan-yoimiya-yunjin.desc: Yoimiya Yelan YunJin Xilonen. 19-20s rot. Picking up the shard is required for Geo Resonance buff. YunJin can easily hold DEF% weapon thanks to team Fav and Xilonen's Geo particles.

arlecchino-layla-mona-yelan.desc: Arle Yelan Mona Layla. Yelan 1E 18s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 6[N3D]. Mona can hold TTDS catching fav particles from layla on-field and being double hydro. activated every other rot though. Layla's shield and Freeze make arle safe.

bennett-emilie-furina-xianyun.desc: Bennett Emilie Furina Xianyun. ~20s Rot. On-field Bennett Burning plunge. 8 plunges, 5 skills. UR Emilie + DM Xianyun & DM Emilie + VV Xianyun are closely matched. VV is only for Hydro when applicable.

bennett-emilie-lynette-wriothesley.desc: Lynette books her particles and Bennett has 6 more ER rolls than KQMS allows. VV setup is easy: Wrio N1, Emilie E, Lynette E.

bennett-emilie-razor-yaemiko.desc: Razor Emilie Yae Bennett. ~22s Rotation. Razor Quickload w/ 61/56% Burning/Quicken uptime. SS may be inconsistent. No burst, EM support Yae. Self-Overloads not implemented.

fischl-kirara-sethos-tighnari.desc: Sethos Tighnari Fischl Kirara. ~17s Rot. Sethos Tighnari Aggravate. Sethos uses a Shadowpiercing at the start of the rotation and after his burst, which is wrapped by skills for energy reasons. Tighnari uses burst after 1 CA, energy permitting. Fischl alternates skill and burst. Kirara uses burst only if available.

arlecchino-emilie-kazuha-kirara.desc: Arle Emilie Kazuha Kirara. 17s rot. No Arle Q 6[N3D]. Emilie Q if available and if not, use Kazuha Q. Kirara right before Arle, protecting Arle. using Kirara Q for better 4DM uptime and AoE coverage.

chiori-fischl-gorou-ningguang.desc: on field ning apl. crystallize and c4 gorou provide some survivability.

eula-furina-raiden-xianyun.desc: Eula Furina Raiden Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Eula Phys Plunge. Eula bursts every 2nd-3rd Rotation, with Raiden skill providing burst damage bonus.

bennett-chasca-layla-xiangling.desc: Chasca Layla Xiangling Bennett. 17s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Xiangling casts Q every 3rd rotation. Pyro% Goblet is ~1.5k DPS (~3.5%) better than ATK% Goblet.

beidou-fischl-kazuha-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Fischl Beidou Kazuha. 26s rot. Neuv's AoE with Kazuha's hE and Beidou Q make the team potent against multiple enemies while Fischl handles single target damage. Beidou can have manageable ER thanks to fischl.

chiori-emilie-yoimiya-zhongli.desc: Yoimiya Emilie Chiori Zhongli. 18s rot. Yoimiya has 18s cd on her E, so fill the downtime with bursts.

cyno-escoffier-fischl-furina.desc: Cyno Furina Fischl Escoffier. ~25s Rot. Cyno Taser with Token superconduct. Fischl uses skill and burst every rotation.

citlali-escoffier-furina-mona.desc: Freeze DPS Mona // Mona Citlali Escoffier Furina // ~23s Rotation

bennett-fischl-furina-raiden.desc: Raifish Furina Bennett. 20s rot. Fischl E at the end of the rot(=every other rot). Furina doesn't get bennett's healing.

chongyun-kuki-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Chongyun Nahida Xingqiu Kuki. ~21s Rot. Shatter Chongyun in on-field Hyperbloom. Chongyun damage share is low. Kuki, Chongyun, or Nahida burst at the end of the rotation based on energy.

ayaka-kokomi-lynette-shenhe.desc: Ayaka Freeze with Kokomi. C4 Lynette uses EQ when E is available and N1 Q otherwise, pre-C4 uses only N1 Q. ToTM is slightly behind Scroll on Kokomi

baizhu-furina-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya double hydro baizhu. Slight optimizations from previous sim. CDmg/EM/Atk on Yoi. Changed rotation to clear dendro before yoimiya uptime. Yoi bursts every other rotation.

fischl-furina-heizou-yaemiko.desc: Heizou Furina Yae Fischl. ~25s Rot. Heizou Taser in ST w/ P-Amber Heizou bursting twice per rotation to heal the team. EM >= ADC Heizou in ST. Burstless Yae.

fischl-nahida-sayu-yaemiko.desc: Sayu Nahida Yae Fischl. ~25s Rot. Sayu Aggravate with a max duration roll with Fav. Yae bursts every rotation.

aetherelectro-bennett-chevreuse-fischl.desc: EMC Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~16s Rot. EMC on-field DPS. Assumes 3 hits from Electro travelers skill; the Thunder amulets are picked up as soon as possible. EMC bursts as available to fit into the rotation length. EMC does N3C. 3EM > EDC EMC. Fischl just before Chevreuse is better for DPS. Chevreuse bursts every other rot, though it may be possible to burst every rot in game if she's consistently catching EMC amulets.

bennett-chasca-layla-shenhe.desc: Chasca Layla Shenhe Bennett. ~17s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Shenhe casts her Q every other rotation starting from the 2nd rotation. Scroll is inconsistent. Chasca prefers Cryo% Goblet by ~1k (~2%).

dori-freminet-furina-nahida.desc: Freminet Furina Nahida Dori. ~22s Rot. Freminet Furina Hyperbloom. Dori Does EN2DN1Q just after Furina. Nahida bursts every other rotation after the first.

cyno-kuki-mavuika-nahida.desc: Cyno Nahida Mavuika Kuki. ~22s Rot. Cyno Quickburn with Nahida and Kuki. Everyone but Cyno bursts every other rotation after the first. Mavuika just does QCED. Kuki does more damage built for EDC for Quicken than 3EM for Overload.

ayato-fischl-kazuha-yelan.desc: ayato yelan fischl kaz with rotation fixed

dori-fischl-kazuha-kirara.desc: Dori Kirara Fischl Kazuha. ~30s Rotation. Dori Aggravate with Ins. Sapwood Kirara.

alhaitham-diona-kuki-xingqiu.desc: Deepwood Alhaitham w/ flexible combo to adapt to energy (essentially, burst every other rot if low ER). Customized random frame delays; 12-3 Icewind Suite energy.

bennett-wriothesley-xilonen-xinyan.desc: Wriothesley Xinyan Bennett Xilonen. ~19sec rot. Xinyan allow Wrio to melt consistently by using a lvl 3 shield gained from her C2 when using her burst, having a pyro application very similar to Mavuika. unfortunately her pyro application is single target oriented has Wrio has to be very close to an ennemy to let the shield DoT apply pyro and is very dependant on keeping the shield active to basically make the team work. Wrio C1 is around 5K DPS increase.

fischl-nahida-xingqiu-yanfei.desc: Yanfei Nahida Fischl Xingqiu. ~24s Rot. Yanfei OverBurgeonVape. Yanfei uses burst at the start of her field time if available. Fischl uses skill and burst every rotation. Note that Yanfei is in melee range; dont expect her to survive past 2 rotations.

chevreuse-cyno-mavuika-ororon.desc: Cyno Chevreuse Mavuika Ororon. ~24s Rot. Cyno Overload. Mauvika EQ every rotation after Ororon; she builds full EM. SoDP > NO Chevreuse.

collei-fischl-sucrose-xingqiu.desc: Sucrose Hyperbloom with Fischl Xingqiu and Collei

cyno-emilie-kuki-mavuika.desc: Cyno Emilie Mavuika Kuki. ~21s Rot. Cyno Quickburn with Kuki. EM Mavuika just does QCED. Kuki does more damage built for EDC for Quicken than full EM for Overload. Kuki bursts every other rotation after Emilie bursts to avoid disrupting Emilie's A1.

nahida-yaemiko-yelan-zhongli.desc: Yae Yelan Hyperbloom with Nahida Zhongli

chevreuse-lisa-mavuika-raiden.desc: Raiden Chevreuse Mavuika Lisa. ~18 Rot. Raiden Mavuika Overload, Raiden bursts every rotation, Mavuika every other with 2[C2D] ED. Lisa burst every rotation before raiden and covers cooldown with electro Aura for Mavuika overload.

beidou-kokomi-nahida-xiangling.desc: Kokomi Vape Burgeon with a CA based rotation. ~24s rotation. Beidou's IR reduces need for dash, but stamina management is needed on player's part to get all 6 CAs off during Kokomi's Burst.

clorinde-fischl-furina-yunjin.desc: Clorinde Furina Fischl YunJin. 16s rot. Clorinde Q every 2 rot. Characters have low enough field time to allow YunJin to spend time on using Level 2 hold E for her ER.

faruzan-xianyun-xiao-yelan.desc: Xiao Faruzan Yelan Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Xiao weaves NAs inbetween 8 high plunges. You may N0 in game. 50% collisions.

furina-keqing-ororon-xianyun.desc: Keqing Furina Ororon Xianyun. ~21s Rot. Keqing Taser Plunge. Xianyun refreshes VV mid rotation. 4 plunges in each half. Ororon before Furina. Hold skill aerial plunge not implemented. 50% Collisons.

baizhu-klee-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Klee Xingqiu Nahida Baizhu. ~22s Rot. Klee Burgeon with Xingqiu. Klee uses CA with when sparks are avialable and does N1W until Xingqiu's burst expires otherwise. Nahida bursts every other rotation after the first.

arlecchino-thoma-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Arle Yelan Xingqiu Thoma. Yelan 2E 21s rot. Arle No Q, 6[N3D]. Thoma for pyro resonance, shield, C6 DMG Bonus and 4NO.

baizhu-fischl-kazuha-raiden.desc: Raiden Fischl Baizhu Kazuha short rotation version (fischl using E every other rot)

bennett-fischl-raiden-yelan.desc: Raiden Yelan Fischl Bennett. 18s rot. Fischl Q every rot and E every other rot at the end of the rot. 4Scroll also works on Bennett.

escoffier-furina-ganyu-venti.desc: Ganyu Furina Venti Escoffier. ~21s Rot. On-field Freeze DPS Ganyu in 2 target. 2 E Ganyu skills per rotation. Assumes freezable enemies and high ability to headshot; -3K DPS with Stillness. Venti always absorbs Cryo, and leads to low ER reqs for the Cryo units.

faruzan-furina-sayu-xiao.desc: Xiao Faruzan Furina Sayu. KQMS. Sayu passes particles to Xiao. 12 Plunges. 50% collisions.

alhaitham-fischl-xianyun-yaemiko.desc: AlHaitham Yae Fischl Xianyun. ~18s Rot. Alhaitham Quicken Plunge. Alhaitham does EP 7JlPN1 C (Q/N2). 60% Collisions.

kazuha-neuvillette-shenhe-zhongli.desc: Neuvillette Guide Weapons (Low ER, no Furina) R5 Sacrificial Jade

aetherelectro-bennett-emilie-fischl.desc: EMC Emilie Fischl Bennett. ~21s Rot. EMC Quickburn. EMC does N3D, skilling off cd. Deepwood exceeds DPS set options. Fischl alternates skill and burst in Bennett burst.

chiori-kazuha-neuvillette-zhongli.desc: Neuv Kazuha Chiori Zhongli. 4CA 28s rot. You just care about hydro 4AP. No worry for aura management.

bennett-citlali-furina-xiangling.desc: Bennett Furina Xiangling Citlali. ~20s Rot. Citlali Furinational with Bennett funneling Xiangling's burst, then on-field skill spam after Citlali skill+burst. DPS weapons on Citlali lead to higher team DPS. -3K DPS with freeze immuninity.

dehya-furina-nahida-sayu.desc: Sayu Nahida Furina Deyha. ~20s Rot. Sayu Burngeon in 2 Target. Max length rolls on Sayu. Deyha provdes crucial IR, damage reduction, and Pyro without NAs. Furina provides Hydro without NAs while and Vapes off of Burning aura.

bennett-dehya-emilie-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Emilie Dehya Bennett. N3CJ combo 19s rot. Emilie and Wrio Q every 2 rots. R5 SacGS can lower Dehya's 20s cooldown.

fischl-kokomi-nahida-xiangling.desc: Kokomi, Fischl, Nahida, Xiangling Curry team

furina-gorou-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Xilonen Furina Xianyun Gorou. ~20s Rot. Xilonen cancels plunge endlag with NAs, since dashes spend Nightsoul. Xilonen bursts every other rotation. Only 6 Geo Plunges, 8 with C1. Gorou skips burst if unavailable. 50% collisions.

aetherpyro-bennett-fischl-yelan.desc: PMC Yelan Fischl Bennett. ~19s Rot. PMC Overvape DPS. 1E Yelan, 2E Bennett. PMC uses hold skill and bursts as available between weaving NAs. Scroll closely trails for team DPS.

faruzan-furina-kokomi-lynette.desc: Lynette hypercarry with Kokomi. 20s rotation. Kokomi offers healing and buff Lynette with TTDS, as well as enable hydro resonance and battery Furina.

baizhu-furina-lisa-ororon.desc: Lisa Furina Ororon Baizhu. ~21s Rot. Lisa-Ororon Hyperbloom. Ororon goes before Furina for higher Electro coverage and energy. Baizhu does 2Es. Baizhu Deepwood > OHC.

bennett-kazuha-lisa-xiangling.desc: Lisa Kazuha Xiangling Bennett. ~20s Rot. Lisa Overload in 2 Target, with Bennett & Kazuha on field maintaining Pyro Aura. Lesser performance in ST.

bennett-fischl-furina-xiangling.desc: Bennett Furina Xiangling Fischl. ~20s Rot. Fischl Furinational with Bennett funneling Xiangling's burst, then on-feild skill spam for the rest of the rotation. CW > NO on Bennett. Fischl alternates skill and burst in Bennett's burst.

escoffier-furina-rosaria-yaemiko.desc: Rosaria Furina Yae Escoffier. ~22s Rotation. Physical Rosaria does N3CD stamina permitting, otherwise does NA spam. Rosaria uses skill 3 times, passing the final skill particles to Furina. Full EM Evenstar Yae.

fischl-kirara-lynette-yaemiko.desc: Lynette aggravate driving Fischl. Used 4Ins Kirara. Lynette is using N2C combo

kazuha-nahida-raiden-sara.desc: Raiden Aggravate with Nahida Sara Kazuha

furina-shenhe-wriothesley-xilonen.desc: Wrio Shenhe Furina Xilonen. Xilonen 2E 22s rot. N3CJ spam. Wrio Q every other rot.

kokomi-kuki-luminedendro-nahida.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with DMC Nhaida and Kokomi

bennett-emilie-kazuha-lisa.desc: Lisa Kazuha Emilie Bennett. ~21s Rot. Lisa Overload in 2 Target, with Bennett & Kazuha on-field maintaining Pyro Aura. UR & Deepwood Bennett are similar. Significant DPS loss in ST.

bennett-chevreuse-keqing-xiangling.desc: Keqing Chevreuse Xiangling Bennett. ~20s Rot. Electro Keqing Overload. A funneled Chevreuse and Xiangling burst every rotation in Bennett Q, then Keqing Spams N1C during and out of Bennett burst. C6 Bennett is DPS Neutral; Pyro & Electro Goblet see similar performance.

bennett-dehya-fischl-furina.desc: C1 Dehya Bennett Furina Fischl. 25s rot. More optimized version with different weapons and Normal Attacks throughout the rotation. Dehya triggers Vaporize and Overloaded. Fischl beats Dehya in DPS. Furina holds an offensive weapon and Bennett holds Scroll. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. Noblesse on Bennett is ~1k less DPS. C0 Dehya loses ~4k DPS.

cyno-fischl-kirara-mavuika.desc: Cyno Mavuika Fischl Kirara. ~25s Rot. Cyno Quickburn with Kirara C4 providing Dendro into Cyno's burst uptime while full EM Mauvika owns most Overloads. Mavuika bursts every rotation.

barbara-mualani-sucrose-xiangling.desc: Mualani Barbara Sucrose Xiangling. 3[3-stacked bite]. Relying on either Pyronado or Sucrose Q. Barbara for Hydro Resonance, filling downtime with favcodex for team energy. Her E provides C2 buff but may remove the pyro aura if unlucky. With Barbara E(triggering vape), 4Ins XL and 4Scroll Barbara has better dmg.

fischl-kinich-xilonen-yaemiko.desc: Kinich Yae Fischl Xilonen. ~15s Rot. Kinich on-field Aggravate, where Kinich uses TF to fit into the shoter rotation. Fischl alternates skill and burst.  Burstless Yae. No Kinich short hold is -6k DPS.

navia-xingqiu-yelan-zhongli.desc: Navia Zhongli Yelan Xingqiu. Yelan 2E 21-22s rot. use navia 3rd E if available. feed fav particles to navia.

furina-kuki-nahida-razor.desc: Razor Quickbloom with 34 second rotation. Kuki casts 2E and Razor does not make an E before the Q since it is not necessary due to the requirements of ER.

baizhu-furina-kinich-thoma.desc: Kinch Furina Thoma Baizhu. ~21s Rot. Shielded Kinich Burgeon. Kinich seeks blindspots. Kinich bursts every other rotation. No short hold E is -2K DPS.

escoffier-fischl-furina-rosaria.desc: Rosaria Furina Fischl Escoffier. ~22s Rotation. Physical Rosaria does N3CD stamina permitting, otherwise does NA spam. Rosaria uses skill 3 times, passing the final skill particles to Furina.

bennett-fischl-furina-lynette.desc: furina "soup" with lynette. fischl uses tf and stays on field to reduce her skill cooldown and fit into shorter rotation .

charlotte-chiori-furina-navia.desc: Navia Chiori Furina Charlotte. 21s rot. Chiori uses her burst between navia's E if available. Charlotte feeds her fav particles to navia, at navia's 2nd E. she trigges Fav twice in this rot structure and its R3 cd.

beidou-fischl-hutao-xingqiu.desc: TF Hu Tao with Beidou Fischl Xingqiu

bennett-chasca-rosaria-shenhe.desc: Chasca Shenhe Rosaria Bennett. Rosaria 2E 20s rot. 4[C] 1[C_4b]. Chasca doesn't use her Q. 4OC has CR overcapping issue, 4SR is used instead. Cryo Goblet is equal to ATK% Goblet.

baizhu-cyno-furina-ororon.desc: Cyno Furina Ororon Baizhu. 25s rot. Ororon provides enough energy for Cyno to use 4MH with Furina.

alhaitham-baizhu-nilou-yelan.desc: MH Alhaitham Nilou bloom team with Yelan. ~21 s rotation. Nilou ENNE-> Baizhu EQ -> Yelan EQ -> Alhaitham E ... -> Baizhu E -> Alhaitham Q swap Yelan E swap back ...

emilie-fischl-razor-thoma.desc: Razor Emilie Fischl Thoma. ~20s Rot. Razor ends his field time on Fiery Collapse to increase Emilie damage. Emilie bursts every other rotation. Fischl alternates skill and burst. EM build Thoma.

bennett-emilie-xiangling-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Emilie Xiangling Bennett. 20s rot. Emilie Q every 2rots outside of Bennett Q. Yoimiya also Q every 2rots filling downtime. Xiangling can hold 4DM

escoffier-furina-mika-rosaria.desc: Rosaria Furina Escoffier Mika. ~20s Rot. Phys Rosaria Freeze with N3D(stamina permintting) and skill off CD. ATK over Phys Goblet. Mika and Escoffier burst in alternate rotations. -2K DPS with Freeze immunity.

bennett-kuki-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Kuki Nahida Xingqiu Bennett. ~22s Rotation. Kuki Hyperburgeon with C6 Bennett. Kuki uses burst & skill as available in Bennett's burst while Bennett swaps and skills occasionally.

chongyun-freminet-furina-xianyun.desc: Freminet Furina Chongyun Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Freminet Shatterplunge with FavGS Chongyun. Conistent Cryo Swirl, inconsistent Hydro Swirl. Combo: (2E 7JPD 1JP 2E Q2E/N3). 50% Collisions.

kokomi-lisa-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Lisa Xingqiu Nahida Kokomi. ~21s Rot. Lisa Hyperbloom. Lisa bursts only if ready at the end of the rotation.

furina-mika-rosaria-yelan.desc: Rosaria Yelan Furina Mika. ~22s Rot. Rosaria on-field. 2E Yelan. ~65% Cryo Resonance uptime.

furina-keqing-ororon-xilonen.desc: Keqing Furina Ororon Xilonen. ~21s Rot. Keqing Taser. Keqing does EQE 5N1C before Xilonen refreshes RES shred. Ororon goes before Furina for her energy needs. Scroll enables AP Xilonen, who almost always picks up Elctro Crystallize Shards.

dori-nahida-razor-xingqiu.desc: Razor Nahida Xingqiu Dori. ~23s Rot. Razor-Dori Hyperbloom. Razor and Dori split Hyperbloom ownership, with Dori's chain typically taking more cores when adjacent.

ayaka-diona-kazuha-mona.desc: Ayaka freeze with Diona. Diona provides much less energy per rotation than other Cryo alternatives, which requires non Amenoma Kageuchi Ayaka to have around 125% to 130% ER with double Fav supports

furina-keqing-kuki-nahida.desc: TF Keqing Furina Nahida Kuki. ~31s rot. Extra particle gen from TF lets Kuki drop Xiphos for umbrella. Nahida is on PAmber because she wants the energy and Kuki's healing alone doesn't stack Fanfare very effectively.

baizhu-fischl-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Double Dendro Double Electro Yae aggravate. F2P/Craftable weapons

escoffier-furina-rosaria-xiao.desc: Xiao Furina Rosaria Escoffier. ~23s Rot. VV Fav Xiao in Freeze Plunge with 12 High plunges. 50% Collisions.

fischl-kaveh-kuki-xingqiu.desc: Kaveh Xingqiu Fischl Kuki. ~21s Rot. Kaveh Hyperbloom. Kaveh needs Fav for ER purposes. Xingqiu 3EM > ADC; Xingqiu owns a meanigful amount of Bloom and EC. Fischl and Kuki alternate skill/burst to fill rotation time for Xingqiu's skill.

baizhu-fischl-raiden-xiangling.desc: Raiden Xiangling Fischl Baizhu. ~20s Rot. Raiden Quickburn. Fischl uses skill after Raiden burst if available, otherwise Baizhu fills time with NA for burst CDs. Xiangling prefers full EM.

dori-eula-furina-yelan.desc: Eula Furina Yelan Dori. ~22s Rot. Eula double Hydro with 2E Yelan attempting to funnel Fav particles to Eula. Dori also supplies some flat energy to Eula after her burst animation.

furina-navia-qiqi-yelan.desc: Navia Furina Yelan Qiqi. Qiqi heals the entire team enabling Furina. She is detrimental to Crystal generation due to shatter occuring before Crystallise. ATK% is slightly better than Geo DMG% Goblet.

alhaitham-baizhu-fischl-raiden.desc: KQMS stats; cozy and fun double carry Quicken team with very easy rotation; Alhaitham is played as quickswap burst DPS, but can stay longer on field if needed. TTDS or Hakushin on Baizhu can be a ~2.5% total dps increase.

kinich-kirara-ororon-tighnari.desc: Kinich Ororon Tighari Kirara. ~21s Rot. Triple Dendro Spread. Kinich seeks blindspots. No Kinich Short Hold E is -2K DPS. Kinich bursts every other rotation. Ororon provides enough quicken to last throught to Tighnari's field time.

furina-klee-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Klee Furina Rosaria Xianyun. ~23s Rot. Klee Plunge with VapeMelt. Low Shatter count, Klee, Furina, and Rosaria get some vapes/melts. Hydro VV only. Klee bursts as available and does CAs between plunges, stamina permitting. Freeze immunity is -2K DPS. 50% Collisions.

charlotte-furina-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Furina Charlotte. Yelan 1E 20s rot. ATK/EM/CRIT 4MH. To maximize yoimiya's damage, used TTDS Charlotte with hE and 2 Fav to manage her ER. her c4 energy also helps.

bennett-emilie-kuki-razor.desc: Razor Emilie Kuki Bennett. ~21s Rotation. Razor Quickload w/ 67/49% Quicken/Burning uptime. Kuki & Emilie burst in alternate rotations. SS may be inconsistent. Self-Overloads not implemented.

faruzan-fischl-kirara-lynette.desc: Main DPS Farusan, dealing anemo dmg on field while swirling electro for fischl A4. 25s rotation to maximise Oz uptime. Kirara won't apply too much dendro and provides some survivability with the shields.

bennett-fischl-freminet-xianyun.desc: Freminet (C5)Bennett Fischl Xianyun. ~18s Rot. Hyper Freminet Phys plunge with Superconduct, no Shatter. Executes 1 lvl 4 Shattering Pressure combo during plunges. 50% Collisions. OHC > VV/SoDP Xianyun, but bubbles may miss.

chevreuse-cyno-fischl-xiangling.desc: "King of Hell" Cyno with Fischl, 26s rotation. Glad is within 1% of Echoes and ping independent

bennett-chiori-emilie-zhongli.desc: onfield emilie with double geo core. Emilie spams N2C, but onfield strings are not too important.

luminedendro-raiden-sara-sucrose.desc: Raiden e > Sucrose n1ed > DMC q e n1 > Sara e aim n1 > Sucrose ed q n2 > Raiden q n4e 3n4d

beidou-chevreuse-fischl-hutao.desc: Hutao Chevreuse Fischl Beidou. ~20s Rot. Overload Hutao with IR. Hutao does 6N3CJ N2CJ. Hutao & Chevreuse burst every other rotation. Fischl alternates skill and burst. Beidou uses skill once per rotation. 20% Counter, 20% Perfect Counters. 3EM Hutao similar in 2T.

fischl-navia-tighnari-zhongli.desc: Navia Zhongli Fischl Tighnari. 27s rot. Tighnari Q once every 2E. 4pc deepwood on him is slightly weaker.

dori-mavuika-nahida-ororon.desc: Dori Nahida Ororon Mavuika. ~20s Rot. Dori Quickburn. Dori stays on field for 3 skill uses, as her C6 infusion downtime is nearly eliminated. Ororon before Mavuika leads to slightly more DPS. Deepwood Mavuika >  OC Mavuika.

furina-mika-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Furina Yelan Mika. ~21s Rot. Yoimiya with a few extra attacks with Mika's attack speed buff. SoDP > OHC Mika.

cyno-fischl-furina-xilonen.desc: Non dendro Cyno carry, 26s rotation. Double crystallize succeeds ~70% of the time, otherwise only Electro is crystallized

kazuha-lisa-nahida-raiden.desc: Raiden Aggravate with Lisa Kazuha Nahida

chevreuse-dehya-fischl-raiden.desc: Raiden Chevreuse Fischl Dehya. ~25s Rot. Raiden-Deyha Overload. Easier rotation: Deyha uses her burst, bookended by Fischl skill and burst every rotation, then Raiden uses her burst. HP and DPS Chev are similar.

fischl-lisa-luminedendro-zhongli.desc: Lisa Fishcl Aggravate with DMC and Zhongli

ayato-furina-lanyan-xilonen.desc: Ayato Furina Xilonen Lanyan. 26s rot. 2 Ayato skills per rotation, Lanyan on Sacrificial Fragments to allow 100% shield uptime during Ayato's skills. Finale on Ayato is ~1.5k DPS loss supposing Lanyan's shield won't break. Echoes on Ayato is 1k dps loss.

ayaka-kazuha-layla-shenhe.desc: Improved Ayaka monocryo's rotation with Layla and also made it safer. Only a 1.2k dps increase from the old one though.

faruzan-furina-kazuha-lisa.desc: Kazuha Faruzan Furina Lisa. ~20s Rot. Kazuha-Faruzan Quickswap. Kazuha skills off CD with Faruzan aimed shots in between. Pamber Lisa provides the only Furina fanfare. Lisa uses skill while both Anemo units are on CD. 100% Collisions.

furina-navia-noelle-xianyun.desc: Noelle Plunge. Do Navia EQ on first rotations and burst on Navia on subsequent ones only if it's available. Furina procs Fav and Navia funnels her E to Noelle in between 2 sets of 4 Noelle High pluges, 50% collision

fischl-kirara-lisa-nahida.desc: Kirara Spread (finally a festering desire user!)

bennett-dehya-ganyu-nahida.desc: Burning Melt Ganyu with Sac Greatsword Dehya

bennett-chevreuse-raiden-xinyan.desc: Raiden Chevreuse Xinyan Bennett. ~18s Rot. Raiden Overload with SubDPS Chevreuse and Xinyan nuking in Bennett's burst before Raiden takes the field. Xinyan's uninvested shield durabilty is suspect for ToM or EM builds, but it should linger enough for RES shred though Raiden's field time.

faruzan-furina-kazuha-kokomi.desc: Kazaha Faruzan Furina Kokomi. ~20s Rot. Kazuha-Faruzan Quickswap. Kazuha skills off CD with Faruzan aimed shots in between. VV Kazuha - MH Faruzan trails slightly. TTDS lands on Kazuha.

bennett-ganyu-nahida-shenhe.desc: Highly Unstable Burning Melt Ganyu with Shenhe

chevreuse-fischl-raiden-thoma.desc: Raiden Fischl Thoma Chev. 18s rot. DPS build Thoma trying his best with so many buffs available. Better xiangling when??

faruzan-furina-lisa-lynette.desc: Lynette hypercarry with Lisa. 20s rotation. Lisa offers def shred and healing via Prototype Amber, as well as enabling electro charged damage. She uses her full hold skill to battery herself.

chiori-furina-sigewinne-xilonen.desc: APL Furina & Chiori Quickswap team with Sigewinne and Xilonen. Crystallize shards are picked up for geo resonance. Xilonen feeds fav particles to furina. Sigewinne can also use fav bow.

cyno-emilie-nahida-thoma.desc: Cyno Emilie Nahida Thoma. 4TF Cyno N4E spam combo 26s rot. Cyno has high ER requirement as  Solo Electro esp when not using 4TF.

mualani-xiangling-yelan-zhongli.desc: Mualani Yelan Zhongli Xiangling. 20s rot. Q if available + 3[3-stacked bite]. Xiangling Q every rot. need high ER yes.

dori-furina-rosaria-xianyun.desc: (C5)Dori Furina Rosaria Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Dori Phys Plunge. Dori uses burst as available at the end of the rotation. OHC > SoDP Xianyun, but bubbles may miss. C6 Dori is -6K DPS. 50% Collisions.

bennett-luminepyro-nahida-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Nahida PMC Bennett. ~20s rot. 5[N3CJ] N4 Q/C. Nahida Q every 2 rot. PMC has really high ER req.

bennett-klee-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Klee 2Hydro Vape -  Klee burst is a dps loss because of time spent not driving Xingqiu and Yelan.

collei-fischl-keqing-zhongli.desc: Keqing Fischl Aggravate with Zhongli and Collei

dehya-lynette-neuvillette-xiangling.desc: Neuv Vape with Dehya and Lynette for some interruption resistance and a Taunt. 4CA ~26s rot. 3 favs + long rot let both Xiangling and Lynette use ATK% sands.

arlecchino-bennett-kazuha-xinyan.desc: Arle Xinyan Kazuha Bennett. 18s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D] N1. xinyan's shield lasts 12s
