dori-furina-jean-nahida.desc: Dori Nahida Furina Jean. ~23s Rot. Dori Hyperbloom with Fav GS Dori Decreasing ER Requirements. Full EM Jean swirls self Electro applied by Dori's lamp.

chiori-navia-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Navia Chiori Yelan Xingqiu: N3D 2N2D on Navia to fit second Yelan skill. Options for Husk and HoD on Chiori and EoSF on XQ in config (NO is ~2% better than EoSF for XQ).

bennett-citlali-ganyu-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Citlali Ganyu Bennett. 18s rot. No Yoimiya Q. 6 out of 10 Meltable hits are melted here. Ganyu's Cryo app pattern can be different against multiple enemies.

ayaka-kokomi-shenhe-venti.desc: Ayaka freeze with random delays of 2 to 6 frames. This makes use of Ayaka's E dash buffer. Venti EQ > Shenhe EQ > Kokomi E d > Ayaka E d N1 Q N2C > Venti E N1 > Shenhe N1 E > Ayaka d N2C E d 2N2C.

eula-furina-mika-raiden.desc: Eula Raiden Furina Mika. Optimized 24s rotation. PF on Eula is ~2k less DPS. Giving Raiden a DMG weapon gives similar results and can pull ahead if she is more invested than Eula. EOSF is generally worse than TOTM unless Raiden is heavily invested.

aetheranemo-fischl-tighnari-yaemiko.desc: Yae Fishcl Aggravate with Tighnari and AMC

beidou-clorinde-furina-nahida.desc: Clorinde Nahida Furina Beidou. ~24s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Quickbloom with Beidou in 2T. Quicken wears off at the tail of the rotation. Beidou wants Aquamarine in single target.

furina-keqing-nahida-xilonen.desc: MH Keqing Furina Nahida Xilonen. ~28s rot. A long rotation minimizes ER requirements and allows more substats to be poured into damage. C2 Xilonen would likely radically change the optimal rotation.

chiori-xianyun-xiao-zhongli.desc: Xiao Xianyun Zhongli Chiori. ~19s rot. Xiao Double Geo without Faruzan. LNO > MH, even with Fav lance. 10 Plunges. 50% Collisions.

kaveh-luminedendro-nilou-xingqiu.desc: Nilou Bloom with DMC Kaveh and Xingqiu

bennett-citlali-wriothesley-xiangling.desc: Wrio Citlali Xiangling Bennett. 20s rot. 5[N3CJ] N3 Q/C. TTDS Citlali so she comes before Wrio, eating up some Bennett Q uptime.

bennett-faruzan-wanderer-zhongli.desc: Zhongli E > Faruzan Q > Bennett EQ > Wanderer Q (if Ava) N2ENC N2D (if a4 Ava) / N2C E > Bennett E without funneling last rotation

bennett-nahida-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Bennett Nahida Raiden Xingqiu. ~22s Rot. Bennett Burgeon on-field with Raiden snatching dendro cores leftover. Nahida omits burst if unavailable.

bennett-ganyu-nahida-zhongli.desc: Highly Unstable Burning Melt Ganyu with Zhongli

chevreuse-fischl-raiden-xinyan.desc: HP Chev Raifish Xinyan damage builded. NO a bit better that ToM

bennett-furina-nahida-yelan.desc: Bennett Nahida Furina Yelan. ~24s Rot. Bennett Burgeon Vape with Furina & 1xE Yelan. Fanfare generation drops after the first rotation. Bennett recieves all healing.

dori-jean-nahida-yelan.desc: Dori Hypbloom with Yelan Jean Nahida

charlotte-mavuika-xiangling-xianyun.desc: Charlotte Xiangling Mavuika Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Charlotte Melt plunge. Charlotte uses hold skill after plunging, allowing Xianyun to VV Cryo and Mavuika to Melt her burst in the next rotation. Charlotte can N1 cancel more plunges for more melts.

bennett-faruzan-wanderer-xiangling.desc: C0 Wanderer C6 Faruzan, one if not the highest AOE main DPS Wanderer teams, but no shielder

aetherpyro-chevreuse-fischl-yaemiko.desc: PMC Chevreuse Fischl Yae. ~17s Rot. PMC double Electro with PMC on-field DPS. PMC uses burst when available. PMC uses hE. PMC does N3C/N3D as available. Chevreuse bursts every rot & builds for healing.

cyno-furina-nahida-xianyun.desc: Cyno Nahida Furina Xianyun. ~27s Rot. TF Cyno Hyperplunge, taking advantage of 6M Plunge AoE in Cyno's burst. Cyno plunges in-between skill uses off CD. Plunges must be canceled with N1. Nahida bursts nearly every rotation. 50% Collisions.

fischl-navia-yaemiko-zhongli.desc: Navia Zhongli Fischl Yae. 16.5s rot. Yae no burst only 3[E] once. 4th rot onwards you need to add some extra actions for navia E cd

chiori-furina-gorou-ningguang.desc: on field ning apl. c4 gorou provides some healing for furina, and crystallize provides some shielding, but survivability is still very limited.

bennett-furina-kaeya-xiangling.desc: Furina, Bennett, (C6) Kaeya, Xiangling quickswap, artifacts follow KQMS. Every unit receives healing from Bennett burst. Reactions can change significantly ingame due to Xiangling's and Kaeya's implementation in sim. Here, Xiangling owns most of the reactions but still has significant unreacted damage. Furina gets some vapes and Kaeya gets few melts. Sim is optimized but not too heavily

fischl-thoma-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Fischl Thoma. 18s rot. 4GD on yoi is only a few hunderd behind. 4CW is ~1k behind. Yoimiya can keep vaping her NAs thanks to overvape.

faruzan-wanderer-yelan-zhongli.desc: Zhongli EHDN1 > Yelan EQN1 (N1 Aim if Ava special charge) > Faruzan N1Q > Wanderer N1 Q (if ava) N1 E N1C (Combo N2C + Dash when the A4 is activated. Repeat this while you have flying stamina) E.

dehya-lynette-nahida-neuvillette.desc: neuvi dehya nahida lynette. ~25s unoptimized rot, 9-15f random swap delay, 2-4f random action delay. energy & some consistency issues.

bennett-navia-xingqiu-zhongli.desc: Navia Zhongli Xingqiu Bennett. 21s rot. use the 3rd E if available. zhongli refreshes pillar between navia's field time. Feeding Fav particles to navia is crucial for her ER.

kazuha-luminedendro-raiden-sara.desc: Raiden Aggravate with Sara Kazuha DMC

aetherpyro-bennett-citlali-furina.desc: PMC Furina Bennett Citlali. ~20s Rot. PMC VapeMelt. 2E Bennett. PMC uses burst as available after hE N1C and spams N2C/N3D. -4K DPS with Freeze immunity.

albedo-bennett-navia-xiangling.desc: Navia Albedo Xiangling Benntt. 21s rot. Albedo's E is used at the start of the rot, it can be broken during setup and stop generating geo particles. you can recast it but you may lose DPS due to bennett Q and 4NO uptime, extending rotation, etc.

bennett-furina-wriothesley-xilonen.desc: Wrio Furina Xilonen Bennett. Xilonen 2E 20s rot. Wrio Q every other rot.

fischl-kazuha-kokomi-yaemiko.desc: Buff Yae's Burst with Hakushin Ring. Refresh turrets every 12 seconds. Refresh Kokomi's jellyfish before it expires

furina-rosaria-wriothesley-xilonen.desc: Wrio Furina Rosaria Xilonen. Xilonen 2E 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] ( Q / N3C ). Rosaria provides off-field dmg, 4NO and A4 CR buff with her field.

dehya-kuki-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with Dehya (and she does something)

furina-wriothesley-xilonen-yunjin.desc: Wrio Furina Xilonen YunJin. Xilonen 2E 20s rot. Wrio Q every other rot. YunJin picks up the Crystallize Shard for Geo Resonance. 4NO > 4Husk. 4AP isn't that big upgrade over these two. She has manageable ER thanks to Xilonen and multiple Fav proc.

barbara-bennett-chasca-xiangling.desc: Chasca Barbara Xiangling Bennett. ~17s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Xiangling casts Q every other rotation and snapshots Bennett's buff. Pyro% Goblet is ~400 DPS (~1%) better than ATK% Goblet.

kazuha-layla-neuvillette-xiangling.desc: Neuv Xiangling Kazuha Layla. 4CA 32s rot. Neuv with Layla's shield. using layla's burst in the second part leads to cryo swirl in the next rot.

fischl-kaveh-raiden-xianyun.desc: Kaveh Fischl Raiden Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Kaveh-Raiden Quicken Plunge. Kaveh spends plunges in the first half of the rotation, Raiden on-fields in the second. Quicken lingers until the last N3 of Raiden's burst. Kaveh skills off cooldown to meet ER needs. Kaveh C6 introduces Swirl issues. 50% Collisions.

bennett-wriothesley-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Wriothesley melt burst every other rotation. N3CJ combo. 2 Bennett funnels to Xiangling

chongyun-clorinde-fischl-nahida.desc: Clorinde TF Aggravate. Uses C2 Chongyun to use 2 Es in a row per rotation.

fischl-neuvillette-yaemiko-zhongli.desc: Neuv double electro with 4AP Zhongli. 4CA 28s rot. Yae w/o burst. prioritize hydro shard over electro shard.

fischl-ningguang-sara-xilonen.desc: Ningguang Fischl Sara Xilonen. 12-14s Rot. Sara buffs Ningguang using her skill and buffs Fischl every other rotation using her burst.

bennett-chongyun-emilie-rosaria.desc: Chongyun Rosa burnmelt with emilie. Benny swaps often to use his E to refresh burning and for energy. Except for personal damage, Emilie enables unfinished reverie for the cryo characters for good damage gain

fischl-lanyan-ororon-yelan.desc: Lanyan Yelan Ororon Fischl. ~18s Rot. Lanyan Taser in ST. 1E Yelan. Lanyan uses burst first, then spends skill off CD while weaving normal attacks. Lanyan Prefers EEC in ST, 3EM in 2T.

furina-kazuha-lisa-raiden.desc: Raiden Hypercarry with P.Amber Lisa and Furina. ~20s Rotation.

nahida-noelle-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom, Noelle and Nahida Driver

dehya-furina-navia-xilonen.desc: C1 Dehya Furina Navia Xilonen. ~22s rot. Navia is the highest DPS but only does 3 actions, Burst and 2 Skills. Dehya Vaporizes her Burst. Xilonen triggers Hydro Scroll more consistently than Pyro Scroll. 4 Crystallize shards are picked up and Navia holds her Skill to pick up the rest. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. ATK% and Geo DMG% Goblets perform similarly on Navia. GT on Navia is ~1k less DPS. C0 Dehya loses ~4.5k DPS.

bennett-navia-rosaria-zhongli.desc: Navia Zhongli Rosaria Bennett. simple 19s rot. Navia EQ in the first rot for energy. Rosaria 2nd E between Navia's field time for better energy economy. Bennett uses EoSF to meet ER needs with alleyflash. Rosaria holds 4NO instead of him. CD circlet due to Rosaria's CR buff.

emilie-furina-klee-xianyun.desc: Klee Furina Emilie Xianyun. ~23s Rot. Klee Plunge with Furina Vape. 33% Burning Uptime. Hydro VV only. Klee uses skill and the start and end of field time (if available) for better Burning uptime. Klee bursts as available and does CAs between plunges, stamina permitting. 50% Collisions.

furina-noelle-yelan-zhongli.desc: Noelle Zhongli Yelan Furina, AP Zhongli dash to pick up crystallize.

escoffier-fischl-nahida-razor.desc: Razor Nahida Fischl Escoffier. ~21s Rotation. Razor Hybrid Aggravate, leans toward Phys. Nahida's uses burst only when ready after the first rotation. Fischl uses both skill and burst in the first rot, then alternates afterward. Escoffier bursts every other rotation.

bennett-luminepyro-wriothesley-xiangling.desc: Wrio PMC Xiangling Bennett. 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] N4 Q/C. Leave Cryo aura before swapping out to PMC for 4Scroll setup.

clorinde-furina-kirara-kuki.desc: Comfy Clorinde hyperbloom. ~16s rotation with Furina skill every other rot, Clorinde burst when available, otherwise use Kirara and Kuki burst. Shield lasts until last N3E on Clorinde, healing covers full rot and is enough to counter Furina drain on each unit.

furina-lynette-noelle-yelan.desc: double hydro with driver noelle and 4pc VV lynette. atk% goblet is better than dmg% for C2+ lynette. rot can be adjusted for pre-C4 lynette by weaving some additional NAs

bennett-faruzan-thoma-wanderer.desc: Wanderer 2 pyro thoma removed aimshot and added frontload Q

nahida-razor-thoma-xingqiu.desc: Razor Nahida Xingqiu Thoma. ~22s Rot. Razor Chaos in 2T, where Razor & Thoma fight for dendro cores.

kazuha-neuvillette-raiden-yaemiko.desc: neuvi yae raiden kaz. ~28s unoptimized rot, 9-15f random swap delay, 2-4f random action delay. skill bot raiden as a worse alternative to fischl.

arlecchino-layla-rosaria-sucrose.desc: Arle Rosaria Sucrose Layla. 17s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel and N15 spam (6[N3D] is about 1k behind). Sucrose E after Arle E for pyro vv and high EM buff.

bennett-emilie-faruzan-lynette.desc: Lynette Emilie Faruzan Bennett. ~20s Rot. Burning on-field Lynette. Emilie burst every other rot. Bennett and Faruzan use skill and aimed shots between Lynette's skill uses. C6 Bennett is -2K DPS.

dori-furina-nahida-razor.desc: Razor Nahida Furina Dori. ~26s Rot. Razor Hyperbloom with Dori supplying energy to the team.

kuki-luminedendro-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with DMC Xingqiu and Yelan

aetherdendro-cyno-fischl-xilonen.desc: Cyno DMC Fischl Xilonen. ~25s Rot. TF Cyno Aggravate with multiwave Dendro. Xilonen creates a Crystalize for AP DMC to pickup. Fischl uses skill and burst every rotation. Xilonen bursts every rotation.

chiori-fischl-luminegeo-ningguang.desc: on field ning apl triple geo. fischl provides off field damage and application for crystallize, which can provide some survivability, as well as keeping uptime on 4pc nighttime for ning and gmc.

furina-keqing-nahida-sigewinne.desc: TF Keqing Furina Nahida Sigewinne. ~25s rot. Most of Sigewinne's value is predicated on buffing Furina. Nahida is building an unpleasant amount of ER. Keqing investing into EM can lead to higher team DPS.

bennett-chiori-furina-ningguang.desc: on field ning apl with furina offering her buffs and personal damage. benny uses fav so he can burst more often without spending time doing skills.

ayaka-kokomi-lumineanemo-shenhe.desc: Ayaka Shenhe Freeze with AMC support. AMC on Cryo Goblet. 20s rotation. Assumes Tornado hits full duration.

bennett-kazuha-raiden-sara.desc: (First rot Raiden e > Kazuha hEp ) > Sara n1e aim n1 > Bennett q > Kazuha q > Sara q > Raiden q n4e 2 n4d n4 > (Next rots start w/ (Kazuha hEp n2 > Bennet n1 e )

chongyun-escoffier-furina-kazuha.desc: Kazuha Furina Chongyun Escoffier. ~20s Rot. Cryo infused on-field VV Kazuha w/ Chongyun doing N1C and EP and & Burst off CD. -4K DPS with Freeze immunity and MH. Few hydro swirls, with or without Freeze immunity.

beidou-fischl-heizou-nahida.desc: Heizou Nahida Fischl Beidou. ~24s Rot. Full EM on-field Heizou in 2-target with Beidou, Aggravate swirling and bursting twice per rotation to heal the team. 20% Counter, 20% Perfect Counters.

bennett-faruzan-lanyan-xiao.desc: Xiao Faruzan Lan Yan Bennett. 23s rot. 12 high plunges with 50% collision. Lanyan utilizes 2nd E usage every 2 rots if C6 or Sacfragments(Pre-C6). ADC build used, triple ATK is 1k lower. You can test Lan Yan TTDS + Fav Bennett in the config and its about equal.

diluc-emilie-furina-xianyun.desc: Diluc Furina Emilie Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Diluc Burning plunge with Furina Vaping; Hydro VV. UR slightly over CW. Diluc uses 3 skills at the start and end of field time. 50% Collisions.

furina-klee-ororon-xianyun.desc: Klee Furina Ororon Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Klee Plunge with Furina Vape. Low Overload count, Ororon goes before Furina to maximize EC and energy. Hydro/Electro VV only. Klee bursts as available and does CAs between plunges, stamina permitting. 50% Collisions.

bennett-navia-xiangling-yelan.desc: Navia Yelan Xiangling Bennett. 21s rot. Yelan 2E with Fav. Navia is using ATK% sands. Catch R5 on Xiangling is DPS neutral at this investment lvl. But this Fav XL variant will scale well with YL and Navia's investment.

fischl-furina-mika-yelan.desc: On field Fischl with Yelan Furina Mika. Fischl's damage is evenly split between Physical and Electro

bennett-faruzan-wanderer-yunjin.desc: wanderer + yunjin improved with wanderer using ult

furina-mika-wriothesley-yelan.desc: Wriothesley Furina Yelan Mika. ~20s Rot. Wriothesley Freeze. N1E 3[N5CD] N1Q/N3C. 1E Yelan.

bennett-emilie-lisa-xiangling.desc: Lisa Emilie Xiangling Bennett. ~20s Rot. Lisa Overload, with Bennett on field skill spam generating particles for the team and Maintaining Pyro Aura.

escoffier-kaeya-shenhe-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Kaeya Shenhe Escoffier. 20s rot. 5[N3CJ] N3 Q/N1C. Kaeya Q E into Escoffier EQ.

bennett-furina-wanderer-xiangling.desc: wanderer driving furina bennett xiangling core. 20s rotation. wanderer uses fav to battery the team. mostly furina vapes, xiangling vapes around 30% of her damage.

candace-dehya-xiangling-xianyun.desc: Dehya Candace Xiangling Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Dehya forward vaporize plunge with Candace's hydro infusion; pyro supplied by both Xiangling's pyronado and Dehya's skill.

bennett-furina-raiden-sara.desc: Raiden Furina Sara Bennett. 21s rot. Raiden Q 3[N3CD] N1CD E. Low ER needs overall with Raiden double Electro and Bennett 2E.

chevreuse-fischl-razor-xiangling.desc: On field Razor overload. Razor's damage is split between physical and electro, atk phys and electro goblets are close. glad performs similarly to echoes. Chevreuse funnels to Xiangling over Fischl.

dori-fischl-furina-xianyun.desc: Dori Furina Fischl Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Dori Taser Plunge. Lower reaction ownership reliability than Aggravate will cause a bit of waiting for skill CD even with TF. After 3 plunges dori uses burst, Xianyun refeshes VV to fill time, then Fischl bursts. 50% Collisons.

ayato-bennett-furina-xilonen.desc: Ayato Furina Bennett Xilonen. ~25s Rot. Buffed Ayato carries ~50 of the team DPS. 2E Xilonen/Bennett/Ayato to fill time between Ayato skills; Ayato's second skill can catch the end of Bennett's buff.

arlecchino-layla-rosaria-yelan.desc: Arle Yelan Rosaria Layla. 18s rot. No Arle Q, N1 CA dash cancel 5[N3D]. mostly melt. KQMS Random Frame Delay.

bennett-emilie-mavuika-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Emilie Mavuika Bennett. ~19s Rot. Yoimiya burning. Yoimiya does a few extra normal attacks when she doesn't burst just for fighting spirit generation. Emilie & Yoimiya burst every other rot in alternate rotations. Mavuika bursts every rotation. Deepwood Mavuika, Mavuika cannot scroll reliably.

nahida-thoma-xingqiu-zhongli.desc: Thoma Burgeon with Zhongli Nahida Xingqiu

kazuha-lisa-neuvillette-zhongli.desc: Neuvillette with lisa buff does the same damage as he does with Fischl instead due to energy; 9-12f swap delay, 2-4f action delay

cyno-fischl-kirara-nahida.desc: Cyno Nahida Fischl Kirara. ~25s Rot. Cyno Aggravate. Fischl skill + burst every rotation, covering Nahida + Kirara Setup time. Kirara C4 Provides adequate quicken uptime in multiwave.

furina-keqing-sara-xianyun.desc: Keqing Furina Sara Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Keqing Taser Plunge. After 5 plunges, Xianyun refeshes VV. Keqing always catches Sara's crowfeather. Hold skill aerial plunge not implemented. 50% Collisons.

bennett-chevreuse-lisa-raiden.desc: Raiden Chevreuse Lisa Bennett. ~21 Rot. Raiden Overload with Lisa is built for damage. Bennett uses skill again just before and after Raiden burst to refresh Chevreuse A1 RES Shred. Lisa uses hold skill after Raiden burst.

collei-fischl-raiden-sucrose.desc: Raiden aggravate with Sucrose+Collei. Note Sucrose infusion depends on positioning.

bennett-navia-ningguang-xiangling.desc: navia ning double pyro. 20s~ rotation. xiangling uses fav to reach her extremely high er requirements.

chiori-gorou-xilonen-zhongli.desc: Xilonen Zhongli Gorou Chiori. ~15-17s Rot. Xilonen on-field DPS. Zhongli uses his burst when Chiori skill isn't ready. Husk and OC are similar.

chevreuse-fischl-keqing-thoma.desc: Keqing Chev Fischl Thoma. ~18s Rot. Keqing Overload. Keqing spams N1C while protected by Thoma's shield. Fischl misses out on snapshotting Chevreuse's ATK buff in the first rotation.

aetherpyro-fischl-xilonen-yelan.desc: PMC Yelan Fischl Xilonen. ~19s Rot. PMC Overvape DPS. 1E Yelan, 1E Xilonen. PMC uses hold skill and bursts as available between weaving NAs. Xilonen bursts every rotation at the end. OC/Scroll PMC/Xilonen is better than Scroll/AP. Fischl runs full EM.

faruzan-furina-lanyan-wanderer.desc: Wanderer Furina Faruzan Lanyan. No healing, sp Furina only bursts on the first rotation, but Lanyan shields. Widsith Lanyan outperforms ttds.

bennett-fischl-raiden-xiangling.desc: Raiden Fischl Xiangling bennett. 20s rot. use Fischl E at the end of the rot if available(every other rot)

bennett-faruzan-furina-xianyun.desc: Xianyun Furina Faruzan Bennett. ~23s Rot. Xianyun Plunge. Burst Support Bennett is ideal. 50% Collisions.

dori-furina-rosaria-yelan.desc: Rosaria Furina Yelan Dori. ~22s Rot. Rosaria on-field with Superconduct Support Dori. Yelan does 2Es. Dori uses burst after Furina's burst.

fischl-furina-xianyun-xiao.desc: Xiao Furina Fischl Xianyun. 23s Rot. Xiao Taser with VV Xiao and Furina.

cyno-emilie-fischl-xilonen.desc: Cyno Emilie Fischl Xilonen. ~25s Rot. TF Cyno Aggravate with an non-Burning emilie for multiwave Dendro. Xilonen can creating a Crystalize for AP Emilie to pickup, but ToM Emilie performs similarly. Fischl uses skill and burst every rotation.

bennett-kazuha-lyney-nahida.desc: Lyney burning team with TOTM Nahida, Kazuha and Bennett. Not all Lyney charge shots hit weak points, but overall team damage hits above 54k if you hit the weak point each time. TOTM edges out both Deepwood and Golden Troupe on Nahida, but all are viable.

kazuha-raiden-sara-yaemiko.desc: Raiden Sara Yae Mono Electro with Kazuha

bennett-chiori-gorou-ningguang.desc: on field ning apl. gorou offers geo crit dmg, geo dmg% and and his a1 def% is useful for chiori.

fischl-keqing-kirara-lynette.desc: Catgirl Aggravate. Burst every other rotation on Fischl/Kirara/Lynette. Fischl Q/E -> Kirara E(Q) -> Lynette E(Q) -> Keqing EQE -> N1C N1 E N1C N1C.  ~12.5-13s rotation with no Oz downtime and nearly 100% Kirara shield uptime. You want a bit of extra ER on Keqing with how short the rotation is.

lisa-xingqiu-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Lisa eH q > Xingqiu qn1 ed > Yelan q n1 e n1 > Yoimuya n1e 2n5d n5 > Yelan n2e > Lisa n4

ayaka-ganyu-kazuha-mona.desc: Ayaka Ganyu Freeze with Kazuha Mona

escoffier-fischl-furina-razor.desc: Razor Furina Fischl Escoffier. ~24s Rot. Phys Razor in a long field time rotation. Razor stays on field until 3 skill are used, with C4 Def shred lingering over the next rotation setup. Fischl can use both skill and burst in the first rotation.

bennett-ganyu-nahida-xiangling.desc: Melt Ganyu with Nahida Bennett Xiangling

cyno-fischl-nahida-zhongli.desc: 4TF Cyno Aggravate with Fischl Nahida Zhongli, 6N2EN3D N2E, 26s rotation

freminet-rosaria-xianyun-yaemiko.desc: Freminet Rosaria Yae Xianyun. ~19s Rot. Hyper Freminet Phys plunge with Superconduct, no Shatter. Executes 1 lvl 4 Shattering Pressure combo during plunges. 50% Collisions. OHC > SoDP Xianyun, but bubbles may miss. EM support Yae > DMG Yae.

bennett-faruzan-venti-wanderer.desc: Wanderer Faruzan Bennett Venti. The rotation does not buff Venti's Burst with Bennett to maximise buff uptime on Wanderer.  It dynamically adjusts based on the state of Wanderer's A4

faruzan-furina-lanyan-lisa.desc: Lanyan Faruzan Furina Lisa. ~20s Rot. Lanyan-Faruzan Quickswap. Sac Lanyan skills twice per rot with Faruzan aimed shots in between. Pamber Lisa provides the only Furina fanfare. Lisa uses skill while both Anemo units are on CD.

bennett-fischl-freminet-furina.desc: Freminet Furina Fischl Bennett. ~20s Rot. Physical Freminet with Bennett. MH>=PF Freminet. Fischl alternate skill and burst in bennett burst. All but the final Shattering Pressure are buffed. C6 Bennett is -3K DPS.

ayato-fischl-nahida-xiangling.desc: Xiangling Burgeon with Fischl Ayato Nahida

faruzan-furina-kokomi-lanyan.desc: Lanyan Faruzan Furina Kokomi. ~20s Rot. Lanyan-Faruzan Quickswap. Sac Frags Lanyan skill/burst twice/once per rot with Faruzan aimed shots in between. Kokomi refreshes her skill with burst. TTDS lands on Lanyan. EM sands Lanyan is very slightly more DPS for a worse shield.

bennett-chongyun-wriothesley-xiangling.desc: Wrio Chongyun Xiangling Bennett. 20s rot. 5[N3CJ] N3 (Q/C). Chongyun E > Bennett E > Chongyun Q > Bennett QE. Thanks to Chongyun's cd reduction. Wrio can finish his combo a bit earlier than this if needed in practice.

bennett-faruzan-fischl-lynette.desc: Onfield Main DPS Faruzan with adaptive rotation to accomodate fischl, bennett and lynette's different cooldown times.

ayato-beidou-kuki-nahida.desc: Ayato Nahida Beidou Kuki. ~20s Rot. Thundery Fury Ayato with Beidou in 2 target. Hakushin competitive om Nahida. 50% Perfect counter chance.

diona-kazuha-neuvillette-xiangling.desc: Neuv Xiangling Kazuha Diona. Nothing impressive. Not optimized. diona's shield isn't reliable you know. its weak but better than nothing. You can try 4NO on diona in the config.

amber-bennett-lynette-lyney.desc: Lyney Amber Lynette Bennett. ~16s Rot. Lyney pulls rabbits and cats from hats, but IR marrs the stars in combat. The twins take a Fantastic Voyage, while Amber cheers her peers from storage.

bennett-hutao-kazuha-xiangling.desc: Hu Tao does 8 N2CJ. Xiangling and Kazuha burst every other rotation. Team eventually runs into a stamina issue, at the 4th rotation, which isn't simmed.

furina-kazuha-kuki-nahida.desc: Kazuha Nahida Furina Kuki. ~18s Rot. (TF) Kazuha Hyperbloom in 2 Target. Kuki optimally bursts every rotation. Nahida bursts nearly every rotation. VV is close to even with Sac Sword. 70% Collisions.

bennett-charlotte-furina-xiangling.desc: charlotte  enables most of pyronado to melt against freezable enemy and battery the team via fav. the team dps drop heavily if the enemy isn't freezable. n1c charlotte for most cryo app until stamina runs out, then n3d. 20s rotation.

bennett-faruzan-furina-lanyan.desc: Lanyan Faruzan Furina Bennett. ~20s Rot. On-field Faruzan with SubDPS Lanyan. Lanyan uses available skill and burst in Bennett's burst, then Faruzan fires aimed shots with Bennett skills during her downtime.

bennett-emilie-kazuha-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Emilie Kazuha Bennett. 19s rot. Alternating Emilie and Kazuha Q, using on Bennett Q. Bennett can hold 4DM.

bennett-furina-shenhe-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Shenhe Furina Bennett. 20s rot. N3CJ spam. Wrio Q every other rot. Shenhe field time can be put before bennett with ~3k less than this.

furina-lisa-nahida-xianyun.desc: Lisa Nahida Furina Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Lisa Hyperbloom Plunge. Lisa uses hold skill after all plunges are spent for ER.

diona-fischl-neuvillette-xiangling.desc: Neuv Xiangling Fischl Diona Overvape. 4CA 27s rot. Simply [Diona (Q)E > XL (Q)E > Fischl Oz > Neuv] twice. You can try 4NO on Diona in the config.

kuki-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Nahida, Xingqiu, Kuki hyperbloom core, with a Xingqiu N1 Ed N2 in the middle of Nahida's field time in order to proc Favonius twice per rotation while also benefitting from Xingqiu's C4.

bennett-chevreuse-razor-yaemiko.desc: Razor Chevreuse Yae Bennett. ~20s Rot. Pyro Infused Razor deals slightly more Pyro DMG; Yae after Chevreuse, before Bennett. Razor monopolizes Bennett field time. Self-Overloads not implemented.

shenhe-wriothesley-xilonen-yunjin.desc: Wrio Shenhe YunJin Xilonen. ~17s rot, w/o using Xilonen Q. 5[N3CJ]. 4Husk on YunJin is huge -15% team DPS drop from 4AP.

fischl-furina-mavuika-mizuki.desc: Mizuki Furina Fischl Mavuika. ~25s rotations. Fav mizuki uses skill for half the rotation, and drives fischl c6 with normal attacks in the second half. OC Mavuika is ~3.5k worse

furina-mavuika-xianyun-xiao.desc: Xiao Furina Mavuika Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Xiao does 12 plunges with Mauvika & Furina vaporizing. VV Xiao + SoDP Xianyun >= LNO Xiao + VV Xianyun. Mauvika bursts every other rotation; Mavuika prefers Scroll to OC. 50% Collisions.

alhaitham-emilie-raiden-xianyun.desc: Alhaitham Emilie Raiden Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Alhaitham Quicken Plunge. AlHaitham uses skill, spams JlPN1, then bursts, followed by abbreviated Raiden field time. Emilie is delivered enough energy to burst every rotation. OHC > SoDP Xianyun, but Bubbles may miss. 60% Collisions.

ayato-citlali-furina-xilonen.desc: Ayato Furina Citlali Xilonen. 25-26s rot. Start with Xilonen Q before Furina ED Q. Use Citlali Q waiting Ayato E cd.

bennett-chiori-fischl-zhongli.desc: ~16s rotation; bennett and chiori just quickswap between each other. comfy team with zhongli shield.

fischl-kazuha-layla-neuvillette.desc: Neuv Fischl Kazuha Layla. 4CA 30s rot. 3 Stacks of Neuv A1. Layla's shield covering C0 Neuv field time. mostly hydro swirl. 9-15f Random swap delay.

cyno-furina-mika-yelan.desc: Cyno Yelan Furina Mika. ~22s Rot. Physical Cyno N3CD spam, skilling off CD. E Yelan.

chevreuse-fischl-thoma-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Fischl Chevreuse Thoma. 18s rot. Yoimiya burst every other rot, if not available do some NAs to make it 18s rot.

bennett-nahida-wriothesley-xiangling.desc: Wriothesley melt burst every other rotation. Nahida burst every other rotation. N3CJ combo. 2 Bennett funnels to Xiangling

fischl-freminet-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Freminet Rosaria Fischl Xianyun. ~18s Rot. Hyper Freminet Phys plunge with Superconduct, no Shatter. Executes 1 lvl 4 Shattering Pressure combo during plunges. 50% Collisions. OHC > SoDP Xianyun, but bubbles may miss.

fischl-lisa-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Yae Fishcl Aggravate with Nahida and Lisa

fischl-furina-lanyan-ororon.desc: Lanyan Furina Ororon Fischl. ~20s Rot. Lanyan Taser in ST. Furina only bursts in the first rotation; DPS significant in subsequent rotations. Lanyan uses burst first, then spends skill off CD while weaving normal attacks. Fischl alternates skill & burst.

bennett-lanyan-mavuika-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Mavuika Lan Yan Bennett. 20s rot. 3[N5CD] N3 (Q/C). Lan Yan between Bennett Q and Wrio field time. Lan Yan can also use 4VV to increase Mavuika and her own personal damage. Due to N5CD combo, Wrio C1 is ~8k more DPS, being huge 21%/16% personal/team DPS increase.

clorinde-furina-kirara-nahida.desc: Clorinde Furina Nahida Kirara. 20s rot. Nahida directly eats up Kirara's particles. Kirara's Fav also helps Furina's ER. Kirara's shield covers most of Clorinde's field time. Clorinde Q when available at the end.

fischl-lanyan-nahida-yaemiko.desc: Lanyan Nahida Fischl Yae. ~16s Rot. Lanyan Aggravate in a simple rotation. Lanyan uses burst first for grouping, then spends skill off CD while weaving normal attacks. Lanyan deals the plurality of team DPS in 2T. Yae weaves in NAs before and after skill in subsequent rotations. EDC > EEC. Anemo > Electro Goblet even in 2T.

furina-ororon-sayu-yaemiko.desc: Sayu Furina Yae Fischl. ~22s Rot. Sayu Taser with a max duration roll. Yae bursts every other rotation and fills time for Sayu's cooldown. Whimsy Purity edges out Widsith GT Yae.

chiori-fischl-gorou-itto.desc: Itto Chiori Gorou with Fischl. Fischl alternates between skill and burst.

collei-raiden-sucrose-xingqiu.desc: 25s Sucrose hyperbloom with on-field Raiden at the end of the rotation.

bennett-emilie-hutao-yelan.desc: Hutao Emilie Yelan Bennett. ~18s Rot. Burning Hutao does 6N3CJ N1CJ. Burstless Hutao. Yelan does most of the Vaping.

lisa-neuvillette-ororon-xilonen.desc: Neuv Ororon Lisa Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Lisa w/o using hold E. Xilonen and 2 Natlan units allow frequent 2pc Scroll proc for Lisa to have low enough ER.

fischl-kirara-mavuika-razor.desc: Razor Mavuika Fischl Kirara. ~20s Rot. Razor Quickburn with Kirara C4 providing Dendro into Razor's burst uptime while full EM Mauvika offers off-field Pyro. Mavuika bursts every rotation. Fischl alternates skill and burst just before Razor. Kirara doesn't burst at all and builds full HP.

faruzan-luminegeo-xiao-zhongli.desc: Xiao Faruzan GMC Zhongli. Zhongli EN1 > Luminegeo N1QDE > Faruzan N1Q > Xiao 12JhP. All members force Favonius procs. 50% Collisions.

bennett-ororon-raiden-yelan.desc: Raiden Yelan Ororon Bennett. 18s rot. Ororon can hold damage oriented weapon at the cost of Raiden's personal damage.

baizhu-freminet-furina-kuki.desc: Freminet Furina Kuki Baizhu. ~23s Rot. Freminet Hyperbloom with Baizhu. Kuki after Baizhu is slightly better; avoid normal attacking with Kuki(C4). Deepwood Baizhu is marginally better than Clam. -4K DPS with freeze immunity.

fischl-kazuha-nahida-sucrose.desc: good at grouping. nahida hEQ > fischl N1E > kazuha N1hEPQ > sucrose N2EDQCN1 > nahida N2EN2C > fischl N2Q > kazuha EP > sucrose N4CN4EDN1 > kazuha EP

chiori-shenhe-wriothesley-zhongli.desc: Wrio Double Geo ft. Petra Shenhe. Shenhe Bursts when available and Wrio alternates between Burst and N2C at the end of his 5[N3CJ] combo. Rotation in config. Random Frame Delays.

fischl-keqing-lisa-nahida.desc: Keqing FIschl Aggravate with Lisa and Nahida

chiori-fischl-freminet-zhongli.desc: Freminet Fischl Chiori Zhongli. ~18s Rot. Physical Freminet Double Geo with 60% Phys shred. No burst Chiori. Freminet bursts every rotation.

mona-mualani-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Mualani Mona Zhongli Xiangling. 20s rot. Q if available + 3[3-stacked bite]. Mona C1 is beneficial. Xiangling Q every rot. Mona uses her E at the rotation downtime. 4AP is crucial (more than 10% DPS increase).

alhaitham-kuki-nahida-tighnari.desc: Alhaitham TIghari Nahdia. ~25s Rot. Triple Dendro Spread. Tighnari uses skill twice per rotation. Kuki bursts in AlHaitham's Burst window. Techincally, Ins Kuki, DM Nahdia, and scroll Tighnari is ideal for team DPS.

collei-kuki-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with Driver Yelan, Xingqiu and Collei

fischl-lanyan-yaemiko-yelan.desc: Lanyan Yelan Yae Fischl. ~25s Rot. Lanyan Taser in ST. 2E Yelan; Fischl Skill and Burst every rotation. Lanyan uses burst first, then spends skill off CD while weaving normal attacks. Burstless Yae.

bennett-furina-luminegeo-xiangling.desc: xl benny furina gmc. gmc provides petra and c1 buff, energy, and personal damage. 3 short hold gmc skills. 2 benny lvl 1 hold skills and one tap. r5 fav gmc to get multiple procs. 20s rotation.

furina-mika-razor-yelan.desc: Razor Furina Yelan Mika. ~20s Rot. Superconduct and Mika's C6 cover the duration of Razor's field time. Razor Atk > Phys Goblet. Mika Clam > SoDP > NO.

charlotte-furina-ganyu-kazuha.desc: Ganyu Furina Kazuha Charlotte. ~21s Rot. On-field Freeze DPS Ganyu in two target does 2 Es per rotation. Assumes freezable enemies and high ability to headshot.

fischl-wanderer-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Wanderer EC with Fischl and DOuble Hydro

bennett-emilie-hutao-zhongli.desc: Emilie burts only if she has it and only from second rotation onwards. Hu Tao has stamina issues so she needs to stall by doing N4 at the end of rotations.

eula-fischl-xianyun-yaemiko.desc: Eula Yae Fischl Xianyun. ~18s Rot. Eula Phys plunge with Superconduct. Eula uses tEQhE if burst is available, other using tEN2, then hE after plunges. OHC > VV Xianyun, but bubbles may miss. 50% Collisions.

bennett-chiori-ningguang-zhongli.desc: Ningguang Zhongli Bennett Chiori. APL. Ningguang on Field.

bennett-furina-keqing-yelan.desc: Keqing Yelan Furina Bennett. ~22s Rot. Pyro Keqing on-field spamming CA. She only detonates the Lightning stilleto with a CA to save time. Keqing bursts after Yelan's burst expires to conserve stamina. 2E Yelan. No healing to Furina/Bennett.

fischl-navia-yelan-zhongli.desc: Navia Zhongli Fischl Yelan. Yelan 1E 18s rot. simple and easy to follow.

ayaka-lumineanemo-shenhe-yelan.desc: Ayaka Shenhe Freeze with AMC Support ft. Yelan. AMC on Cryo Goblet. ~21s rotation. Assumes Tornado hits full duration.

bennett-emilie-rosaria-shenhe.desc: Onfield emilie providing pyro for rosaria reverse melt. Emilie and shenhe burst every other rot. Quickswappy rotation to get more energy from rosaria/bennett.

bennett-xilonen-yoimiya-yunjin.desc: Yoimiya YunJin Xilonen Bennett. 18s rot. Picking up the shard is required for Geo Resonance buff. 4NO Bennett is 3k loss from 4AP.

fischl-freminet-xianyun-yaemiko.desc: Freminet Yae Fischl Xianyun. ~19s Rot. Hyper Freminet Phys plunge with Superconduct, no Shatter. Executes 1 lvl 4 Shattering Pressure combo during plunges. OHC > SoDP Xianyun, but bubbles may miss. 50% Collisions.

bennett-emilie-nahida-razor.desc: Razor Nahida Emilie Bennett. ~23s Rot. Razor Quickload with 64%/54% Burning/Quicken uptime. SS may be inconsistent. Self-Overloads not implemented.

bennett-furina-luminehydro-xiangling.desc: xl benny furina hmc. hmc use the full hold skill providing hydro application for xl to vape, energy for furina, and hydro resonance. r5 fav to get multiple procs. dps depends slightly on target size for hmc burst hits.

cyno-nahida-xingqiu-yaoyao.desc: Cyno with Xingqiu Yaoyao and Nahida

bennett-faruzan-kazuha-xiao.desc: Xiao with Kazuha C6 Faruzan and Benentt

ganyu-navia-rosaria-zhongli.desc: Navia Zhongli Ganyu Rosaria. 17s rot. Navia swaps out earlier than usual to shorten the rot length

bennett-faruzan-furina-kazuha.desc: Crit Kazuha/Faruzan quickswap. Options for VV Faruzan and 2p Anemo/Atk or Emblem Kazuha in the config. GT on Faruzan and VV on Kazuha is slightly better than other options.

fischl-kirara-mizuki-yaemiko.desc: Mizuki Yae Kirara Fischl. Yae bursts every rotation other than the first. One mizuki skill and 2 oz casts per 25s rot. Fischl does over half of the team's damage in single target.

arlecchino-nahida-yelan-zhongli.desc: Arlechinno Nahida Yelan Zhongli. ~18s Rot. Arlechinno with Token Burgeon, with Zhongli Keeping the team alive. Burstless Nahida. Zhongli could technically hold Deepwood.

chongyun-escoffier-freminet-xianyun.desc: Freminet Escoffier Chongyun Xianyun. ~18s Rot. Freminet Cryo Plunge. Chongyun uses Skill just before Xianyun and the Cryo infusion lasts for all 8 plunges. Xianyun VV also lasts for all 8 plunges. 50% Collisions.

lisa-raiden-xiangling-xingqiu.desc: Lisa n1q > Xingqiu q ed n2 > Xiangling q n1ed > Raiden n1q 3n4d n4e n2 > Lisa n1 hE n2 - "Raiden Nationalisa"

bennett-emilie-kirara-xiangling.desc: Emilie burn quickswap. Keep funneling bennett to xl, and kirara to emilie to reduce er req of the whole team.  In the gaps onfield emilie to get bennett buff

ororon-wanderer-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Wanderer Ororon Yelan Xingqiu. ~21 Rot. Wanderer Taser with VV Wanderer NA spam. Wanderer ends his field time with Q or lPDN1. 1E Yelan.

chiori-gorou-navia-yelan.desc: Navia Chiori Gorou Yelan. Yelan 2E 21s rot. Used 3[N2D] navia due to its longer rot length. You may want navia's shorter combo to line up yelan E timing.

bennett-kazuha-lisa-nahida.desc: Lisa Kazuha Nahida Bennett. ~20s Rot. Lisa Overload in 2 Target, with Bennett & Kazuha on-field maintaining Pyro Aura. UR Bennett is better than support sets. Lesser performance in ST.

bennett-candace-furina-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Furina Candace Bennett 20s rot. Furina & Candace C6's hydro for Yoimiya vaporize. Noblesse is better than instructor.

bennett-faruzan-furina-lynette.desc: hyper buffed dps lynette. 20s rotation. c5 bennett is slightly higher dps than c6.

bennett-dehya-furina-xilonen.desc: C1 Dehya Bennett Furina Xilonen. ~20s rot. Pyro Scroll is consistent. Dehya might miss a Vape on her first punch. Furina can Vape a few hits during setup time. Xilonen uses her burst before Furina. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. C0 Dehya loses ~7.5k DPS.

bennett-emilie-furina-kazuha.desc: Kazuha Furina Emilie Bennett. ~20s Rot. Kazuha and Bennett use skills as available to apply Pyro. Bennett builds EM. Emilie on fields during downtime for more Bennett burst buffing. 70% Collisions. Swirling Hydro mutiple times per rotation may be problematic in as targets increase.

aetherpyro-bennett-furina-yelan.desc: PMC Furina Yelan Bennett. ~20s Rot. PMC double Hydro Vape with OC. 1E Yelan, 2E Bennett. PMC does N1 hE N1 Q into N3C/N3D spam. OC/Scroll PMC/Bennett narrowly beats Scroll/NO PMC/Bennett.

cyno-kuki-nahida-yelan.desc: Kuki Cyno Hyperbloom with Nahida and Yelan

barbara-furina-xianyun-yelan.desc: Barbara Furina Yelan Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Barbara Hydro Plunge. 2E Yelan. 50% Collisions. Not very optimized.

bennett-nahida-razor-yelan.desc: Razor Nahida Yelan Bennett. ~22s Rotation. Razor Hyperburgeon with C6 Bennet and 1xE Yelan. Self overloads not implemented.

dori-furina-nahida-sayu.desc: Sayu Nahida Furina Dori. ~23s Rot. Max roll duration for Sayu. Full EM Sayu & Dori. Dori can help Sayu absorb Electro with her windwheel.

baizhu-freminet-furina-raiden.desc: Freminet Furina Fischl Baizhu. ~23s Rot. Freminet Hyperbloom with Baizhu. Raiden uses the first hit of her burst if available. PF = MH if using Serpent Spine.

chiori-furina-noelle-zhongli.desc: Noelle Zhongli Furina Chiori, APL version. Chiori only uses Burst when Furina's fanfare is 200 points or more.

dori-furina-kazuha-mizuki.desc: Mizuki Furina Dori Kazuha. Double-anemo electrocharged 2T team ~20s rot. VV mizuki + GD kazuha has ~1k dps loss.

bennett-dehya-faruzan-wanderer.desc: Wanderer + Dehya improved. R5 fav could fix the small er issues, but sticking to r3. Wanderer uses Q as frontload

bennett-fischl-furina-razor.desc: Razor Furina Fischl Bennett. ~20s Rot. Overvape Razor using C6 Bennett. ATK > Pyro Goblet. Fischl Q/E in Bennett Q. Self-Overloads not implemented.

escoffier-lynette-shenhe-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Lynette Shenhe Escoffier. 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] N3 (Q). Lynette uses 2nd E with her C4+ batterying Shenhe.

fischl-lanyan-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Lanyan Xingqiu Fischl Yelan. ~25s Rot. Lanyan Taser double Hydro with 2E Slingshot Yelan commanding the largest portion of team DPS.

chiori-gorou-ningguang-zhongli.desc: on field ning apl mono geo. gorou provides geo dmg% to ning, def to chiori, and geo crit damage to both. zl provides shield for survivability and geo resonance. ning does not get full value of nighttime since there is no crystallize.

bennett-ganyu-rosaria-xiangling.desc: Melt Xiangling with Rosaria and ganyu

charlotte-furina-navia-zhongli.desc: Navia Zhongli Furina Charlotte. 22s rot. use navia 3rd E if available. it is required to force fav to be triggered. zhongli and charlotte comes in between navia's field time to trigger 2nd fav proc.

chiori-xilonen-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Chiori Xilonen. 18s rot. Xilonen Q every rot for healing. Use either Yoimiya or Chiori Q at the end of the rot. Dash to pick up the shard for better Geo Resonance uptime. Xilonen/Chiori's Constellations would be nice for this team.

ayaka-nahida-thoma-xingqiu.desc: Ayaka Oven: Xingqiu E d Q N1, Nahida EQ N1, Thoma E N1 Q N1, Ayaka d N1 E d Q d 2N3CD N3C E d N1

bennett-fischl-gorou-navia.desc: Navia Gorou Fischl Bennett. 18s rot. Fav gorou feeding navia energy. he doesn't use burst. 4totm to buff navia's first E

bennett-fischl-neuvillette-xiangling.desc: Xiangling overvape with Neuvillette. Remember to refresh Fischl oz and Xiangling guoba stuff when you see Oz expire - Optimise random delay sim - 2-4 frames delay between non-bufferable actions, 9-15 frames of swap delay

fischl-lisa-nahida-raiden.desc: Raiden Fischl Aggravate with Nahida Lisa

furina-keqing-nahida-xianyun.desc: Keqing Nahida Furina Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Keqing Quickbloom Plunge. Xianyun only applies VV in the second half of the rotation. Hold skill aerial plunge not implemented. 50% Collisons.

chevreuse-fischl-mavuika-razor.desc: Razor Chevreuse Fischl Mavuika. ~20s Rot. Razor Overload. As the sole healing, Chevreuse builds for HP. Mauvika bursts every rotation. Mauvika prefers to build Full EM.

escoffier-furina-razor-rosaria.desc: Razor Furina Rosaria Escoffier. ~26s Rot. Phys Razor in a long field time rotation with long lasting support effects. Razor stays on field until 3 skills are used, with his C4 Def shred lingering over the next rotation setup. Razor should also lead with skill. Superconduct and Rosaria's C6 RES Shred lingers long past Razor's field time.

bennett-citlali-dehya-escoffier.desc: C1 Dehya Bennett Citlali Escoffier. 20s rot. Non-TTDS friendly rotation. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. Small delay added to Melt Dehya's kick a bit more consistently. C0 Dehya loses ~6k DPS.

nahida-xiangling-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Xiangling Burgeon with Nahida Xingqiu Yelan

yelan-yoimiya-yunjin-zhongli.desc: Zhongli N1ED > Yelan EQ N1 > Yunjin hE N1 Q N1 > Yoimiya E 3N5D N2

chongyun-dehya-nahida-xianyun.desc: Dehya Chongyun Nahida Xianyun. ~16s Rot. Dehya Melt Plunge. Uses Dehya just before plunging for Burning aura. Nahida bursts every other rotation. Chongyun uses E before Xianyun. 50% Collisions.

freminet-nahida-thoma-xingqiu.desc: Freminet Burgeon team. He'll be driving the burgeon core of Nahida, XQ and Thoma with his burst combo. Assumes 5 stacks of SS on Freminet.

baizhu-emilie-furina-klee.desc: Klee Furina Emilie Baizhu. ~20s Rot. Klee Burngeon with Emilie. Klee bursts every rot when available. Emilie bursts every rotation after the first. Similar damage from Klee, Emilie, and Furina.

charlotte-eula-furina-raiden.desc: Eula Furina Raiden Charlotte. ~22s Rot. Eula with Charlotte. Charlotte uses Hold E and particles are caught by Eula. Raiden does Q N4D N4.

charlotte-freminet-furina-yelan.desc: Freminet Furian Yelan Charlotte. ~25s Rot. Phys-Shatter Freminet with attack buffs from Charlotte.

furina-mizuki-ororon-sigewinne.desc: 2T Mizuki EC team with Sigewinne. Skips Mizuki burst since Sigewinne covers healing. Mizuki 2N1C + C at the end to cover CDs for rotation length.

bennett-chiori-ningguang-yelan.desc: on field ning apl with yelan's off field damage and buff.

citlali-xilonen-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Citlali Xilonen. ~18s Rot. Yoimiya Vapemelt. Pyro Scroll by Citlali is merely incidental past the first rotation, as Yoimiya uses burst when Xilonen does not burst. -5K DPS with Freeze immnunity.

ayaka-bennett-navia-zhongli.desc: Standard Navia core with Ayaka as flex

ayato-collei-fischl-thoma.desc: Thoma Burgeon with Ayato Collei and Fischl.

aetheranemo-ayaka-rosaria-shenhe.desc: Ayaka Shenhe Rosaria Mono Cryo with AMC. No sustain unit. Assumes Tornado hits full duration.

candace-furina-jean-yelan.desc: Jean Candace Yelan Furina. ~22s rotation. On field Hydro Jean. 2xE Yelan E.

chongyun-escoffier-kazuha-xianyun.desc: Kazuha Chongyun Escoffier Xianyun. ~19s Rot. Kazuha Cryo plunge. Kazuha hEP 6[JhPD] (Q) tEP. Chongyun passes particles to Xianyun. Escoffier only bursts when ready. 100% Collision from skill plunges, 60% collisions from Starwicker.

freminet-furina-mika-yaemiko.desc: KQMS 4MH Freminet with Yae. Furina EdQ > Yae 3E > Mika QE > Frem EQ N2 EE 4N2E N3 E. Full EM Evenstar Yae outperforms Purity/Widsith Yae.

beidou-fischl-sucrose-xingqiu.desc: Improved Sucrose Taser (assumes Beidou has a 30% chance to full counter).

bennett-furina-lumineanemo-xiangling.desc: amc furina xl benny. 20s rotation . amc absorb pyro with burst. mostly furina vape, but xl get some vapes. amc perform one tap e and one hold e. r5 fav to get multiple procs

bennett-jean-raiden-sara.desc: Raiden Hyper with Sunfire Jean Bennett and Sara

bennett-chevreuse-dehya-fischl.desc: C1 Dehya Bennett Fischl Chevreuse. 25s rot. Chevreuse is on a damage build to fill downtime (needs C4). Dehya has half Overloaded ownership so EM is valuable. EM sands is a ~600 DPS increase. Rainslasher and Mailed Flower are similar DPS to Serpent Spine. Fischl is a bigger portion of the team's DPS than Dehya. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. Scroll on Bennett is ~1k more DPS. C0 Dehya loses ~4k DPS.

bennett-kazuha-lyney-venti.desc: Lyney with double anemo in 2T: Lyney, Bennett, Venti, Kazuha. Lyney 3CA Rotation with Venti burst snapshotting Bennett buff.

fischl-kirara-nahida-tighnari.desc: Tighnari Triple Dendro with non-4TF Fischl and 4Instructor Kirara. Nahida and Tighnari are on-field

faruzan-furina-sucrose-xianyun.desc: Sucrose Faruzan Furina Xianyun. ~19s Rot. Sucrose plunge. Sucrose spends skills and burst before plunging. 50% Collisions.

kazuha-tartaglia-xingqiu-yelan.desc: tart yelan xingqiu kazuha with fav yelan isshin xq, same tart string as internat

bennett-furina-wriothesley-yelan.desc: Yelan does 2 E's per rotation. Bennett does QE so he heals himself. Yelan has to stall for a bit after doing 2nd E because her E has a 10s cooldown.

fischl-sethos-xilonen-yelan.desc: Sethos Yelan Fischl Xilonen. ~18s Rot. Sethos Taser. 8N2W. Sethos encloses his burst with skill uses and fires 2 Shadowpiecing shots after burst ends. Sethos EM goblet optimal. Xilonen funnels particles to Yelan.

chiori-furina-kokomi-ningguang.desc: Ningguang Chiori Furina Kokomi. 20s~ rotation. Onfield Ningguang and Kokomi. Dashing for picking crystallize shards.

collei-fischl-lisa-zhongli.desc: Lisa Fischl Aggravate with Collei and zhongli

freminet-furina-mika-yelan.desc: Freminet Furian Yelan Mika. ~25s Rot. Phys Shatter-Freminet uses Mika's speed to add one more Yelan dice proc between skill uses.

navia-rosaria-shenhe-zhongli.desc: Navia Zhongli Rosaria Shenhe. 20s rot. use navia's 3rd E if available. Shenhe buffs Rosaria and Navia's E(15% DMG), and enables cryo resonance.

furina-raiden-xianyun-xiao.desc: Xiao Furina Raiden Xianyun. ~25s Rot. Xiaoden Taser. 8 plunges. You can do 1 more plunge at no loss to DPS. Raiden does just QN4EN4. Low ER req leads to significant Furina damage. 50% Collisions.

faruzan-furina-kazuha-xianyun.desc: Kazaha Faruzan Furina Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Kazuha-Faruzan Quickswap. Kazuha skills off CD with Faruzan aimed shots/Xianyun plunges in-between. MH > GT Faruzan despite low Field time. OHC Xianyun with VV Faruzan is better paper DPS, but Bubbles may miss. TTDS lands on Kazuha. 100% Collisions on Kazuha, 50% on Xianyun.

lisa-nahida-raiden-sara.desc: Raiden Aggravate with Nahida Sara Lisa

bennett-emilie-yoimiya-zhongli.desc: Yoimiya Emilie Zhongli Bennett. 18s rot. Emilie Q every 2rots on Bennett Q. Zhongli can hold 4DM

chevreuse-dehya-fischl-yaemiko.desc: Dehya Burst OL with Chev c6. 25s rotation for fischl. With Chev c0-3, second hE needs to be dropped, fill with another yae n2 at the end. At Dehya c2 she can drop ER and run Vourukasha's Glow.

baizhu-furina-nahida-razor.desc: Razor Furina Baizhu Nahida. 17s field time Razor Furina Quickbloom w/ ~65% Quicken uptime.

bennett-kaeya-rosaria-xiangling.desc: quickswap reverse melt. 21s~ rotation. 3 kaeya and 3 rosa skills. xiangling get some forward melts.

aetheranemo-fischl-kirara-sara.desc: AMC Aggravate DPS buffed by Kujou Sara, carried by Fischl. EM/Electro/Crit. Assumes Tornado hits at full duration.

escoffier-faruzan-lanyan-rosaria.desc: Lanyan Faruzan Rosaria Escoffier. ~19s Rot. Lanyan-Faruzan Quickswap double Cryo for Resonance and Rosaria for additional CR to the team. Sac Lanyan builds a bit of ER to burst every rotation and skills twice per rot with Faruzan aimed shots and Rosaria's skill inbetween. Lanyan appreciates catching Rosaria's particles. Escoffier bursts every other rotation.

furina-mizuki-ororon-sucrose.desc: Mizuki Furina Ororon Sucrose. Double-anemo electrocharged 2T team 20~21s rot. Sucrose attack after mizuki's on-field time to reduce er rerequirement. Refinement of sacfrag of mizuki does not matter. For furina cons < 4, there is no need to burst every rot.

aetherpyro-bennett-citlali-yelan.desc: PMC Yelan Bennett Citlali. ~19s Rot. PMC VapeMelt. 1E Yelan, 2E Bennett. PMC uses burst as available after skill and N3C/N3D. -8K DPS with Freeze immunity.

bennett-dehya-escoffier-skirk.desc: C1 Dehya Bennett Skirk Escoffier. ~21s rot. Skirk hE twice and Q once. Dehya does not Melt. Escoffier casts her Q when it's available. Escoffier uses her abilities outside Bennett's Q and Melts her Skill. Skirk is the highest portion of team DPS and Melts 2 hits of her Q. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. C0 Dehya loses ~2.5k DPS.

kirara-nahida-tighnari-yaemiko.desc: Tighnari Triple Dendro with 4GT Burstless Yae and 4Instructor Kirara. You can try key on kirara here

ganyu-kazuha-layla-shenhe.desc: Ganyu Mono Cryo with Kazuha Shenhe Layla

xingqiu-yelan-yoimiya-zhongli.desc: Vape Yoimiya with DOuble Hydro and Zhongli

chiori-freminet-yelan-zhongli.desc: Freminet Yelan Chiori Zhongli. ~19s Rot. Physical Freminet Double Geo with Shatter. Burstless Chiori. Freminet bursts every rotation.

furina-ganyu-wriothesley-xilonen.desc: Wrio Furina Ganyu Xilonen. Xilonen 2E 21-22s rot. 5[N3CJ] ( Q / N3C ). Ganyu provides off-field dmg, 4NO and A4 Cryo DMG% buff with her field.

aetherpyro-bennett-emilie-fischl.desc: PMC Emilie Fischl Bennett. ~20s Rot. PMC Overburn. Near Zero Quicken uptime, 3EM Fischl is more damage. Emilie bursts every other rotation and carries the plurality of team DPS

bennett-furina-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Bennett Nahida Furina Xingqiu. ~22s Rot. Bennett Burgeon Vape with Furina & Xingqiu. Fanfare generation drops after the first rotation; Bennett recieves all healing. Noticeably better survivability than other 2x Hydro options.

candace-furina-kazuha-xianyun.desc: Kauzha Furina Candace Xianyun. ~19s Rot. Kazuha Hydro Plunge. Kazuha bookends Xianyun plunges with skill plunges. Kazuha only uses his burst after spending all plunges. Candace passes particles to Furina in the next rotation. 100% collisions for skill plunges, 70% Starwicker plunges.

bennett-candace-furina-xiangling.desc: Candace Furina Xiangling Bennett. ~20s Rot. Candace Furinational with Bennett funneling Xiangling's burst, then skill spam for the rest of the rotation. Candace's C6 & infusion increase AoE Hydro uptime while vaping Bennett's skill.

bennett-jean-shenhe-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Shenhe Jean Bennett. 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] N3. Wrio Q when ready. Jean requires high ER even with 2Es per rot. Fav is recommended.

fischl-nahida-tighnari-zhongli.desc: Tighnari Nahida with 4GT Fischl and Zhongli hold E twice in 25s rot. Nahida is on-field instead during his downtime.

fischl-nahida-xiao-yaemiko.desc: Yae Fischl Aggravate with Nahida and On field Xiao

furina-nahida-razor-xilonen.desc: Razor Furina Nahida Xilonen. ~25s Rot. Razor Quickbloom with Xilonen. 2E xilonen creating both Electro and Hydro Crystallize.

escoffier-furina-itto-yelan.desc: Itto Escoffier Furina Yelan. ~22-23s rotation. Itto running Favonius Greatsword to lower the team and his very high personnal ER req (2 Fav procs per rotations). Whiteblind is around 2-3k DPS loss due to having higher ER req for Escoffier and himself

candace-furina-xianyun-yelan.desc: Furina Candace Yelan Xianyun. ~22s Rot. C0 Furina Hydro Plunge with N1 cancels. 1E Yelan. VV expires before the final two plunges.

beidou-nahida-xingqiu-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Burgeon with Beidou: Beidou E > Nahida N1EQ > Xingqiu EDQN1 > Beidou QN1E > Yoimiya E 4N5D

faruzan-furina-lynette-sayu.desc: Hypercarry Lynette with Sayu. Triple anemo lowers Faruzan's er requirements and enable her to run damage weapon. Sayu prefers ADC build because of Faruzan's and Furina's buffs.

barbara-collei-nahida-nilou.desc: Nilou Bloom with Collei Nahida and Barbara

fischl-kazuha-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Fischl Kazuha. avg 20s rot. use Yoi Q or CA for pyro swirl. 4GD ATK% sands. 4SR or 4CW is a bit weaker.

albedo-bennett-chiori-ningguang.desc: on field ning apl. chiori burst when ready. albedo does not burst

bennett-dehya-escoffier-furina.desc: C1 Dehya Bennett Furina Escoffier. ~21s rot. Escoffier casts her Burst when it's available. Escoffier uses her abilities inside Bennett's Burst and attempts to Melt them. Escoffier and Dehya are the highest portion of team DPS. Reactions are inconsistent. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. VS Freezable enemies with gear change is ~1.5k less DPS. Scroll on Bennett is ~400 more DPS. GT on Furina + HP% Goblet is ~200 more DPS at the expense of Dehya's personal DPS. C0 Dehya loses ~4k DPS.

beidou-bennett-emilie-fischl.desc: Beidou Emilie Fischl Bennett. Beidou Quickburn with C6 Bennett's Infusion. Tries to use a small enemy burning AoE Damage to activate Beidou C4, but this will still be inconsistent due to Beidou's C1 shield, Q damage reducation, and Emilie's burning damage reduction. Despite questionable Serpent Spine uptime, it's still better than Talking Stick without refines. Beidou bursts as available. As CA is not implemented, Beidou does N2D to E of CD.  25% perfect counter, 25% counter. Deepwood Bennett edges out NO. Burning DMG actives bennett ER passive. Self-Overloads not implemented.

bennett-furina-yoimiya-yunjin.desc: Yoimiya Furina YunJin Bennett. 20s rot. YunJin 2Es per rot. Furina doesn't get bennett healing.

baizhu-cyno-fischl-nahida.desc: Cyno Nahida Fischl Baizhu. ~25s Rot. Cyno Aggravate. Fischl skill + burst every rotation, covering Nahida + Baizhu Setup time. Baizhu provides adequate multiwave Dendro.

alhaitham-fischl-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Xingqiu Fischl Nahida

bennett-chongyun-nahida-rosaria.desc: Burn melt Chongyun and Rosaria with updated stats and rotation

dori-eula-furina-shenhe.desc: Eula Furina Shenhe Dori. ~21s Rot. Eula manages her ER needs with 3 Favs; Shenhe passes her particles to Eula Before and after Eula's burst; Dori increases her ER and restores some flat energy to Eula after her burst animaton. 78% Base Phys RES Shred; Shenhe's burst Phys RES shred expires immeditately after Eula's Lightfall sword drops.

bennett-furina-lynette-yelan.desc: Lynette Furina Yelan Bennett. ~22s Rot. DPS Lynette spams CAs in Bennett burst. ATK Goblet Lynette deals Anemo > Pyro > Hydro Damage.

dehya-fischl-nahida-razor.desc: Razor Nahida Fischl Deyha. ~20s Rot. Razor with 16s of Field time. Nahida bursts every other rotation starting 2nd Rot. Fischl alternates skill and burst.

ganyu-shenhe-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Xilonen Ganyu Xiangling Shenhe. Ganyu melt. Xiangling alternates between Guoba and Pyronado. Xiangling dashes to pick up crystalize for AP.

bennett-chevreuse-razor-xiangling.desc: Razor Chevreuse Xiangling Bennett. ~17s Rot. Ignores Razor's burst cd. Pyro > ATK > Electro Goblet. Chevreuse Q3E in Bennett Q. XL burst every other rotation in Bennett Q. Razor Self-Aura not implemented.

ayaka-ganyu-kazuha-kokomi.desc: This config provides as much buffing as possible for Ayaka using this team. (Ayaka d) -> Kazuha EPQ -> Ganyu EQ -> Kokomi E -> Ayaka d E N1 Q N1 -> Kazuha EP -> Ganyu N1 E -> Ayaka d 2N2C E d N1C

chevreuse-dehya-raiden-sara.desc: C1 Dehya Sara Raiden Chevreuse. ~21s rot. Raiden performs a shorter combo of "N4 E N4D N3". Sara uses Skill + Aimed Shot to buff Dehya and Burst to buff Raiden. Dehya's Burst does not get buffed by Noblesse. Chevreuse uses a healing build. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. ATK% Sands on Raiden is ~500 more DPS at the expense of Dehya's personal damage. C0 Dehya loses ~5k DPS.

bennett-diluc-fischl-xingqiu.desc: diluc xingqiu fischl bennett, 2 full E usages from diluc

fischl-kokomi-lynette-nahida.desc: Lynette as an off field HB trigger. Electro Q triggers hyperblooms while Kokomi is on field. VV is slightly better than fopl. Lynette's limited off field electro app reduces the number of HBs, so Fischl & Kokomi also make up significant parts of team damage. Team relies on Lynette getting electro burst to function.

beidou-cyno-fischl-nahida.desc: Cyno Nahida Fischl Beidou. ~25s Rot. Cyno Triple Electro Aggravate, Nahida provides the only healing with Pamber, and Beidou the only RES Shred with C6. 10% Counter, 20% Perfect Counter.

bennett-kazuha-lyney-xinyan.desc: Kazuha uses only Q or E before Lyney comes on field. Otherwise doing an extra Lyney CA is worth more than a Kazuha E. Xinyan EQ > Bennett EQ > Kazuha Q or E > Lyney 2CA Qc CA E 3CA

dori-eula-furina-rosaria.desc: Eula Rosaria Furina Dori. ~21s Rot. Eula manages her ER needs with 3 Favs; Rosaria forces Fav procs and funnels partciles to Eula after Eula's burst; Dori increases her ER and restores some flat energy to Eula after her burst animaton. 84% Base Phys Shred.

bennett-chiori-yoimiya-zhongli.desc: 18s yoimiya rotation with chiori and zhongli. Alternate yoimiya Q or Chiori Q

aetherelectro-bennett-nahida-xingqiu.desc: EMC Nahida Xingqiu Bennett. ~22s Rotation. EMC Hyperburgeon with C6 Bennett. EMC does N4C. Nahida bursts (nearly) every rotation.

chevreuse-fischl-sethos-thoma.desc: Sethos Chevreuse Fischl Thoma. ~16s Rot. Sethos loses a lvl 1 aimed shot at  the start of the chamber. Sethos does 8N2W N1(last N1 is Phys). Chevreuse builds for damage. Fischl alternates skill/burst.

kokomi-nahida-thoma-xingqiu.desc: thoma burgeon with Kokomi xingqiu and nahida

bennett-chiori-ningguang-yaemiko.desc: on field ning apl with yae's off field damage. yae does not burst. benny uses fav so he can burst more often without spending time doing skills.

kirara-raiden-sara-sucrose.desc: "Kiraraiden" - Raiden e > Sucrose n1e/n2c  > Kirara q e n1 > Sara e aim n1 > Sucrose ed q n2 > Raiden q n4e 2n4d n4

bennett-fischl-lynette-yelan.desc: Lynette Yelan Fischl Bennett. ~20s Rot. On-field Lynette Soup in ST Target with C6 Bennett infusion contributing Overloads. Fischl snapshots Bennett's buff. Fischl alternates skill and burst.

bennett-faruzan-jean-xiao.desc: Xiao with Sunfire and C6 Faruzan, 50% Collision

dori-fischl-jean-nahida.desc: Dori Nahida Fischl Jean. ~28s Rotation. Dori Aggravate with Fav GS decreasing ER requirements. Full EM Jean swirls self Electro applied by Dori's lamp.

alhaitham-kuki-xingqiu.desc: Alhaitham Xingqiu Kuki hyperbloom trio, split Alhaitham uptime for more Xingqiu favonius procs

bennett-fischl-kazuha-yaemiko.desc: Kazuha Fischl Yae Bennett. ~16s Rot. (TF) Kazuha Overload in ST Kazuha stays on field until Bennett's Q fades. Fischl snapshots Bennett's buff. No burst Yae. 70% Collisions.

furina-kazuha-ororon-xianyun.desc: Kazuha Furina Ororon Xianyun. ~20s Rot. APL. (TF) Kazuha Taser in 2T. Xianyun plunges when Kazuha's Anemo plunges are not available. Note that in situations in which this team is ideal, Sac Sword and Vhunt offer additional value. Accomodates Kazuha constellations. 80% Collisions from Kazuha Skill, 50% From Starwicker plunges.

ayato-kokomi-nahida-xiangling.desc: Ayato Burgeon: Nahida  > Xiangling > Kokomi > Ayato 7s Q> Kokomi > Xiangling > Nahida > Ayato 7s

escoffier-furina-mika-razor.desc: Razor Furina Escoffier Mika. ~23s Rot. Phys Razor. Razor should start the rotation even if his burst isn't ready. Razor end his field time on a skill for Def shred over the setup. Mika and Escoffier burst in alternate rotations.

bennett-sucrose-xingqiu-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Xingqiu Sucrose Bennett. 21s rot. Sucrose N3 E dash N1 for double VV. use dash on bennett not to ruin the setup by xq's hydro orbital. Xingqiu's long cooldown allows Yoimiya to use her Burst and she can easily restore her energy with 4SR thanks to bennett.

furina-nahida-raiden-xianyun.desc: Xianyun Nahida Furina Raiden. 26s Rot. Xianyun stapled to Hyperbloom, she doesn't swirl much and builds ADC.

bennett-escoffier-raiden-xiangling.desc: Raiden Xiangling Bennett Escoffier. ~20s Rot. Raiden Overload with Escoffier. Escoffier uses her burst every rotation in Bennett burst. Don't think too hard about it.

bennett-rosaria-wriothesley-xiangling.desc: Wrio Rosaria Xiangling Bennett. 21s rot. 5[N3CJ] N3 (Q/C). Rosaria EQ > Bennett QE > Xiangling QE. Bennett batteries Xiangling twice.

bennett-xingqiu-yanfei-yelan.desc: Yanfei Xingqiu Yelan Bennett. ~21s Rot. A less dank Yanfei Double Hydro rotation. 1E Yelan. Yanfei does N1C, mostly. The opponent is out of XQ orbital range.

bennett-dehya-furina-skirk.desc: C1 Dehya Bennett Furina Skirk. ~20s rot. Skirk hE twice and Q once. Skirk deals more DPS than Dehya despite not Melting anything from her Q. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. GT on Furina + HP% Goblet is ~300 less DPS. C0 Dehya loses ~4.5k DPS.

collei-fischl-kokomi-sucrose.desc: Sucrose Hyperbloom with Fischl Kokomi and Collei

bennett-chiori-ningguang-xingqiu.desc: on field ning apl with xingqiu offering off field damage and some interrupt resist. benny uses fav so he can burst more often without spending time doing skills.

chiori-xilonen-yunjin-zhongli.desc: Xilonen Gorou Yunjin Zhongli. ~18s Rot. Xilonen mono Geo. Chiori and Zhongli's burst are used to fill time in for CDs in subsequent rotations.

faruzan-fischl-wanderer-zhongli.desc: Zhongli EHD > Faruzan N1Q > Fischl  EN1 (N1Q if elemental skill is on the CD) > Wanderer N1 Q N1 E N1C (Combo N2C + Dash when the A4 is activated. Repeat this while you have flying stamina) E N1C.

bennett-nahida-xingqiu-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya BurgeonVape - Nahida EQ(if up) > Xingqiu EQ > Bennett EQ > Yoimiya E 4x AA Q(if up) > Bennett E - 21s Rotation. Nahida should use Deepwood but ToTM performs marginally better in this single target sim.

bennett-candace-fischl-furina.desc: Bennett Furina Fischl Candace. 20s Rot. Bennett OverVape with Candace overding his C6 infusion. Fischl snapshots Bennett's burst. CW > MH.

chiori-fischl-rosaria-zhongli.desc: phys zl+chiori+fischl+rosa chiori bursts every other rot

bennett-fischl-navia-tighnari.desc: Navia Fischl Tighnari Bennett. Navia 3E 25s rot. Fav bow is used for Solo Geo navia and fischl's high ER needs. but luckily fischl still does good damage with bennett buff and/or aggravate.

bennett-chiori-lyney-ningguang.desc: on field ning apl with lyney. lyney uses burst & skill when ready and use 1 aim shot to weak spot before each. benny uses fav so he can burst more often without spending time doing skills.

furina-kaveh-raiden-xianyun.desc: Kaveh Furina Raiden Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Solo Dendro Kaveh Hyperbloom with No ICD plunges for additional Dendro application. Fav Kaveh skills off cooldown to meet ER needs.

escoffier-lanyan-shenhe-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Lan Yan Shenhe Escoffier. 20s rot. 5[N3CJ] N4 Q/C. If Escoffier is Q every 2 rot, add ~3k, check the config.

freminet-kirara-kuki-yelan.desc: Freminet Kirara Yelan Kuki. ~20s Rot. Freminet Hyperbloom with a shield. Adds 2 N1s between skill uses for Yelan burst procs.

bennett-ganyu-lynette-nahida.desc: ganyu burnmelt with lynette. 22s~ rotation. lynette swirls cryo for vv and absorbs pyro to sustain melts. nahida burst when ready.

albedo-chiori-gorou-xilonen.desc: Xilonen Albedo Gorou Chiori. ~15-17s Rot. Xilonen on-field DPS. All characters use bursts as available, with gorou sometimes using burst before Xilonen field time, given the desynced cooldowns. Reliant on high DEF and Gorou healing to maintain HoD passives. Husk and OC are similar, -1K DPS with Ezpital.

alhaitham-fischl-nahida-raiden.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Nahida FIschl and E bot Riaden

albedo-chiori-itto-zhongli.desc: Itto Monogeo with Albedo, Chiori, Zhongli. Husk on Albedo for resin efficiency is a negligible loss in damage. Includes an adjustable random chance for stone stele to break on cast (0 by default)

bennett-faruzan-kazuha-wanderer.desc: Faruzan EQ > Bennett EQ > Kazuha EQ > Wanderer Q (if Ava) N1EN1C N2D (if A4 ava) / N2C E > Bennett E. Triple Anemo with front load dmg

bennett-chasca-mona-xiangling.desc: Chasca Mona Xiangling Bennett. 21s rot. 4[C] + ( Q / C_4b ) depending on Q ready. Pyro and ATK Goblet is about equal. Mona uses E and NA spam to trigger Fav before Bennett Q.

bennett-citlali-diluc-escoffier.desc: Diluc Citlali Escoffier Bennett. ~20s Rot. Diluc Double Cryo Melt. Diluc does 2 sets of skills. Not heavily optimized.

bennett-rosaria-xianyun-yanfei.desc: Yanfei Rosaria Bennett Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Yanfei melts 6 plunges, waiting between Rosaria's cryo application.

chiori-faruzan-wanderer-zhongli.desc: ~19s Wanderer double geo with Chiori. Chiori burst when able. Wanderer uses N2C or N2D combos.

emilie-yoimiya-yunjin-zhongli.desc: Yoimiya Emilie YunJin Zhongli. 18-19s rot. 4NO instead of 4Husk on YJ is better. Yoimiya Q when available filling downtime.

ayaka-ganyu-layla-shenhe.desc: Ayaka Ganyu Layla Shenhe Mono Cryo

chevreuse-xiangling-yaemiko-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yae Xiangling Chevreuse. 21s rot. Yoi and Yae use their burst every other rot. you can't run 18s rot due to XL's 20s cd burst. yae NAs at the end of the rot to wait for the 20s cd

escoffier-eula-rosaria-shenhe.desc: Eula Shenhe Rosaria Escoffier. ~22s Rot. Phys Eula mono Cryo. Eula EQE N4D N2 hE N2. 59% Phys Res Shred, though Shenhe's RES shred expires just before Eula's Lightfall sword can drop. Shenhe uses hold E for energy reasons. Rosaria passes particles to Eula after Eula's burst. Escoffier bursts every rotation.

bennett-fischl-furina-xiao.desc: Xiao Furina Fischl Bennett. ~22s Rot. Xiao Taser with VV Xiao Bennett. 12 Plunges. Fischl alternates skill and burst in Bennett burst. 50% Collisions.

bennett-chiori-klee-zhongli.desc: Klee Mono with Double Geo Core: Klee, Chiori, Bennett, Zhongli. Klee bursts every other rotation and only uses her skill when available to shorten the rotation. 16-18s rotation.

nahida-raiden-xiangling-yelan.desc: Raiden "chaos" without defensive options with Nahida Yelan Xiangling. Deepwood XL and Gilded/Golden Troupe Nahida slightly better than EoSF XL and Deepwood Nahida. Options for Engulfing on Raiden and Dragon's Bane/FoPL in config.

baizhu-fischl-raiden-tighnari.desc: Raiden Tighnari Fischl Baizhu. ~20s Rot. Raiden Tighnari Quicken with Baizhu. Tighnari tries to use his skill & burst every rotation. Fischl uses burst every rotation and skill if available.

bennett-furina-yoimiya-zhongli.desc: Yoimiya Furina Zhongli Bennett. 20s rot. Due to furina's 20s CD, Yoimiya use burst every other rot, if not available use N3 before yoi E.

bennett-charlotte-xiangling-xianyun.desc: Charlotte Xiangling Bennett Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Charlotte Melt plunge with no Cryo VV. Charlotte uses hold skill. Without hold skill Charlotte can N1 cancel plunges at the start of the rotation without flipping the aura.

furina-kokomi-nahida-thoma.desc: Kokomi Furina Nahida Thoma. ~20s Rot. Kokomi Furina Burgeon.  Kokomi's skill heals over the setup period and is freshed with her burst. Kokomi stays on field until her burst expires before Nahida attemts to trigger fav. Burstless Nahida.

beidou-fischl-furina-heizou.desc: Heizou Furina Fischl Beidou. ~25s Rot. Heizou Taser in two target w/ EM P-Amber Heizou bursting twice per rotation to heal the team while Beidou's damage reduction aids survival. 20% Counter, 20% Perfect Counters.

diluc-furina-kokomi-nahida.desc: Diluc Nahida Furina Kokomi. ~20s Rot. Diluc Burgeon in 2 target. CW >= FoPL in ST. Nahida does not burst. Kokomi refeshes burst before Diluc does a second combo; Infusion Retained.
