fischl-furina-mika-rosaria.desc: Rosaria Furina Fischl Mika. ~22s Rotation. Physical Rosaria does N2CD stamina permitting, otherwise does NA spam.

albedo-chiori-furina-noelle.desc: Noelle triple geo with Furina. No Gorou but at least there is a construct for Chiori. Uses NAs, in practice full stamina CAs should be better.

bennett-gaming-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Gaming Xiangling Bennett Xilonen. ~20s Rot. Gaming Monopyro with 7 plunges. Bennett funnels Xiangling and Gaming. No burst Xilonen.

bennett-dehya-furina-ororon.desc: C1 Dehya Bennett Furina Ororon. 20s rot. Dehya triggers Vaporize and some Overloads. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. Bennett C6 is used for Scroll consistency. C0 Dehya loses ~5.5k DPS.

fischl-furina-mika-razor.desc: Razor Furina Fischl Mika. ~21s rotation. Razor's burst terminates early for (de)buff uptime. Razor SS > TSr5. Furina ToM > GT. Mika Clam > NO > SoDP.

beidou-chevreuse-cyno-xiangling.desc: 2T cyno-beidou team. ER sands required on everyone for standard energy drops.

fischl-layla-nahida-razor.desc: Razor Nahida Fischl Layla. ~22s Rotation. Razor Hybrid Aggravate. ATK > EM Sands. ATK & Electro Goblet are very similar. ToM and Deepwood Layla are the same.

bennett-ganyu-kazuha-nahida.desc: Burn Melt ganyu with Bennett Nahida and Kazuha

kazuha-kuki-nahida-raiden.desc: Raiden Aggravate with Kuki Nahida Kazuha

ayato-collei-kuki-nahida.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with Ayato Collei and Nahida

bennett-wriothesley-xilonen-yunjin.desc: Wrio Yun Jin Xilonen Bennett. 18s rot. Yun Jin can hold 4AP if you are willing to deal with it. Picking up shard is also related to Geo resonance.

bennett-dehya-emilie-xiangling.desc: C1 Dehya Bennett Xiangling Emilie. 20s rot. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. Emblem on Xiangling is ~400 less DPS. VG on Dehya is ~300 less DPS. Deepwood on Bennett is ~1.8k more DPS. C0 Dehya loses ~3.5k DPS.

aetherdendro-barbara-collei-nilou.desc: Nilou Bloom with the F2P guaranteed units (at C0, Traveler at C6). The more enemies within Barbara's melody loop the more her damage share increases compared to Nilou's. OHC is slightly better than FoPL on Barbara.

albedo-chiori-gorou-itto.desc: Itto Monogeo with Albedo, Chiori, Gorou. Chiori burst is used when available, otherwise Albedo burst while waiting for Ushi CD. Use against enemies with innate aura for Crystallize to maintain Geo resonance, Serpent Spine and Harbinger.

hutao-kaeya-layla-xingqiu.desc: Hu Tao Vape-Melt with Kaeya xingqiu Layla

furina-nahida-raiden-zhongli.desc: 4 Archon semi-AFK Hyperbloom using APL (very simple)

chiori-dori-gorou-itto.desc: Itto Gorou Dori Chiori. ~22. Ittodori Festival with Chiori bursting every rotation.

charlotte-furina-razor-xingqiu.desc: Razor Furina Xingqiu Charlotte. ~23s rotation. Razor stays on field until Xingqiu's burst expires; Superconduct covers the duration of Razor's field time. Xingqiu uses burst after Furina. Charlotte OHC > SODP > NO.

citlali-furina-kokomi-rosaria.desc: Kokomi Furina Rosaria Citlali. ~21s Rot. Kritkomi with MH, Sac Jade, Rosaria A4, & Cryo Resonance. Kokomi leads the rotation with skill and refreshes with burst. 2E Rosaria. Don't play this.

layla-navia-rosaria-yunjin.desc: Navia yunjin double cryo 18s rotation. Random chances of picking up shards while dashing.

ganyu-kazuha-mona-shenhe.desc: Ganyu Freeze with Kazuha Mona SHenhe

yaemiko-yelan-yoimiya-zhongli.desc: Yoimiya Overvape with Yae Zhongli Yelan

faruzan-wanderer-xiao-zhongli.desc: Wanderer and Xiao alternating rotations, buffed by Faruzan and Zhongli. Xiao has a 50% collision rate while Wanderer plays dynamically around his A4

chiori-furina-itto-noelle.desc: Itto Chiori Noelle with Furina. Noelle provides healing for stable fanfare through E Q N1 and shielding. Scales well with Furina constellations.

nahida-thoma-xingqiu-yaoyao.desc: Thoma burgeon, but not dying thanks to YaoYao

ayato-fischl-kuki-luminedendro.desc: Ayato Dendro Traveler Fischl Kuki. 25s rot. The team triggers even less Hyperblooms than the Collei variant due to Dendro Traveler's cooldowns not aligning with Ayato rotations.

ayaka-nahida-xiangling-xingqiu.desc: Ayaka Oven: Xingqiu E d Q N1, Nahida EQ N1, Xiangling Q N1 E d, Ayaka d N1 E d Q d 2N3CD N3C E d N1

fischl-freminet-yelan-zhongli.desc: Freminet Fischl Yelan Zhongli. ~20s Rot. Shielded Phys Freminet on-field. Yelan loses few dice procs. 1E Yelan. Configurable chance for Zhongli's pillar to break on cast.

bennett-nahida-raiden-yaemiko.desc: Raiden Yae Aggravate with Bennett Nahida

faruzan-fischl-lanyan-nahida.desc: Faruzan Fischl Nahida Lanyan. APL. (TF) Faruzan Aggravate in 2T with a VV Lanyan providing shields. Nahida does not burst past the opener.

bennett-lisa-nahida-raiden.desc: Raiden Aggravate with Lisa, Bennett Nahida

freminet-ororon-yelan-zhongli.desc: Freminet Ororon Yelan Zhongli. ~20s Rot. Shielded Phys Freminet on-field. Freminet's Cryo application does not majorly interfere with EC. 1E Yelan. Configurable chance for Zhongli's pillar to break on cast.

chongyun-escoffier-furina-razor.desc: Razor Furina Chongyun Escofier. ~24s Rot. Cryo Razor meme dream. Full EM Razor; SC > Shatter > Talent > EC damage. Aquamarine can technically be better, but Fav makes this less unpleasant to play.

dori-eula-furina-mika.desc: Eula Furina Mika Dori. ~22s Rot. Eula incorporates Mika's ATK Speed buff. Triple Fav; Mika forces Fav procs, funneled to Eula after Eula's burst; Dori increases her ER and restores some flat energy to Eula after her burst animaton.

nahida-xingqiu-yanfei-yelan.desc: Yanfei Burgeon with Nahida Yelan Xingqiu

cyno-fischl-luminedendro-zhongli.desc: Cyno DMC Fischl Zhongli. ~25s Rot. TF Cyno Aggravate with an AP ZL shield to focus on the combo.

bennett-furina-luminedendro-xiangling.desc: xl benny furina dmc. dmc provides mostly personal damage and energy via r5 fav. 20s rotation. benny uses 2 tap e and one c4 hold e. very low count of burgeons.

kazuha-keqing-kuki-nahida.desc: keqing aggravate with kuki. AoE focused team. nahida burst every other rotation. kuki burst guaranteed easy electro swirl.

kazuha-kuki-luminedendro-raiden.desc: Raiden e > Kazuha eP > DMC qe n2c > Kuki qe > Kazuha q eP > Raiden q n4e 2n4d n4

chevreuse-dehya-lisa-raiden.desc: C1 Dehya Lisa Raiden Chevreuse. 22s rot. Raiden performs a shorter combo of "N4 E N4D N3". Lisa funnels her Hold Skill to Dehya. Dehya has 75% Overloaded ownership, making EM stats better than ATK% stats. Chevreuse is on a healing build but could use an damage build. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. EM Sands on Dehya is ~700 more DPS. TTDS on Lisa ~1.5k less DPS in favor of ~1.5k more Dehya personal DPS. C0 Dehya loses ~5.5k DPS.

kuki-nahida-tartaglia-tighnari.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with Childe+Tighnari. Childe 3N2CD when off cd, Refresh Kuki E off cd.

raiden-sara-xilonen-yaemiko.desc: Raiden Yae Sara Xilonen. ~22s Rot. Raiden triple Electro with Xilonen. 1E Xilonen. Yae bursts mid rotation before redeploying her skills.

albedo-nahida-navia-raiden.desc: Aggravate Raiden and Navia dual carry with Albedo and Nahida

furina-kuki-mika-yelan.desc: Kuki Yelan Furina Mika. ~22s Rot. Phys Kuki on-field. No burst Kuki. 2E Yelan. OHC > SODP Mika.

bennett-kazuha-navia-zhongli.desc: Navia team with kazuha grouping. Dps kazuha is a valid usecase here

bennett-ganyu-layla-xiangling.desc: Ganyu Xiangling Melt with Layla and Benentt

freminet-furina-shenhe-xilonen.desc: Freminet Furina Shenhe Xilonen. ~21s Rot. Cryo Freminet. 2E Xilonen. Perfect weaves of N2 before E is tight timing.

ganyu-kazuha-kokomi-shenhe.desc: Ganyu Freeze with Kokomi Kazuha SHenhe

bennett-freminet-furina-xiangling.desc: Freminet Furina Xiangling Bennett. ~20s Rot. Physical Freminet; MH>=PF. Xiangling burst funnelled. C6 Bennett is slightly higher DPS.

bennett-ganyu-jean-zhongli.desc: Elegy sunfire meltyu. KQMS. It is very competitive with all 5 star bows. Ranked DPS in config, highest being Aqua with around 1k difference.

candace-furina-razor-xilonen.desc: Razor Furina Candace Xilonen. ~25s Rot. Hydro ATK Goblet Razor. Xilonen RES Shred lasts the duration of Razor's field Time. Xilonen scrolls Electro, then Hydro, with Electro expiring partway through Razor's Field time in the next rotation. Xilonen passes particles to Razor.

nahida-raiden-sayu-yaemiko.desc: Yae Raiden Aggravate with Nahida Sayu

citlali-furina-mizuki-ororon.desc: 2T Mizuki EC + SC team. Reaction can be pretty fragile as auras changes easily with 3 elements.

albedo-fischl-gorou-itto.desc: Itto Albedo Gorou with Fischl, modified Itto combo for Fischl synergy

bennett-fischl-freminet-yaemiko.desc: Freminet Yae Fischl Bennett. ~19s Rot. Physical Freminet double Electro with Bennett. Fischl alternates skill and burst in Bennett burst. All but the final Shattering Pressure are buffed. C6 Bennett is -4K DPS.

bennett-citlali-rosaria-xilonen.desc: Bouken Da Bouken doing some Melt with Goth Girl. ~18sec rotation. KQMS substats. Specific rotation, thanks to haafr for the help!

bennett-chevreuse-fischl.desc: Bennett Chevreuse Fischl Trio. ~18s Rot. Bennett on-field generates partcles for DPS build Chevreuse. Chevreuse Q3E every rotation in Bennett's Q. Fischl snapshots Bennett's buff.

fischl-furina-qiqi-yelan.desc: Qiqi Furina Yelan Dori. ~20s Rot. Phys Qiqi on field. 1E Yelan. OHC > PF.

chevreuse-dehya-furina-ororon.desc: C1 Dehya Chevreuse Furina Ororon. ~20s rot. Dehya triggers Vaporize and some Overloads. Chevreuse is on a damage build. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. GT on Furina is slightly more DPS but ~1k less Dehya DPS. Chevreuse on a healing build is ~1.2k less DPS in favor of ~600 more Dehya DPS. C0 Dehya loses ~6k DPS.

ganyu-kazuha-shenhe-zhongli.desc: Mono Cryo Ganyu with Kazuha Zhongli

dori-furina-sara-xianyun.desc: Dori Furina Sara Xianyun. ~21s Rot. Dori Taser Plunge. 3 Dori skill per rotation for ER reasons. Just 6 plunges are spent. Dori uses burst before Xianyun for reliable VV. 50% Collisons.

amber-hutao-kazuha-xingqiu.desc: VV Hu Tao with Kazuha Amber Xingqiu

chiori-keqing-nahida-zhongli.desc: keqing aggravate double geo. random frame delays. 17s~ rotation. nahida burst when ready. TF keqing slightly worse.

bennett-jean-wriothesley-xilonen.desc: Wrio Xilonen Jean Bennett. 21s rot. Cryo Scroll+Cryo Swirl every rot. Jean Q is used after Bennett Q. Jean and Bennett have really high ER req, 2 or 3 Fav weapons are recommended. Extending rotation to use more E for better ER leaded to DPS Loss.

bennett-freminet-furina-rosaria.desc: Freminet Furina Rosaria Bennett. ~21s Rot. Phys Freminet. CR Cap issue with MH. ToTM >= GT Furina. 2 Shattering Pressure hits miss Bennett's buff. Bennett C6 is -4K DPS.

bennett-faruzan-kazuha-lanyan.desc: Kazuha Emilie Faruzan Bennett. ~19s Rot. Triple Anemo Quickswap with Fav Bennett. 3 Kazuha skills off CD with Faruzan aimed shots & Lanyan E in between. 1E Bennett. Not heavily optimized.

hutao-kazuha-xingqiu-yanfei.desc: VV Hu Tao with Kazuha Xingqiu Yanfei

bennett-dehya-furina-yaemiko.desc: C1 Dehya Bennett Furina Yae. ~22s rot. Dehya triggers Vaporize and Overloaded. Dehya is the biggest portion of the team's DPS. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. EM and ATK% on Yae are similar. Scroll on Bennett is ~500 more DPS. C0 Dehya loses ~4.5k DPS.

fischl-heizou-xingqiu-yaemiko.desc: Heizou Xingqiu Yae Fischl. ~25s Rot. Heizou Taser in ST w/ P-Amber Heizou bursting twice per rotation to heal the team. EM >= ADC in ST. Burstless Yae.

itto-xilonen-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Itto Xilonen with Yelan Xingqiu. Xilo Q is not used. Itto ER reqs are high at 144%.

nahida-raiden-tighnari-zhongli.desc: Raiden Tighnari Nahida Zhongli. 19s rot. really simple and straightforward.

furina-mika-rosaria-yaemiko.desc: Rosaria Furina Yae Mika. ~21s Rotation. Physical Rosaria does N2CD stamina permitting, otherwise does NA spam. Rosaria uses skill 3 times. Full EM Evenstar Yae outperforms Purity/Widsith Yae.

fischl-furina-mika-yunjin.desc: Physchl with Yun Jin Furina Mika. Fischl cancels N2 with Physical aimed shot. Option to switch to N5D in config. Rust can outperform song if not aim canceling

amber-hutao-sucrose-xingqiu.desc: VV Hu Tao with Sucrose Xingqiu Amber

beidou-kokomi-kuki-nahida.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with Kokomi Nahida Beidou in 2T

fischl-navia-sara-zhongli.desc: Navia double electro with sara, if you dont have bennett free.

cyno-furina-kuki-luminedendro.desc: Cyno+Furina with 4 star supports -- unoptimised -- uses custom randomized execution delays for non-bufferable actions (usually 2-4f) and swaps (usually 9-15f)

bennett-furina-jean-xiao.desc: Xiao Furina Bennett Jean. ~23s Rot. Xiao does 12 plunges, 2 unbuffed. Furina gets a few vapes off of Jean Sunfire. 50% Collisions. C4 Jean is worth ~5K DPS.

barbara-bennett-jean-xianyun.desc: Barbara Jean Bennett Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Barbara Vape plunge with no Hydro VV. Barbara can N1 cancel plunges at the start of the rotation without flipping the aura. 8 vaped plunges.

fischl-heizou-xilonen-yelan.desc: Heizou Yelan Fischl Xilonen. ~18s Rot. Heizou Taser in ST. ADC in ST. 1E Yelan. Fischl alternates skill and burst. Xilonen burst every other rotation.

bennett-kazuha-wriothesley-xiangling.desc: Wrio Xiangling Kazuha Bennett. 23s rot. N3C spam. Q every 2 rots. Wrio leaves Cryo, use Guoba and Kazuha hE to Double Swirl. Kazuha doesn't use his Q.

chiori-furina-sigewinne-zhongli.desc: Sac bow sigewinne driving furina and chiori. APL sim to ensure maximize chiori & furina uptime.

bennett-emilie-kazuha-wriothesley.desc: Wrio Emilie Kazuha Bennett. 22-23s rot. Kazuha Q every rot on Bennett Q, providing off-field pyro app. Kazuha swirls cryo every rot. Wrio & Emilie Q when available.

ayaka-ganyu-kazuha-zhongli.desc: Ayaka Ganyu Mono Cryo with Kazuha Zhongli

faruzan-furina-jean-xianyun.desc: Xianyun Furina Faruzan Jean. ~21s Rot. Xianyun Plunge with 3x Anemo. Jean passes particles to Xianyun. 50% Collisions. C4 Jean is worth ~6K DPS.

bennett-kirara-neuvillette-xiangling.desc: Neuv Xiangling Bennett Kirara. 4CA 29s rot. Vaping Neuv CAs with Kirara's shield. probably sapwood blade can be used but I didn't.

kirara-nahida-raiden-tighnari.desc: Raiden Tighnari Nahida Kirara. 20s rot. kirara's shield for tighnari. nahida can hold 4GT thanks to kirara holding 4Deepwood

chevreuse-fischl-lisa-mavuika.desc: Lisa Chevreuse Fischl Mavuika. ~20s Rot. Lisa on-field N2C spam with Overload. EM and talent damage Mavuika are similar.

ayato-fischl-kazuha-kokomi.desc: Ayato Q, Fischl N1 E, Kazuha Ep, Kokomi Ed, Ayato E 7s, Kokomi Q N1, Fischl N2 Q, Kazuha EpQ, Ayato N1 E 7s

bennett-ganyu-nahida-thoma.desc: ganyu rev melt with thoma as flex, kqm 20s rotation

fischl-jean-nahida-razor.desc: Razor Nahida Fischl Jean. ~25 Rot. Razor Aggravate, with EM Jean Swirling Razor's Electro self-application. Razor Self-Aura not implemented.

fischl-kazuha-kokomi-luminedendro.desc: Kazuha Hyperbllom with Fischl Kokomi DMC

kazuha-kuki-nahida-sara.desc: KQMS stats, no random delays, particle generation based on hp threshold. On-field Sara aggravate team, Kuki variant. Keeps up with or surpasses the Fischl variant in AoE. 23 sec rotation

ayato-charlotte-citlali-furina.desc: Ayato Furina Citlali Charlotte. 27s rot. 2 Ayato skills per rotation. Both Citlali and Charlotte are on TTDS to ensure its uptime on both of Ayato's skills. 1st rotation is weaker (41.5k DPS) setting up for the following rotations (48k DPS).

chevreuse-dehya-raiden-xiangling.desc: Raiden Xiangling Dehya Chevreuse. 20s rot. bursting dehya with dps build.

aetheranemo-faruzan-furina-kokomi.desc: AMC Faruzan w/ Kokomi to provide heals and buff AMC w/ TTDS. Double hydro also helps Furina. Assumes Tornado hits full duration.

bennett-klee-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Classic Klee mono 5-6N1C with Petra ZL.

chongyun-furina-kaeya-xilonen.desc: Kaeya Furina Chongyun Xilonen. ~22s Rot. Cryo Infused Freeze Kaeya. Reliable Cryo Scroll, incidental Hydro Scroll buff. 2E Xilonen. Freeze immunity is -5K DPS.

citlali-freminet-furina-xilonen.desc: Freminet Furina Citlali Xilonen. ~24s Rot. Cryo Freminet Espam with tight N2 weaves in-between. 2E Xilonen uses AP. The rotation doesn't allow TTDS onto Freminet.

kazuha-lisa-raiden-yaoyao.desc: "Yaoden" w/ Lisa - Raiden e > Kazuha eP > YaoYao q n1e > Lisa n1q > Kazuha q eP > Raiden q n4e 2n4d n4 > Lisa n1 hE

hutao-sucrose-thoma-xingqiu.desc: VV Hu Tao with Xingqiu Thoma Sucrose

bennett-eula-lumineelectro-rosaria.desc: Lumine (Electro) E > Eula N2 E > Bennett E Q > Rosaria E Q > Eula Q W N3 HE W N4 > Lumine (Electro) E > Eula N2 > Rosaria E > Bennett E

bennett-candace-xiangling-xingqiu.desc: Bennett Xiangling Xingqiu Candace. ~21s Rot. A less dank Candace National rotation with Bennett funneling Xiangling's burst, then on-field for the rest of the rotation.

ayaka-diona-ganyu-kazuha.desc: Ayaka Ganyu Mono Cryo with Diona and Kazuha

charlotte-furina-kazuha-shenhe.desc: Charlotte Furina Shenhe Kazuha. 21s Rot. DPS Charlotte. Charlotte uses Hold E. 2E Shenhe. Hydro swirls are inconsistent. A more optimized rotation is probably possible.

jean-nahida-raiden-yaemiko.desc: Yae Raiden Aggravate with Nahida Jean

candace-yelan-yoimiya-zhongli.desc: Yoimiya Double Hydro with Zhongli Candance Yelan

Lots of self damage between Burning and Burgeon combined with limited Bennett uptime for Alhaitham makes this team risky. ~21s rotation; fav Alhaitham is important for team's and his own energy. Optimized sim with many build options in config. KurtC, customized random delays, 12-3 Icewind Suite energy drops.

bennett-fischl-xingqiu-yanfei.desc: Yanfei Xingqiu Fischl Bennett. ~24s Rot. Eevesaur#6368 - Thundering Fury Yanfei. Yanfei bursts every rotation. Fischl uses skill & burst every rotation.

fischl-kazuha-nahida-sayu.desc: Aggravate Sayu while shes rolling, with Nahida Kazuha Fischl

bennett-wanderer-yelan-zhongli.desc: Zhongli, Yelan, Bennett, Wanderer (updated attacks for A4)

aetherelectro-bennett-eula-yelan.desc: Yelan N3 E Q N1 > Bennett E Q > Aether (Electro) E N1 > Eula E Q W N4 HE N4 D > Aether (Electro) E N1 > Eula N2 > Bennett E

amber-furina-kokomi-xiangling.desc: Amber c6 Furina Xiangling Kokomi happy idea that did not turn out to be good but has some informative value. Rotation is filled with Kokomi normals during her burst to vaporize Xiangling. Amber ended up being mainly a support to Xiangling.

fischl-layla-neuvillette-yaemiko.desc: Neuv Fischl Yae Layla. 4CA 28-29s rot. Yae Burst every other rot.

bennett-fischl-kazuha-xianyun.desc: Kazuha Fischl Bennett Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Kazuha TF Pyro Plunge with grouping. Kazuha does not use burst and skills off cd. 100% collisions for E plunges, 50% for starwicker plunges.

bennett-dehya-furina-sigewinne.desc: C1 Dehya Bennett Furina Sigewinne. 20s rot. Sigewinne only uses her Skill. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. Scroll on Bennett is ~1k more DPS. C0 Dehya loses ~6k DPS.

bennett-thoma-wriothesley-xiangling.desc: ATK and EM sand is interrchangeable. Using HP% goblet on Thoma only decreases the dps by around 300, so might be worth it.

hutao-xingqiu-yoimiya-zhongli.desc: Hu Tao Yoimiya Vape with Xingqiu Zhongli

bennett-diluc-sucrose-xingqiu.desc: Classic Diluc vape with Sucrose. This particular double VV setup relies on Orbital positioning; read config for more info.

fischl-kazuha-keqing-xingqiu.desc: Keqing EC with Kazuha Xingqiu Fischl

albedo-gorou-itto-yelan.desc: Itto Albedo Gorou with Yelan, modified Itto combo for Yelan synergy

ayaka-bennett-citlali-dehya.desc: C1 Dehya Bennett Ayaka Citlali. 22s rot. Ayaka uses her Skill twice. Dehya waits a few frames towards the end of her combo to make sure she melts her Kick more often. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. C0 Dehya loses ~6k DPS.

fischl-mika-nahida-razor.desc: Razor Nahida Fischl Mika. ~22s Rotation. Razor Hybrid Aggravate. ATK & Electro Goblet are very similar. Nahida's burst is DPS neutral.

chongyun-furina-rosaria-xilonen.desc: Rosaria Furina Chongyun Xilonen. ~22s Rot. Cryo Infused Rosaria. Reliable Cryo Scroll, incidental Hydro Scroll buff. 2E Xilonen. Freeze immunity is -3K DPS.

kuki-nahida-wanderer-xingqiu.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with Wanderer Driver and Nahida Xingqiu

chevreuse-thoma-yaemiko-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Yae Chevreuse Thoma. avg 19s rot. Yoi and Yae use their burst every other rot.

kazuha-neuvillette-tartaglia-zhongli.desc: Neuv with 0 fieldtime tartaglia support. 4CA rotation, use EN3 at start just so you won't get stalled while neuvi is onfield and turn off sac jade passive

albedo-furina-mizuki-ororon.desc: 2T EC mizuki with albedo. albedo burst when available to give em buff to mizuki. Mizuki fills rotation length with N1C if necessary.

kuki-luminedendro-raiden-sucrose.desc: Raiden e > Sucrose n1ed n2c > DMC q e n2c > Kuki qe > Sucrose n1ed q n2 > Raiden q n4e 2n4d n4

bennett-citlali-dehya-furina.desc: C1 Dehya Bennett Furina Citlali. ~21s rot. Dehya does not Melt nor Vaporize most of her Burst. Citlali uses Fav and Bennett does an additional Skill. 4pc Emblem is similar DPS to 4pc MH. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. Against an enemy that can't be Frozen, the team loses ~1k DPS.
